sanskrit: rīśīlavṛttaphalaṃ śrutaṃkaccidvaḥ sa phalaṃtapūṃtapaścāṃdrāpaṇādikaṃyathāmati pravakṣyāmi vadaṃ tu munipuṃgavāḥkṛtāṃjali purā ūrcurnattvā sāṣṭāṃagamādarātkathaṃ brahmavijijñāsyaṃ kīdṛśairniyata vrataiḥkālasvarūpaṃ dādibhirdvijaiḥ vibhāṃḍakasutaḥ prāhanāmṛṣīnśaṃsitavratānśrotavyaṃ yogināṃ śreṣṭheḥ sāvadhānaiḥ samāhitaiḥnimeṣakāla ityuktaḥ kāṣṭhātetriṃśadīditāḥgaḍīrūpaṃ muhūrtaḥ syādyāmasteṣāṃ catuṣṭayaṃṣaṣṭināḍyo dinaṃ prokta mahorātraṃ tadevahipakṣe pakṣe paurṇamāsī puṇyātithiramāpi vāmāsairdvādaśabhirviprāḥ saṃvatsara iti smṛtaḥcatvāryāhuḥ sahasrāṇi vatsarāṇāṃ kṛtaṃ yuge** (?) varṣa sahasrāṇi tretāyugamiti smṛtaṃsahasradvayamandānāṃ dvāparaṃ yugamīritaṃtasya tāvacchatī saṃ***(?) mānena gaṇyateitthaṃ dvādaśasāhasrama**(?)devayugaṃ smṛtaṃcaturyugānāṃ sāhasraṃ brahmaṇo hatadīritaṃcaturyugānāṃ sāhasraṃ dvayaṃ brāhmaṃ dinaṃ smṛtaṃcaturvaktasya tasyāmasargakṛtparameṣṭinaḥbrahmaṇaḥ paramāyuḥ syāddivasaṃ viṣṇurudravoḥnaivāhastasya na niśā nityasya paramātmanaḥkālaḥ saṃharate viśvaṃ kālādhītamidaṃ jagatlayaṃgatā asaṃkhyātā rudrā api tapodhanāḥnarāṇāmapi tiryaścākā kathāpipra puṃgavāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhakṣayaṃtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sṛjaṃtamakhilaṃ jagatbrahmatatvamavijñāya prajayā karmaṇāpi vāaśrutvācārya śuśrūṣāmavijñāya cidātmakaṃkālasyāpi pitāsākṣādbrahmarūpī śriyaḥ patiḥparasya brahmatatvaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmanaḥācaryasya kṛpā mūrteḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmanaḥtasnānairna tapobhirvā na bhasmasnānatopi vāgaṃgādi sarvatīrteṣu matsyāśca makarādayaḥvakāmaunena tiṣṭhaṃti mīnā udakapāyinaḥrāsabhātryādhicaścāno bhasmāhaṣitavigrahāḥsaṃcaraṃto mṛgānityamahiṃsādharma tatparāḥtasmādācārya śuśrūṣāṃ kṛtvā nityaṃ ciraṃ dvijāḥbhītyāvānāṃ vāti hasaṃ tataṃtadājñaṣaivakālopi viśvaṃ sṛjati haṃti cavijñāya vaṃcayitvā saukālaṃ sarvabhayāsūrāṃsaiṣānaṃdasya mīmāṃsā vakṣyate vipra puṃgavāḥarogī pakvabhugnityaṃ sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥsārvabhaumatvamāsādyamānuṣānaṃdamaśnuteekomat**(?) gaṃdharvānaṃdamuktaḥ śrutau smṛtauśataṃ manuṣyagaṃdharvānaṃdānāṃsataṃ dvijaptatadānaṃdaśataṃ divyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ munipuṃgavāḥānaṃdānāṃśataṃ prokta **(?) ājānajāmareānaṃda ekaḥ saṃproktastato mukhyasureṣvapitadānaṃdaśataṃ śakrasyaika ānaṃda ucyategurvānaṃda*****(?)vasyānaṃda ucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hiraṇyagarbhānaṃdānāṃ śataṃ viṣṇoḥ śivasya catadānaṃdaśataṃ sākṣānnityasya paramātmanaḥnārāyaṇasya nityasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥācāryapādaśuśrūṣā niratasya yatātmanaḥjīvanmuktasya tasyāpi brahmānaṃda udāhṛtaḥkoṭijanma tapobhirvā mahādānāyutairapitasmādbrahmavijijñāsā kāryācārya mukhāṃvujāniti kāla japopāyaḥ kathito brahmavittamāḥiti dāśarathīye smin sarvavedārthasaṃgrahebrahmatatvaṃ kathaṃ jñeyaṃ śrotavyaṃ kathamādarātsarvametatsamāsenavadāsmākaṃdayānidheśāśvataṃ śuddhamavyaktaṃ sadānaṃdamayaṃ hi tatcidānaṃdamayaṃ nityaṃ manovācāmagocaraṃna strī na ṣaṃṭho na yumānnadvāmaparamaṃ mahathṛdguhāsusthitaṃ sarvaprāṇināṃcitapaṃkajemanubhāti sarvaṃ tasya bhāsāmidaṃ vibhātisargāsthiti vināśānāṃ hetu bhūtasanātanaṃtasmānnādātmakaḥ sākṣādakārātmāsanātanaḥviṃdussamabhavatasmājjīvātmāṃ tassanātanaḥtayormadhye samudabhūtkalā cidrūpiṇī parātata āvirabhūt sākṣātpaṃcāśadvarṇamātṛkāsākṣānnārāyaṇamayī brahmābhinnā cidātmakāathāṃtasthā athoṣmāṇa ityevaṃ mātṛkāsmṛtāaca ityevamākhyātāḥ kādamohala īritāḥkādayohala ityuktā vyaṃjanāni vidurbudhāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmādi yamakārādi kṣakārāṃtākṣarātmikāmātṛkā paramāśaktirabhinnā brahmaṇo dvijāḥca anayai samudbhūtā vedāḥ sāṃ*(?)sanātanāḥcatuṣṣaṣṭi kalāvidyā vidhā aṣṭādaśāpi caparāsisṛkṣā bhagavadbrahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥasṛjatadbrahmarūpī puru****(?)dvijāḥarddhena nārī tasyāṃ tu virājamasṛjadvibhuḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarātmāsāveka eva parocyutaḥsa evādyaḥ pumānnityaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥaṣṭākṣara **(?) vedavedāṃtairapyagocaraḥparāsya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā casā nārīśrīrmahālakṣmīḥ khyātāparakalāmayīstrīpuṃrūpamidaṃ tasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥcidrūpiṇīṃ śriyaṃ guptāṃ vibhrannārāyaṇo vibhuḥśrūyate vedavedāṃtairapi vigrahadhāribhiḥsargakāle yadā vibhrat strīpuṃrūpamakalmaṣaṃtadvādaśārṇamaṃtreṇavācyaṃ brahmaparātparaṃvirājaṃ puruṣaṃ sargādikālesṛjadīśvaraḥpuruṣaṇavirāduktaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇaṃyamāha sarvajagatāṃ kāraṇaṃ parameśvaraṃtasya vaktrādāvirabhūtpraṇavaḥ śāśvatovyayaḥbhūriti vyāhṛtiḥ paścādbhuṣaḥ suvariti dvayaṃetadeva mahadviśvaṃ vairājaṃ rūpamuttamaṃsavitāviśvarūpo sau virāṭpuruṣa īśvaraḥayameva jagatsarvaṃ sṛjyatyavatihaṃti ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ayaṃ savitṛrūpiṇyagyāyatryākālarūpayākālātmako vedamayo yenedamakhilaṃ jagatamāduha tato vedānbhūrādivyāhṛti trayaṃutpannāḥ sarvalokānāmihāmutragatipradāḥnārāyaṇamayonityomahāpuruṣa īśvaraḥaya eva sargādautāsuvīryamavāsṛjattasminjajñe vidhirbrahmāsvayaṃ bhūritiḥ śrutiḥayanaṃ tasyatāḥ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥaṃdhakā****(?) saṃtatāya sumahattayaḥnārāyaṇotha brāhmāṇaṃ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṃgalaḥlajjayāvanataṃ sargakarmāśaktaṃ svayaṃ bhuvaṃśrutyuktena vidhānena sargaṃ kurvititi ***(?)bhagavatejasaḥ prāptyai bhūyopi sumahattayaḥmahāpuruṣo bhūtvā vidhūyāṃ dhanamokhilaṃśrībhagavānuvāca bho bho vra**(?)pitāṃhaṃ yoyakastavaahameva paraṃbrahma paramātmā sanātanaḥvāsudevosmyahaṃ viṣṇurvirādrūpī hiraṇmayaḥcinmayohamanaṃtohamādi madhyāṃtavarjitaḥvedāṃtavedyoviśvātmā viśvarūpohmyahaṃ vibhuḥyosāvaṣṭākṣaro maṃtraḥ svabhāva praṇavādikaḥnārāyaṇastadātmāhaṃ cidrūpiṇyāśrimānnitaḥasyaivāṣṭārṇamaṃtrasyaśrīmatvaṃ trijagatsvapiśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīvidhā tasmāt vyātā jagattrayevedeṣu sārabhutayaṃ śrīmaddaṣṭākṣarī mamaiti madvadanodbhūta śrutibhissamudīritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇetimannāma paraṃbrahma śriyānvitaḥanyāstu sakalāvidhāḥ prakṣipraśrī samanvitāḥparatejomayīṃ saṃvinmahāsāmrājyanāyikāṃdadāmyetāṃ mahāvidyāṃmatejaḥ prāptaye tava** chaṃdaḥ syāgāyatraṃ nānyaduktaṃ jāyatemadaṣṭārṇamayī jñeyā mama tejaḥ kalānvitāmadardhatejasāyuktānārīlakṣmīritīritādvādaśārṇamahāvidhārūpo brahmamayomyahaṃahaṃ jaganmayatvenacchaṃdasāṃ jāgataṃ varaṃbrahmavidyeti vikhyātā pradānādittastavaimāmapi mahāvidyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇabhidhāṃyosau virāṅmayaḥ sākṣāt puruṣohaṃ purātanaḥsa eva vedapuruṣo vedanārāyaṇomyahaṃsahāyaṃte kariṣyaṃti sargakārye prajāpatetadvācyaḥ savitā brahman devo nārāyaṇosmyahaṃjanmamṛtyujarāvyādhi saṃsārabhayanāśanaḥmātṛkāyā samākhyātā sāmadrūpaiva vāvayatelakṣmīrūpaṃ ca madrūpaṃ tatatsāraṃ na saṃśayaḥbrahmavidyopāsakomevirāṭpuruṣarūpadhṛkmamatāmupāsmanaraḥ sākṣān mamasāyujya mahyutemadātmakaṃ **(?) maṃtrayītatasmātmadātmikāgāyatrīṃ samupāsyātha hutvāṃmāṃjātavedasiyāvaccha samupāsyātha śrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ yataupāsyamatkālāmuko bhūtvā sṛsṭikarobhavatvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvakāle kāle harāmyahaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇosmyahaṃ tena sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥgrahāṇatvatsahāyena sṛjatya vahaṃti caetadācārya vadanādvijñāyā ***(?)rthanaḥahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ śaucamiṃdriyanigrahaḥmama tādā**(?) siddhiṃ pratyete saptahetavaḥaṃtarddhānaṃ jagāmāśu nityamuktairamiṣṭutaḥsṛṣṭvādau sanakādibhyo vaśiṣṭāddibhya uktavānbrahmabhūtāstaponiṣṭhā adyāpi sukhi***(?)aciṃtyaśaktitā sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥśraddhayācārya vākyeṣu sarvasiddhistapodhanāḥkālasya vaṃcanopāyakāraṇaṃ nānyadīṣyatejñātvācāryamukhāṃbhojāt saṃsevyācāryamanvahaṃparasya brahmaṇastatvasvarūpaṃ kiṃcidīritaṃsuguptamapita tatvaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥācāryaḥ kīdṛśo lokeśiṣyo vāpi kathaṃ munetatpāda padmabhaktānāsmākaṃ tadvadāśubhoācāryacaraṇāṃbhojaśuṣaṇavidhiparaṃsatataṃ vaidikācāranirataḥ śāstrapāragaḥśāṃtodāṃtojitāmitrojiteṃdriyaḥ vedādhyayanakṛnnityaṃ vedārthasya vicārakṛtaharniśaṃ śruterjāmī śrautācāraratasyadāśivaviṣṇorabhedena nityopāhitarato dvijāḥsahasrakṛtto gāyatrī japakartā dine dinedadāmyetāṃ mahāvidyāṃmatejaḥ prāptaye tavachaṃdaḥsyādasya gāyatraṃ nānyaduktaṃ prajāpatemaddaṣṭārṇamayī jñeyā mamattejaḥ kalānvitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madardhatejasāyukānārīlakṣmīritīritādvādaśārṇa mahāvidyārūpo brahmabhayosmyahaṃahaṃ jaganmayatvena chaṃdasāṃ jāgataṃ varaṃbrahmavidyeti vikhyātā pradānādādittastavaimāmapi mahāvidyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidhāṃyosau virāṅmayaḥ sākṣātpuruṣohaṃ purātanaḥsa eva vedapuruṣo vedanārāyaṇohmyahaṃ *(?)jño gururukto mahānayaṃtatsānnidhyenavidhānāṃ kartavyaṃ grahaṇaṃbhuvinyāsānāma parijñātā pūjāyaṃtrādikasya casarvāgamarahasyārthapāragaṃ śrūti tatparaṃa****(?)to nityaṃ daṃbhalobhādi saṃyutaḥtamoguṇapradhānaśca paranārīratassadājihmaḥ kaṭhinavittau sau satataṃ krodha tatparaḥvadavāhyodurālāpī***(?) grahakārakaḥvedādhyayana kṛnnityaṃ daṃbhalobha vivarjitaḥsatataṃ vaidikācāra tatparaḥ śrutipāragaḥpiturmātuśca śuśrū*****(?) vivarjitaḥanvahaṃ gurupādābja śuśrūṣurvītamatsaraḥsakṛdvā guruniṃdāyāṃ samāsaktamanāyadiākruṣṭastāḍito vāpikaśābhiḥ pādatāḍanaiḥavaśyaṃ tasya dātavyā vidyāsvargāpavargadācatvāro guravaḥ proktāḥ pūjyāḥ pratyahamādarātsevyamanvahaṃ bhaktyāpāda śuśrūṣaṇādibhiḥakṣapādakṛtaṃ śāstraṃ mīmāṃsā dvitayaṃ tathāśāstraṣaṭkamiti proktamapavargādikāraṇaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: upādhyāya iti proktaḥ pūjyo guruvadanvahaṃsāṃganyāsādi sahitāṃ yaṃtrapūjādisaṃyutāṃācāraṃ śikṣayennityaṃ rahasyamapi vodhayansākṣānnārāyaṇātmāsau vijñeyaḥ puruṣo namaḥyaṃtraṃnyāsavidhiṃ vāpi tadrahasya mathāpi vāvidyāllokavacakaṃgṛhītvā prajapedvidhāṃ sa jñeyo naragarddamaḥvidmāmāśramadhītyānyaṃ sarahasyajñamuttamaṃvahuyojana sāhasradūraṃ gatvāpi vā dvijāḥekena janmanā sākṣādbrahmānaṃdābhidhaṃ sukhaṃācāryamāśrayennityaṃ prāṇairarthairdhipāpi cabhagavadraśmi vidyābhissahitāṃ sarahasyakāṃācāryarūpiṇaṃ vidyātasevaśrīpatiṃ vibhuṃācāryamagrato vastrālaṃkārādyairghanairapibrahmaviṣṇumaheśādipurogyācāryamagnataḥsarvasvamapi datvā vā prāṇānapi kalevaraṃathekākṣaradātāraṃ guruṃdhikṛtyavāsakṛtśvānajanmasamāsādhacaṃḍāleṣvabhijāyateācāryonāva saṃtavyaḥ prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhagataiḥrapimahāpātakinaṃ viṃdyātameva varakālayaṃnahi dhanyattarastasmādadhikovidyate bhuviśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarī vidyā **(?) vidyā tathaiva catṛtīyaṃ raśmimālākhya sūktamatyaṃtapāvanaṃlabhyate yadi dhanyosau brahmānaṃdayuto bhavetkurvaṃti bhagavadbudhyāprāsādāṃvarabhūṣaṇaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlaṃ sakaladharmāṇāṃ hetuṃ svargāpavargayoḥnārcayaṃti vimūḍhāste pratimāsu yathā tathāācārya eva bhagavānsākṣānnārāyaṇo vibhuḥnarākṛtirasausākṣādbhagavāniṃdirāpatiḥsaṃsārasāgaraṃ tīrthāyāti brahmapadaṃ mahatmahādānāyutairvāip vājimedhāyutairapidhikṛtyavāpi huṃ kṛtyaniṃdāṃ kṛtvāpi vāsakṛtmajjaṃti narakaudyeṣutyatkādehamataḥ paraṃśrutvāpātakamāsādyanimajjaṃtyapi rauraveācārya evastottavyorājavidvatsabhāsu caārcā evayoṣmo hi dhanavāsonnabhūṣaṇaiḥācāryasadguṇā eva śrotavyāḥ pratyahaṃ budhaiḥācāryāyaiva dātavyamapi sarvasvamādarātitthamācārya śuśrūṣāṃ kurvannapyekavatsaraṃitthamācārya śuśrūṣāṃ kṛtvā varṣatrayaṃ bhuvikurvannācārya suśrūṣāyāṃvajjīvamataṃdritaḥitthāmācārya śuśrūdhā kuryan pratyahamādarātbrahmavidyānusaṃdhātāraśmimālānuciṃtakaḥkalevarāṃte sāyujyaṃ māpnotyeva śriyaḥ yateḥvidhyarthavādamaṃtrātmarūpiṇī sarvasiddhidādharmaśāstrāṇi divyāni kṛtavaṃtastapodhanāḥkṛtaṣaṃtodarśanāni ṣaḍete paramarṣayaḥupanīyatuyaḥ śiṣyaṃ vedamadhyāyayedvijaḥdvitīyo brahmāpidyāyāḥ pradātācārpaṭhacyatenyāsayaṃtrarahasyādisahitāmidirāpateḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daṣṭāṃkāmayāto sonāmrāmāhiṣikah smṛtaḥatevārdhuṣikaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāśāḥpirāmāḥ pītarogatāḥtāvadaśraṃtitaroyāvabhīktohavirguṇaḥkrīḍatyoṣadhayaḥ sarvāyāsyāmaḥ paramāṃgatiṃrodityannadīpamānaṃ kiṃ mayāduṣṭataṃkṛtaṃsatārayati dātāraṃ daśapūrvāndṛśāparānnavarātrauvaserjāṣṭena kuryādvaidikāṃ śrutiṃsuvāsinīnāmevaṃ syānnāthaścāmuṃḍanaṃ bhavetkeśānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāyaṣvādviguṇadakṣiṇāṃyo gṛhītvā vivāsinī nāmevaṃ syānnānyathā muṃḍanaṃ bhavetkeśānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya dadyādviguṇadakṣiṇāṃannatasya na bhoktavyaṃ kṛthāyākohi saṃsmṛtaḥparivetā sa vijñeyaḥṣarivitī ca pūryataḥpīṭhedeśāṃtarasthe ca sūke pravratitaṃ jaḍevedākṣarāṇi yāvaṃti niyuṃjyādarthakāraṇātyasvasuvrātito bhūtvāsevagtemaithunapunaḥśūrasaṃsaṃparkaṃ śūdreṇa sahāsanaṃśūdrādāhṛtyanirvāyaṃye yatyavudhādvijāḥhastadatātilavaṇavyaṃ janādīni saṃtataṃāsase naiva pātreṇayadannamupadīyateaṃgulyādatakāvyaṃ pralakṣalavaṇaṃ ca yatagratonivasensūkhohṛraiścaguṇānvitaḥbrāhmaṇāti kramonāsti vipre vedavivarjitasānnikṛṣṭamadhīyātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yo vyatikrāmetagorakṣakān vāṇitakātstathā kāmakuśīlakān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmakuśīlakāndevadravyanibhāgena brahmasvaharaṇena caācāryacaraṇāṃbhojepuraścaraṇākarmaṇimāsāsyaṃtaratovaśyamathavā dakṣiṇāśubhāmāsādvayāttribhirmāsairdāḥ tavyāvṛddhisaṃyutāḥmāsaṣasūmatikramyasvarṇeyīpatatyadhaḥmāsenanenerusadṛśaghṛṇaṃdasudhāyatesadya eva pradātavyaṃ puraścaraṇakarmasusadyovitaraṇaṃ kāryamācāryārthe mahīyatebhikṣānnamapivācāryakule bhikṣe tatraiva hisadharāvapradātavyāmāsatritayatoṣi vāvidyasāśī bhavennityaṃ cāgratabhojanaḥhastau prakṣālyagahvaṣayaḥ pivedbhojanottaraiḥ****** gaṇā aṃgaṇikānnaṃ cayākepakṣe vā yadi māse vā yasyageheti na dvijaḥsatriṇāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ ca yatīnāṃ brahmadhāṇāṃajīrṇotyuditavāṃte śmaśrukarmaṇi maithunecaisuvṛkṣedhiṃtiṃpūyaṃ śivanimolyabhojanaṃagryāgrāragavāṃgoṣṭhedeva brāhmaṇasannidhīkhalakṣetragataṃ dhānyaṃ kūpavāriṣu tajjalaṃyadveṣṭitaśirābhuṃkte ghāndaṅge dakṣiṇāmukhaḥdharmaśāstrarathāruṣavedakhaḍgadharādvijāgaṃdhābharaṇayātyāniyaḥ prāyacchati saṃtataṃamṛtaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ syābhaṃkṣatriyānnaṃ yayaḥ smṛtaḥvaiśvadevena homena devatābhyarcanairjayaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyavahārānurūpeṇanyāyena yaddayājjanaṃpravāhānaddha vāyamatramutvādhamicchatiajñānatimirādhasyamadyapānaratasyatranavṛthāṃśayathaṃ kuryāt svalyepyarthenarovudhaḥkāminīṣu vivāheṣu gavāṃ bhaktaṃ janakṣayenayamaṃ yamaṣṇāharātmāvaiyama ucyateekaḥ kṣamāvatāṃ doṣānadvitīyaḥ kathaṃcanayadenaṃ kṣamayāyuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥsvādhyāyayogeratamānasasya mokṣo dhruvaṃ nityamahiṃsakasyaśrīdvratsatyavādī ca nityamācāryasevakaḥdevatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ vāpyanugrahātadhyāyoyaṃtrayo viśastaṃtre dāśarathīritavalīyavita saṃyuktasūtīyāśramamāśrayetpatnīputreṣu niḥkṣipya yatmāvāvanamāviśetśākamūlaphalaivopi paṃcayajñānpravartayetamūlaphalabhikṣābhirarcayedbhikṣukātithīnācāryacaraṇāṃbhojaśuśrāṣaṇaparāyaṇaḥvaitānika ca juhuyādagnihotraṃ yathāvidhisvayaṃkṛtaṃ calacaṇanāyānmadhuphalapradaḥutyabhūmāścignemāsityajenṛtyūvaṃ saṃcitaṃtriṣadvadvādaśamāsānnaphalamūlādisaṃgrahīcāṃdrāyaṇavratīvāsyātyakṣabhugvāthamāsabhuktapasāśoṣayedvehaṃ pitṛdevāṃśca tarpayetbhikṣayet proṇayātrārthaṃ tāpasān ṣanavāsinaḥitthaṃ ranāśramīviprobrahmatokemahīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyuṣyasyaturīyāṃśetyatkāsaṃgānparivrajettathā yajñānaniṣṭācamokṣanicchavrajatyadhaḥsarvabhūtāni tasyeha prayacchaṃtya bhayaṃ sadāsidhyarthamasahāyaḥ syādbrāmamannārthamāśrayetkālameva pratīkṣeta nityamoṃkāratāyakaḥśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyāmavaśyaṃ nirato bhavetvastraprakṣālanādyaiśca nityamāvāryasevakaḥvṛkṣabhūlaniketaśca mumukṣarihaśasyateyateścatvārikarmāṇiyaṃ carmanopayadyatevījjāṃ kurāṇāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ hiṃsā tatra yara yato bhavetvācaṃ vadedanudvegosakṛdvākenacitkvacitsamadhyātyaniratonīcakeśanaravodarīalāvudārumṛdveṇāpātraṃ śastaṃ nayaṃcamaekākālaṃ varohaikṣyaṃtakuyo tatra vistaraṃdateśarāvasaṃyāt bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ careyatiḥrāgadveṣa vinirmukto bhikṣurmokṣāyakalpatekiṃtasvānekataṃtreṇa kṛtakṛtyaḥ sajagatpatenirdṛhivyatitsarvamekarāprovinoyatiḥdehatyatāṃyunagarbhagarbhakleśaṃ ca dāruṇaṃapriyaiḥ sahasaṃyogasadharmaduḥkhasaṃbhavaṃkarmadīṣasasandratānṛṇāṃ jātīranekadhākurvaḍetamuktayeyatraṃ yatra kutrāśramerataḥavaśyamācāryayadadvaṃdvaśruśrūṣaṇerataḥraśmividyāsamānyuktanyāsajālaṃ samanvitāṃkṛnatretādvāpareśukramādāśramasaṃyutāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmacaryaṃ vanevāsoyugetiṣṭhyena vidyateputramitrakalatrādiyoṣaṇāsaktamānasāḥdaṃbhatībhānṛtayutāḥ śaucāravivarjitāḥvṛthā śāyaṃ vimuṃcati bhikṣārthamapi saṃtataṃtāsu saṃsarganiratāḥ putradarśanalālasāḥgārhasvapnevasakalāśrameṣūtamamucyateprāyaścitairvimuktaḥ sthānnānyatrāsakta āmeasminkaliyuge ghore gṛhasthā api saṃtataṃparanārīṣuniratādaṃbhalobhānṛtapriyāḥeteyamātithībhūtāssarvenarakabhāginaḥkurvatnācāryaśruśūṣāṃ kurvanprāṇadhanairapiśrīmadṛṣṭākṣarīṃ japtvā śuddhakaivalyamaśruteyauṇaṃ māsyāmamāyāṃvāmāsīmāḥsisamāhitaḥekaikaśohunedātyaṃ mūlanāṣṭotaraṃśataṃniṣkatekanadardhaṃ vā pradatvā dakṣiṇāṃ nṛpaamāsomena raviṇā sahitā yadi bhūyatedatvā śeṣatoniṣkasuvarṇaṃ vā prayatnataḥprasahaṃ labhate vaśyaṃ tasminmāsi na saṃśayaḥanusyādyasutānuvipronarakeṣu nimajjatiagniṣṭomādayoyāgāḥ kāyoḥ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥatha vā sarvayāgīnī phalamicchanmahītalenyāsa yuktā prajaptavyā hotavyā haviṣā sadāgrahaṇādiṣu koleṣu navarātravrate śubheyathokta dakṣiṇāsāṃgādātavyā ca sudhāyatenārāyaṇabhidhaṃ sūtāṃmapi pātakabhaṃjanaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja śuśrūṣānyahamādarātmokṣalakṣmīsādhanāni catvārye tāni bhūyatetatrāpyācārya śuśrūṣā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīratiḥgṛhastha eva devānāpi gṛhastha eva devānāpi rahaṇāṃ yogināmapiyaṃgadhovadhirā aṃdhāvaidikaṃ kartamakṣamāḥśraute karmarāyaśaktānāṃ caturthāścama īritaḥkṛtvācāryasya śuśrūṣāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ tayanbrahmanaṃdamaṣīktimāvaśyaṃ abhate nṛpaḥnyāsassahāṣṭārāminuprajāyīhītāṣṭātādyairmithunārcakaścavaiśākhaśukledivasekṣayākhyeyogeghalabhyeṣurameśayogejaptvā ca hutvā gurupādayumisamarpyavittaṃ vahulaṃ mahīśatāṭaṃkavālīyugalādibhūṣaṇairabhyarcya viprālathabhojanīyāḥāyuṣyamārogyamathārthasiddhiṃ ratnānimaktāhayahastisaṃghānmātuḥ piturvaśaśatānvitotedivyaṃ vimānaṃ maṇīkāṃ canāhyaṃbhṛgossutāpi dine dine yojasvāvahutvāvidhivanmanuṣyaḥpunnaghapautrerassahitāṃ samṛddhiṃ prāpyātha sākṣīddhari hṛyametibhakṣyai rājyabhokṣyaiśca vastraiśakalyairvātauṣapitvā dvijāgryaḥvaṃśābhivṛddhiṃ samavāpya cāte viṣṇoḥ padaṃ tatpuramaṃ prayātikṛtārthāmanuje iṃ nityaṃ saṃprātyakāmā athayāṃti muktiṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīnyāsa chaṃda ārṣādikaṃvuvaṣaṭmekuruṇāmūrtekṛtyayā dharmanaṃdanachaṃda āṣādikaṃ sarvaṃ yadvātvā siddhimānbhavetchaṃdogāyatramuddiṣṭaṃ vidrayā śrīḥsarasvatīaklīvadīrghahrīsvādhavargauḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍaṃgakaṃtrinayanāṃ vāgdevatāmāśraye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na siddhilabhate maṃtrīpuraścaryā śatairapikṛtvā pūrvoditanyāsamārṣachaṃdādikaṃ tathābhagavaīmapi kāṃcanābhyādhyāyetanyā samārṣachaṃdādikaṃ tathābhagavatīmapikāṃcanābhyādhyāyeskarājjaghṛtapustakavarṇamālāṃbrahmarūpī bhavatyeva satyānaṃdacidātmakaḥṛṣiḥ prajāpatiḥ chaṃdogāyatradevatāhyāparāpāraṃgato sau vidhānāṃ bhavatyeva jaḍopi caṛṣi prajāpati chaṃdogāyatrasamudāṃhṛtaṃhrasvadīrghāṃtaragataiḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ praṇavai smṛtaḥsakalaśaśinibhāṃśāradānāṃ namāmirodhikā dīpikā caiva recikā mocikā parāāpyāpinī vyāpinī ca vyomanī ca ka sāddhamāsadāśivasamudbhataḥ ṣoḍaśoktā mahosthitiḥ sīdviriti prīkādeśavahyakalā imāḥvaradāhrādinī prītidīghoviṣṇukalādaśautkārī mṛtyurityuktādaśarudradakalā imāḥīśvarāṃga samudbhatāḥ kalāḥ paṃcāśadīritaḥājñāsiddhiṃ samāsādyatejomayatanurbhavetnyasecchīkaṃṭhapūrṇādi paṃcāśān mithunātmakaṃsa dhātuprāṇaśaktyātmayuktāyāhiṣite kramātprokto devatāṃ tannavedibhiḥ hasāṣaḍdīrghayuktena kuryādagānideśikaḥadyoḥśobhārabhūteśotithīśaḥ sthāṇanāṃharaḥakrāśca mahāsenaḥ śivaṣoḍaśaśamūrtayaathaikarudrakṛrmokanejñādvacaturānanāḥarddhanārīśvāraścīmākāṃtaścāṣājaḍaṃḍinau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: chagalaṃḍa**(?)dviraṃḍeśaumahīkālakapālinauśvetabhṛnvīśalakūliśivassaṃvartakustataḥpūrṇodarīsthādvirajāśālmalītadanaṃtaraṃsadīrghamusvigomukhyaudīrghajihvā tathaiva cajvālāmukhī tatojñeyā paścādulkāmukhītathāmahākālīsarasvatyau sarvasiddhisamanvitāātmaśaktibhūtamātā tahā laṃvodarīmatārūpiṇīvāriṇī paścātkyakodatanākālarātriśca kubjīsyāt kapardinyapi vajrayāvāruṇīvāyavi proktā yaścāddrakṣopadhāriṇīetārudrāṃ pīṭhasthāḥ siṃdūṇaruṇavigrahīḥśrīkaṃṭhamātṛkāmetāṃ vinyasyādau dine dinerudramūrtissamahartā kartā sākṣānna saṃśayaḥkartavyassatataṃnyāso brahmatādātmyasiddhidāḥsa dhātu prāḍaṇaśaktyātmayuktāyādiṣuviṣṇavaḥnārāyaṇodvelakṣmīśodevatānnasamīritāpuṃḍarīkākṣalakṣmyoḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ tatvā sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavetbhavedbrahmamayaḥ sākṣādvaiṣṇavīnyasyamātṛkāṃṛṣiḥśaktiḥ spṛtaḥ chaṃdīgāyatraṃ devatāvudhaiḥdīrghāddhayujāṃgāni kuryānmāyātmanāvudhaḥdivādvojagatīśvarotrinayanāpadmeniṣastāsukhaṃāśrayassarvabhāgyānāṃ bhavatyatra na saptayaḥṛṣirbhṛguḥ smṛtacchaṃdīgāyatraṃdevatāmatāprāktrastunena vījena kuryādaṃgānisādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kucanatāṃ dhyāyejjagatsvāminīṃācāryānugrahātsākṣādbhavecchrīkalayānvitaḥṛṣiḥ saṃmohanaḥ proktaḥ chaṃdogāyatramucyatesmareṇadīrghayuktena vidadhyādaṃgakalpanāṃvaśīkarotinnailokyaṃ kiṃca brahmamayo bhavetṛṣissaṃmohanachaṃdogāyatraṃ chavatāmanoḥbhāvartitaistribhivījaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni prakalpayetcūḍāṃsarvasaubhāgyasaṃyamabhassakalaiśvaryasaṃyutaḥhaṃsavidyādikāṃ nyasenmātṛkāmakhileṣṭadosamastavastusaṃprāptikaraṃ tejobhayaśivakhāhādyauḥ paṃcamunibhiḥ paṃcāgāni prakalpayetvedādiśaktirajayāparamātmamahāmataḥsamastaphalasiddhidyāhaṃ sādyomāttakāṃ nyaset parabrahmamayīmathaaṇimādiguṇauśvaryasahito bhagavānasauācāryānugrahāllabdhā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarījayanaṃsarāvasarvajagatāṃ kartā hartā ca pālakaḥekādaśavidhanyāseṣaśaktovasudhāpatetatvanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryādyena tatvamayaḥ pumānṛṣirbrahmātatacchaṃdogāyatraṃ daivataṃ smṛtaṃṣaḍdīrghamāyayākuryāt ṣaḍaṃgaṃ praṇāvādyayāhṛdabjasthitaṃ yuktaṃ citkalayāśrayehamaniśaṃ nārāyaṇākhyaṃ mahaḥvinyastha śrīmadaṣṭārṇa prajapanvudhaḥtanmūrtiyaḥ jaranyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryādinanyadhoḥchaṃdasmṛviturmaṃḍalasthitaḥ ādityātmājagatsyāmīdevonāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: keyūravāmakarakuṃḍalavānkirīṭīharīhiraṇmayavupurvṛtaśaṃkhacakraḥbhavet sa bhagavānmūrtiḥ śabdabrahmamayaḥ pumānṛṣirasyāhamevāḥsmisādhyānārāyaṇonṛpaharirnārāyaṇaḥ svāmīdevatānna samīritaḥsuṃdāramacyutasuramuni brahmeśa śakrārcitaācāryānugrahātpaścādavaśyaṃ harirūpabhākkuryādavaśyaṃ sakalanyāsa jātaphalaprahaṃchaṃdaścadevīgāyatrī paramāśriyaḥpatiḥsadbhirūdīritaḥ ṣadbhirvargauḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vā vinyasedvasudhāyatesarvanyāseṣaṣṭeśaktopi svācāryānugrahānnṛpacidrūyamātṛkāṃ nyasya sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavetbrahmatādātmyamanvicchanamuktimekena janmanāsaṃsevya vahuvarṣaṃvāratpraprāṇārdhanairapiavaśyamapi gṛhīyāt samastanyāsagūrvikāavaśyaṃ sakalanyāsā ācāryacaṃdanāṃvujātavaśyaṃmupadeṣṭavyāḥ karotu na karotu vāācāryonuprahāhātvānyāsajālamidaṃ śubhaṃjaptvāmāsatrayaṃ yaścāsaśyatyeva śriyaḥpatiṃtejomayaturmṛtyujarāmuktetbhavatyasaukṛtvā dine dine vaśyaṃ nyāajālamidaṃ śubhaṃvaṃdyamānī vratavratyena mṛtyuṃ māsānnasaṃśayaḥśubhe dine śubhelagne nyāsajālamidaṃ śubhraṃsasadvoyavatī bhūrmirdhanadhānyaudyasaṃkulāvarṣāśanamitadravyamathavāguraveryayetkṛtvā vaśyamidaṃ nyāsajātaṃ pratyahamādarāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tameva bhagavadrūpaṃ prāhurācāryamuttamaṃnārāṇo jagatsvāmī bhagavāniṃdirāpatiḥśrīrāma iti lokesminvyāto dāśarathi vibhuḥguptaṃ rākṣasakorībhirbhinnāṃjanacayopamaṃvaśiṣṭhādimaharṣīsammitaṃ ******kathayāmāsa rudrāya pṛcchate munipuṃgavāḥ**(?) bhūtamidaṃ vedavedāṃtārtha rahasyakaṃpatraiva brahmaṇastatvarahasyaṃ śrutisaṃgrahaṃrahasyamapi yatroktaṃ bhogasvargāparvargadaṃbhagavadvadanāṃbhojādāvirbhūtamidaṃ śubhaṃācāryavadanāṃbhojādvijñeyaṃ nānyathā dvijāḥślokamekamathātrāpi japtvā jīvan vimucyateśrutvā caturmukhaḥ paścāt sanakādibhpaṭhaktavānśrutvā vibhāṃ ukāyātha svasuttāyoktavānidaṃadhītavān piturvaktrādvibhāṃḍakatunedvijāḥbrahmadarśana sidhyarthaṃ mokṣalakṣmīsamṛddhayeidaṃ dāśarathīyākhyaṃ taṃtraṃ dṛṣṭvā maharṣayaḥsanatkumāro bhagavāndattāteyo jagatpatiḥbhārgavo jāmadagnyopiyosau bhagavadaṃ śataḥpaṃcaite saṃhitāśca krurvedavedāṃtasaṃmmitāḥtat tadācārya vadanād jñātavyaṃ tatvamuttamaṃsevitavyaṃ bhagavataḥ sākṣātkārasyasiddhayekṣīyaṃte cāsyakarmāṇi tasmindaṣṭe parātmanijarāmaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ malamūtraughasaṃkulaṃsevitavyaṃ sadācārya pādāṃvujayuṃgādvījāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhārgavevāsarevāpi yakṣevāmāsimāsi vāmahatiṃ siddhimicchadbhirnyastavyaṃ pratyahaṃ budhaiḥnyāsajālamidaṃ puṇyaṃ bhagavadrāvasiddhidaṃāśvinenavarātre ca vijīyedaśmimīdinesamastanyāsasahitā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīśubhaavaśyaṃ mahatīṃ siddhimaṇimādi guṇānvitāṃprāprotyatra na saṃdeho vivāhyemajayādikaṃtatvanyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvānyāsaṃtanmūrmirtīyaṃvraraśrīmadaṣṭāṃkṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ japennityaṃ mahīyatevarṇanyāsaṃ daśavidhaṃ nyasya cidrūyamātṛkaṃnyāsya avaśyaṃ nyastavyāssavaisandurvanugrahānavaśyaṃ sakalanyāsā kartavyā hariśāsanātjapaṃtīṣṭhāṣi sarvāsu bhārgavāsarepi vāvyatīyāttepi vā kāryaṃ nyāsajālamidaṃ śubhaṃvaidikayāvakecu hṛtvā havirdādaśadhāpi bhūyabhojyaṃ ghṛtasūyasaṃyutaṃ varṇāmuktāphalabhūṣaṇādikaṃtyadhvāvibhānaṃ maṇihemanirmitaṃ prāprotyathāṃte bhagavatpadaṃ cahutvā vidhivatsamarcyacāryavalyaimaṇikāṃcanādikavaṃśāmivṛddhi samavāpya bhogā āproti sākṣādbhagavatyudaṃ canyāsesmahāṣṭārṇajayī śivaścanyāsaissacūṣṭākṣaramaṃtrajāyīnyāsaissahānārāyaṇassarva carācarasya gururgarīyānapi viśvavaṃdyaḥetadeva paraṃ tatvaṃ vijānīhamahīpatepuraścaryābhidhaṃ karmavakṣyamiva sudhāyateācāryacaraṇāṃbhojaṃ dhyātvā brahmavileśubhedhyātvātha śrīmadaṣṭārṇā yathā śaktyānvahaṃ japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japtvā hṛtvānyahaṃ bhūyatvalite jātavetavedasivatsarān mahatīṃ siddhiṃ devānāmapi durlabhāṃkaṃdarpa samasaubhāgyaṃ vācāṃ siddhimanuttamāṃmṛtānāmapi sāhasrakarasparśanamātrataḥaṇimādigarṇoryuktovatsarātsvecaro bhavetuktayeta mahābhāga yadivighro na jāyatedvāpareravilakṣaṃ syātkalau ṣoḍaśalakṣakaṃtathā sarasvatītīraṃ yamunātaṭamapyathasamudratīraṃgoṣṭhaṃ ca suvarṇāmukharītitaṃsutedyāccāryasānnidhyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ prāhuriṣṭadanaktāśyekāṃtarāśī vā phalamūlāśanopi vātayet ṣoḍaśalakṣāṇi śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃhunet ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ tata ācāryayādayoḥdvādaśakaṃ vatsaṃ vahukṣīrasamanvitaṃdatvācāryapriyāputrānapi saṃtoṣyavastubhiḥitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryāmividhināvakṣudhāyateśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī siddhāpado bhavati bhūyateathastaprepivāsākṣāddhāṣvarudrādivivaṃditaṃnārāyaṇaṃ parabrahmarūpirṇayaśyati dhruvaṃbhavatyeva na saṃdehasrasminvarṣe mahīyatejapahomāccaṃ naṃdānaṃ vrataṃdeva dvijārcanatasmādavaśya kartavyaṃ puraścaraṇamādarātmahatīpuraccaryā saṃpūrṇoktāmayātaānāyāsenavidhāyāḥ śirdviguptatarāmapivaiśākhemāsi śukevāt tīyākṣayasaṃjñitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hohirāyāṃ saṃsthito jīvemeṣarāśigateravauyogoyaṃṣaḍvibhirvaṣairllabhyate nānyathā nṛpapitṛṇāmapi sarveṣāmakṣanaṃdakārakaṃtatraiva bhṛguvāreṇaptahitedevaseśubheasminnevadine bhūyarohiṇyāṃ bhagavān vibhuḥkiṃ ca dharmasyatayasātoṣitovasudhāyateprājāpatyarkṣasahite bhṛguvāsarasaṃyutevaiśākheśuklapakṣehamutyanosmindine nṛpadharmasya tapasātuṣṭodākṣāyaṇyāmahaṃ nṛpaasminnevadine pūrvarīhiṇyāṃ bhṛguvāsarekiṃ cāsminnevadivaserohiṇayāṃśaśiśekharaḥtasmādakṣayanāmnīyaṃ tṛtīyā sarvasiddhidāetai samanvito yogauralakṣyoyoga ītirataḥrohiṇī bhṛgucāreṇa sahitātra bhavedyadirīhiṇīsasthitijīvemesurāśigateravauakṣayākhya tṛtīyaṃ yaṃmahatparvamamerirtaṛṣayassiddhasaṃghāśca pratyahaṃ pūjayaṃtimāṃmatokṣayalaṃ prāpya gacchaṃti tridivaṃsurāḥmatmasādbhavatyeva diname tatrathāthākṣayaṃnārāyaṇāśramonāmnātanmanasthā na mucyatedākṣāyaṇīsutaṃ nāṣāravyātaṃ nārāyaṇāṃ muniṃkoṭijanmārjītaiḥpāyasaṃghairapi sudāruṇaiḥakṣayesmin dine tasmāduktayogobhavedya hialabhyayoge saṃprāptodivasekṣayasaṃjñitenaisakaṃ karmakṛtvātha tadanujñāpurassaraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triśatādhikasāhasraṃ śrīmaṃtrānyatamaṃśataṃvivapatrairghṛtābhyaktaiḥ śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayāśrīmaṃtrānyatamenāthahutvā dvādaśadhā ghṛtaṃutpalairvilvapatrairvāyairvākaravīrakaiḥsāṃgāvaraṇapūjāṃ ca kṛtvādau niyatavrataḥadhyetavyā raśmimālāśiṣyeṇaniyatātmanāavaśyamasyindivase śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīśubhāadhyetavyā prayatnena sarvanyāsapurassarātata ācāryapādābjedhairyagāṃbhāryasaṃyutaḥvarṣāśanamitaṃ dravamathavāvaśyamaryarpatācāryakarṇayordeyamavaśyaṃ ratnasaṃyutaṃpītāṃvarayugaṃdādyātssakṣyakāryāsakaṃtu vāavaśyaṃ guravedeyaṃyānasaṃ phalapaṃcakaṃdṛṣṭvātphulanicānyāni dhanārḍhyā bhūmiyo yadidhānyarāśimathāśvaṃcagatānāṃdolikāṃdikaṃtata dakṣayamevasyādyādyadasmindine kṛtaṃavaśyaṃ yānasaphalaṃ yaṃcakaṃtritaḥ prātayaṃtu vāvarṣośanamitadravyaṃdayamāvaśyakaṃ vudhaiḥdaridrodhanahīnīpidakṣiṇāṃguraveryatavaśyaṃguravederyadarivairapi sādhakaiḥakṣayāṃ putrapautrādisamṛddhijānamakṣayaṃākalyamakṣayāsiddhiḥ śrīmadṛṣṭārṇājāpibhiḥācāryāliṃganaṃ prāthatadāśībhiḥ kṛtādaraḥbhojayedvipravarṣoścasuvāsinyoṣṭabhūyatepītvā kṛtārthatāṃ prāpyabhuṃjīyādvaṃdhabhissaha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vinūśāṭhyaṃ parityajya kṛtvokta vidhinā śuciḥtādṛśīnāśataṃ sāgraṃ kṛtvā yatphasamaśruteśriyācidrayayāthāsthiyoge phalamudīritaṃsutena yukte viriṃcisthita devadevasadūṇai meṣasthiterkedivasetṛtīyeumāmaheśābhidhamāhareketatraivagaurocare mātrajātātakṣīpatiḥ prāhurabhūddharitryāṃ nārāyaṇonāmanaraiṇayuktaḥhutvā ca havyaṃ vidhisaṃskṛtegrauyūvauyadiṣṭāmapiraśmimālāṃbhūyo gṛhītvā gurupādayugmedayugmedatvā samastaṃ ca dhanaṃ maṇiṃ caphalatrayaṃ pānasaṃpaṃcakaṃ vāhyatvā sadācārya yadāraviṃdeputrābhivṛddhisakalāṃścanogāyurmahadbhāgyamathākṣayaṃ capituścamātuḥ kulakoṭiyuktāmamaitadakṣapyayaṃdaṃ prayātidinamātreṇa kṛtvetthaṃ mahatīṃ siddhimaśruteanena yogarājena samolabhyonavihvatepuraścaryorataraṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣāṃ vahnio nṛpabhāskaragrahaṇeprāpte caṃdrasyadivasepi vāgrahaṇasparśa samaye gatvā sāgaṇāṃ nadīṃsnātvā śūmedhāvabhṛthasnānapuṇyasamanvitaḥaṃtassamastayāyebhyo muktaḥ syāt sadya eva hikṛṣṇaistilairhunedravyaghṛtaṃ yuktaistataḥ paraṃśirṣṭerdhanāḍikāmātre smṛtvā brahmāryaṇāhutiṃvahavinnayuktāṃ bhūmiṃmāvāryāya samarpayetatha dvādaśaniṣkaṃvāṣaḍviṃtā samarpayetdakṣiṇāvasuniṣkaṃ vā triniṣkaṃvātha dakṣiṇāṃdadāti padyadgṛhaṇesavituḥ śaśinopi cagrahaṇeva sudhāṃ datvā satyadvīpavatīṃ mahau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śālagrāmaśilāmekā datvā pūrvoktadakṣiṇāṃdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca vā sāṃsibhūṣaṇaṃ kuṃḍalādikaṃsamastābhīṣṭasaṃsiddhimatyaṃtaṃ mahatī labhetsvarṇadānaṃ merusaṃyaṃ prāhuścaṃdrārkaparvaṇidattāstra yastena bhavaṃtilokāyaḥ kāṃcanagācagahīṃ pradṛdyātdadāti mahatīsiddhiṃ daivatairapi durlabhāṃsīdhyarthameva maṃtrāṇiṃ nityaṃ yatnaparo bhavettadā tasya prasastābhikalyāṇābhi bhavaṃti hividyāḥ samastā api divyabhogāna prāprotyathāṃte bhagavatyahaṃ casiddhigatā brahmasaṃrūpatāṃ ca śriyaṃ parāṃ sarvagurṇāyayabhāṃdivyāmaraṇānidhānyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣāsaupituśca mātuścakulānyito sau paraṃpadaṃ yātinaṃ saṃyotrayacchatvā pitaro dhīmān na jñānatimitaṃ viśetpūrvoktayāgasaditā sarvasiddhipradetāatiguptataraṃ vakṣye sāvadhānamanāḥ śṛṇuḥpaṃcavādyeṣu natvādaugaṇanāyakaṃalaṃkṛtyasacāryaṃ punarnatvārtha daṃḍavatśrīmannāvārya sarvajñā yāvajjīva mahaṃtavatvahājñoryūghanaṃ nāhakaromi karaṇanidhiśaraṇaṃ mama sarvajña gatirnānyāstime sadāpitāmātāpi bhayavatvameva mama daivataṃprārthayitvetthamācāryaṃ prārthayitvā mahīyateācāryavadanāṃbhotā hṛhṇīyādva sudhāyateupadiṣṭāṃ ca bhūyopi svācāryavadanāṃvujātitthaṃ maṃtraṃmayīṃ dīkṣaṃ sarvanyāsamayīmapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svatojyotirmayauvidyāṃgacchaṃtīṃ bhāvayeddharuśarīramarthaṃ prāṇaṃśca svācārya caraṇadvayeakṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃmihaṃ dīkṣīdvayaṃ śubhaṃavaśyaṃ bhagavāṃstasyatasminmāminyasīdatigṛhītvācāryasadhye pratiṣṭhāpyātha yācakaṃhomaṃ śatādhikaṃ kuryāddekasāhasramādarātmaṃtrānyatamenāpi śatamaṣṭottaraṃ junetjayādibhistatohutvātvanyāyaśrittāhatīrhunetmallikākusumaivāpinaṃdyāvartairathāpi vāsāṃgāvaraṇapūjāṃ ca kṛtvādau niyatavrataḥtata ācāryayādāvuddhitayaṃ praṇipatya casamarpya pūrvamācāryamalaṃkṛtya tataḥ paremadhyaphaleraṃdhramekaṃ kṛtvārājatayātrakaṃsarvasvamapi ratnauṣaṃdhanaudyaṃmaṃdirasthitaṃphalasyo paritatyātraṃ raṃdhramadhyonidhāya catvadraśividyāsaṃsidhyau maṃtrarājasya siddhayesiddhirbhavatumesvābhinnācāryakaruṇānirdhaarpayet sakalavastu dhanadhānyauva saṃkulaṃsarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇādeyātadardhevāṃ tadardhakaṃathavā kuṃḍalayugmaṃ tatyakāṃcananimitaṃniṣkadvāsśakasvarṇaṃ sūkṣmavāso yugānvitaṃpradatvā mahātau siddhimakṣayāṃ prāpnuyādasauṣaṇinaṣktamathavādadyāttriniṣkaṃ vā prayatnataḥkuṃḍaladvitayaṃ datvā maheṃdrasadṛśaḥ śriyāmātāmahāṃśca śataśa uddhatyāsau mahīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: akṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyā varṣāśanamitaṃdhanaṃdatvā yathpalamānyoti tatphalaṃ samudīritaṃphalapaṃcakasaṃyuktaṃ datvācārya padāṃvujaakṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ haricadanamuttamaṃkalpadamagaṇākoṇe nivasedbhagavatpadeannaṃ dadhiyutaṃ vāpi datvā viprebhya ādarātprāpnotyatra na saṃdehassatyaṃ satyaṃ dāmyahaṃtādṛśīnāṃśataṃ sāgramakṣayāyāṃ kṛtaṃ bhavetvājiyeyaśataṃsāgrasaṃpūrṇevaradakṣiṇāṃasminmājjanmadivasetarvukāmobhavārṇarvamanorathānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavet siddhirihākṣayāśeṣeṇāpi punagītaṃ sarvamapyatra vakṣatevaiśāhamāsedavasekṣayāhavyemaṃtreṇa nārāyaṇavācakenasaṃtaptahaimaṃ maṇirviduyuktamākalpayugmaṃ gurukarṇayugekiṃ cātra siddho ca parāmavāpyaprātyāḥ syurbhāgāna yadurlabhāṃścavaiśākhamāse civasekṣayesmin nārāyaṇoktavratamādareṇasākṣāhuruḍādhirūḍhaṃ dṛṣṭakattārthāsyuranaṃtabhogātārūtvasākṣātkamalādhi vā sapadaṃ prayāṃtyaivanasaṃśayonnaaṣṭākṣaro homakalaṃ viśiṣṭa samastapurāyeṣu dinekṣayesminitthaṃ kṛteṣṭākṣara homakarmaṇyasya prasīdatyasvisāmareśaḥna rājasūyo na ca vājñimedhonagosavīvāpihinekṣayāstyeaṣṭākṣarī homarataṃ dinesmin vaiśākhasāsekṣayasaṃjñitethaśakrādayodikayutayopi siddhāst sadhyāśca sarve samaruhaṇaścagaurīramāvāpnukhaśaktaścaścatuṣṭāḥ prasannāvaradāṃ bhavatissrapṛṣyaupicaṃdanaiśca-bhakṣyaiścabhojyairbhikṣunānyathāpi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sānyotyavaśyaṃ sakarlāśca kāmānnārāyaṇāpaśyati cakṣurṣevaakṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmitthaṃ sidhyarthamācaretśriyaḥpateḥ prasādopi bhavatyevākṣayo nṛpabhagavatsannidhāvaṃtebhavejatirathīkṣayābhūyopi saṃyavakṣyāmi samāhitamanaḥ śṛṇuatigaṃḍena yogena yadvā yuktetyu karmaṇasaumyavāsarayukte vā dvādaśīdivasepi vāyogarājomajānuktoraviparvaśataprabhaḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇoyegaste naiva sama ucyatevarṣairdvāśabhirbhūmau labhyateyaṃ mahīpatejapahomādikartṛṇaṃ dadātyakṣayamāśitaṃmahādāna sahasraṃ vājiyeyāyuṃtaṃ tu vāalabhyo nāmayogoyaṃ sarvayogottamomaḥsrātvā navāṃvidhānena devānṛṣiyohṛnapiācāryacaraṇaṃbhojayugmaṃ natvā tataḥ paraṃtriśatādhika sāhasraṃ samasanyāsasaṃyutāṃsāmrājyalakṣmīvidyāṃ vā ṣaḍarṇīmathavāśriyaḥyathā rucijayedvidyāṃ komalaisulasīhalaiḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇi paścātriśataṃ brahmavidyayāvidhivat saṃskṛte vahnau tilairgavyaghṛtaplutaiḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ datvā śrīmaṃtreṇājyamādarātprāyaścittāhutā hṛtvā brahmārpaṇāhutiācāryakarṇayordatvā kuṃḍaladvayamādarātsūkṣmaṃ vāsoyugaṃ datvā śālagrāmaśilāṃśubhāṃprārthayitvāpi vahuśastilānapi samarpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadardhaṃ vā tadāvāryamaṃciresthāpayedvudhaḥpratigṛhyāṇamātraṃ vā pātakaṃ na labhet kvacitācāryācaraṇāṃbhojadeyamāvaśyakaṃtitannivṛttirathocyateśrītriyāyatathānyasmaidatvā mucyetapātakānācāryacaraṇāṃbhojedeyamāvaśyakaṃ dhanaṃdhenupratinidhidravyaṃ yadvādadyāt sakṣiṇaṃlakṣmīnārāyaṇenāmnāyogesmin sarvavīmidvidebrāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścādbhaujayecca suvāsinīḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇoyogeśrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīsiddhimāvaśyaṃ mahītīmapiprāpnotyatra na saṃdehassatyaṃnītra vicāraṇatādagdvādaśākaṃtenakṛtaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥekāmāpyāhaṛtirkṛtvā lakṣmīhomaphalaṃ spṛtaṃekāṃ sa dakṣiṇā datvā koṭi brahmāṃḍadānataḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇe yogeniṣkaṃvākāṃcanaṃ śubhaṃācāryakarṇayugale kuṃḍaladvayadāmanalakṣmīnārāyaṇe yo sahasrajayamātrataḥyatphalaṃ sa bhavāpnoti tadeva phalamīritaṃkṛtvetthaṃ nāmnasaṃdehobhagavaṃtaṃ praśasyatistatyeyaśyatyasau sarvakāmadaṃ bhaktavatsalaṃviyuktaḥ pāparīśibhyaḥ kalyāṇāni dine dinevaṃśābhivṛddhimatulāṃ putrapautrādisaṃkulāṃdivyaṃ vimānamāruhyakulaviṃśatiṃ saṃyutaḥna divasenoktaṃ punaranyatpravakṣyatebhūyopi saṃpravakṣyāmi śūṇuṣva vasudhāpate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: punarjarāpunarvālyamādhayovyādhayaḥ punaḥstotavyamarcanīyaṃ ca sevitavyaṃ dvijottamāḥjānakīpatināsākaṃrāmeṇa paramātmanākimarthamuktavānetta taṃtraṃ vedārthasaṃgrahaṃśṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve rahasyamapi vakṣyatepulastyavaṃśasaṃbhūtadurātmānaṃ mahābalaṃsākṣātparabrahmamayaḥ śrīrāmojagatīpatiḥraṇehatvādurādharṣaṃ vīraṃ trailokyarāvaṇaṃbhrātṛbhiḥ sahitorāyo vaśiṣṭhādhairmaharṣibhiḥayodhyānagare ramye pālayāmāsamedinīṃsarvadevagaṇairyuktāssiddhavidyā dharānvitāḥtadājñayā samāsīnāḥ suśubheṣāsaneṣu*(?)narākṛtidharaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇamajaṃ hariṃdraṣṭumabhyāyayau devaṃ brahmāpi caturānanaḥdattātreyopi bhagavānagastyaḥ ka eva eva caekanaścadvitaścaivayavakrītothagālavaḥjāmadagnyastatorāmyedevarāto mahātapāḥyogācāryotha vālmīkiramamanyustaponidhiḥśrīrāmaṃ paramātmānaṃ nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhuṃabhyāyayustayoniṣṭhā ṛṣayodīptatejasaḥtaṃdunaṃdīśabhṛṃgīśavīrabhadragaṇeśvaraiḥdraṣṭumiṃdīparaśyāmaṃ prasannaṃ jānakīpatiṃśivasya brahmaṇonyeṣāmāsanāni samādiśatidamūcurvacotyaṃtarāmaṃ rājīvalocanaṃyatadakṣayamavyaktaṃ paśyāmastvāṃ jagatpate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatroktā śrīmadaṣṭārṇa puraścaryāmayātavaśrāvaṇemāsipaurṇabhyāṃ caṃdrasyagrahaṇaṃ yadivasunakṣatrayuktaṃ vāyogolabhyo mahānayaṃsarvāsāmanividyānāmavaśyaṃ siddhiruttamāśrīmadaṣṭarṇavidhāyāssiddhiktuṃ na śakyateprātastasmindine srātvā svācāryacaraṇadvayaṃtriśatādhika sāhasraṃ prajapetriyatavrātaḥpaṃcadhā bhagavadraśmividyāsūktaṃ tato japetkeśavādīni nāmānimaunenamanasoccaranvāsasīparīdhāyāthatrirācamyayatavrataḥpītvā vimuktaḥ payaudyairvahiraṃtasthitairapihanedravyājasaṃmiśraistilaikṛṣṇaiḥstataḥ paraṃhunityaṃ paṃcaśataṃ vāpi catuḥśatamathāpi vāekadhāvādvidhā predhāraśmimaṃtrairhunaittṛtaḥpradakṣiṇyaṃ namaskṛtya jātavedasamādarātsarvasvamaryadvīmān yadvāvarṣāśanaṃ dhanaṃvaṇiṣkaṃ cātriniṣkaṃvātanyūnaṃ na samarpya yatsālagrāmaśilāmekāmavaśyaṃ guraveryapetvibhave sati bhūdānaṃ godvayaṃ ca samarpayetśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāsiddhiṃ sumahatīmapicaṃdracūḍāmaṇirthyojastriṃśadvatsaratī bhavetkoṭiśastilahomasya phalamānyosanuttamaṃtulāpuruṣakoṭīnāmavaśyaṃ labhate phalaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāpuraścaryāśatātphalatasminnevadirnasvaye yadvā sākṣācchriyaḥ patiṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvā samastabhāgyānāmāśrīyosaubhaveddhruvaṃcirāyuṣyamathārogyaṃ vācāṃ siddhiṃ ca durlabhāṃsaṃprāpyasakalānbhogāndivyānapi ca mānuṣānvimānavaramārūṭholabhate bhagavasadanavarātramiti protaṃ navanavapyaṃtaṃ mahīyatedivase divaseja saṃhutaṃtta ca bhūyateyā mahānavamī proktā navārātre tathāśvirnasakṛjjasaṃhatamapi tatrānaṃta phalapradaṃmaredyurvaiṣṇavaṃ tāraṃ yadi sā navamī parāvarṣamadhyasthitamidaṃ yarvaratnaṃ mahīpitaṃnavarātre pratiyadi svācāryājñāpurassarasaṃpūjyādaugaṇādhīśamadhyarcyācāryamādarātsvācāryacaṇāṃbhojasannidhauśaṃsitavrataḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃvidyāṃ sahasraṃ ca catuḥśataṃsāmrājyalakṣmīmaṃtraṃṣāśrīṣaḍarṇamathapi vācatuḥśatādhikaṃ yadvā sahasraṃ pratvatuḥhaṃ japetśrīmrājyalakṣmīmaṃtraṃ vā śrīṣaḍarṇamathāpi vānavarātravṛte yadvākaumāistulasīdalaiḥśrīśrīpatīsamabhyarcyastāṃgācaraṇapūrvakaṃātharvaṇa mahāsūktaṃ lakṣmīdudayanāmakaṃpaṃcādhikāṃ vā catvāriṃśavṛtiṃjapennu vāprāṇānāyamya sakalpyajvalite jātavedasiśrīmadaṣṭākṣariṇātha sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃmadhutritayayuktena dvādaśārṇa śriyā hunetatha sāmrājya lakṣmyāvāśātādhika sahasrakaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣmīhṛdayamaṃtraiśca ślokarūpairataḥ paraṃjāyādi homaṃ kṛtvātha prāyaścittāhunīrhunetśrīśrīyātī samabhyarcya pūrvavadbrahmaviyānamaskṛtyārpyayedvomānakuṃḍaladvitayaṃ śubhaṃvāsobhirgaṃdha puṣpādyairvahūśasyaugha saṃkulaṃbhagavatmannidhau datvādācāryāyamahātmaneniṣkadvādaśakaṃ madhyadakṣiṇā ca trivinirmitādṛdyādavaśyamācāyekarābjeḥ dakṣiṇānvitāṃekāṃ sopaskarāṃ śayyāmapi dakṣiṇaṃ yānvitāṃcaturvṛṣabhasaṃyuktādātavyā satataṃ mahīpaṃcaviṃśatinirṣṇuvā tadardhaṃ vātvardhakaṃekaniṣkasuvarṇaṃ vā vittalobhaṃ vivarjayetniṣkārvamathavādeyaṃ dhenumūlyaṃ mahīyateśrīmadaṣṭārṇe sidhyarthaṃ kāryamāvaśyakaṃvudhīḥhutvaikāmāhutimapi koṭihomaphalaṃ labhetmahānavamyāṃ datvāsau satyadvīyapradānataḥmahāvamyā prātyāyāṃ kuṃḍalakṣitaṃyaṃ śubhaṃkiṃ vāsyapitaromagrānarakaudyeśu koṭiśaḥmahānavamyāṃ bhagavatsālagrāmāśelīśubhāṃphalamāsādyaśuddhātmā bhagavaṃtaṃ prapaśyatitanmālya svalpasvarṇamathavālakṣagodānajaṃ phalaṃprāpnoti bhagavaddhāmaśāśvataṃ divyamakṣayaṃtulāpuruṣamukhyāni hānānivasudhāpateśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā puraścayo sahasrajaṃprāpnoti mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ dhanratnaudyasaṃkulā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidhā siddhiṃ ca mahatī nigrahonugrahakṣīmāṃavāpyaiccharīrāṃte prāpnoti hārisatridhiṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī siddhiyādaśī navarātrakenavarātravrate yāvat prasāhaḥsyācchriyaḥpatehnavarātravrataṃsāṃgaṃ kṛtvethāṃ vidhinādarātavātha brahmarudrādyauḥ śakrādyairapi pūjitaḥprāpnoti bhagavadvāmakulānāṃśatasaṃyutaḥācāryatoṣaṇātuṣṭābrahmaviṣṇumaheśvārāśakrāyā āpi dikpālāḥ keṃkaryaprāpnuvaṃtihinavarātravratamidaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ samācaretnavarātra pratakuryācchriyaskāmo dvijottamaḥariṣṭāṃ jāyate tasya tasminvarvenāsaṃśayaḥnavarātravrataṃ kuryācchromadaṣṭārṇe siddhayeudīritā mahāsiddhirbrahmavidbhisamoṣṭatāḥnavarātravratamihaṃ samastādhaudhabhaṃjanaṃācāryānujñāyā prātaḥsnātvā pratipadāditaḥsaṃkalpārkāsahasrīṇi prajayennavarātrakeprajapedaṣṭasāhasraṃ paṃcasāhasrakaṃ tu vāśrīrāmajanmanavamīdivase sarvasiddhidevidhivat saṃskṛte vahāvikṣukhaṃḍairghṛtatthataijuhuyādvitvāpatrairvāgavyājyatribhadhuplutaiathavā śuddhagavyenadyānena juhuyāśuciḥpuratorato juhuyānmaṃtrairṣṭahadāvaraṇoditaiḥjayāhi homaṃ kṛtvātha kṛtvā brahmarpaṇāhatiṃācāryācaraṇāṃbhojadvayasāyyaṃgamādarāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sālagrāmaśilāṃ śuddhānikṣityāṃkāpyapātrakeniṣṇerdvādaśabhiḥ svarṇairvasuniṣkairathāpi vāprīṇā tu bhagavānsākṣācchīrāmātmāśriyaḥpatiḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāsaṃsiddhimahatīmapiiti tradvayenātha sālagrāmaśilāśubhāṃsūkṣmavāsodyugaṃ datvā haricanamuttamaṃathācāyalatrasyakarṇe laṃkaraṇādikaṃnavabhojyāḥ savāsinyovāsobhirdikṣiṇādibhiḥvāsaṃte navarātrepivrataṃ kṛtvetthamādarātśrīrāmajanmadivase śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāśrīrāmajanmadivisesālagrāmaśilāṃśubhāṃbrahmāṇḍakoṭidānasya phalamatyaṃtamaśrutaṃpuraścaryāśataṃphalaṃ prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥāvaśyaṃ mahatīṃsiddhimihaṃ ca prāpyasādhakaḥsaṃprāpya mahatīṃ lakṣmīvākyadviṃ vā tulāṃ śubhāṃsaṃprathakulasāhasrasrasahito bhagavatpadeathāparaṃ pravakṣyāmi viśiṣṭaṃ parvasiddhidaṃamārkavāsarayutāsomenesahitāpi vāravicūḍāmaṇirvāmnāyogoyaṃ samudāhṛtaḥatrajasasaṃkṛdvāpi koṭiśojaptamevahiatrekaniṣkasvarṇe vā datvācārya yadāṃvujaraviparvaṇi saṃprāpte tatpūrvadivaṃ satrayaṃbhāskaragrahaṇesparśakāle prāte tataḥ paraṃstutvāmasastupāyaudyairvimuktassadyarāvahiācāsannidhāvagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyavidhānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maṃtrairātyenagavyena tatastrimadhusatyutīḥkṛtvā śrīmanunāyaścīcchātamaṣṭottaraṃ hunetprāyaścittahutīrhutvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇāhutiṃdatvā ca strīsūkṣmīsisvarṇa niṣkasahasrakaṃyāvacchakāmalaṃkāraṃ datvā śrīguravetha vāpaṃcaniṣkasuvarṇaṃ vā niṣkatrayamitaṃ tu vāśrotriyebhyaḥ pradedyānidaśadānānyataḥparaṃabhyarcayettriniṣkādiyāvacchavacamitaurdhanaiḥitthaṃ kṛtvā vidhānenena grahaṇe sāṃgamādarātśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyāstatopi mahatī parāṃāyurārogyasahitaḥ śriyādhanadasannibhaḥprāpyavaṃśābhivṛddhiṃ ca kalpātaṃ vasudhāpatekulasāhasramādāyavarīdviṣṇuyurrasukhīramyamokṣāṃte śuddhārāvahitātayaḥekena divase naiva samāhitamānāḥścarāpūrvoktā yogasahitā daivatairapidullebhābhūyopi saṃvaḥ pravakṣyāmi viśeṣādvasadhāyateyatrāvirāsotkāmalābhṛgoḥkhyātyāṃtrayīmayīyatroyamebhagavāncyutaḥ priyamīśvarīṃtatrākṣara tṛtīyāyāśrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī siddhiravaśyaṃ bhavati dhruvaṃamāvāsyāpūrṇimā ca tadvādaśa samāsmṛtāsavivāre saṃkramaṇaṃ tadvādaśasaṃmasmataṃcaṃdracūḍāmaṇisamoyegaśrīddhaudayaḥsmtaḥvaiśākhemāsiyāścaktratatīyākṣayasaṃjñit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: akṣayāṃyātatṛtīyāyāṃ muktaṃ yogatrayaṃ śubhaṃakṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyā muktoyogobhavedyadividhānāmupadiṣṭānāmapitasmin dineśūseavaśyaṃ mahanīsidvissadyarānākṣayā bhavetnapusakāścayurmatrāḥ strīmaṃtrāvaidiṇastathāniṣiddhamāsatāreṣu labdhāśca śubhasiddhidāḥpuraścaraṇanīnāścanyāsahīmāśca saṃtataṃprāptā avaśyaṃbhūyopi sacchiṣyairdvityavekṣayetatra prātaḥ samuhyāyanatvācārya padāṃvujaṃavaśyaṃ bhagavadraśmimālikaṃ paṃcadyāsmarettriśataṃ vātayecchadvānānprathāsiddhibhāgasauprārthadvaṃśaḥ sākṣādīvāṃ bhagavanmayaṃbhavatpādāvrayugmasya kiṃkarīssidinedinekaromitavapādātvakaikarpaśāśdhimāṃ vibhoavaśyaṃ tavayāddātva kiṃkarosmidyaśādhimāṃbhūyaḥ samastavidyānāṃ grahaṇaya samāhitaḥ*** ācāryopi kṛpāsidhurvaidikaipi vābhagavadraśmividyābhireke kāmāhuti hunethyavāmabhāge saṃsthāpya sacchiṣyaṃ karuṇānidhiḥdattātreyaṃ mahātmānaṃ kṛṣṇadvaiyāyanaṃ muniṃśiṣyasyadakṣiṇe karṇe prahṛdyādvasudhāpateśiṣyasya dakṣiṇekarṇo pradadyāhraśmimālikāṃupadiṣṭāṃśca bhūyopinyānuyaddiśedvadhaḥrājñī samastavidyānāśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīśubhāṃkṛtārthosmītimatvāsāvartavāsīmahāmatiṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidhānāṃ grahaṇārthāya sarvasayassamṛddhayeyasminmāsetasamapidattaculukamātrakaṃupānehau ca chatraṃ ca madhudadhyohanādikaṃyasmanāsīyaurṇamālīviśārayāsahitāśubhāyogā bhavaṃti yadyanna mayā pūrvamudīritāḥrājarājamimaṃ prāhulakṣmī nārāyaṇābhidhaṃāvaśyaṃ sarvavidyānāmacāryavadanāṃvujātitthaṃ samastavidyānāmācāryavadanāṃvujātācāryanujñayā tatra vidhivat saṃskṛtenalekṛtvāpya śrimadīṣṭārṇa manunāsādhakottamaḥśatādhikaṃhānecchīmaddaṣṭāryo na sahasrakaṃbhagavadraśmividyābhirhuneddavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tridhāśrīmadaṣṭārṇamaṃtraṇaśatādhikasahasrakaṃbhagavadraśmi vidyābhistridhā hutvājyamādarātpradakṣiṇaṃ namaskṛsajātavedasamādarātmallikākusumairvāpikarevīrairathapi vāārcadvilvapatre vā tulasīdalamiśritaiḥphalapaṃcakamādāyānasaṃsamanoharaṃnikṣipya bhūtale śūdve yatkiṃ vitpātramadhyataḥnikṣipya bhagavanmūrtisālagrāmaśilāṃśubhāṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ niṣkasuvarṇairbrahmavidyayābrahmavidyāṃ samuccāryalakṣmīnārāyaṇau yajejetdadhyodanaṃ tato dadyācchīśrīśrībhyāṃ mahīyateācāryaṃ samalaṃkṛtyaṃ vastrālaṃkaraṇādibhiḥsūkṣmavāsopugaṃdatvā sālagrāmaśilāṃ śubhāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samāhitamanādayācchīmadaṣṭārṇasiddhayephalasyāsyapradīnena mamasaṃtumanorathāḥśaktādyā api dikpālānivaṃsaṃtyamarādhiyaḥnivasaṃtisadīsarvasiddheyopi jagattrayaṃsarvadevamayīṃdīsye prītomestaśriyaḥpatiḥdadyādādhāryahastānnaṃ śrīśrīśaprītikāriṇīṃsālagrāmaśilāṃ śuddhasāṃpūjya kusumādibhiḥtatsannidhāvakṣācāryakarṇayoḥ kuṃḍaladvayaṃsālagrāmaśilāṃ śraddhāṃ pūtitāṃ yātra saṃyutāṃsarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇaprokā varṣāśanadhanaṃ tu vādakṣiṇāprokta varṣāśanadhanaṃ nu vā tannyanaṃ nahi bhūyatesamarpya śrīmadaṣṭārṇasaṃsiddhiprāpnuyātparāṃvastrairābharaṇairdivyairbhojanādyairathādarātpaṃcaviṃśaṃtisaravyākaviprebhyodadhisaṃyutaṃtataḥ ṣaḍgasasūyājyabhakṣyabhojyaiḥ suvāsinīḥācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja prakṣyātitajala.,m śubhaṃupānahau ca chatrāṇivyaṃ tanānyapi bhūyateācāryāliṃganaṃ prāpya tadāśīrbhiḥ kṛtādaraḥkoṭī sahasrasaṃkhyākasvarṇadakṣiṇayānvitaṃitthametuddhataṃ sāṃgaṃ kṛtvā tatphalamaśrutetādaśīnāṃ śataṃ sāmaṃ kṛtaṃ tena na saṃśayaḥnivatātanayārūḍhe brahmarudrādibhirvṛrtaikṣā tadāditomāsimāsi svapne śriyaḥpatiṃsākṣātsvamepi vā dṛṣṭe kamalādhipatauhaṇaicirādyuṣyamanārogyaṃ bhāgyaṃ māhadacaṃcalaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvavidyādhiyatyaṃ ca jātismaraṇanuttamaṃparakāyaṃ praveśādi sāmarthyaṃ vākṣayaṃ nṛpatrailokyanāyakaḥ svāmī bhagavāniṃdirāpatiḥyāryatīnaṃdi caṃḍīśagaṇeśebhyo mahātmanāsa śobhane vā bhṛguvārayukte viriṃcitakṣannayute tathaivayogaṃ mahārājamudāharaṃti lakṣmīpatiyogamathāhuranyeālabhyarāṣaudhuhavaṣalabhyogādhirājobhūvidyārthivedaprāptāstaddaivākṣayasiddhidāḥ syuratrāpyamutrāpisadādvijānīṃsvedyā gṛhīturdvivasekṣayesmin homādikartaścavaṇan dadātisaṃprāptavidyā āpi sarvasiddhisamanvitāḥ syurnahiṃsaṃśavotrahutvātha japtvāya gurormukhāhādvadhāpi sākṣādbhāvatametiuvātha siddhimahatīṃ pitṛṇāṃ śatānvito divyapadaṃ prayātiavaśyamācāryamukhāraviṃdādṛṣṭākṣaraṃnyāsasametamādauihāpi sīddhīṃ mahatīmavāpyasidyaṣṭakaṃ cāpuraṇegatāṃ cavimānasāruhyaramādhivāṃ saprayāti vaikuṃṭhapadaṃ mahīśaanenalakṣmīśamasūtratvāsakṛdvāpi jagatpatiḥ syātsamastadevairapi pūjyamānāprayāṃti sarveśitasiddhimagryāṃjānī hi māmeva puruṃguruṇāmācāryamīśaṃ jagadevanāthamayāyirakteṇa viriciṃ mukhyairniścityaniścitya ca bhūdhabhūya uktaṃnānena yogena samosti yogaḥ satyapunassatyamidaṃ mahīśaviśeṣatoṣṭākṣarasiddhidoyamācāryasaṃtoṣaṇatonṛpālasahasramekaṃ triśataṃ śataṃ vā sadhomahāsiddhisamauprayātivailvaiścapatraistrimadhutprataṃ ca svācārya pāhāsrayugethabhūyadatvāmra saṃbhūta bhavāni sadyoramāramādhīśa mahāprasādātlakṣmīkalāpūrṇaśarīradhārīkaṃdarpasāhasrasaṃmānatejāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aghanaḥ saphalā yajñā vahuśo dakṣiṇānvitāḥvedā api ca vedāṃtā svāmeva brahmarūpiṇaṃyato vāco nivartatepyaprāpyamanasāsahatrailokyakaṃṭakaṃ vīraṃ durdharṣa mamarairapipālayitvā gajadidaṃ punarāgaccha tatpadaṃrājīvalocanaṃ rāmaṃ paśyaṃtassamupāsatesuprasannasukhaṃ śātaṃ gaurīsahita ādarātrāmacaṃdrakṛpāsiṃdhośaraṇāgatavatsalaime brāhmādayo devāḥ śakrādyāścadigīśvarāḥkapilādyā mahāsiddhā dattātre pādayopi cakiṃcidvijaptumicchāmidedānujñāṃ mama prabhoājñāyayāmāsa tathā brūhīti girijāpatiṃhitāya sarvalokānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca nityaśaḥnārāyaṇātmanaḥ sākṣāt parabrahmamayaspatesaṃsārasāgaremagnāḥ kathaṃ tvāṃ brahmarūpiṇaṃkathaṃ tuṣṭaḥ paraṃdhāma prayacchasi jagatpatevedā api ca vedāṃtāstavarū***(?) mahatmāṃ prerayaṃti brahmādyā amī ca paramarṣayaḥ*(?)tyukto bhagavāṃstatra śrīrāmojagatīpatiḥprasannavadanaḥ prāhaśaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaraṃbhagavato mama rahasyamapi vedāṃtasārabhūtārthasaṃgrahaṃtadeva me parabrahmarūpaṃ nārāyaṇābhidhaṃdhyeyosmi yogeśvara siddhasaṃghaiḥ pūjyosmi nityaṃ bhuvaneṣu sarvaiḥnārāyaṇohaṃ nararūpadhārī rudrosmi kālokādhipatiśca śakraḥsatyānaṃdacidākāraṃ nityaṃ śāśvatamakṣayaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prayāti lakṣmīpatidhāmadivyaṃ sa prīprāpyadīrghāpurarogatāvaniṇītamatyakṛṣṇarudramukhyaiḥ surottamaiḥhutvā japtvāpi vā vidyāṃmāryavātha tatsṛtsaṃsevyavatsarayugaṃ pādaṃ saṃvāhanādibhiḥvidyāsiddhimavāpyāsaubhagavaṃtaṃ prapaśyatidīkṣiṇāmūrtināpyetahītaṃ bhatyebhya ādarātakṣyayesmin dine bhūyakuruvratamanuttamaṃbhaviṣyati na saṃdehau mākusadyātrasaṃśayaṃgāṇayatyamahāmaṃtrīramāyāmanavopi cakṣetrapālakamaṃtrāścacādīmīnavopi casadyaḥ siddhābhavaṃteva saṃśayonātravidyateakṣayābhīṣṭasaṃsiddhiṃ prāptot yatra na saṃśayaḥekonatriṃśa uto yamadhyāyokhilakāmadhukbhūyopi saṃpravakṣyāmi samāhitamanāḥśūṇasārdhatrioṭitīrthānāṃ sa tridhyaṃ gautamītaremahāpuṣkarayogetradevatāmunibhissahasamastadevasānnidhyaṃ samastamunisamidhiḥāāvaṃte dvāśāhaṃ puṣkareṇa samāgamaḥekaikaṃ dinamapyatraraviyarvaśataprabhaṃstātvā japāṃdikaṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥsarvāsāmapi vidhānāmaṃtrahomajapādibhiḥmāhāpuṣkarayoyetra snātvā prātaransanyadhīḥuditetha sahasrāśau nityahomaṃ samāpya caabhyarcyagotamīdevīmurācāryamapi prabhuṃācāryānujñayā śrīmadaṣṭārṇanyāsaṃ saṃyutaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dine dine japet darvalorrāgayussastūnamaskṛtyapi gautamīprajayehnautamītīrisvācāryānajñayānvahaṃtriśataṃ juhuyādāṃtyamadhutritayamiśritaṃśrīmadaṣṭārṇamaṃtreṇa śrīmaṃtreṇaśataṃ hunetayodhyādhuracakrethalakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidheśālagrāmāśitācakre vṛccakretha vā yajetkusumairatteyenni saṃvilvapatravimiśritaiḥarcayettriśataṃ nityamupacārān samaryatsa vīyacārairabhyarcya śataniṣkaṃdinī naṃdaneācāryapādukāyugmetiṣkamekamathāpi vāācāryapādukābhāvepādakāmaṃtramādarātekaikasmin dine dadyādvanaṃ lobhavivarjitaḥavaśyaṃ tatkalaṃ yatatyautrāyāpi vāryayetavaśyamantraviddhīmānsarvasaṃyatsamṛddhayekṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ homajapādikamanukramātkāpilājyaṃ hutennedhākevalagavyameva vātataḥ śrīgurūsarūmabhyarcya svācāryaṃ harirūpiṇaṃsālagrāmaśilāṃ śuddhāṃvat kīṭavinirmitāṃabhāvevahulavyaratnīdīnāṃ mahīyateṣaṇinaṣkamathavādadyāttriniṣkavātha dakṣiṇaṃācāryāprapradātavyamekācāpiyayasvinīekāsuvāsinī vāpi śrīvadhyānityamarcayetmahāpuskarayogitrasaṃbhojyaḥ paścimedineanvahaṃ prapiveddhīmān brahmadarśanasiddhayaṃmahāyātakasaṃghaiśca koṭijanmakṛtairapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīsiddhirdaivatairapi durlabhāṃyatpuraścaraṇaṃ sāṃga mahatprāktaṃ mayā purāśrīmadaṣṭākṣrī siddhirdevatairapidurlabhāmahāpuṣkarayogesminautamītīravāsibhiprayāṃtodripuraraṇyaṃ yāvaccaṃdradivākarāmahāpuṣkarayogete satyalokevasaṃtiticaturṣṭaṣabhasaṃyuktāvaktuṃ śakyaṃ na tatphalaṃmahāpuṣkarayorgatravahmātādātmyesiddhidasūkṣmanastrapradānaṃ vaca bhagavadvaṣṭisiddhidaṃśrīmadaṣṭārṇasaṃsiddhipradasadyomahīpateyathotavidhināvarṣārjjātismāṇasiddhidaṃbhūmiyāledhanāḍhye vāṇarūpaṃ vā nanaṃsthitaḥśvetāśvadānaṃ kurvīta hasnidā na mahatphalaṃvahuvastrapradānaṃ ca dhānyadānaṃ dine dinenadārāpūrvakaṃ hānamācāryebhyovidhīyateācāryacaraṇāṃbhojedasāddevya mataḥparaṃpāritoṣikamevāsmai svācāryāyāryayeddhanaṃdātavyaṃ sakalaṃ dānaṃ nānyathā siddhibhaścyutedadhikṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ avyaguḍaṃ madhu ca śarkarāsamastasaṃpatsāgrājyasidvayuktoyamutibhākmahāpuṣkarayogetra kṛtvā siddhiṃ vrajet parāṃpaśyatyeva svacakṣurbhyā sākṣādevaśrivaśriyaḥ patisvacchaparaṇe bhūtvānidhissakalasaṃpadāṃmānuṣānapi divyāṃśca bhuktvā bhogānmanoramānpuṣpemāddivase viṣṇunakṣatrerkasamanvite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhānūdaye savijñeyoyogoddhodvayānāmakaḥsomavāsāsarayuktaścenmahodaya udīrataḥbhāskaṃrodayavelāyāṃ tadāstātvā mahodadhaulakṣmīpatisaṃmārādhyasetkāskṛte jātavedasiśrīmadaṣṭārṇamaṃtreṇatilairgavyaghṛtasutaiḥśrīmaṃtretraṇahunedājyaṃ gavyaṃ triśatamādarātjāyāhi homaṃ kṛtvāthā prāyaścittāhutīstataḥśrīśrīyatyarcayetyaścī triśataṃ brahmavidyayāṃnamaskṛtya samabhyarcye vāso laṃkaraṇadibhiḥācāryāmahāṃdadyādvahṛdaśiṇayāvvitāṃbhūdānedakṣiṇāṃdadyāṃtta yathā vanmahīpateācāryakarṇayodvedhānmuktā saṃkaraṇaṃ śubhaṃavaśyaṃgodvayaṃ dadyātyasatsaṃdakṣiṇānvitaṃbrāhmaṇānbhojayetpraścādbhojayecca suvāsinīsamarpayetkāṃsyapātrabhojanārtha sadakṣiṇaṃsamarpayedathācā itthamardhodaye kṛtvā kṛtvāpi ca mahīdayetadārabhyahariṃmāsisvame prapaśyatiprāpnotyavaśyaṃ bhūpālasaṃśayo nātra vidyatedatvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ niṣkamātrakaṃtatīdhikaphalaṃ sāṃgaṃ prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥsatataṃ varadāstasya bhavatpatra na saṃśayaḥcaturdaśīvatipātasahitāsvātisaṃghutācaturviśatibhirvarṣaiyogosaulabhyate bhuvivāsasīyaridhāyātha pitṛnsaṃtarpya yatnataḥācāyo sānnidhautasya putraṃ patnīmathāpi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣmīvidyāsusarvāsu vidyāmīṣṭatamāṃtataḥsaṃskṛtya jagātānāthaṃ tatrābhyarcyoyacārakaiḥmadhvatritayasaṃmiśraṃ gavyājya srutamādarātbhagavadraśmividyāmiṣṭatamekaikaśo hunetnamaskṛtyāpimācārya pādābja daṃḍavannabhetpaṃcaviśasalaṃ vapi viṃśatyalamitaṃ tu vācatvāriṃśatpalamittaṃ viṃśatyatamitaṃ tu vāsthūlaṃ sumadhuraṃ cataphalarāśiṃ samarpya camaṃgalavārayuktāsvātīvyatīpānayutāyadisyāllakṣmīnṛsohoyamalabhyayogaḥsamarpyamātotthaphalāni vāso yugyaṃ ca gaṃdhaguḍanīrapātraahaṃprasannocchasamarthasiddhiṃdadīmilakṣbhāvalāṃ ca vidyāṃbhogānatha divyamānuṣānprayāti vaikuṃṭhapadamamāṃtebhūtvā yatnaparonityamajjeyeddakṣiṇādhanaṃagnichomādayoyāgājapahomādayo camahīyate saphalādakṣiṇāyuktā aphalādakṣiṇāṃ vinātasmādvarmaratonityamarjadyedvanasaṃdharyakṛtvā kāryaśataṃ vāpi yogoyā dine dinemāna ārcayapatnīputrādyāḥ poṣaṇīyāne dineācāryasyājñayānitye śreyaskāmīvasennapasvarvasvadakṣiṇaṃ dadyādvarṣāśanamitaṃ tu vāravaudugrahaṇaṃ varṣe varṣepi satataṃ bhavettatrāvaśyaṃ puraścaryā kṛtvā sūryasya parvaṇiukteṣvalabhyayogeṣu saṃprāptyeṣu mahīyatevittaśāṭhyaṃ parityajya dakṣiṇāmadhamānuvākṛtvā vaśyaṃ puraścaryaṃ yoge labhye mahīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhagavatkalayāyuktassadyarāvamavatyasausāṃgadakṣiṇayāyuktā navarātravratekṛtāḥsahasrakoṭisaṃkhyākasvarṇadakṣiṇayāyutaṃpuraścaraṇakṛtyenateneṣṭaṃ nātrasaṃśayaḥgulaṃ samastavedeṣu śāstreṣvapi sugopitaṃvaiśākhe śrāvaṇe vāpi prathame bhṛguvāsarevarṣadvādaśakaṃ vā viprāṇāṃtaṃ vā mahīpateśrīmadaṣṭākṣarījasvāyāthāśaktyā sasāhitaḥtriśataṃ juhuyādravyenājyenaniyatavrataḥbhagavadraśmividyāmirekaikāmāhutidṛtjohvaprāvālairathavāśrīśrīśabrahmavidyayāaāvaśyabhojayedbhakṣyabhojyairājāyevallabhāṃbhārgave vāsarevaśyaṃ niṣkeniplārdhamevā vāsatataṃ bhārgavevāridadyāditthaṃ dhanādhikaṃācāryapatnī saṃbhojyāmāsimāsyathavādineniṣkādyaṃ vāyaṃ yeddhīmānbhakṣyādyairapitauṣayetgurupatnyā āsābhidhye lakṣmīlakṣmīśa sannidhauādimebhārgavevāre gurupādāvatorpayetprathamebhārgavevāre māsmisītthamācaretekaṃ vāmīthunaṃdadyathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇaṃicchanvratamidaṃ kuryādavaśyaṃ siddhimaśnutebhārgavavāsare prāpte prārthayitvā guruṃ vibhuṃdviguṇāddakṣiṇādeyā tadā cāyoyadhīmatākṛtvāvaśyaṃ mahāsiddhiṃ vrajatyatra nasyaṃśayaḥācāryānugrahāllakṣmīdhanadhānyādi saṃkulāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyuṣyaṃ mahadārogyaṃ śriyamṛṣaguṇā apina viyukto bhavetyalyāpatrairvāyaśrubhirdhanaiḥicchatā mahatīṃ sisiddhiṃ śroyaścāpyakṣayaṃ paraṃetaccharīrayātāṃte daśāpūrverdaśāparaiḥārūsvabhagavaddhāmaprayāsatra na saṃśayaḥśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyāsiddhiyoryadi bhaviṣyatiiti dāśarathīyesmin triṃśodhyāya udīritaḥsādhayetkāmyakarmāṇi samastāni tataḥ paradarāricārmāsigadāyārācāyeṣudhāriṇaṃsthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ vāpi kṛtimaṃcāpi yadviṣaṃravigrahaṇe prāptetaddine sagupoṣitaḥspṛśanbrāhmīraraṃvidhāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ jāpanpāragassarvavidyānāṃ māsābhyaṃtarato bhavetpalāśā kusumairhutvādaśasāhasramādarātcaturṇāmapi vedānāṃ pāragovāgvibhūtimāntulasīvanamadhyastho japtvālakṣaṃ yatavrataḥdīrghāpuṣpamavāpnoti svacchaṃdamaraṇe bhavettriśatādhikasāhasraṃ samastanyāsasaṃtāṃpaṃcaviṃśatidhānityamabhirmaṃtrya jalaṃ pivetpaṃcaviṃśatidhānityamabhimaṃtryābhamādarātpratimāsavyatīpāle yoge lakṣmīpatiśriyeśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japtvā śrīmaṃtratriśataṃ japetśrīmadaṣṭārṇamaṃtreṇa triśataṃ juhuyādathabhagavaddaśmividyābhirekaikāmāhutiṃ hunetniṣkaniṣkārdamathavā svācāryāyā samarpyayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāyāyoyayāyīdyaurapi rorogairvimucyatebhūvyā samastavidyānāṃ yāragassudarākṛtiḥvilvamūle samāsīno maṃtrarājaṃ śriyaḥpateḥhutvātha daśasāhāsraṃ rājyalakṣmīmavānyuyātlakṣamekaṃ prajaptvāthatapatrairghṛtaplutaiḥmārgaśīrṣe paurṇamāsyāmācāryānujñayāśuciḥsamastanyāsa sahitāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ śrībhātriśataṃ prajayetyaścādiṣṭamekaṃ śriyomanuṃsālagrāmaśilāḥ cakramayodhyānagarābhidhaṃpa ekadhaivobhayatrāpi lakṣmīnārāyaṇai vibhūpūrṇaṃ niśākaraṃdasūsāyaṃ sadhyāmupāsya canniśataṃjuyādagrauśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayābhagavadraśmividyābhiryatamekaikaśo hunetācāryacaraṇāṃbhoje niṣkamānasuvarṇakaṃhaviṣyāśī phalāśīvāvareṣkarmithutadvayaṃbhuṃjīta vaṃdhubhiḥ sārdhamiṣṭamannaṃ tataḥ parabhagavaṃtaṃ śriyāsārdhaṃ paśyatyeva svacakṣuṣāacalāṃ śriyamānyoti prasādārhidirāyateḥmahākavirmahāvāhrīputrapautrāyautrādisaṃyutaḥprāpnoti bhagavaddhāgaderhāte nātrasaṃśayaḥyaḥ karoti viśuddhātmājātiṃssaratiyaurvikīyogamadyāṃgasahitamajarāmaratāmapipaurṇamāsīvrataṃ puṇyaṃ viśeṣarkṣudinānvitaṃcitrāyukteduvāreṇasahitā caitraptāyāācāryānujñayā tatra snātvā prātassamāhita
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sīnāssamastanyāḥdyauvabhaṃjanī ācāryānujñayā tatra sasaṃyutāṃtriśataṃ prajapetyaścīdiṣṭaṃ śrīmanumādarātpūrṇaniśākaraṃ iṣṭvājvalite jātavedasiśrīmadaṣṭārṇamaṃtreṇa triśataṃ juhayādathaāṣṭottarathathaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śrīśrīśadvādaśārṇayādviniṣkamekaniṣkaṃ vā dakṣiṇāmaryayedathamithunatritayaṃbhojyaparedyuddhiṃtayaṃ tu vāidameva vrataṃ kṛtvā ravisaṃkramaṇānviteetadevrataṃ kurvannidagrahaṇasaṃyutaekena divasenetthemavasyaṃ siddhimānbhavetviśākhāsahipūṇīvaiśākhāmahatisṛtānaityakaṃ karmakṛtvātha samīmastanyāsasaṃyutāṃtrirātraṃ vrajayetpaścādiṣṭaṃ śrīmaṃtramādarādaṣṭaniśākaraṃ pūrṇejvalitetājātavedasiśrīmaṃtreṇahunedravyamājyaṃ triśatamādarātcatvāriṃśatpalavīpiviśatpalamittaṃ tu vāśayyāṃ soyaskarāṃ datvā yathā śaktyā sā dakṣiṇaṃsamarcya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādekaniṣkadhanaṃ tu vāmithunadvitayaṃ bhojyaṃ pare pūrvasudhāyateśrīmadaṣṭāṇaividyāyāḥ puraścaryādvayaṃ śubhakṛtetthameva savisuśāṃ krameṇaptamanviteyadīdgrahaṇaṃ tatra vai**(?)reva paurṇasī dineśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyā mahatīṃ siddhimaśrutetriguṇādakṣiṇādayā caṃdraparvasamanvitejyeṣṭānakṣatrasaṃyuktā mahatījyeṣṭapaurṇamā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryājñāṃ samādāya prāteḥ srātvā viśuddhadhīḥjaptvāyīṣṭamanuṃ lakṣmyāḥ sādhakastriṃśataṃ tataḥtriśataṃ śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyā trimadhusrātaṃbhagavadraśmividyāmirājyena juhuyāttridhāācāryacaraṇāṃbhoje niṣkamānadhanaṃ tu vāācāryapatnyai śrīvudhyāsatpālaṃkāramarpayetmithunacitayaṃbhojyattasminneva dine vudhaiḥpuraścaryātrayaphalaṃvratenānena jāyateyadi saṃkramaṇaṃ tatra paurṇamāsyāṃ prajāpatetriniṣkadakṣiṇāṃ vāpi datvācārya padāṃvujaḥāṣāḍhe paurṇamāsīyavaiśvaddaivatyasaṃyutādvaipāpanaḥ purātasyā mamūnmatvā layānvitaḥpaurṇemāsyāmāthāṣāṭhyāprātaḥsrātvā viśuddhadhīḥtarpayitvāpi hṛnyaścāt samastanyāsa saṃyutātriśata prajayellakṣmīmaṃtrami.ṣtataṃmaṃśutaṃsāyaṃ saṃdhyāmuyāsyātha madhutyritayamiśritaṃśrīmatreṇa hunet praścīdṛṣṭottaraśataṃ ghṛtaṃarcayettriśataṃ brahmavidyayākusumādibhiḥgurupādābjayugmetha dadyātriṣkadhanaṃ tu vāitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryāphalaṃ sāṃgamavāpnuyātyadi saṃkramaṇaṃ tatra kṛtvetthevratamādarātgrahaṇaṃ yadi tatra syāt sudhāśorvasudhāyateyādṛśī jāyate siddhistāmevāpnoti śāśvātoīdavāsasaṃ yuktā mūratī samudīritītatrādhāryājñāyāsrātvā kṛtvā dharmāthanaityakaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇābhidhaṃ sākṣāttamaḥpāre pratiṣṭitaṃna vratairnamahādānairnayāgairbahuvakṣiṇaiḥaśakyaṃ mama tadrūpaṃ prāptuṃ gaurīpate vibhośrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyājapahomādi tatparaiḥraśmimālālāpakaistadrūpaṃ prāptuṃ hi śakyatebhinnevabhāti lokesminmamāyāduratyayāśrutirmadvadanādāvirbhūtāsāṃgāsanātanīvāmavāhurmadīpastvaṃ viṣṇurhṛdayamevametatrāpi dahūṃ gaganaṃ viśokastasminpadaṃ tasvadupāsitavyaṃtena vācyosmi satyātmā paramabrahma śabdabhāknārāyaṇābhidhaṃ brahmarūpaṃ yattsaccidātmakaṃviśvataḥ paramaṃ nityaṃ viśvanārāyaṇātmakaṃakṣayaṃ śāśvataṃ divyaṃ vedāṃtairapyagocaraṃtadeva me mahadguptaṃ rūpaṃ jyotirathākṣayaṃpatiṃ viśvasyātmeśvaraṃ śāśvataṃ śivamacyutaṃnārāyaṇābhidhaṃ jyotistatvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakaṃ śivaṃnārāyaṇa paraṃbrahmatatvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ parāyacca kiṃcijjagatyasmindadṛśyate śrūyatepi vānārāyaṇopaniṣadāyadetetpratipādyatenārāyaṇeti mannāmayesmaraṃ tyapi saṃtataṃmatsvarūpa parijñāne yadi vāṃchā prajāpateśuśrūṣaṇa parobhūtvā prāṇairarthairdhiyāpi cabrahmavidyānusaṃdhānaṃ kṛtvā mama dine dinemadraśmi vidyāsahitāṃ samastanyā sa saṃyutāṃprajaptvā satataṃ bhaktyā mama sāyujya maśnute
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triśatādhikasāhasraśrīmadāṣṭākṣarī japetsārye sadhyāmuyāsyāthajvalite jātavedasipāyasaṃ juhuyāllakṣmīmaṃtreṇātha ghṛtaṃ śubhaarcayettriśataṃ puṣpaiḥ patrervā brahmavidyādyayāpuraścaryāphalaṃ sāgasadyarāva labhedhruvaṃpuraścaryātra ekalaṃ prāprotyatra na saṃśayaḥcaṃdracūḍāmāsinonnāyoṇai labhya udāhṛtaḥvarṣāśanamitadravyamathavāguraverpyayetāthavācāryahastā datvā samāhatī parāājanakṣātrasahitāpūrṇā bhādrapadepiyāḥtatrācāryajñayā prātarnityakarmasamātha caśrīmadaṣṭākṣīrījāptvā śrīmaṃtraṃ triśataṃ japetmadhutritayagavyājyaplutaṃ pāyasasādarātśrīmaṃtreṇahunedātyamaṣṭottaraśataṃ nṛpatriśataṃ tulasīrṣatrairarcayadvabrahmavidyāyākṣīrāśī vā phalāśī vā divasetra tataḥ paraṃpuraścaryāphalaṃ prīpyasiddhiprīpnoti śāśvatīṃphalaṃ prāpnoti somasyagrahaṇaṃ jāyate yadiphalaṃ prāpnoti somasya grahaṇṇaṃ jāyate yadiguruvāsarasaṃyuktāmaktāmahatīsāsasīritākṛtvā pūrvavadārabhyadatvācāryasya dakṣiṇaṃpuraścaryātrayaphalaṃ sāṃgamaṃtravrajatyasaupaṃcavārapuraścaryāphalasāṃgamapruyātkṛtvācārya padāṃbhoje samathotha triniṣkakārtike paurṇemāsīyāvahidaivatyasaṃyutā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāyonujñāyā tatra nityakarmasāmāpya caśrīmadaṣṭākṣaritasvāśrīmaṃtratriśataṃ japetśrīmadṛṣṭvāṇaṃ maṃtreṇa triśataṃ sādhākottamāḥrāśiṃdhātrī phalānāṃ ca saṃsthāpyācārya sa sannidhaudakṣiṇāṃ gurupāānnedatvādhātrī phalānvitaṃpūrṇaṃ niśākaradṛṣṭvā pradatvārghyaṃ tridhedaveśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidhā siddhisumahātīmapiravisaṃkramaṇaṃ tatra yadisyādvaṣudhāyatedviguṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādācāryasya padāṃvujesudhāṃśugrahaṇe tatra vratamevedamādarātcatuḥṣaṣṭhipuraścayāṃ phalaṃ sāṃgramavānyuyātbhūgavāsarasaṃyuktāmahatāsaṃprakīkīrtitatrisattādhikāsāhasraṃ samastanyāsasayatāṃmadhutritayagavyājyamiśraṃtilvadṛsānvitaṃśrīmaṃtreṇahunerājyaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ vudhaḥmithunatrinayaṃbhojyaṃ bhakṣyasūpaghṛtādibhiḥniṣkaśyaṃ pradātavya haridreṇāpi bhūpatesāyaṃ saṃdhyāmupāsyātha japecchrī hṛdayastavaṃāṣṭāvārapuraścaryāsamuddrūtāṃ vrajatyasovilvapatraissumabhyarcya triśataṃ brahmavidyayāmṛgāṃkagrahaṇaṃ tatra yadisyadva sudhāyatecaṃdracūḍāmaṇāvukta homaṃ kṛtvā sadakṣiṇaṃpuṣpamāsyarkacāreṇa sahitāyauṇaumīyadiācāryānujñāyāpyatramātaḥ saṃdhyo samāpya catriśatādhikasāhasraṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarītayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryasaccidhāṣvagniṃ saṃskṛtyavidhi ca tataḥtriśataṃ juhuyādagnau pāpasaṃtrimadhuplutaṃbhagavadraśmividyābhiḥ kuryādājyāhutiṃ tridhāḥtikadvaya suvarṇaṃ vā dṛdhāhācāryapādayocūḍāmaṇirayaṃ yogonāmnālabhya udāhṛtaḥtriniṣkadakṣiṇāvāpi dṛtvācārya padāṃvujemṛgāṃkagrahaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ yaditaprabhavennṛpaśuddhamaṃḍalaryaṃta kartasyādviśeṣataḥkuṃḍaladvayasaṃyuktāṃ pradṛtvācārya pādayoḥprāthāvaśyaparāṃ siddhiṃ vrajatyatra na saṃśayaḥmādyamāse paurṇamāso pitṛnakṣatrasaṃyutāguroranujñāyāpyatra samāṣyāvaśyakaṃ vidhiṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ jāhvā śrīmatratriśata juhuyāddhaviḥmithunatritayaṃbhojyaṃ bhakṣasūyādikairathaiutpalairarcayet paścātriśateva vahavidyayāpuraścaryātra phalaṃ sāṃgaṃ prāpnoti śāśvataṃṣaṭkasya labhate phalamuttayaṃyudīdagrarāhaṇaṃ tatra jāyate sudhāpatenayacaṃdracūḍāmaṇāvuktajapāhikamathādarātcatuḥṣaṣṭipuraścarya phalaṃsāgaṃgaṃ vrajatyasaubhānuvāsarasaṃ yuktā mahāte sā samīritājapahomādvikaṃ kārya māghavadvasudhāpatetaddeva kalamuddiṣṭamatrāpi nahi saṃśayaḥyathoktametatkṛtvāso siddhavidhaḥ prajāyatetattanmāsepaurṇamāsī mahatī sā prakīrtitāḥekasyāṃ paurṇamāsyā vā vrataṃ kartavyamādarāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yeṣu pūvasudyatsāṃgaṃ japahomādi ki śubhaṃna vidyā sidvimātyoti nāsyasiddhiti vāṃchitaṃnānarakadaḥ khānicārya ca punaḥ punāśrīmadāṣṭākṣarisiddhiyādisyāddaṣudhāyartaalabhyayoge saṃprāpte bhikṣitvā śūdrakānapisadya eva pradātavyaṃ hānadravāṃ mahīyateannaṃgrāsamitaṃ vāpi yācayennaguroḥ kuleḥprayatne nāpi saṃpādya dātavyaṃ gurave dhanaṃsadya eva pradātavyamīcchatāsiddhimuttamāṃkuṃḍaladvitayāpyātaṃ yadalaṃkaraṇamuttamaṃsadyasīddhimavāpyā saupīndṛn svargaṃ na yatyatiarddhasīddhipradāproktā dakṣiṇāmāsamātrataḥurddhaṃ māsatrayādattāniskalāmātrasaṃśayaḥpradakṣīṇā sadyau māsādvāphaladāyinīśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīti bhavartavyā phaladāyinīadhyā ekatriṃśoyamuktobhīṣṭaphalapradaḥpunarāhakṛhādevaṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ ca sannidhauyacchrutvāpīnarodhīmānasīddhīmetāṃ mahattarāṃlakṣaṣoḍaṣakaṃ proktaṃ yadyaitsadyasīddhihetukaṃtatpuraścaraṇādevasīddhiḥ kṛtayugādiṣu*** rogādoṣa vahvalatvataḥ tayā tathāśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyāmasīddhāyāṃ mahītalelakṣmīpatisādasyāleśopī na hi jāyateavasyaṃsīddhimāpnoti puraścaraṇakṛtyataḥnavarātrovrate cāpī puraścaraṇakarmaṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navarātrevrate prāpte ravīṃvugrahaṇe tathāmahāpuskarayogetrayogepyardhodayānidheyatpuraścaraṇaṃ muktamādauṣoḍaṣalakṣakaṃsarveṣvalabhyayogeṣu puraścaryā yadīrītāākṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tato daśaguṇoparāakṣayedinamātrepī kṛtvā majayādikaṃkimuktayoge sahite vaiśākhedivasekṣayeukta vaiśākhe dīvasekṣayemadaṣṭārṇavidyājapahomādibhīrnītyamācāryeṇa dīne dīnesacāsādmapi vidyānāṃ bhūyaḥ ṣīśyopadeśataḥśīṣyaśyadakṣīṇe karṇayāyāṃ vidyāṃ dadātyasauuttamāṃ dakṣīṇāṃ dadyācārya padāṃvujemadhyadakṣiṇayāsīddhirmadhyemeva vidhīyatetaśmādavaśyamācārya pādādvayugale śubheuttamāṃ dakṣīṇāmeva datvācāryamukhāṃvujātgrahaṇe naiva vidyānāṃ sadya aiṃ vamahattarāṃācāryaṇāvīśīṣyebhyasma prāpte divasekṣayesarvasvasya pradātre vā prāṇānāmapi yatnataḥācāryatapasaḥ siddhīryataḥ śīṣyagacchatitadā prabhṛtisacchiṣyaḥ ācāryasya padāṃvujegrahaṇādiṣu yogeṣu tatādṛksīddhisīddhirīrītāhomenāpī mahāsīddhīsāravedīvasekṣayemithanāni samarbhyarcyatebhyo datvātha dakṣīṇāṃtriśatādhika sāhasraṃ vā śatādhikaṃvāsu devamahāvidyāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ ca ṣaḍakṣarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taśmīdīnephalāśītavāhaviṣyāśi bhavedvratiguruḥ prasādo bhoktavyaḥ paradyurgīrījāyatepuraścaraṇakṛtyeṣu samāpteṣu tataḥ paraṃanena sarvapāpaidyanīvṛrtiḥ sīddhiruttamātapaḥ sīdvagurorvaktrācchīṣyaiḥ sādhakapuṃgavaiḥbhūyopī saṃgrahitavyaṃ datvottamadakṣiṇāṃvidyājālaṃ na dātavyaṃ taponāśīnadhīmatāvahūprārthanayādeyaṃ yogelabhye yaśaskareaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpī japatvā nītyaṃ labhet phalaṃnārāyaṇe nayatproktaṃ janakāya mahātmanesaṃpūjyaṃ dvādaśākṣaryā prajasvāṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃaṇīmādiguṇeśvaralabhate nātra saṃśayaḥdaśasāhasrakaṃ hūtvā dīyudīrghāyusānnīrāyamaasaubhāgyena yuktā pīsubhagaḥ kāmavadbhavetbhagavatkalayāyuktaḥ kāṃtimānarkavadbhavetjaḍopīparvavīdyābhīrvacasyati samo bhavetbhagavatkalayāyuktaḥ kāṃtimānarkavadbhavetyanasasya phalaidūrtvānadhūtrimadhusaṃplutaiḥhūtvā vilāphalainīrgavyaghṛtātrimadhumīśrītaighṛtatrimadhusaṃmīśrāṃ hūtvā pāyasamādarātghṛtatrīmadhusaṃmīśraihūtvā tu kadalīphalaiḥayutaṃ sutamāpnoti bhavatkalānvitaṃtulasīdassīśrairhūtvā śohūtvā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥdrākṣāphalairgavyaghṛtamadhutrītayamīśrītaiḥikṣūkhaṃḍairghṛtābhyaktairmadhūtritayāmīśrītaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaiphalaiḥ ṣaṣṭhīmītaiśubhaiḥaṣṭāṃgayogamāsādyakhecarojāyate dhruvaṃayutaṃ cittamāpnoti vāṃchīnaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥbhavatyusāvathā puṣpān dhaneśo vākyanirbhavetayutadvītīyaṃ svarṇaśarīrobhavati dhruvaṃhūtvā vā laravīprākhyaḥ kāṃtyā bhavati sādhakaḥanunadvitayaṃ paścātsuvarṇasadṛśaḥ śrīyāsarpī strīmadhusaṃmīśraihūtvā guggulubhīḥ śūcīḥayutaṃ sarkharāṃ khaṃḍairgavyājya trīmadhusrutaiśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vīdyāṃ japtvaikaṃ lakṣamādarātlakṣadvayaṃ japeyastu śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃcaturlakṣya japādāśrumahatīṃ śrīyamakṣayāṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ japtvā vastulakṣaṃ jīteṃdriyaḥlakṣadvādaśakaṃ japtvā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīmanuṃśrīyādhānadaśaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥśaṃkhādīnāṃ nidhānānāmapīyo jāyate dhruvaṃsvatyārūpaṃ pradatvā smaikalpāyusmamacaṃcalaṃpaṃcaviṃśati lakṣāṇī śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ mamuṃdivyadṛṣṭau samāsādyakāmakāmarūpī bhavatyasaudvātriṃśa lakṣajapatiḥ sīddhānāmadhīyā bhavetṣaḍvīṃśannakṣajāpena mahāvidyādhārorbhavetpaṃcāśalaksajapataḥ sīddhānāmajīto bhavetadhīroti tejaptvī divyakanyā satānvitaḥajarāmaraṇo bhūtvā devatvaṃ labhate dhruvaṃprāpnotidraṃ samo bhūtvā jarāmṛtyu vivarjitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ajarāmaraṇo bhūtvā satyaloyo bhavetdakṣīṇāmūrti dṛṣovidyābhīrdīvyadehabhākaṇīmādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ pādukādyaṣṭakaṃ tathāaṣṭādhikaśataṃ lakṣajapena niyatavrataḥbrahmaviṣṇumaheśānāmapīvaṃdya padāṃvujaḥavāpyayogamaṣṭāṃgaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ manojñatāṃavāpyadi kanyānāṃ sahasreṇa samanvītaṃbhṛtyānāmagragaṇyosau bhūtvā bhagavato mahānnārāyaṇasamaṃ daivanāstīnāstī mahīpateanyatrayoge japahomatarpaṇaḥ na tādṛśī sīddhimupaiti vipraḥnārāyaṇastayadhārīvaṃdyapūjyaśca gurugarīyānprajāpīvaṃdhyaṃ na kuryāddivasaṃmanuṣyaḥnyāsaisahāṣṭākṣaramaṃtrajāpīnārāyaṇānamasmanā evabhagavānuvāca nārāyaṇenāmaranāyake na rājñe yaduktaṃ paramaṃ pavītraṃavaśyatsāgarekūrmamahāṃtaṃ divyavarcasaṃnāhaṃ dhanya iti prāhakurmastaṃ nāradaṃmunīdhanyā bhavatya ityāhūto āpo nāradomunīḥnāradastābhuvaṃ prāhadhanyāsīti vasuṃdhanesādhārabhūtāgīrayadumedhanyāmahāmatedhanyānavayamītyāhūrnārabhūdharā apīsamīpaṃ brahmaṇo gatvādhanyosītyāhataṃ munīḥsṛjyaṃte sakalokāvaidainṛtyaṃ sanātaneḥityukto nāradovedānāhanatvādaṃḍavatvedāśca nāradaṃ prāhvadhanyā navayamītyapīyuyaṃdhanyatarāyajñā iti nāra āhatān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ijyate bhagavān sākṣādevadevaḥ śrīyaḥpatisarvaviyāmayaḥ svāmī trijagatpatirīścapitāmahastutogatvā sannidhaṃ praramātmānānāradaprāhaviśvātmādakṣiṇābhīssahetyathadakṣiṇābhīssakathaṃ dhanyo bhagavannīdīrā bhaveuvāca lakṣmī sānīdhyamūrti sa dvedaśanīdhauete vakṣaṃti vedāste niścītaṃ manmukhodbhvaḥbhuṃjahītī bhūstvāyannagāśanavāhanaḥvedā apī brahma apīsucustamucastatvaṃ sa nivīścītaṃvayaṃ lokahītārthāya sṛṣṭā bhagavate muneavaśyamapīkartavyaṃmasīdājñāvaliyasīvalīyasenarakaudyeṣu majjatyācaṃdratārakaṃsakalāyāgāsaṃpūrṇavaradakṣīṇārahītopīcadakṣīṇāyuktameva karyaṃmate *****dakṣīṇābhīsahetyuktaṃ vaco yatparamātmanāsvalpadakṣīṇayāgopīdakṣīrahitopīcayajñeśvaro yajño bhoktā sākṣādyajñapumān vibhuḥsakuṭosthe ca locavyaktaḥ paramātmā śrīyapatiḥyaṣṭavymahāyāgaisaṃpūrṇa varadakṣīṇaiḥavaśaśahitarūpa eva labhate gatiṃdarīdreṇāpīdeyasyānītyaṃ śākādīne muneviśeśataḥ kalau prāpto nārakodā namovahījapahomādīkaṃ karmakṛtvā pratyahamādarātsaṃkapamāsīmāse vā dātavyaṃ bhūtimīcchasījapahomādikaṃ tāsāṃ kṛyate yai sadakṣīṇaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatrāpīśrīmadaṣṭārṇomahaṃ naraḥtasyaiva raśmayaḥ sarvasṛjaṃvīdyāṃtiyāṃti caśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyātmāharīrnāyaṇo vibhuḥśrīmadarṇavīdyāyājapohāmādikaṃ śubhaṃnāsvamedhasadvastrairvānarahādānakoṭibhiḥcūṇāvaradakṣīṇāṃ kṛtaṃ tena na saṃdehaḥ paśyapīramāpatiṃbrahmarūdrādibhīrdevairapyasau pūjyate puneadatvācārya pādābdenasīddhīṃ mahatiṃjetsarvasvamīti tatmokṣaṃ taduktā pūrṇadakṣīṇāvastrādikaṃ ca sakalaṃ sarvasvaṃ tatsamīrītaṃathavarṣāṣanamīnadravyaṃ cottamadakṣiṇāṃaṣṭākṣarīpuraścryāsadṛśaṃ na mahāmatepurāṇajātaṃ sakalaṃ kalpasūtrādikaṃ ca yatbhagavadṛśīsahitā samastanyāsaṃyūtāyasya sīddhirthititaṃ vṛddhititaṃ vṛddhī brahmarūpīṇamacyūtaṃśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyāṃ sīddhāyāṃ divīvā bhuvīaṇīmādiguṇaisvaryasaṃpūrṇakhyātirakṣayāaṣṭāṃgasahitoyāgojātijātiśmaramaṇapyathāācāryacaradvaṃdvassalasīddhidā etadevījānīhīparabrahmaikasīddhīdaṃbrahmadarśaśaṃsīddhi hetubhūtamudirayetdharmārthamokṣadharmāṇāṃ nidānamamītikathatekathyate śrūyanityamyarcyate dhyāyae tathāsādhakaiprāpnumakṣaramanojayetśrīmadaṣṭākṣaśrīddhīyatnakartavya ādarātācāryavadanāṃbhojātsaṃprāpyāṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mama vidyānusaṃdheyāsvācāryānugrahaṃvināmadvidyā japahomādi karmānuṣṭhānamuttamaṃtatrāpyācārya pādābja śuśrūṣaṇamanuttamaṃekena janmanovāsau madrūpaṃ soṣṇute dhruvaṃmatsvarūparijñāne kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchāsibhūyopi jānakīnāthaṃ prāha lokahitaṃ vacaḥete brahmarṣayaḥ siddhāstvatprasādāptavaibhavāḥmanvādi munibhiproktamapyācāraṃ śrutīritaṃlakṣaṇaṃ gurubhaktasparaśmisūktaṃ śriyaḥ pateḥmāhātmyaṃ brahmavidyāyāḥ śrotuṃ kautūhalānvitāḥbhavatīhadvijātīnāṃ sarvametadvadasvanaḥbrahmarṣayopiśṛ evaṃ tu siddhāye ca tapodhanāḥyacchrutvācārya vadanā brahmabhūto bhavedihasārajñena mayā guhyaṃ brahmadarśanamuddhṛtaṃmedinīṃ pālayāmāsaḥ vedādhyayana tatparaḥtulāhiraṇyagarbhādyairyajan devaṃ śriyaḥ patiṃārādhayāmāsamuniṃgautamaṃ brahmatatparaṃkuṃḍaladvitayaṃ nityaṃ dadātyācārya karṇayoḥpādukādvitayaṃ kṛtvā muktālavibhūṣitaṃācāyaṃ pādukāvidyāmuccaranpratyahaṃ śuciḥpādukādvitayasyātha kṛtvā śuśrūṣaṇaṃ namaḥācāryadupādukāyugmamarcayitvānvahaṃ śuciḥitthaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi pādukādvayapūjanaṃsiddhaye brahmavidyāmavāpyādau bhagavadraśmi saṃyutāṃśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ prāptavān gautamādguroḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇamunerjanmadivasekṣayasaṃjñītesamastalakṣmīvidyānāṃnyāsadhyānādikaṃ vadhavidhānamapī saṃkṣīptaṃ śrīmaṃtrāṇāṃ pravakṣateagnivīṃdu samāyuktaṃ dvītiyaṃ vījamūdhṛtaṃbhūvijaṃmūkhakṣatatyaṃ vāyumārtaṃḍasaṃyūtaṃaṣṭākṣarī mahāvidyā mahālakṣmyādudīrītādārīdradukhasamanīsamastai sarvasīddhidachaṃdogāyatramītyuktaṃ mahālakṣmīstrayīmayīsaḍaṃgaṃ vinyaset paścācchrīyā ṣaṭdīrghayuktāpītāṃ varāṃ laṃkṛtāṃ mahālakṣmīmīti dhyātvā japennityamamemanuṃaṣṭalakṣaṃ paraścaryadutyatrairvāthapaṃkajaiḥhūtvācārya padāṃbhoje datvā vahvalakṣīṇāṃvaisākhe phālgune vāpīvāyetvā śrāvaṇepīvāsaṃkalpya paurṇamāśyaṃtaṃ paṃcaviṃśatsahakaṃdṛśāṃśaṃ juhuyādmai vilvapatraidathāpīvādakṣīṇāsahitaṃ datvā kāṃcanena vīcanevinirmīdatvā dvādaśabhuṃjīvādalaṃkṛtya suvāsīnīḥsīddhimavāpnoti vidyāyānātraśaṃśayaḥādhīvyādhī prasamanī sarvasaṃpṛtsamṛddhīyeālakṣmīkalahādhārātadgehenavatyagvacitaṣṭākṣarīṃ mahālakṣmyā japedbhāgyasamṛddhayepradipadvīramābhyanavamyaṃ tathamādarādvādaśahasraṃ kṛtvā saṃkṛtyamādarātnavamyāṃ jvalivahau śūddhaṃ gavyājyamādarātaṣṭārṇavidyayālakṣmyāmadhutitayamīśrītaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣṇvapatra samāyuktaṃ havītīlānvitaṃkarṇayopaścādvahūśyaśaudyaśaṃkulāṃsadakṣīṇaṃ tapto dedyāddhe tu dvayamalaṃkṛtaṃalaṃkāraiśca vāsaubhīrdakṣīṇābhīścabhaujanevivāharahitākanyā avaśaṃpūjayennaraḥatha vāvau ca nārūḍhāḥ yatra vatyoguṇānvitaḥvibhave satyalaṃkāraṃ tāsāṃ vā sāṃsicāryayetbhojayitvā mṛṣṭhānnaṃ dakṣīṇābhīścatoṣayetevaṃ kṛte vidhāne navarātravrajeśu **daditimahasatisīddhitrailokyanāpīdurbhāṃbhojayītvāthamīṣṭānnaṃ bhagavātyaṃkulīmahahīśrīyaṃdadāti bhagavāṃstasmaiśaṃśayonātra vidyayoyayajñeśurasedyūrīgu umīśvajalena vādhanasenasamolathā jīvaṃ bhagavatyasauaṣṭākṣarīṃ mahālakṣmyā japtvā lakṣamataṃdriyaḥsaulanatevītavṛddhīṃ ********śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā japakartādīnedīneparāsīdhaṃti yasya japato brahmedrādivībhūtayaḥvā tavahnī samārūḍhāṃ vāmalocanabhūṣītaṃviṃddhahīnaṃ vahnīyutaṃ maṃtasyadyamataḥparaṃśrīṣaḍakṣaravīdheyamuktāpapaudyabhedīnīdhanadhānyagajāścaudyamūktā-māṇīkavarṣīṇīśrīvījasahitāmaṃtrāvairīṇopi mahātmaneśrīyuktameva sakalaṃ pūjyatejagatitale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na pūjyate bhūtale lakṣmīnkṣūdravadūsudhāpatetrijagatsvapīnārcya syādbhavasyāpīniditaḥapīpuṣpaphalānvitaḥ na dṛṣṭumapīśakyaṃte******** pūjameva jagatpateabhyarcitaḥ svādbhūyādyāladevatsakalairjanaiḥsaṃpūjyate mahīpāla śrīyāyukto jagariyesa eva brahmavidyāna sa evāryo dine dineśrīyāvīrahitaḥ sākṣādbhagavānabhūpateṣaḍaśaramīdaṃ tasmācchīyodevyāḥ phalapradaṃṣaḍakṣarīḥ śrīyovidyāsargāḍhyītyaṃtakārīṇībhṛgurasyamunīśchāṃdonīvṛdgāyatramīrītaṃdvitivījamaktaṃ ca śaktirnatirudirītākṣomāvaddhaninaṃvadhīṃ valalītāṃvaderavedastītāṃśrīyamabhyarcayannīsugaṃdhī kusumādibhīḥjapāṃto juhuyānmaṃtrītilairvāmadhurāplutaiḥathavā śrīmadaṣṭārṇa catuviṃśata ṣahasrakaṃpāpasaṃjūhūyāt paścātcchīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyāmaṃtreṇāpī juhuyātāvadeva ghṛtaṃ śubhaṃsarvasvamarpayeddhīmānathācāryapadāṃvujealaṃkāraiścavāsobhirabhyarcāryavallabhā**** śrīśaḍakṣaravidyāyāḥ kṣarasya caagnīśāsuravāyamadhyadīkṣaṃgapūjanaṃhīmamītamamāleṃdūnīlāyabhatavāsasaḥvidigātreṣu pātreṣu damakādinyajedṛthāyacchechaṃkhanidhidevyādakṣiṇedayitānvītaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
