sanskrit: nyonyāliṃganaparauśaṃkhapaṃkajadhārīṇauvasuṃdhārāthastaniṃtamataḥ paṃkajanidhīṃ prīyayāsahitaṃ yajetnisaradalavarṣābhyāṃ padmābhyāṃ mūhvīlāṃchīnaudalāgreyajedevatālākyādyāḥ samatalaḥvibhīṣīṇīmālikā ca śāṃkārīvasumālikālokeśāṃnpūjayedativajrādyāstrāṇī tadvahiḥdhanyadhānyamṛddhīchīyamopnotyaniditāṃsaṃyuto maṃtrī devīṃdhāyetvārkamaṃḍinesavilasya mūlasvasya mūlamadhyāsthe maṃtravit** madhuratrayuktai juhuyājātavedasaiaśoka vahū juhuyātatpuṣpaurājatolataulatoḥjuhuyātadvalaiḥ śuddhairayutaṃ trimadhuplutaijuhuyādvaidike vahnau tadvalergaughṛtahnūtaiḥprakṣāmīmahārājakīcinmātmamīṣṭadaṃteyasyāvijñānamātreṇa palāyaṃ mahāpadaḥvātanaṃ vahnisamārūḍhaṃ vāmanetrāvibhūṣītaṃvasuṃdharākṣaraṃ paścādvāyuvaikuṃṭhasaṃyutaṃviṃduhinaramāvārṇa vaikuṃṭhavasudhākṣaraṃ paścāvāṇītaṃdrāvāyutaṃ mātṛkāṃtyarṇamavyathavedavedāṃtaśāstraughasārabhūtāsanātanīsarvavidyā vibhedinī mahābhāgya samṛddhīdāsīddhavidyāmimāṃ prākūrmunayo brahmavādinaḥdvādaśārṇa mahālakṣmīrahitāniḥ sthūlāsmṛtāḥyogīnopi mahābhāgājīvamuktājīteṃdrīyāḥsamastaṃ nivṛtyarthaṃ sarvasaṃpadavāptave
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyuyārārogyajananīmadropadravanāśīnīdvādaśākṣarīvidyāsonāsarādhya brahmadarudrādayopi caṛṣīrvraṣṭhāsyaimaṃtrasya bhṛgurvāmunīsīsyatepaścāt ṣaḍaṃgakaṃ ṣaṭdīrghayuktayālakṣavinyaset praṇavādyayāsvamurddhīmuktāralaughavarṣachatreṇaśobhītāṃsataptahemasākāśapītāṃvarayugāvṛtāṃlasadvāmākanilayānāsīnasya jagatpateḥmahālakṣmīṃ bhagavatiṃ dhyātvātha mādarātdvādaśāṇaṃ mahālakṣmyāśatamaṣṭādhīkaṃ japetpratyekamathā lakṣmīsaṃpūjayenṛpaḥcaturddhāra samāyuktaṃ catusramataḥ paraṃāgnīsāśuravāyathāmadhyadikṣvaṃgapūjanaṃsarasvati brāhmyādyā aṣṭakoṇeṣadīrghasvarṇavibhūṣītāḥcaturasrasyāṣṭadikṣuvajrādinyāyudhānīcaartayedrupacapācadyairupacārairattuttamaidaśāṃśatarpayedikṣurasenapayasāpivā**** sātāṃ sāgraṃ sṛṣṭānamapībho japetdadyāniskaṃśataṃ vāpī suvarṇakuṃḍalānītaṃācāryasannidhautiṣṭe vādyājītaṃmateṃdriyaḥprāpnoti mahatiṃ sīddhiṃ purāṇāmapīdurlabhāṃ dīkṣītaḥna navarātrābhīdhaṃ parvavarṣevarṣyemahattaraṃtatrālakṣīvidyānāmatrasīddhiṣeśataḥekaikaṃ divasattaravīparvasumaṃviduḥmahati navamī tatraccha ḍāmaṇīśataḥ prabhaḥ ekaikaṃdvādaśārṇaṃ mahāla apītatra mahāmate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japet aṣṭamyaṃ tathādarātśrīmadakṣarīvidyāṃ japedarkaśrūtirūpaphalapradaṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityamarcayt brahmavidyāyāparīcchahasamanvītaṃ rājaputrodhanyādyopīniskasāhasramarthayetcedguruverpayet sālagrāmaśīlādyānāṃ bhūdānaṃ ca dakṣīṇaṃgodānamapīśayyāpādānamāvaśyakaṃ smṛtaṃvarādyālakṣaṇaḥ saṃpūtāṃ pautrikanyakāṃdadyātsurāpāṃcasulakṣaṇāṃācāryacaraṇḍadvaṃdvaśuṣruṣaraṇaparo bhavetkaharācitākādyalaṃkālaṃ kālaiśca vāsanāathavā na vijirbhājyāsuvāsīnyo dṛśavratāitthaṃ tvāpuraścaryāṃ navarātre dṛḍhavrataḥprāpnotyapībhṛpraśaṃśayaḥ nātra vidyatemahālakṣmīrbhagavate vā tasya trayī mayītasmī saṃvatsare tasyā gṛhe ratnodyasaṃkulāguṇaiśvryamayī tasyā śuddhīsitinirāmayodīrādyusmatātu sukhaṃ medhateśreyāṃśrīśalabhate nityakalyāṇānidīnedīnegajāsvāsīsamṛddhiśca navarātramṛtādbhavetmāmevartivijānīhīsṛddhīmaṃtraṃ jīteṃdrīyaḥdivyakanyāśatākīrṇaṃ sarvabhogasamṛddhitasamṛddhīsamṛddhistādaśī bhavetnavarātravrate kṛtvā puraścaryāṃ yatavrataḥnavarātravrata samaṃnānyatsīddhīpadaṃ nṛpanavarātrenvahaṃ bhaktyāṃ navamyāṃ navaniskamaṃyatheṣṭavidhīnā kṛtvā navarātravrataṃ śubhaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svacchaṃdamaraṇau bhūtvā śrīyamaṣṭaguṇānvitāṃvāsaṃte navarātrepīkuryādītthaṃ vrataṃ śubhaṃ***** niskaṃ vā samarpyācāryadakṣīṇāṃnavarātravrataṃ sāṃgaṃ kṛtamāśvinamāsī caretnavarātravrataṃ sāṃgaṃ krīyate nāsvīneyadiyadīsūtakepīnasaṃtyājaṃ navarātravṛtaṃ śubhaṃācāryaputrairathavākārayedvidhināvrataṃtasya saṃvatsarehānirbhavīṣyati mahīpatesāṃgadakṣiṇayāyuktamavarśaṃ vratamācaretkartavyaṃ śreya icchadbhissāṃgadakṣīṇāṃ yāyukta********** vā svarṇamarpayetekasmīndivase vāpīsīddhīdavamudhāpatevaiśākheśrāvaṇe vāpīkīrtikemādyamāsi vātattadvāsarasaṃyuktā paurṇamāsya bhavedyadiviśeśātsomavāreṇasahitaṃ caṃdraparvacetamāpīsomasīhitāyogaḥ padmaka ucyatesamanvitaṃtathaiva pratyahaṃ lakṣmīdvādaśārṇajapedapīsnānaṃ kuryātsparśakāle hṛdevāpī na jījalecatuviṃśatidhā snātva vimuktaḥ pāparāśībhīḥśrīmaddaṣṭākṣareṇāditrīṃśataṃ hūyātilaiḥdvādaśārṇamahālakṣmīśuddhaṃgavyājyamādarātbhagavadraśmividyātiraikaikāmātiṃ hūnetācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvesāṣṭhāṃganatipūrvakaṃatha dvādaśaniskaṃ cāpaṃ ca maniskamathāpī vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trīniskaṃ vārpayet suvarṇaṃ niskamātraṃ vā tadardhvaṃ vā samarpayetācāryādāśīkhaḥ prāpyasvamyaṃmūnyītavāgyataḥmahatiṃ sīddhimāpnoti devānāṃmapīdurlabhāṃkṛtvā sīddhimāpnoti śāśvatī nātra saṃśayaḥitthaṃkartuḥ puraścaryāṃ sīddhivaktuṃ na śakyatetatra kartupuraścaryāṃ sīddhivaktuṃ na śatatra kartuḥ puraścaryāṃ puraścaryā śatodbhavaḥśrīśrīśānugrahātrasyatrapautādyaipaśuratnārāma yathā puṣpaṃ cīraṃjīvanahenatukaṃkavitvādyāsīddhiḥ kavitvādyāsīddhitvaiva na saṃśayaḥbhagavatyadamaṃtesyādaśapūrverdaśāvaraiprātaḥ prātvā viśuddhātmā gāyatrīṃ triṃśataṃ japetmithūnātriyaṃ tu bhojyaṃ mīthūnadvitiyaṃ tu vāācāryapatnīṃmāsādibhārgavevāsare vratiniskaṃniskādharmekaṃ vā svarṇaṃ tasyai samarpayetācāryapatnyasānnidhye bhavatsannidhau nṛpatatputrāyātha vā dadyātatyautrāyātharvārpayetkṛtvā samastavāre supūjyamīthūnānyathakuryādivyaṃ vṛdhimānyāvajjīvamathā vāramāmaraṇabrahmabhaṃ na patnyā vā na putrai vā na yujyeta vaṃdhubhīḥmuktāmaṇīgaṇākīrṇaṃ gajavājīrathākulaṃmānuṣānapīdīvyāṃśca bhogānāpnoti śāśvatāścatānkalyāṇaṃ jagatinityaṃ nītyaḥ śreyaḥ parāṃ parāṃ******** keśavasya śrīyopī cabhagavadṛśmī vidyābhīkṣādaṃte brahmaṇilīyate hūtvaikaikāmathyate hūtiṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kumudhaimairvāpī bhojayedyugma paṃcakaṃācāryapatnyaṃ datvāthasīddhiṃ prāpnotyathāthāśreyaskāmasmadākuryāṃ brahmasāyujyasīddhidaṃdvāvevatārakauloke sarvāmadbhyo nīraṃtaraṃsamastanyāsasahitāṃ śatādhīka sahasrakaṃśatādhika sahasraṃ ca prajaptvā saṃskṛtenale******** śrīmadaṣṭottaraṃ hūnetniskamekṛtarpa vā samarpacāryapādayoḥvyatipāteti kṛthvemāmekaṃ vāsarevratataṃmucyate mahāpāpaiścadāruṇaiḥavalaṃ mahadaiśvaryaṃ yogaṃ cāṣṭāṃgasaṃyutaṃsaṃprāpya cākṣayaṃ saukhyāṃ dehāṃte bhagavatyadaṃśrīddhīdaśārṇamaṃtreṇa juhuyādaruṇāṃvujaiḥvailaiḥ phalairhunedyastu sahasratritayaṃ śuciḥsthūlairgavyaghṛtābhyaktai-jvalītavaidasaihūtvā śrīdvādaśārṇaśetriśataṃ jūhuyādvṛtaṃarcayaitrīśataṃ puṣpaiḥ patraibrahmavidyayā hūtvātriniskamathavā datvā gurupatnyai tataḥ paramciṃtākābharaṇaṃ vāpīniskaṃvārthaṃ tadardhakaṃācāryādāṣīśaḥ prāpyalakṣmīśavīdyayogamaṣṭāṃgasīhītaṃ lakṣmīakṣayaṃ mahadaiśvaryaṃ dhanaratnaughasaṃkulaiathayaṃ yogamaṣṭāṃgasahitaṃ putrapautrakaijātismaraściraṃ bhūtvā yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃśrīmadaṣṭārṇamaṃtreṇahutvāṃ triśatamādarātghṛtenāhutimekaikākṛtvā śrīpatiraśmibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvācāryadadvāṃdveniṣkadritayadakṣiṇaṃsamarpya tatpareṣuścabhojayenmithunānivasabhāsupūjyatasarvabhūpālānāṃ ca sannidhauśrīmadaṣṭvārṇavidyāyāvidyāśrīdvādaśākṣarīdevatāpitṛkāyaiṣu saṃbhojyāḥ paḍiyāvanāḥehiyāva naciprāgyānpravakṣyāmī mahīyatepubhāti paṅktisāhasraṃ dvijānāmapi pāpināphunātyasauyaṅdhiśatapayipāpātmamānṛpanipaṃcadhāprajapannanvahaṃ paṅktiśataṃ sāgraṃ punātyapibrahmabhūtaḥ paṅkti śatamapi nityaṃ punātyasauapipaṅktiśataṃ sāgramassainityaṃ punātihibrahmabhūtaḥ paṅktiśatayāvamosaubhavatyapipunāti paṃkti sāhasramapi nityaṃ na saṃśayaḥpunāti paṅkti sāhasrāmapithāyavatāḥmasausādhitvāmevanārīṇāṃ pavitratvādikāraṇaṃtebhya eva sadādeyaṃ daivepitrye ca karmaṇibhasmānīvahutaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavatvatra na saṃśayaḥaśrotriyebhyaḥ pradadātiyosauvyarthaṃ bhaventasya sarvaṃ hi dānaṃanmaṃ pradatvāpyānadhīta vipre prāprotyathāṃte narakusṭhaghoraṃrohitpannaṃ dīpāmānaṃ kiṃ mayāduḥhṛtaṃ kṛtaṃācchādanairbhojanādyaiḥ pūjyā eva samṛddhayesvarṇaṃ cihuṃkamātraṃ vāhutamācāyaryādayoḥśrīdvādaśārṇasahitāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīśubhāālārpacaraṇadvaṃdvedajasarvasvadakṣiṇaḥśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyāṃ dvādaśārṇepi cāśriyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtavānniyamaṃ ghoraṃ brahmadarśanasiddhayesauvarṇapuṣpasāhasrairbhokṣyāmyahamataḥ paraṃprātaḥ samutthāya samabhyarcyopacārakaiḥjāti smarattvaṃ prāpto saupādukā dvitayārcanātanaśnanneva bhūposau japannācārya pādukāṃprārthitaḥ pitṛmātṛbhyāmapi brahmarṣi puṃgavaiḥanaśnanneva bhūpālo bhagavanyarpitāśayaḥprādādaṣṭākṣarīṃ siddhiṃ **(?) darśanasiddhidāṃathājagāmataṃ saṃbhūyaṃ draṣṭumunmattaveṣabhṛtkṛṣṇājinottarīyaśca śiṣyeṇaikena saṃyutaḥbhūtvā paramahaṃ soyaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇāvibhuḥpādukā dvitayārūḍhaṃ śiṣyeṇaikena saṃyutaṃdadarśapādukāyugmaṃ tenārūḍhaṃ mahātmanābhūyo bhūyonamaskṛtyasvarṇapuṣpairapūjayattanmastaketha dṛṣṭvāsau vismayaṃ prāpasādaraṃdṛṣṭvā na māmasāṣṭāṃgaṃdhanyosmīti muhurvadandṛṣṭvā nimīlitākṣausau pādayugme yamāhatahaathāyaśmaccharīresya sarvametaccarācaraṃśakrādīniṣṭa dikpālānsādhyāṃśca samarudgaṇānviśvametadaśeṣeṇa dṛṣṭvā macchaśuronyāḥdṛṣṭvā vismayamāpannaṣyunastatpādukādvayaṃsāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṃḍavannatvā śruti sūktairanekaśaḥapaśyat pūrvavadvipraṃ jaṭāvalkyalasaṃyutaṃācārya pādukāyugmapūjanādgurutoṣaṇātsākṣānnārāyaṇāsyedaṃ darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa eva brahmavidyegītigrahānugrahakṣamaḥtameva pūjayennityaṃ ratnairathairenekaśaḥpaścimaṃ nahiyajjanmanabhavedyomadaśajaḥācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvadṛḍhabhaktairnirataraṃdvādaśākṣiravidyāyāṃ mahālakṣmyāssadāratiḥśuddhakaivalyasahitapaścimaṃ janmanatsmṛtaṃitite kathirtalakṣmīhṛdayasyātha kathyateataḥ paraṃ pracākṣyāmi sāvadhānamanāḥ śūṇḍavyajanādyamathādvratyavaikuṃṭākṣaramapyathābrahmavījaṃ mahīvījaṃ mukhavṛtavibhūṣitaṃprasīdayugalaṃ yaścādvrāṃtaṃ vahni samanvitaṃcaturthasvaraviṃdvāṣyamaṃtastha paṃcamaṃ tataḥaṃtasthādyāmathoccārya śivaṃ dīrghavibhūṣitaṃsavitṛsvarasaṃyuktaṃ tadapaṃcasamuddharetsamastapāyasaṃ hatrīsarvādhivyādhibhaṃjanīlakṣmīhṛdayanāghrīyaṃ vidyāsakalasiddhidatathaiva lakṣmīihṛdayajāturnityasukhaṃ bhavetjñātvaitannpatrasaṃdehe nityaṃ kalyāṇabhāgasauāyurārogyajananī sarvopadravaghātinīsatataṃ suprasanneyaṃ mahālakṣmīḥ phalapradātasmāttribhuvaneśānīvījaṃ śrīvījamapyathatasmaditatsamāvidyāna dṛṣṭā kutracit kvacitaṇimādi guṇaiśvaryavradā kaivalyasiddhidāvidyomenāṃ samārādhyā prāhmavāmacalāṃ śriyaṃabhūtsamastavitānāṃ nāyakaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairapi sarvatrapūjitāagninādāhaśakṣitvaṃ nipatṛtvayamena caasyā evopāsanayā prāptaṃ pūrvaṃ mahātmabhiḥlakṣmītdayanāśnīyaṃ mahāvidhāna labhyatelakṣmīhṛdayanāśrīyaṃmahāvidyānalabhyatelakṣmītadapavidheyaṃ japtavyā vaśyamanvahaṃsevyaṃ bhajavānvahaṃ paścādvidyā śrīt dayāmidhāśrīkāmibhirviprairnajapyeyaṃ mahīyatejapedetāṃ mahāvidyāṃ mahāsiṃhāsateśvarīṃlakṣmītadapavidyeyaṃ jahmavyāvasyamanvahaṃjasavyāvahuśonityaṃ vidyeyaṃ sarvasiddhīdāādhipatyaṃ ca devānāmicchatāni yatātmanāsāmrājyalakṣmīvidyepaṃjapyate yena nityaśaḥbhūmau samastabhūpānāṃ sannidhāvanimānyatāṃyojanānāṃ sahasraṃ vā gatvācāryapadadvayesaṃsevyavahudharṣaṃ ca vidhāmenāṃ śriyonṛparājyalakṣmī mahāvidyāpradātaivamahānpitāetatkālevarāṃtepitamācāryaṃ na hityajetna śakyate mahīyālasastravadanairapisākṣānmāmevajānī hi sarvajñatyādilakṣaṇaṃācāryameva satataṃ pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥna tathāvāti medhyānāṃ sahasreṇāpi bhūyatetato ṣaṇena saṃtuṣṭaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaraṃāvāyārādhanaṃ hatvā manovāpkāryakarmabhiḥtasya lakṣmīyatirlakṣmyāsahanityaṃ prasīdati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asyā ārādhanenāśusaṃsidhyaṃti mahītaletadgahadvāritiṣṭaṃti satataṃ kiṃ karāivirudrākrodhāgninādagdhaḥ punaḥ prācetasobhavettrailokyasvargakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ ca parāṃ śriyaṃyameya trilokānāṃ mātāsarvatrapīmayīyoginopi mahānāgāmunayopiyatavratāaśvamegha samoyāgo vidyate vejjagattrayepārijātena sadṛśo vidyate yadi bhūruhagaṃgāsnānasahasrāṇi vājimedhaśatāni casarvalokasya sāmrājyamapyayodhyāpuraśriyaṃciṃtāmaṇimayaṃgahamapiralauthasaṃkulaṃkalpadrumagaśānvāpi pārijātavanānyapipadyācārya haṭhābhaktiyāmvajjīvaṃ mahīpateasyā ārādhanenāśusidhyalpasya na saṃśayaḥkaṃdarpasāhasrasamānakīrtitejasvitāṃ dhārmikatāṃ ca nityaṃavāpya divyānapi mānuṣāṃśca bhogānathāṃte bhagavanmayaḥ syātbhūtvā maheṃdrapratimānalakṣmīmavāpyamuktothā bhavatyavaśyaṃsamastasiddhairapi pūjito sau prāpnotyaśeṣānapivāṃchitārthānsamastasaṃpatsamavāsiheturnānyāstivedeṣu purāṇasaṃghesāmrājyalakṣmīhṛdayaṃ prajaptvā kṛtārthatāmāpusnutamāṃ casa eva sākṣājjagatāṃvidhātā nārāyaṇo sau bhagavān śivātmāācāryavataṃ paripūjayaṃti datvā samastānapi vīchitārthānaiśvaryamakṣapyāmavāpyamavāpyapaścānnārāyaṇātmābhagavaṃtamitidakṣiṇamūrtināgītamarhaṣīṇāṃ ca sannidhausāmrājyākamalāhṛdayākhyāṃ mahāmanuṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: putrapautrādisahitāsamṛddhirdhanasaṃkulājarāmaraṇarāṃhityemahadārogyamakṣayaṃlakṣmīhṛdayavidyāyājapahomatātmabhiḥbhṛguvāre ca puṣpārkagrahaṇādiṣu parvasuvāsobhirapyalaṃkārairgurupatnīsamarcanātcaṃdracūḍāmarṇoyogeravicū.āmaṇāvepiarddhodayābhidheyogejapahomādikaṃ śubhaṃkṛtvācārya priyāyaścāddarvapitvā vibhūṣaṇaiḥrājyapradāyarājñe vā prāṇadāyāyivaṃdhavelakṣmihṛdayavidyāyāṃ siddhayāṃ vasudhāyateyadicchedātmanaḥ śreyasiddhimatyaṃ tadurlabhāṃpitṛmātṛgurudrohakāriṇe vā'thakāriṇeprasannalakṣmīvidyeyaṃ na dātavyāmahīteparāmukhosya bhagavānmahālakṣmī samanvitaḥatyaṃtadāruśāśāyaṃ pradāsyati jagatpatiḥācaryeṇa pradātavyaṃ śubhemāliśubhedineācāryasya sakṛddhyāṃyimidhyābhāṣaṇa tatparaḥpinarnidāparo nityaṃ mūrkha ācāryarnidakaḥparityabjedamūnaśiṣyānapi srvasvadāyakānprasannalakṣmīvidyeyaṃ dātavyātaḥ paraṃ śubhāprasannalakṣmīvidyāyājapakartāramanvahaṃasurāṇī ca rājyaśrīḥśakrūṁaṃ ca durātmanāṃvedavedāṃga tatvajñodharmaśāstreṣuniṣṭitaḥiyaṃ samastavidyānāṃ sāmrājñī sarvasiddhidāśṛṇu rājanmahīpālayacchatvāmucyate nṛpa
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃdhyoyāstiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nityahomaṃ samāpya caprāṇānāyamyamūle nagāpatryāvātridhānṛpaṛṣirbrahmāsyamaṃtrasya trailokyādhimatirvibhuḥchaṃdogāyatramityuktamahāsiṃhāsaneśvarīdevatoktājaganmātāmahālakṣmīstrayīmayīpraṇavaṃkīlakaṃ prāhurathāṃgāni pravinyasetśikhāyāṃ ca prasīdeti kavacaṃ ca tribhirnyasetpṛthak aṃgulīnyāsamarpyaṃ kuryādbhapālasādhakaḥkalpadumasamākīrṇepārijātavamāvṛtpārijātatarormūle navarātravinirmitedivyākalpaśatākīrṇakālāṃbhodharasannibhaṃśrīvatsavakṣaṃsaṃdivyapītāṃvaradharaṃ vibhuṃtasyotsaṃgesamāsīnāṃte pūjāvūnadaprabhāṃvilasatyamarāgādi divyaratnavinirmitaṃatha sīmaṃta siṃdūrasahitāṃ caṃcalālikāṃmuktāratnasamāyuktavālīyugalaśobhitāṃkāmakodaṃḍasaṃkāśabhūdvayena virājitāṃmuktāmaṇigaṇākīrṇanāsābharaṇaśobhitāṃdājimīvījalasadaṃtāvalivirājitāṃsukurṇamaparcitākamuktāhāchibhūpitāṃmuktāmaṇigaṇakīrṇaṃcukenavirājitākalpabhūruhasaṃbhūta kusuprasavibhūṣitīsuvarṇakaśākārapīnīnnadyanastanīśānodī pṛthuśroṇīṃ nimnanabhisamanvitāṃkadāphalasaṃkāśajaṃ yugalābhūṣoṣitāṃ

sanskrit: saumyaṃ paramaṃ prāpyādhanaṃ prāpnotirvāchitaṃacalāṃ labhate śīghraṃ dhanadhātmākulāṃbhiyaṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā ghṛtaṃ dvādaśadhāpi vāasaubhāgyavinirmuktaḥ kāmavatsubhago bhavetdhanadhānyādisaṃpūrṇaṃ muktāratnau samāṃkulāṃkaṃdarpasadaśaḥ kāṃtyā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥgavyājya manalehutvā nityaṃ dvādaśadhāpi vāsahasravājisahitaṃ mahadaiśvaryamaṣṭuteputrapautravatīmṛddhiṃ prāpyārogyamathākṣayaṃsābhāsu pūjyate nityaṃ vāksiddhiṃ cātulāṃ labhetaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā gavyājyaṃ jvalinenalebhūtvā rājasahasrāṇanārīṇāṃ prapivallabhaḥprāpnotyāśu mahālakṣmīmacalāṃratha saṃkulāṃgaṃgāpravāhavatasya vāgvibhūtirvijṛṃbhetvaikuṃṭerametatedivyakanyāśatānvitaḥsaṃprāpya virajīvalvamahadārogyamakṣayaṃaṃprāpyaśaṃkhayamadinidhonāmadhiyo bhavetkalyāṃtamapi rājyaśrīstaṅgahanavimuṃcatidurlabhabhuvimartyānāṃ sarvakalyāṇasiddhidaṃvaidikādhāraniratovidyārallamidaṃ japatjātasyanigrahakuryāt kāmasyātargatasya caśayīta śuddhaśayyāyāṃtarūṇyā sahabhāyayāācāryapatnīśrīṣudhyāpūjayedvranasaṃcaryaiḥśrīśrīpatidhiyābhūyamithunānyeva bhojayetkamalaṃ vilvapatraṃ ca tulasīdalama

sanskrit: avaśyaṃnityakarmāṇi kuryāddedyānvahaṃ gṛhoācāryāyāryayeddhīmānnityasaṃyatsamṛddhayeśrīvidyā ca tathālakṣmīrmahālakṣmīstataḥ paraṃkhaṃḍatritayasaṃyuktāvidyā paṃcadaśākṣarīekākṣarī sadālakṣmīrmahāsāmrājyadāyinīmahālakṣmītivikhyātā sarvasāmrājyanāyikāādāvaṃte śriyo vījasahitāṣṭākṣarī śubhāicchatā sarvasāmrājyalakṣmī trailokyadurlabhāṃbhidhekartevyāvidhināphajānavarātravratādiṣutāṃvūlaṃ natyajeddhīmāsajedvāsaścakutsitaṃācāryaputrepyācāryadhiyapūjanamācaretiṣṭāprāśvānayoniśataṃ gatvā caṃḍālekṣabhijāyateparanārīṣu saṃsarga'kulepatanahetavaḥtulasīvilvavṛkṣaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā praṇatimācaretitthamācāryaniratoviṣṇupūjana tatparaḥkollāpurana mahālakṣmīślokāṣṭakamathāpi vābhārgaveṇa purādṛṣṭhaṃ ślokarūpaṃ yaśaskaraṃaṣṭādaśākṣarī vidyāmathavā pratyahe japetlakṣmīhṛdayavidyāyāḥ sīddhikāmedinedineyacchutvapinaraudhīmātsarvāpabhyo vimucyatekiṃjalkeṣu dineśapatravilasanmaṃtrākṣaraṃ tadvahiḥdharāvirbhvābhyāṃ-vaṣadurtayātvaritayāyatraṃ likhedveṣitaṃmahālakṣmīyaṃtramirdasarvaiśvaryaphalapradaṃkimatra vahunoktena paramasmānnāvidyateādāvagāni saṃpūjyavahnīśāraturadikṣu ca

sanskrit: vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇī pradyumnamaniruddhakaṃgāyatrīrpārvatīṃcāṃdrīśavīṃ dikṣu prapūjayetvidikṣu pūjayedetānsarvakāmārthāsiddhayeanurāgovisaṃvīhovijayovallabhomadaḥśakrāhīnaṣṭhadikpālān caturasrāṣṭhadikṣu caarcākramāṃtaramathovakṣyami śṛṇu bhūpatepūjayedakṣiṇeyāśvedevyāḥ śaṃkaranaṃdanaṃaṃgāni upūrvamukteṣusyāneṣu vidhivadyajetumābhūḥ śrīsarasvatyaudurgādevīratistataḥjaṅgusūryasutebhyarvyepādaprakṣālanopatedhṛtānapatravaṃruṇarvayetpaścime tataḥarghayedimājān dikṣu caturdaṃtavibhūṣitānpuṣkadaṃtaḥ sārvabhaumaḥ supratīkaśvate kramātāgamoktena vidhināstugaṃdhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥitthamabhyarcya vidhivat prasannāṃ kamalālayāāyuṣyā mahadārībhyaṃ prāpyakaivalyamaśrutesugumamapi vakṣyāmi yaṃtrarājaṃ mahīyateaṣṭhamaṃcatalekhyaṃdaśāradvitaya tataḥṣoḍaśāraṃ tato lekhyaṃ punarvṛta samanvitaṃayodhyāpuranāmedaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇabhidhaṃmātṛkālekhanaṃ kuryādvidhānenātrabhūyateayodhyānagaraṃ nāmnā mahāsāmrājyasiddhidaṃnavayonyātmakaṃ cakraṃ śrīcakraṃ ceti kathyatetripurālalitānāmnā mahālakṣmīrnigadyatenava cakrātmakīmidaṃ sarvatsaramaryaśubhaṃ

sanskrit: trailokyamohanaṃ caktaṃ caturaśratrayaṃ smṛtaṃsarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaṃ cakramaṣṭayatradvaryaviduḥvahirdaśāraṃ kathitaṃ sarvasaubhāgyadāyakaṃsarvarogaharaṃ cakramaṣṭāramiti kathyatesarvānaṃdamayaṃ cakraṃ vai devapāramaiśvaraṃtrailokyākārṣaṇākaraṃ jagadgajanakārakaṃsarvasaubhāgyadaṃbha i samastai"varyasiddhidaṃsarvasaṃgrāmajapadaṃ sarvaśatruvimardanaṃsarvaduḥkhapramanaṃ sarādhivyādhināśanaṃatra sā lalitāsākṣātpūjyate kamalālayāpūjātratrividhāprākādevavedāṃtavedibhiḥbhogāṃgākhyā tṛtīyāsyāditi pūjātridhāmatātrividhārdhātrakartavyā navarātravrātādiṣukathitāpīṭapūjeyaṃ nityasaubhāgyasiddhidāupacarya ṣaḍaṃgānāṃ nityāmapi pūjanaṃaṇimā siddhimārabhya śrīdevīpūjanītimaṃtrividhā cātukurvāṇe māsamekaṃ tu vā nṛpacaturviṃśati saṃkhyākairūpacārairathāditaḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇai savamithunāvaraṇanvitauasmintaṃtre mayā prokte vedasārārthasaṃgrahecakrasya pūjāvistorodvitīyeśe pravakṣyateatra sā kathyate vidyā caturvargaphalapradādaśadhāpi smarannūyanityaṃ siddhimavāpnuyātsarvavedamapraproktaṃ sarvadvamayataṃthāyena prapūjyate nityaṃ sa eva bhagavanmayaḥ

sanskrit: āsanaṃ kalpayāmāsayogiveṣadharasyahiarghyapādyādibhirdivyagaṃdhaiśca kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥācāryapādukāyugmamagnebhyarcyaiva śaṃkarauvāca vacanaṃ bhūyaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuraṃ sthitaṃtattaddāsyāmi bhūyopi prārthitādadhikaṃ phalaṃkimanyadvarayebhīṣṭaṃ sakalaṃ prāptamadya meācāryapādukāyugmapūjāpratyahamastumetvadvidyābhajanemestudṛḍhābhaktissadā mamaprāhanārāyaṇoyogīnareṇasahito vibhuḥtatadastu mahīpāla nityamācāryasevayātvatayaḥ phalataḥ sarvetvadanyapa sa muktvāḥahaṃ dāśarathirbhūtvālakṣmaṇānucaro bhuviśrīryācidrūpiṇī śaktirmamavedeṣu viśrutāavāpta sarvabhāgyastvaṃ bhūtvā vigatakalmaṣaḥityuktvā bhagavāṃstūṣṇīmāsīnaḥ samyagāsaneprasādābhimukhaṃ vīkṣya ****(?) sanātanaṃuvāca janakorājā kṛtāṃjaliridaṃ vacaḥhitāya sarvalokānāṃ kiṃcidvijñaptumudyataḥgurupādābja śuśrūṣā kartavyā kathamādarātvidhinā kena kartavyaṃ tvadvidyābhajanaṃ vibhopṛṣṭametattrijagatāmupakārakamādarātyatatsatyaciānaṃdamakhaṃḍaṃ brahmanirguṇaṃsaguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ ceti rūpadvitayamuttamaṃsaccidānaṃdamadvaitaṃ jyotirūpaṃ parātparaṃsaguṇaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhāra sthitikāraṇamadbhutaṃ

sanskrit: godāvavarī bhīmararthākāverīkṣaṣyaveṇikācakrarājasya sannidhye nivasaṃminaṃ saṃśayaḥācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ dṛḍhabhakto yatavrataḥlaghukracakraṃ vṛhaccakramayodhyā nagaraṃ tu vālikhitaṃ kāṃcaneraupyetāmre vā bhūrjapatrakeetādṛśīmahavidyosarvasākrājyasiddhidāsaṃpadassarvadevānāmapi yogaratātmanaṃkinnaraṇāṃ ca siddhānāmasurāṇāṃ ca bhūyatesaptadvīparghātaṃ tvaṃ vā gajāśvarayasaṃkulāsiddhatyasya na saṃdehaḥ prasanna śrīasādataḥśṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi samāhitamanāḥ śṛṇuna siddhiḥ kathyate loke siddhiṃ kuryātataḥ pumānna siddhiḥ sarvamaṃtrārṇakathyate puruṣarṣabhapūrṇadakṣiṇayāyuktā sa sadyassiddhimaśrutaṃna tādṛśaphalaṃdāna sahasreṇapi labhyateviśvātmāyajñapuruṣe ekaeveti kathyatepatnībhagavataḥ sargasthitisaṃhārakāriṇīupāsya bhagavadrūpaṃ saṃprāpnoti hi nānyathābrahmatādātmyasaṃsiddhiḥ śrīśrīśopasanavinānārāyaṇaṃ trijagatāṃpatimacyutamīśvaraṃmahālakṣmīmupāsyātha brahmatādātmyasiddhibhakbhaktāḥ putrā iti jñeyāḥ śriyaścakamalāyatemātaraṃ sarvajagatāṃ mahālakṣmīharipriyāṃta eva bhagavatputrāmahālakṣmyāḥ sutā apiprāsannakamalāvidyāsiddhāyasyamahītale

sanskrit: prasannalakṣmīvidyāyāssidhyaniyatavrataḥsadyassiddhimavāpnoti mahatīṃ nātra saṃśayaḥpuraścaryā kṛtoyanagulīlaghī ca vā nṛpaācāryaḥ pūjyate yatra puraścaraṇakarmaṇitatpuraścaraṇaṃ sāṃgaṃ sadyaḥ siddhipradaṃ bhavetkoṭiśo vipuraścaryā niṣphalā sā prakīrtitāācāryapatnīmathavā tatpautramathavārcayetarcayedbhātaraṃ tasya pautrābhāvemahīpatesannidhāvarpayitvātha satpātrāya samarpayetvidhināpi kṛtānīhamahānānibhūriśaḥśuddheti yāvane deśepuraścaṇamācaretyatra sālākanaṃndābhūrnigatāhimavadgireḥtīrtharājaḥ prayāgotrayamahāsiddhidharaḥ smṛtaḥayodhyāmathurāmāyākāṃcikāvaṃtikāpurīgokaṇanaiviṣam puṇyaṃ kurukṣetramataḥ paraṃprabhāsaṃsiṃdhutīraṃ ca padmanābhamataḥ paraṃsatdyāvalomaheṃdraśca malayaḥ śrīgiristathākubhakoṇaṃ setuvaṃdhodakṣiṇemathurāpurīatha siṃhācalādīnipurāyakṣetrāṇibhūtalegaṃgātīraṃ sarasvatyāyamunāyāstaṭaṃ paraṃsuvarṇamukharītīraṃ sa godāvarītaṭaṃkṛṣṇaveṇītaṭaṃ śuddhesadyassiddhipradāyakaṃuktānyetanilokeṣu sadyasmiddhikarāsmitvimatyadepi na siddhiḥ syādvinācāryasya sannidhitadeva sarvavidyānāṃ siddhidaṃtramīritaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasannalakṣmavidyāyaḥ puraścaṇāmācaretvipradrohamasūryā ca niṣiddhānnasyabhakṣṇaācāryaniṃdāpatrasyātadeśaṃ ca parityajetbhātaraṃ svasutaṃvapi patnīputrīmathāpi vāācāryaniṃdākartāraṃ yadiśakte na daṃḍayetkiṃcānena kṛtaṃ yāgaśataṃ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaṃbrahmahatyādipāpānāṃ manvādyaiḥ paramarṣibhiḥācāryaniṃdāpatra syātaṃ tyajedaṃtyajaṃ yathāsaptadvīpapavatī pṛthvīdhanadhānyaudyasaṃkulāṃniṣkamātraṃ pratijñātamapyācāryāpabhūpatebrahmāṃḍakoṭidānāpātrabhūtebhya kṣādarātmāsānmāsadvayādvāpi tribhirmāsairathāpi vātadarṇabdaddhisahitasyavāṃna smādācāryayādābja dṛḍhabhaktoyatavrataḥsidhyarthaṃ brahmavānādaupuraścaraṇamācaretdaivatairapi pūjyaḥ syādvidyāsiddhomahītalebhuṃjānovāhaviṣyānnamekabhaktāśanopi vāpaṃcagavyāśano vāpi nityasrāpī jiteṃdriyaḥadhaḥśāyī brahmacārī sahoṣṭhīniratassadāācāryasannidhī kṛtvasādhayedgavatpriyāṃlakṣadvayaṃ syāttretāyāṃ trilakṣadvāpareyugekṛte yuge sadā viprāvedādhyayatatatparāḥgurvarthemeva satatamarjayaṃti dhanaṃ vaddhaagnihotroratā nityaṃ yajvānodhūri dakṣiṇaḥprāṇairathairthimācāpi svācāryārcana tatparāḥ

sanskrit: tasmallakṣadvayaṃ proktaṃ tretāyāṃ siddhaye śriyaḥtasmāllakṣatrayaṃ proktaṃ yugedvāparanāmakeśrautācāravihīnāśca mithyā bhāṣaṇatasyādāḥācāryaniṃdāśravaṇaritāḥsvayaṃ naṣṭhāḥ parāḥ srūṣṇīṃ nāśayaṃti pratārakāḥdaṣṭācāryarpinaṃdaṃti maṃtronāstyapadaivataṃbhagavanmayamācāryaṃ bhogasvargāpavargadraṃpitaraṃ mārararmapityajaṃtyeva kalau yugeprāpte kaliyugedyeriyugyadharmo mahīyatedatyajaṃtimatsaragrastā ācāryahohakāriṇaḥvedikācāryatāṃtrikācārajatparāḥsvapūjārthamathācāryāsapiśāstreṣvapāragāḥnyāsayaṃtradhyānasūktamajñātvāpi mahāmanūnitthaṃ kaliyuge ghore mahāpātakisaṃkuleekesti bhagavadyiṃtātasarovijiteṃdriyaḥācāryacaraṇardvadvaśuśrūṣākṣīṇakelmaṣāḥkaveḥ pātakavāhulpyāraprasannaśrīmahāmanoḥcāturlakṣayaṃ kṛtvā evokti vidhināśuciḥtadaśāṃśaṃ hunedājyamadhutritayamiśritaiḥsuvāsinīśataṃbhīrjyaviprāṇāṃśatamapyathaācāryacaraṇadvādhanarāśisaṃmayetamarairapi pūjyaḥ syācchiyaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣāśrūyate dūrato vā vārtasaśatayojanagāpi cakaiṃkaryartasya kurveti maheṃdraghamarā apisvayamevāsya vaktrābjāntirgadyatinasaṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadāti vaḍgalaṃ dradhyayāvadīpsitamakṣayaṃnāṣṭākṣarī samāvidyāsadaśīramayānapāmahavīyaṃ puraśvaryāsāṃgāsaṃpūryādakṣiṇāalpāpuṣpānmanuṣyāṇāṃ cāṃcalyānmanasopi caiḍuvāsarasaṃyuktāpauṇīmāsīpadābhavetravivārayutāmāvāyogoyaṃ padmakaḥ smṛtaḥcaṃdracūḍamaṇiḥ prokto ravicūḍāmaṇistathāekabhaktāśanonityamadhaḥśāpī jiteṃdriyaḥvārṇanyāsaṃyutāṃ vāpi śatādhikasahasrakaṃtriśatāvika sāhasraṃ japtvā śrīhṛdayastavaṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhāṅgatvātedamātrādyajaṃgavāḥprasannabhagavatpatnī-vidyayāṣyetaraṃ śataṃcaṃdraparvaṇisaṃprāpteravipavīṇivāpyathavidhivat saṃstūtevṛhauvaṃdamātrādyataṃ garvāaṣṭottaraśataṃ ūtvā vilvapatrairghṛtapnutaiḥlakṣmīhṛdayamaṃtreṇa śatādhika sahasrakaṃprāyāścitāṅgānī kṛtvā prāṇamyāgnimataṣparaṃarpayet sakalaṃ dravyamapi svagṛha saṃsthitaṃathavā kuṃḍalayumaniṣkadvādaśasaṃyutaṃkarṇalaṃkāramanyaṃ vā yāvacchakyaṃ samarpya caṣaṇnikamtha vā ityāniṣkatrayamitaṃ tu vā || 113 |||yathā śatmāsemābhyarcya vāsolaṃkaraṇādibhiḥanaṃtaramathācāryapūjāyāvasudhāyotadatvā bhukteṣu vipreṣu dāsaṇī ca samarpayetācāryānugrahātsadyassiddhimāprovyanuttamāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryāya mahīdaṃdyādvahusya samanvitāṃprasannalakṣmīvidyāyāssidhyarthamatha vā nṛpapūrvokta dakṣidadyādvāsolaṃkārasaṃyutāṃācāryacaraṇardvadve tata dakṣapātāṃ vrajetcūḍāmani prasannalakṣmīvidyāyāssiddhiṃ sa labhate parāṃacalāṃściyamāpnoti śāśvatīmanapāpinīsaubhāgyaṃ mahadāsādyasamaddhiyaṃtrapautrakaiḥitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryāṃ grāhaṇe ravicaṃdrayoḥjātismaraściraṃ bhūtvā dhanadhānyājākulāputrapautravātī mūrddhividhī sumahatīmapiateva sati vaikuṃṭhe kulasāhasrasaṃyutaḥekaikaṃ divasaṃ tatra cūḍāmaṇi samaprabhaṃprasannalakṣmīvidyeyaṃ tatrāvaśyaṃ phalapradāmahatī navamī tatrāyā proktā paramarṣibhiḥbhaguvāsarasaṃyuktā vaiśvadaivatyasaṃyutāācāryājñāmanuprāpyaprathame pratiyadineabhyasyatriśataṃ vāpi vidhivājjvalitenaleśrīmadaṣparṇayāyaśvādaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hunetdivase divasepītyaṃ homakarmasamāpyā casāmrājya śrīmahāvidyāmetāṃ paṃcaśatādhikaṃyadvā dvādaśasāhasraṃ saṃkalpya navasatrakeātharvaṇaṃ mahuḍgardyalakṣmī hṛdayamiṣadaṃbhojyāḥ suvāsinyo mahālamīdhiyātṛpaaṣṭaviṃśatidhāṅgatvā vedamātrāpuroghṛtaṃsāmrājyalakṣmīmāvādyasamabhyarcyopacārakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triśatādhikasāhasramiṃdirāviyāhunetvilvapatrasasāyuktaṃ tilaiḥ kṛṣneḥ samanvitaṃlakṣmīhṛdayamaṃtraiścallokarūpairataḥ paramalakṣmīhṛdayamaṃtraiścallokarūpairataḥ pasra tataḥ paraṃjapādihomaṃ kṛtvātha prāyaścitāhutastataḥācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ sāṣṭhāṃgaṃ praṇipatya cagodvayaṃ dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ samarpyācāryapādayoḥsahasraṃ śataniṣkaṃ vā tadarthaṃ vā tadardhakaṃpaṃcaniṣkasuvarṇaṃ vā triniṣkavātha sadgurāḥsamarpyācārya patnyai ca vāsa ākalpasaṃcayaṃācāryasannidhau tasya patnī putrādyasannidhauācāryapatnīputrāṇehṛtaddhanaṃcaturvaṣabhasaṃyuktaṃ kuṃḍaladvitayānvitaṃbhojyājathasuvāsinyodvādaśa brāhmaṇā apiprasannalaptamī vidyāyāmahatīsiddhimaśrutekṛtvakāryaśataṃ vāpi dravyaṃ pādyayatnataḥsapūrṇadakṣiṇānaṃ kāryaṃ siddhimabhīpsatāpuraścaryāśataphalaṃ sāṃgamāpnoti niścitaṃyādṛśī jāyate siddhirnavarātravrate śubhenavarātravrataśaṃśopasyapuṃsaḥ prajāpatenavarātravrataṃ kṛtvā vidhinā sāṃgamādarātmahṛdārogyamāsādya dhanadhānyaudyasaṃkulāṃacalāṃ labhate lakṣmī trailokopisudurlabhovrasatyeva na saṃdeho dhandhānyādi saṃkulājaptvā paṃcaśataṃ protaṣṭāviṃśamidhāghṛtaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: itthamācarataḥ puṃsobhāgyarāśiḥrmadimanejāyate dhanadhānyāśvagajaralasamākulākaikaryaṃ prāpnuvaṃtyasya sarvenapavarā apiitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryāmanvahaṃ prātarādarāttatrā calājayaśrīḥ syāt sanmānaṃ pauruṣaṃ yaśaḥvaṃśābhivṛddhirācaṃdramārkumasya bhavedvudhaṃasādhyāmāpi devānāmapi dvīpāṃtarasthitaṃkulasāhasramuddhatyamagraṃ ca narakārṇavevāsaṃte navarātrasya puraścaraṇamādarātatha vakṣyami bhūpālasādhanātaramiśrāvaṇekārtikevāpi mārgaśīrṣetathaśvineprathame śuklapakṣasya svācāryājñāpurassaraṃprajahvatriśataṃ vāpi jvalite jātavedasiśrīmaraṣṭārṇamaṃtreṇāpyaṣṭhāviṃśātidhāṅganathutyāgavyaghṛtaṃ śuddhaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇau yajettriśatādhika sāhasramiṃdirāhṛdayaṃ japetmithunadvitayaṃ vāpi yugmamekamathāpi vāprasannaśrīmahāvidyāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ japetśreyaskāmojecchucchaḥ pratibhārgavavāsaraṃśrāvaṇe pūrṇimoyāṃtabhārgavevāsare śubhehutvā triśatamājyena pūrvavat prajapetataḥniṣkatrayaṃ dviniṣkaṃ vā niṣkamekamathāpi vātatrāpi triśataṃ hutvā lakṣmī hṛdayavidyayāmārgaśīrṣe pauṇaimāsyāṃ lakṣmīhṛdayavidyayāpūrvavadakṣiṇaṃ dadyāt svācārya caraṇadvaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: itthaṃ kṛtvā bhṛgorvārevratamatyaṃdapāvanaprāpnoticirasmāpuṣpaṃsamastāssaṃpadopi caavāpya mahatīlakṣmīsaṃtativyāpinīmapidivyāṃjanamavāpnoti siddhidarśanahetukaṃbhogānaṣṭavidhāścapi samāsādhāti durlabhānihāmutrāpi saṃsiddhimicchatāniyatātmanāanuttamaṃ yaśolābhaṃ japalakṣmīmacaṃcalāṃviśeṣeṇa vrataṃ kāryaśreyovṛddhikaraṃ nṛpaśaktaśca navarātrādivrataṃ sakalamācaretprasīdati na saṃdehassatyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyahaṃpūrvamuktāmayābhūyasāhāsiddhidathinīipsitā nāmasādhyānāmapi siddhistato bahvetgrahaṇena samaḥ puṇyakālonāstijarīttrayena saṃtyājyamiti prāhumunayo brahmavadinaḥsamastadānaṃ saṃghānāṃ mahākālassa eva hijapahomādikaṃ sarvata trākṣayaphaladaṃgraṣuṇeṣu puraścaryākāryāsīgāsadakṣiṇāsamastāriṣṭaśamanaṃ varṣe varṣe na saṃśayaḥnavarātravrate vaśyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥbhṛguvāravrataṃ proktamavaśya sarvasiddhidaṃcatvāriṃśopamādhyāya uktassarvayaśaskaraḥsādhayetkāmyakarmāṇi samastāni mahīyatelakṣamekaṃ prajaptvaimāṃ vidyāṃ sakalasiddhidāṃhutvā tatra samāpnoti dhanaratnaudyamakṣayaṃmadhutritayagavyājyasaṃplutairmaṃḍaladvayaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sākṣātsvapnepi vā paśya sau vigrahadhāriṇīṃjāyate tadgahe sadyo mahatīdurvabhāpi caaruṇaṃbhohahairnityamaṣṭottaraśataṃtrayaviramāpuṣpamāsādyasaubhāgyamacalaṃ śubhaṃcaṃpakaijuhuyānnityamaṣṭottaraśatatrayaṃmaṃḍalenīnasaṃdehaṣkaṃdarpasamakāṃtimānrājyalakṣmīmavāpnoti svānvāpavyayinīṃ nṛpamaṃḍalaṃ jvalite vahno hutvānniśatamādarātsāṃgāssamastavidyāścanirgacchaṃti mukhāṃvujātnirāmayo sau dīrghāprabhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥvaśīkaroti bhūpālānatha tatkiṃkarānapihutvā yutaṃ vipraḥ paśyatyeva haripriyāṃguḍucīrājyasaṃsiktā juhuyāt saptavāsaraṃhutvā tilairghṛtābhyaktaidīrghamādyuravāpnuyātśālībhirjuhvatonityamaṣṭottaraśatatrayaṃprasūnairjuhuyānmaṃtrīllakṣmīvallīsamudbhavaiḥmahatī śriyamāpnoti mānyate sarvajaṃtubhiḥsamṛdvairājyasaṃyuktairapūvairījyatolataiḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ maṃḍalādvanadobhavetjapāpuṣpāṇi juhuyādaṣṭottarasahasrakaṃtilakaṃtanupātena sarvavaśyakaraṃ paraṃjātīpuṣpaiyātāścavaiśyānaraktaut-palaiḥ śubhaiḥpuṣpairmanohau hutvāvaśamānayatistriyaḥabhikaṃ prakurvīta vidhināsarvasiddhayeśubhalakṣaṇān caṃdanāliptasarvāṃgānkūrcākṣarasamanvitān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saguṇasya mamodbhūtāvadanācchutirāśayaḥajñāchedī mamadrohīdehāṃte narakālayaḥnārāyaṇapadaṃ nityaṃ dehāṃte praviśatyasauācāryapādāṃvujasevamāthanārāyaṇānugrahabhāgasau bhavetteṣuniṣṭhassadācārayutomadbhajanerataḥācāryapādukāsevāpurassaramathādarātsamastanyāsasahitaśrīmadṛṣṭāsarīṃ japanbrahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprasthopi saṃtataṃdevatāṃ maṃtrarūpiṇyo maṃtrāvedeṣu saṃsthitāḥsarvavedamayā viprāḥ sarvadevamayo hariḥpṛṣṭo vadarikāvāsīprāhanārāyaṇo vibhuḥsadācāraṃ parabrahmāparokṣajñānasiddhidaṃācārāvyāpyane saukhyamācārāt prāpyate yaśaḥadhītyavedānvedau vā vedaṃ vā śaktitodvijaḥrajanī prāṃtayāmasya pūrvārddhaṃ brāhmyanāmakaḥsaṃdhyāparārdhakālaḥ syāccaturnāḍī mahīpatejananīcaraṇau smṛtvā sarvatīrthottamottamaucaraṇau paṃcadhā smṛtva śriyaḥ patimathācyutaṃgajāsyamatha saṃsmṛtya viśveśaṃ pārvatī vibhuṃaruṃdhatyādi sādhvīśca devarṣīnnāradādikānkavīvālmīkimukhyāṃścatvadādīndvayatinapikiṃ karānyāyuputrādīnmahādidṛḍhānvasuṃdharāṃ namaskṛtya daṃkṣaṃ pādaṃ mahītaleprāṃjaliḥ svagurūnsarvānnatvā brahmaviletanaḥdhyātvā tatpadakamalagalatpīyūṣa viṃdubhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sudhātīrthavaribhirāpūryasugaṃdhibhirataḥ paraṃmadhyakuṃbhokṣityapreyaṃtrāvyaṃdeśikottamaḥkuṣṭhāgarutamālailābhāgaṃ saṃghṛṣyabhāgtaḥlakṣmīharvāsadābhadrāsahadevīmadhuvratāgumudgagodhūmavrīhoścaivatilānupavāndhānīpikucavilvānokadalīnārikelayoḥpadmasaugaṃdhikajāti mallikāvakulaṃ tathāpallavānivadyeśvatyahyakṣoduṃvaraśākhilāṃkuṃbhavaktāṇi vastrairācchādaye tataḥyajedumādhāḥ śiṣṭeṣṭhakaleśeṣṭaṣṭasukramātnaivedyabhakṣyabhojyadyaistānspṛṣṭā prajayenmanuṃtrisahasrājapasyāṃtai sādhyamānīyedeśikaḥramyairābharaṇaivastrairalaṃkṛtyatamādarātarcitānāṃ dvijātīnāmāśīrvādapurassaraṃmadhyasthaṃ kuṃbhamudvatmamahālakṣmīmanusmaranvā karūktamukhyaiḥ sūktaiścavaichavaiḥkeraṇasyaśiraḥsyaṣkā prayuṃjītāṣiśaṣauguruḥprasīduturakṣatutvāṃ sādādevī saṃpadassatusarvadāathotthāyābhiṣaktaḥ sanvāsasoparidhāya cagaṃdhādyairapyalaṃ kṛtya svātmānaṃ sadhakastataḥdāsīdāsaiśca vidhivatoṣayediṃdirādhiyātadākṛtarthamātmābhaṃ bhāvayedgurvanugrahātpadecchuḥ padamāpnotirījapujonasaṃśayaḥmahārogeṣu jāteṣu kṛtyāṃdeheṣu deśikaḥsarvasaṃpatkaraṃ puṃsāṃ sarvasaubhāgyasiddhidaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhiṣekamimaṃ prāhurāgamārthaviśyādāḥmāhadāpuṣparogyagejān ratnānivājinaḥathāparamahālakṣmī hṛdayasyāsya sādhanaṃvaiśākhemāsi saṃpropte amiṇupha siddhideācāryasyājñayā prātasrātvā saṃdhyāyussaraaṣṭāviṃśatidhāhutvādedamātrāghṛtaṃ garvāprasannarājyalakṣmyāthayanasasyaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥtriśatādhikasāhasrajuhuyānniyatavrataḥpratyekaṃ pānasairhutvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ phalaiḥekaikaśastatohutvā prāyaścitāhutīstataḥācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ saṣṭhāṃgaṃ praṇipatyatya capadmarāgasamāyuktaṃ pradatvācāryakarṇayoḥatha vā karṣemānenataptahe āvinirmitaṃācāryavallabhākarṇayugmaidadyānāhīpatedatvā śrīcaṃdanaṃ sūkṣmavāso yugasamanvitaṃdaṃdyādācārya sānnidhye vahudakṣiṇayānvitaṃpaṃcaviṃśoyugaśatinirṣkavāniṣkadvādaśakaṃ tu vābrāhmaṇanbhojayet paścatpaṃcavāpi suvāsinīḥtauṣayedakṣiṇabhiśca brāhmaṇānvasudhāyateācāryāliṃganaṃ prāpyatadāśībhiḥ kṛtādaraḥmāsmādarvādgasaṃdeho brahmarudrāvivaṃditāṃaṇimādi guṇaiśvaryaṃ jātismaraṇamuttaṃśriyamāsādyabhuktvābhogāśca durlabhānbhūyo'pisādhanaṃ vakṣye mahāsiddhipradāyakaśāpādurvāsaptonaṣṭaśriyobhagyavivarjitāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samudramadhanaṃ cakruramṛtonmathanāpateapi yatra vacatāṃ teṣāṃ nāvirāsītrapīmayīsurāsurānirāhārālakṣmīhṛdayanāmakaṃsamudramathanaṃ cakrurharīnāya mahāśriyaḥāvirāsīmmahālakṣmīssasāmudrājjagadaṃvikāsahasrapatrakamalamālyayuktā trayīmapīdṛṣṭvā bhagavato vakṣyasthalaṃ prāyasanātānīsamastasaṃpadādhārā abhabhavanvasudhāyetśṛṇudhvaṃ brahmarudrādyāḥ śakrādyāśca saharṣayaḥnāmnā kārtikamāsesminyomāmartṛsamanvitāṃyosminmajjanmadivasobhāmarccayati suvrataḥvasāmi maṃdire tasye dhanaratnaughasaṃkulārahasyabhayi vakṣyāmi sarvasiddhikaraṃ paraṃārabhyācāryayādābjadvitayaṃ praṇipatya casahasraṃ triśataṃ vāpi prajaptvā vedamātaraṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā vedamātrāghṛtaṃ juvāṃājyaṃ prasannāramapādunedaṣṭottaraṃśataṃsaṃkalpyatadaśamyaṃtaṃ japedekakāmamānasaḥsaṃkalpyārka sahasrāṇi daśamyaṃtaṃ japecchiviḥdvādaśākṣaralakṣmī vā śrīṣaḍarṇamathāpi vāekādaśīdinaiyaścādācryājñāpurassaraṃācāryacaraṇādvamdvaṃ sākṣyaṃgaṃ praṇipatyacaaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayātriśatādhikasāhasraṃ kamalairvākuśeśayaiḥlakṣmīhṛdayamaṃtreṇa juhuyāt sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmābhavevilvadalairgavyājyamadhumiśritaiḥtulasīmiśritairvilvadalaiśvakusumaiḥ śubhaiḥtriśatādhikasāhasrāmāvītadbrahmāvidyayābrāhmemuhūrte utthāya srātvātha dvādaśīdineaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā gāyatryāghṛtamādarātaṣṭottaraḥ śataṃ paścatpadmairmadvidyayā hunetbhagavadraśmibhiḥ yaścodakaikāmāhuniṃ hunetathācāryadadvaṃdvaṃ sāṣṭhāṃgaṃ praṇipatya capadmarāgasamāyuktaṃ kuṃḍaladvayamarpayetvāso yugmaṃ samarpyātha kṣaumaṃ kāpī sameva vāsavatsagaudvayapunāṃvahudākṣmiṇayānvitāṃdhanāḍhyorājaputraśca dadyāt sāhasradakṣiṇāṃpaṃcaniṣkacaturniṣkaniṣkavayamitaṃ tu vāācāryapatnīmabhyarcyavāsolaṃkaraṇadibhiḥdakṣiṇābhiścatāṃ kūlaistauyeddevatādhiyākātikenasi kṛtvetthaṃ vratamatyatapovanaṃmahatīsiddhimrāpnoti sadya eva na saṃśayaḥavaśyaṃ maṃdabhāgyasya sannidhautasya saṃtataṃśaṃkhādīnāṃ nidhānānāmādhipatyaṃ ca śāśvataṃakṣayaṃ mahadāregyamakṣayāpuṣpamapyathaakṣayaṃ sarvasaubhāgyaṃ dadāmyasya na saṃśayaḥmadvidyāyā prasūnnāyāssāṃgasaṃpūrṇadakṣiṇātadvā daśaphalaṃ tasya bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥasādhyamapi devanāṃ sādhayatyeva vāṃchitaṃdādāmi mahatī lakṣmīmaṃtepi paramaṃ padaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvādhanārjanaṃ nityaṃ datvācārya padāṃvujaṃavaśyaṃ phalamāpnoti saṃśayonātravidyetadhanārjanaṃ mahatpuṇyamāhurdivyāmahārṣayaḥbrahmalāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ datvā brahma prāpnoti śāśvataṃyācitvāpi pradāyātha brahmaprāpnoti śāśvataṃkṛtvādhanārjanaṃ nityaṃ nimagrairapi koṭiśaḥdakṣiṇāmapi yatkiṃcidatvā siddhiṃ parāṃ vrajetjaptvā paṃcaśataprātaḥ sāyamaṣṭhotaraśataṃsaṃprāpya sadvīyāmacirādadhiyo bhavetdehāṃte bhagavaddhāmayāti vaṃśasamanvitaḥtasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nāhaṃ śaktāsmivāmarāḥpaurṇamāsī ca vaiśākhīmahāsiddhikarīmmatāekādaśyapitanmāse mahāsiddhirī smṛtāmajjanmadivasevaśāṃ kuryādvatamataṃdritaḥkārtike sā sikṛtthaṃ varṣevarṣe vrataṃ śubhaṃmaṃtramūrtirviśuddhātmā svātmānaṃ brahmarūpiṇīśrūyate dūragāvannākhecarānapipaśyatipaśyatyeva svacakṣurbhyāṃ nārāṇa samanvitāṃsvakaṭākṣekṣaṇenānyān śrīsamṛddhānkarotyapitṛṇīkaroti madbhaktaḥ svaśriyānātrasaṃśayaḥpaśyatāṃ sarvadevānāmapi cātahitā bhavatuyatkṛtvā sādhakoloke mahatī siddhi maśnutevaiśākhe śrovaṇevapi sāmārabhyāśvinepi vāsamastasaṃpatyāśrājyakāraṇaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃukteṣu śubhamāseṣu prathame bhārgavodine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nityaṃ paṃcaśataṃ japtvā svācāryājñāpurassaraṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā gāyatryādau gavāṃ ghṛtaṃprasannalakṣmīmaṃtreṇa triśataṃ juhuyādvyataṃācāryapatnī saṃpūjyārātanaṃ bhārgadineabhyacyajaṃghapuṣpādyairvāsolaṃkāramarpayetsamarpyasvaguroḥ palyaimahālakṣmīdhiyānṛpagurupatnyākṣasānnidhyedradyādācāryapādayoḥsarveṣāmapya sānnidhye bhagavatsannidhau nṛpaathavācārya pādābjārūḍha śrīpādukāyugebhārgavevāsare kurvaśiṣṭaṃ vratamutamuttamaṃlabhatamadaṃ bhāgyopi svarṇaratnasamākulāṃāyuṣyasyātha vṛddhiḥ syādārogyasvya ca saṃtataṃmīmāṃsādvayatarkadiśāstrapāragatopi cayogamaṣṭāgamāsābhuktvā bhogāṃścakṣubhānmahāsiddhipradānyasyāssaṃtyanyāni śrutau smṛtaudurlabhamimanuṣyāṇāṃ mamarāṇaṃ ca durlabhādīkṣāyuktaḥ śucirnityaṃ virdyasājyaśriyojepankiṃciraktaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasitadvidhānaṃ vadasvādya mama nārāyaṇaprabhoupāsanāśatenapi vināyena na sidhyatitoṣayetsalalairathaibhaktiśraddhā samanvitaḥsvayamevā tathā kuryāditi katavyatā kramaṃśuśrūṣitaśca satataṃ bhaktyā śiṣyeṇāsādaraṃkuryānnāṃdomukhaśrāddhamādau ca svāstivācanaṃmadhumāse bhaveduḥkhaṃ mādhaṣeratnasayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samṛddhiḥ śrāvaṇenhanavīryāṇaṃ saṃmadāmapijñānaṃ syāt kārtike saukhyaṃ mārgaśīrṣe bhavatyapisamastabhīṣṭasiddhiḥ syāt phālgunemāsi saṃtataḥaśvinīrohiṇīsvātīviśākhāhastabheṣu capūrṇimāpaṃcamī caiva tṛtīyasasamītathāpaṃcāṃgabhuddhadivase valavatyapi vā kāmaucaṃdratārānukūle ca śasyate sarvakarmasutatra yadyatkṛtaṃ sarvatadanaṃtaphalapradaṃsavitugraheṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ somasya grahaṇadapikṛtasya karmajātasya phalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyategṛhītāpiyunāvidyā tatra dīkṣā purassarābhūyopi sarvavidyānāṃ grahaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥanāyāsena siddhiḥ syāt sadya eva phalapradākartavyaṃ sarvayaleranaśiṣyāṇāṃ phalasiddhayesuramyaṃ maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra dhānyāṃjalidvayaṃveṣṭītaṃ vastrayugmena paṃcaratnasamanvitaṃnārikela phalopetaṃ maṃgalaiḥ parito jvalaṃśriyācitkalayāyuktaṃ yaṃtreṣṭākṣārasiddhidemaṃtrairāgamikaiścaivaṣvaikṛvairnāthamacceyetśrāvayetaiśca sūktāni maṃtrānviṣṇutsavetadāathavā mātṛkāṃ śuddhāṃ mātṛkāṃ vaihuvīmapivārṇanyāsaṃ daśavidhacinmayīmātṛkāmapinyāsajālamiti nyasya pūjayetatra pūrvavatuttamaṃ kāyennṛtyagītavādhairmanoharaiḥgaṃdhapuṣpāvṛtāṃ kalasuvāsobhūṣaṇādikaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ tatrotsarvakṛtvātrikālamapi pūjayetnirāhāraḥ phalāśīṣā pūrvepustri sahasrakaṃlakṣmī hṛdayavidyāṃ vā dvādaśārṇamathapivāparehani tathā prātaḥ pūrvavat sarvamācaretkuṃḍanirmāya vidhivat kṛtvā tatrapi maṃḍalaṃsāṃgāvaraṇamāvātdyatatrābhyacyaśriyapatiḥdadhidugdhājyasahitaiḥ sahasraṃ juhupatilaiḥkṛtvā pūrṇahutiṃ tatrā tatatra tatastaṃ kalaśeceyetśiṣyavaryamathāhnapabhakti na amakalmaṣaṃpāvamānena sūktai na surāstvāmini maṃtrakaiḥnārāyaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śiṣyesaṃnidadhātivaiiti saṃsmṛtyasasmṛtyatajjalairabhiṣecayetdhārayitvāmgulīyādibhūṣaṇanyaṣi sarvaśaḥtanmūrtipaṃjaranyāsamṛṣyādinyāsa pūrvakaṃtatastacchi ravi svasya datvā hastaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃśrīmaṃtrānyatamaṃ paścācchatamaṣṭottaraṃ japetācāryotha prasannausmai śiṣyāyodakapūrvakaṃśrīmaṃtrānyatamenāthasveṣṭhamaṃtreṇasaṃyutaṃāgatāṃ bhāvayecchipyodhanyosmīti punaḥ punaḥtvātha śrīmadaṣṭārṇayaṃtrarājaṃ samarpayetśiṣyasya dakṣiṇe karṇe tata iṣṭamanūnapikṛta kṛtyastataśiṣyastasme sarvaṃ nivedayetgobhūhiraṇyābharaṇagṛhakṣetrādikaṃ nṛpaaśleśādatra vastrādi dadyādvitānusārataḥsahasradakṣiṇaguktamācāryāya prasannadhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādaudī dīkṣāvidhiṃ kṛtvā vidyāṃ dadyādgurustataḥkalaśasyāyanādīmi kṛtvā pūrvoditanicatriśatādhikasāhasraṃ śrīmaṃtrānyatamaṃ japetśrīmadaṣṭākṣeraṇaśca sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃśrīmaṃtrānyatamenātha śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunetpūrvavatpūjayet kuṃbhe lakṣmīnārāyaṇavubhauparīdhāpya ca ṣosaścadhārayitvāthābhūṣaṇaṃtato dehepi vinyasya vaiṣṇavīmātṛkāṃ tu vāśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāṃ brahmavidyāpurassarāṃpaścādiṣṭhamanūnadatvā kārayedāśiṣastataḥsarvasvaṃ vā tādardhaṃ vātadardhārdhaṃ samarpayetpaṃcaviśatinikaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā suvarṇakaṃdatvā vahnanivāsāṃsidhānyarāśimathākṣayaṃavaśyaṃ vahubhirvitaistoṣayenmanusiddhayearhaṇabhi"ca vahudhāvāsolaṃkatāṇadibhiḥkṛtatyo bhavet sadyassiddhaṃ maṃtro na saṃśayaḥupadiṣṭhāṃśca bhūyopi yogahlājimanūtamāntāvatkālakṛtaṃ hāmajapādi phalamakṣayaṃtasmādācārya pādābje dātavyā pūrṇadakṣiṇāvidyāssamastā datvā datvāpi rahasyamupadiśya caupadiṣṭaṃ ca bhūyopi maṃtraratnanidaṃ śubhaṃravīdugrahaṇe puṇyeyadidīkṣābhicanaṃetatkalovārāṃte sau vaikuṃṭhe bhagavatpudeavijñāya valaṃmāsa vāracaṃdrādisaṃbhavaṃtasmatsarvajñamācāryamāśreyadbhagavaddhiyā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāsudevādikānmātrānvahnanārāyaṇadikāndvayaṃ bhāgavatī proktā dīkṣānārāyaṇīśubhāna saṃdigdhāya mūrkhāya vedaniṃ vā parāya vāyo dadāti mahāvidyāṃ śiṣyaṃ cātmānamapyasauajñātvāmāsavārāddivalamācāryavaktrataḥkiṃcāpyavivadaḥ sarvābhayaṃtīha dine dinesarvavit sadgurorvaktrādgṛhītvā siddhimaśrutaṃdīkṣiteṣvapi sarveṣu dīkṣito vaiṣṇavodhikaḥekena janmanau vāsau mukta ityabhidhīyateśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā sakṛtsmatvāpi mucyateaṣṭadaśakṣarīṃ vāpi brahmavidyāpurassarāṃihāpi siddhividyo saumuktaḥ saṃsārasāgarātsadyaḥ pātakarāśighraṃ vahuśroyovivardhanaṃviṣṇudīkṣābhiṣeko vā yogoṣṭāṃgayutopi vānainaścitayatostyanyadbrahmasaṃprāptikāraṇaṃjānakīpatināpūrvaśreyoṣṭhaddhipradāyakaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarījyahvābhajadhdhvaṃ rāmacyutaṃkṛtakṛtyābhavaṃtotha brahmaprāptyatha śāśvataṃ idameva paratapaḥayameve paro yogo dīkṣeya vaiṣṇavī śubhādīkṣito viṣṇudīkṣāyāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī japandīkṣābhiṣecānaṃ labdhā paṃcadhāvānnidhaikadhānāṣṭāṃgayogābhyāsenanayāgaipūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥbhūyobhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi bhagavādīkṣayānviteḥdvicatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥśrunamasyabhiratyaṃtarahasyamapi siddhidaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlādi brahmaraṃdhrāṃtaṃ jvalaṃtīṃ saṃvidaṃ parāṃāsaneramyagāsīnaḥ prāṇānāyasya vāgpataiḥjptvā dvādaśadhāvadhinatvācārya padāṃvujaṃācārya caraṇāṃbhojārūḍhaṃ śrīpādukādvayaṃdāruṇā nirmitaṃ vāpi śubhalagneśubhedineprātaḥ prātaḥ samutthāya śreya icchannanuttamaṃācāryapādukāvidyāmuccaranpraṇamenṛpapāpakaṃ bhūpatiṃ vipravaryaṃ vedāṃtapāragaṃprātarutthāyayo nityaṃ pādukā dvitayaṃ guroḥjāhnavyādīni tīrthāni saptako pṛṣayopi caācāryapādukābhāvepyācārya caraṇadvayaṃupacāraiḥ samabhyarcya manasā kalpitaiḥ śubhaiḥbrahmavidyāpradātāyasmarayācārya ucyatebhagacadraśmi vidyābhiḥ sahitāṃ sarvasiddhidāṃsarāvabhagavadrūpī mahānācārya ucyatetameva brahma tādātmya siddhimūlaṃ vidurbudhāḥācāryākṛtimannityaṃ saṃpūjyoghaṃghodinedinebhagavadraśmi vidyānāṃ kramasūktamathojapesaṃsmṛtya bhagavatsūktaṃ japennārāyaṇaṃ sakṛnvāsasāśira āvṛtyaṣṭīvanocchāsavarjitaḥudaṅmukho malaṃ mūtramaharbhāge parityajetśuddhāṃ mṛdaṃ samādāyadadyālliṃge mṛdaṃ sakṛtdaśavāmakare dadyādubhayossaptamṛtikāḥ || 38 |||etacchau ca gṛhasthasya dviguṇaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥśaucācāravihīnasya niṣphalāḥ saphalāḥ kriyāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhegavacchāstramasmādhiḥ śrutaṃ tvadvadanīvujātyogasvarūpaṃ pṛcchāmastadasmākaṃ vadaprābhoagānyaṣṭāviti proktamasya tatsakarlavedavaśiṣṭādi mahaṣīṇaṃ sannidhau janakīpatiḥyathā nārāyaṇeyogīnjanakāyamahātmaneśṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi yogamaṣṭāṃgasaṃyutaṃnityanaimitikaireva kurvāṇeduritakṣayaṃajadurjanasargabajasādhusamāgamaṃaṣṭāvaṃgāni vakṣyāmi yogasāvasudhāyateyamaścaniyamaḥ paścādāsanaṃ ca tṛtīyakaṃdadhāraṇa ca tathādhyānaṃ samādhiriticāṣṭamaṃyama"caniyamaḥ paścādāsanaṃ ca tṛtīyakaṃprāṇayāmāvratatadvibhajya pravakṣyamitatallakṣāṇamapyathakṣamādhṛtirmitāhāraḥ śauvaṃ ceti yamādṛśavāṅmanaḥ karmabhirnanamahiṃsetyabhidhīyatesvātyamityucyeta dhīraistadbrahmapraptisvadhimaasteyametadapyaṃgaṃ brahmaprāptessanātanaṃstrīsaṃgatiparityāgo brahmacaryaṃ pravakṣyateutsādanānu saṃdhānaṃdaye procyate vudhaiḥsarveṣāmapi kauṭilyarāhityaṃtvārjavaṃtuvaṃdhuṣvivasamācāraḥ kṣamāsyādbrahmavitamalobhavatsudhatiṃdhīśaḥ pravadaṃti satavaraatyugrahakaṭutiktālasavaṇādivivarjitaṃnirgataṃ navaraṃdhrebhyoromahūyebhya eva cagṛjjalābhyā vahissamyaṅgirmalīkaraṇaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidurbudhāḥ etedaśayagābhūya brāhmatā pratihetavaḥsiddhāṃtālocana caiva lajjādānaṃmatistathāpratyekameṣāṃ vakṣyamilakṣaṇānihahīyateanāyāsopapannenatṛṣṇarthe naiva jīvanaṃśrutyādyukteṣyuviśvāsamāstikāṃ pravadaṃti hitrisaṃdhyamekasaṃdhyaṃ vā bhavatyeveśvarārcanaśruti smṛtipurāṇādi madhyāṃtoktorthadarśanaṃśrutyādibhirlekikaiśca yadyadatyaṃtaniṃditaṃyādiṣṭadevatādhyātvā tadarpaṇādhiyātarkeṇapyanusaṃdhānaṃ samyaktadasatorapigurorlabdhasya maṃtrasyaśaśvadāvartanaṃ hi yatakartavyasya samastasya niyamagrahaṇaṃ vrataṃyamaiścanipamairyadyallataṃ tatsaphalaṃ bhavetkṛtairdadyatedyaudyaḥ śuṣkaṃ dhanamivāgnināsaha ācāryārpinahraihasyacaitadāsanamucyatetvāgasṛprāṃsemadosthimajyāśukrādisaṃbhavāḥprāyaścitamadyaudyānāṃ mukhyametadvahaṃtyapiprāṇayāmaścasatataṃ kartavyo vidhivansunesvayamevāvaśiṣṭassanbrahmayāyakalpatepradadyācchoṭikāmekāmiyaṃ mātrākanīyasītrirjapedāyātaproṇaḥ prāṇāyāmopamucyetaadhamaḥ purakethatrithovāryakuṃbhake pūrvavannṛpaprāṇayāmaiḥ kṛtaiḥ śaśvannityaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirnapaparopatāya japāyaṃparadravyāyahājaṃmahāmātakarjayāpaśatāvṛtopapātakaṃ

sanskrit: sarvāṇyapi pradatdyete praṇayāmaiśratuḥ śataiḥkarmasvapi ca sarveṣu śubheṣudyaśubheṣu caāto yatnena kartavyāḥ prāṇāyāmāḥ śubhatithiḥna nārāyaṇe tadādhyāyanmuhurmahurananyadhiḥparaṃ jyotiḥ paraṃdhyāyataṃtarevamanujīyetdaśapraṇavasaṃyuktaṃgātryā sarvakarmasupiṇaṃ marūpiṇaṃ vā satataṃ smarannarāyaṇadhibhuṃniyamyavāyuṃ kartavyaḥ prāṇayāmodyanāśanaḥna phalaṃtyevatāḥ sarvāyātrenāpi kṛtāḥ kṛtāḥpratyāhāro bhavatye tatsamyagiṃdriyanigrahaḥpūrvoktotamatrāśca prāṇayāmatrayodbhavāḥsamyagālokanaṃ dhyānaṃ nidhāyahṛdayevibhuṃsatyajñānasukhaikatvaprāyeprāptasādhakaḥsamādhirathavājīvabrahmaṇeremacitaṃsvatīpyananyasadbhāvātsvayamevāvaśiṣyateevamaṣṭāṃgasaṃpatrayogupraktāssusaṃyataḥya evamabhyasennityaṃ vinītaḥ śāṃtamānasaḥnirastāṣoḍaṣīrataḥ kāmakrodhādivarjitaḥkarmayogena vā jñānayogenātho bhayena vākarotyanudinaṃ yastu tatphale vigatasyahaḥsuguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vāpi nārāyaṇamajjaṃ vibhuṃdhyātvā karmānavekṣyātha yātyeṣa paramaṃ padaṃsapātyaivotamasthānaṃ yadbhavānānivartatepraviśasaniyamaijanmikediṣānuṣṭhitaiḥhaṭhāsaṃsārasāgasthāsyayāraṃ prāptu yadocchāse

sanskrit: sarvayū uḥkhabhi bhūtānāṃ āṃtānāṃ hatacetasāṃsa eva jānakīmātho brahmarūpī jagatpatiḥprakṣīṇa śeṣapānāṃ jñānayogaḥ praśasyatejñānena karmeśāvāpi devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃādimadhyāta ititaṃ rāmaṃ samyagihārcayajanayogāḥ praśasyatekaitaccharīraṃ hikṣayi vṛḍapiyatiṣṇuśāstreyapāditaṃ samyaganutiṣṭhārtināśanaṃkaripyaumikartavyamiti kaścidvicitayetśvaḥkāryamadyakuvītamadhyāhne cāparāhnikaṃsamyagvairāgyamiṣṭasya paratatvasthacetasaḥśarīritvamayi prāyo viraktasyaiva śobhayetanyamedhyaṃ śarīrasyaṃ viṣṭāmidhyagatādapiśarīresminnamedhyatvāmīdṛśaṃ nāma hehināṃśṛgālairapi ghṛdhraiścanīyete yadyahovidhiḥpūtat pratipadaṃ samyagāpadāṃpadamīdaśaṃ tataḥduḥkhai kānubhavārthyayavidhinaitatkṛtaṃ unaḥvyāmohito jagatparenmāpayaiva mahātmanaḥsukhaṃ mithyāduḥkhemavabhūyopyanubhavatyayaṃ******** bhūtvā duḥkhāvrtepunaḥsarvātmanā parityājyai sarveṣāmapi duḥkhadena kiṃcipikarmātraniḥphalaṃ vidyāte munetato na karmakartavyaphalarthitvena sūribhiḥna cevyatatisaṃsāre duḥkhākartarbhavimohitaḥyogābhyāsarato vāpi guruśuśrūṣāṇerataḥchiṃdhipṛcchāmitātātrānugrahaṃ kuru

sanskrit: punarāvṛtiratirahitaṃ śāśvataṃ brahmayātyapiśrīmatābhihitaṃ brahmavidyānuṣṭhānatatparāḥnivṛtirevamuktistu pravṛtirbhuktirucyatetvayārye sāya uktaṃ tatsatyaṃ satyavidāṃvaranivṛtilakṣaṇatdveṣāmuktirityabhidhīyatebhuktiṃ pravakṣyetelokevaiṣamyamubhayorapimuktirātmānusaṃdhānenātmāvasthānameva hipravṛtau ca nivṛtau ca sarvadātmānubhāvināṃyenusmarati satataṃ nate sasāriṇo nṛpabhoktātra bhagavāneva bhojyamārpabhujiktiyāato na muktimārgasyarodhinī bhuktirīṣyetaśrīrāmamiṃdirānāthaya ekasminnamanutiṣṭhitayathavidhiniṣedhautumuktaṃ nevāpasarpataḥbrahmaiva satyaṃ tadahaṃ bhagavānahamīśvaraḥiti yenusmaraṃtīha ciṃtayaṃti dine dineyathā ghaṭaśca kalaśa ekārthapyabhidhāyakaḥato rāmo hamityevaṃ brahmaivāhamathāpi vāvadaṃti tatvataḥ sākṣāte sarvebrahmarūpiṇaḥmaṃtratrasya chaṃdo vā munidhyānādikaṃ tu vāatrānyatamamāyāyānmaṃtraṃ brahmaikyasiddhidaṃgacchan siṣṭansvāyanmujananugrannapi hasannapibrahmabhūtamathātmānaṃ svayayeva prapaśyatibrahmatādātmyavidyāyāḥ smāṇainaiva siddhibhākācāryāyapyeyeddhrīmānetedvidyāpradāyineudakodanavastrādi kiṃcidatvāpi vānvahaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ato brahmavidedatamānaṃtyāya prakalpatekuṭaṃvinī daridrāśvaduḥkhinaḥ syurnasaṃśayaḥkārāgṛheṣu sarvasvayamevanigṛhṇateato brahmavidāṃdveṣo na kartavyaḥ śubhessubhiḥyestuvaṃtyaṃnumodaṃti vadaṃtyapi manīṣiṇaḥjñātvā tameva viśveśaṃ kṛtyaṃ kuru niraṃtaraṃsahasra kṛtvo gāyatryā japāḥ pratyahamādarātśrīmadaṣṭākṣrīvidyājayotha sarahasyakaḥgurūdaivatamaṃtrāṇāmaikyaṃ sa bhāvayet sadābhidyate hṛdayagraṃthirvinaśyaṃtyāpi saṃśayāācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja śuśrūṣā pratyahaṃ śubhāśrutyāktācārasaṃyatiḥ pratyahaṃ samaye kṛtāniyamavyatirikteṣu samayeṣu niraṃtaraṃbrahmaprāptikarāṇahunaitasmādvidyate paraṃnāstikānāṃ na vaktavyaṃ kṛtaghrānāṃ durātmanāṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī japtvā brahmavidyājapaḥbrahmaikyasiddhidaṃ nārayaṇadhiyānityamācāryaṃvaśo japan śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī japtvā brahmavidyāpurassarāṃmahākālaṃ durādharṣamapijitvā bhayaṃkaraṃnārāyaṇamayobhūtvāyātitadbrahmaśāśvataṃbrahmadarśanaparyaṃtaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ samarcayetśālagrāmaśilācakrecakrarājasamanviteihāmutrāpi mahātī siddhiṃ māpnotyanuttamāprāpnoti vasudhāmāladānahomādibhirvināna pūjayedyovidhinārgājaṃ vrājatidāruṇa
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryerbhyo vinānyatra datvādhāgatimāpnuyātparivrāḍajñānamātreṇa dānahomādibhirvināparivrāḍaviraktaśca viraktaśca gṛhītathāpurāyastriyo gṛhasthoścamagalairmaṃgalārthibhiḥcaṃdanāgarūkastūrīkarpūrasahimāṃvubhiḥpuṣpamālyaiśca vahubhirdūrvābhidhaṃ valākṣataiḥjātīprasūnairvilvaiśca punnāgairvakulairapināgavāṇadipuṣpaiścaṃgadhavadbhirmanoharaiphalaiśca vahubhiḥ patrairjalasyāla samudbhavaisamyakusaṃpādyatnenaśatmābhatmāśriyaḥpatiṃatyākaurvaṅgavidhaiḥ piṣṭakairiṣṭasiddhayedadhyodanānnapānādivyaṃ jānādibhiḥāvartakedhūpadīpaiḥ yajāvṛtyupakalpitaiḥvahnībhirdīpamālābhirarcayepuraharniśaṃkapūracūrṇasahitaistāṃvūlaiśca suvāsitaiḥsvasvaśatmanusāreṇa sarvaṃ saṃpādya yatnataḥdadyurdānani juhupurarcitagnauśubhārthinaḥevaṃ gṛhasthaniyamastathaiva brahmacāriṇaṃyadikuryuḥ prayatnena pūjāṃtatsādhanairihaetenaiva mahīpāla kalyāṇaṃ tava sarvadāsaguṇaṃ viṣṇumārādhyapūrvoktiḥ sādhanairihateṣāṃ bhuktiścamuktiśca bhavatyevahinānyathāsaṃsārānnanivartataṃ vidhyati kramadoṣataḥahiṃsāparamodharmasteṣāmeva mahāṃpatebhāvanākalpitairdravyairpatīnāṃ pūjanaṃ smṛtaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sevyasevakarūpatvādgṛhīṇīmīśvarasyasya cajīvabrahmaikaciṃtātu punarāvṛtivarjitācayenateṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃciduḥkṛtotthānacāpadaḥyadgātvā mucyate tejaṃturjanmasaṃsāravaṃdhanātakarṇaḥ samṛṇetyetacchabdarūpaṃ paraṃ mahaḥsamahāpuruṣaḥ puṃsāstrīrṇavyaktivilakṣaṇaḥsarveśvarassarvarūpassarvadevamayohariḥajaḥ smaraṇamātreṇa janmādi kleśabhaṃjanaḥniyamenaiva sarveṣāṃ svāśramoktena sa prabhuḥsvāśramoktaṃ parityajya ātmanamupāsatevaṃdhanāt śrutismṛtipurāṇeṣuyo yoniteato niyamabhādṛtthakuryāddhyānamananyadhīḥmithyādavyatiriktaṃ yadaśyatvāta tathānṛpaekākī yatacitātmaciṃtayeadananyadhīḥetatsvavyātiriktaṃ yadyatṛḥsvenaiva kalpyatevālājñayāvāṃkobhedaḥ kalpyatatvakvacakṣuṣāadhyātmavidbhikhyavijñāpitaḥ sarvagaḥ smṛtaḥna stridhovyatricāriṇyaḥ puruṣaścaivadhārmikaḥpūjyaṃte tithayo yatra guruśiṣya paraparaṃparāḥniyamopyāśramasteṣāṃ na kadācintivarjateyeṣu vaṃśeṣu sarveṣāṃteṣāmeva prakāśatesvayameva paraṃ brahmatatonpannāsti kiṃcanajanmakoṭi sahasreṣu prakṣīṇeśoṣaduṣkṛtaiḥsukhāmṛta rasāsvāhasatyaikajñānarūpatāahopuṇyamahodharmonātaḥ parataraṃ piyaṃ

sanskrit: aṣṭākṣarānusaṃdhānamācaryacāraṇarcanaṃācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaśuśrūṣānvahamādarāttvadhanyosi mahārājatvameva brahmaviṣvakaḥbhavadbhāgyādayenaiva parabrāhmāmayo hariḥrāmābhidhānaḥ svervaṣāmātmārāmaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥyeyaṃ cihnapiṇī sākṣānmahālakṣmīstrapījānakītpakṣivikhyāṃtā divyakāṃti sāmacitātanjamaskaroti bhagavantathapādāṃvujadvayaṃgṛhītvā mithilādho śanayācyamapi kutracittubhyamuktaṃ mahārājavedasārārthasaṃgrahaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī sāṃgāṃ japtvā mukto bhaviṣyasinālyena yasālabhyā satya satyaṃ mahīyatebhūyopi śrīmadaṣṭārṇasādhanaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃbhūyopi saṃpravakṣyāpi samāhitamanāḥ śṛṇusāmrājñī sarvavidyānāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī parāvaiśākhemāsiyā muktā tṛtīyākṣayasaṃtitāprātaḥ śucibhūtvā saṃdhyāmupāsya capanasai vījarahitairmadhutritayamiśritaiḥtriśatādhika sāhasraṃ śrīmaṃtrānyatamena cagavyājyena tridhā hutvā kṛtvā homaṃ japādibhiḥpradakṣiṇaṃ namaskṛtyajātevada samādarātvāsobhirapyalaṃkārairalaṃkṛtyā tataḥ paraṃatha dvarūdaśaniṣkavāpaṃcaniṣkamathāpi vābrāhmaṇanbhojayet paścādvādaśātha suvāsinīḥtādvine pānasādīni phalāni guraverpyayet

sanskrit: kṛtvotthaṃ mahatī siddhidaivairapi durlabhāṃakṣayaṃ saukhyamatyaṃtamāropyaṃ ca tathākṣayaavāpyākṣayabhogāścamodate bhagavatpadekṛtenaye narājedaṃ sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyatesarvāsāmapi vidyānāṃ sidhyartha. kṛyate bhuvisidhyarthaṃ kṛyate yatrānavarātravrataśubhaṃkriyate satataṃ siddhaissamastaphalasiddhayepūrvapūrvadinātpurāpaśutaredivase kṣayaṃdhanadhānyagajāśvadimahāsaṃyatsasṛddhidaṃciṃtitārthapradaṃ śreyaskaraṃ sadyodyanāśanaṃatrāvaśyaṃ prakartavyaṃ puraścaraṇamādarātsatataṃ vijayī bhūtvā duḥkhasadyairvimucyatecaitramāsavratamapi navarātrābhidhaṃ tathāśaktaścedubhayaṃ kuryādekaṃ vā navarātrakaṃpratipaddinamārabhya tatra vamyaṃtamādarātpratipadivasetatra prātarutthāyavāgyataḥraśmimālāmanusmatyapacadhāvātridhā tataḥsamastanyāsasahitāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ śubhāṃsaṃkalpārkasahasrāṇi vratī nityaṃ japedbudhaḥprasannalakṣmīmathavāsaṃkalpyārkasahasrakaṃyadvā paṃcādhikāṃ catvāriṃśadāvṛtimabhyasetpadyāśatmāthavābhojyaṃ mithunaṃ bhagavaddhiyāpatraiḥ puṣpairyajet paścānniśataṃ brahmavidyayāātmānaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpādyairalaṃ kuryā dine dinekuryādinedine vaśyaṃ mahotsavamataṃdritaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratipaddarśa ṣaṣṭhīṣu navamyāṃ ravivāretṛṇaparṇaissadā kuryādayādamāmekādaśīṃ vināsnānaṃ kuryānmahānadyāṃ taḍāge vā hṛdepi catasmāt snānamṃ prakartavyaṃ vāhyāṃtarmalanāśanaṃprājāpatya samaṃ prāhustanmahādyavighātanaṃdhyātvā snānaṃ prakurvīta sarvapāpa viśuddhayekeśavādi caturviṃśannāmāni manasāsmaranekasmin divase vāpi snānaṃ kṛvattha mādarātsnātvātha vāsasī śuddhe paridhāya samāhitaḥudayāt prāktaṃnī saṃdhyāṃ ghaṭikā tritayāṃ viduḥsaṃdhyākarma paṭityāgī sarvakarma vahiṣkṛtaḥtyaktā saṃdhyābhidhaṃ karmayonyatra kurute pratiṃprātasāṃdhyāṃ sa nakṣatrāmupāsīta yathāvidhiarddhāmita nakṣatramaṃtarikṣaṃ yadā bhavetprāṇānāyamma saṃkalpa saṃdhyākarma samāretayamevahi dṛṣṭāṃto vaṃdhyāstrīsaṃgamo yathāgāyatrī maṃtratoyādyaṃ dattaṃ yenājalitrayaṃtena vajrodakenāśumaṃdehānāmarākṣasāḥsaṃdhyākarmaparityāgī maṃdehorākṣaso bhavetpradakṣiṇī kṛtā tena saptādvīpavanīmahīāsanastho japenmaunī pratyagātārakodayātsavinābhagavānsākṣādbrahmarūpīśriyaḥ patiḥtanmaṃḍalagataṃ dhyātvā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃsahasra paramāṃ devīśatamadhyaṃ daśāparaṃgāyatrīṃ prajapennityaṃ pātakodyaiḥ pramucyate

sanskrit: sruvāyīnībhirdātavyaṃ sāyaṃkāle mahīyategavyājyaṃ juhuyādagnau aṣṭāviṃśatidhāśriyāsadyassamastavipadāṃhatrīsaṃyatkarīśubhāācāryāṃnujñayāsrātvānityakarmasamāpya caekaikavilvapatreṇa sahitaṃtramadhusutaṃhutvā śrīmanunāpaścācchatādhikasahasrakaṃlakṣmīhṛdayamaṃtraiśca tridhāgavyaghṛtaṃ hunetprāyaścitāhutīḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇāhutiṃarcayet puṣpasahitairvilvairvātulasīdalaiḥācāryacaraṇaṃ dvaṃdvaṃ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya casuramyapadmarāgākhyamaṇibhissahitaṃ śubhaṃkṣayāṃṣacintukasauvarṇamathavā-kuṃḍaladvayaṃkuṃḍaladvitayaṃ dadyādvitalobhavivarjitaḥkuṃḍaladvitayābhāvetanmānasvarṇamarpayetvahuśasya samāyuktāṃ vasudhākṣiṇānvitāṃdatvā godvitayaṃ paśvādadyādakṣiṇayāścitāṃpradastāvastudhādāneśatāṭhakamitāmahīmahīpratinividravyaṃ paṃcāśatriṣkamutamaṃadharmasmṛtaṃ adhamādhamamevoktaṃ tatrāpyardhaṃ mahīyatevarṣāśanamitaṃ dravyamathavotamadakṣiṇatadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā vitalobhaṃ varityajetācāryapatnī śrīvudhyāpūjayet tataḥ paraṃpaṃcaviṃśati saṃkhyākamithunānnātyathabhojayetvāsobhidaṃkṣiṇābhiścataṃ kalairapi tauṣayetsadyassiddhimavāpnoti mahatīdurlabhāmapi

sanskrit: aṣṭhottaraśataṃ hutvā vāsudevena cāpyathaekaikaśobhagavato raśmirbhirjuhuyādvataṃmahāvyāhatibhirhutvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇahutiṃācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvasāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya camahīśasya samāyuktāṃ dadyādavahuladakṣiṇaṃsiddhi mama vāpnoti devānāmapi durlabhāācāryāya pradātavyā sālagrāmaśilāśubhādātavyānyapi vipreyodānānyanyāni bhūyatebhagavatsannidhau datvā svācāryāsannidhau nṛpasaviturgrahasoceṃdoryadyadvastu pradīyatecūḍāmarāyādiyogeṣudatadravyasya bhūyetaekāhuti phalaṃ sūryasāmayorgrahaṇe kṛtaṃviśeṣācchīmadaṣṭorṇa homāditanitaphalaṃcūḍāmaṇyādi yogeṣuko vā varṇavitaṃ kṣamaḥhimavanmerusadaśaṃprāhārāgamapāragāḥraviparvaṇi vā koṭibhūṣaṇāṃ pradānajaṃmāturanvayasaṃbhūtāna śataśopi sahasraśaḥdatāthaṃ vasudhāṃ pakvavahuśasya samanvitāṃyatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tatsyātpūryedravarvaṇiācāryāyavratīdhīmānkoṭibrahmāṃḍadānajaṃitthamācārya pādābje pradatvā vahudakṣiṇāṃśrotriyāmadaridrāya vedābhyāsaratāya cakṣīyaṃte salilānyadhvermāścatrasareṇavaḥkṣīyaṃte salilānyabdhermomāścatrasareṇavaḥśakyaṃteyāṃśavobhūmergaṇituṃ vṛṣṭiviṃdavaḥ

sanskrit: vivāhārthaṃ dhanaṃ datvā grahaṇe caṃdrasūryoḥdatvā yatphalamāpnoti tadekasminvivāhitegrahaṇeṣu puraścaryāṃ kṛtvā saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaṃkṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti tatopyadhikamaśruteyatphalaṃ samavāpnoti śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayātatphalaṃ samavāpnoti bhagavadvacana yathāyatphalaṃ samavāpnoti grahaṇe caṃdrasūryayāḥkoṭī sahasrasaṃkhyākadakṣiṇasahitaṃ nṛpasagaṃ dakṣiṇayayuktāṃ grahāṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥtatphalaṃ samavāpnoti vajimedha sahasrajaṃkṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti cūḍāmārāyākhyaṃ varveṇiavaśyam tatphalaṃ bhūyaprāprotyatra na saṃśayaḥsālagrāmaśilāṃ datvā suvarṇaniṣkapaṃcakaṃśrīmadaṣṭarṇavidyāyāssiddhiprāpnotyunuttamāṃtasya lakṣmīpatiḥ sākṣātprasīdati na saṃśayaḥparadehāpraveśādi sāmarthyaṃ cāṇimādikaṃbhargavevoraviśeṣassaṃpravakṣyatebhārgavevāsare prāpte svācāryājñapurassaraṃvidhivat saṃskṛte vahnau śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayāprasannalakṣmīmaṃtreṇadvādaśārṇaśriyāpi vāvāsudevasya manunāvaiṣvavyāthaṣaḍarṇayāekaikaśestatohutvā triśataṃ brahmavidyayāekaṃ vaptiyunaṃ bhojyaṃ mṛṣṭhātrerdakṣiṇadibhiḥekaniṣkasuvarṇaṃ vā dadyādācārya dakṣiṇaṃniyatovaṃdhubhissahabhūyate bhṛguvāravrataṃ kurvannityaṃ vatsarapaṃcakaṃ

sanskrit: vidrūpamātṛkāyuktāmathavā prajapecchuciḥśrīmaṃtramapi japtvaikaṃ lakṣyaṃ śuddhau jiteṃdriyaḥtadaṃte juhuyādagnautilai strimadhusaṃplutaiḥsahasraṃ śataniṣkaṃ vā tadardha vā tadardhakaṃbrāhmāṇannojayet paścācchataṃ sāgraṃ suvāsinīḥsugrīvavāyuputrādikapināyaka saṃvṛtaṃtasyānugrahatassadyojarāmaraṇavarjitaḥśrīrāmasyājñayanityaṃ rājarājovibhīṣaṇaḥsaprayacchatidhanāni divyavastrāṇi divyānyābharaṇāni caanenaiva śarīre śāmanovegī ca khecaraḥraṃganāthasya sānnidhyamāśrityanityaṃ sādhatavrataḥkurvananniṣavaṇasmānaṃ kuveratanayātaṭeprajaptvā śrīmanuṃ paścāpaṃcadhājyaṃ tato hunet ipyekalakṣamabhyasetvāsudevatyekaṃ daśasāhasraṃ prajaptvāniyataḥ śuciḥmadhutritayasammiśrairgavyenājyena saṃplutaiḥśrīmaṃtreṇa tato hutvā trisahasraṃ tilairnṛpasahasramekaṃ juhuyātilairevaghṛtaplutaiḥsālagrāmaśivāṃ datvā śatadakṣiṇayānvitāṃācāryacaraṇadvaṃdva datvā vipraśataṃ tataḥnasminnevadine sākṣādraṃganāthaṃ prapaśyatitejomayatunurbhūtvā vaśiṣṭādi prapūjitaḥśeṣācalasya śikhare suvarṇamukharītaṭesahasra kṛtvo gāyatrīṃ prajaptvātriśataṃ tu vāśrīmadaṣyakṣarīṃvidyāṃ prajaptvā lakṣamādārātvāsudeva mahavidyā vaiṣṇavī ca ṣaḍakṣarī

sanskrit: japedaṣṭhottaraśataṃ bhagavadraśmimālikāṃjuhuyādaśasāhasraṃ tilaistatrāpi bhūyatevidyayā vāsudevasya vaiṣṇvyātha ṣaḍarṇayābhagavadraśmibhirhutvā goghṛte naiva paṃcadhāācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvegośātaṃ dakṣiṇānvitaṃdatvātasmindine sākṣāccheṣā valapatiṃ vibhuṃtatprasādena sadyo sau sarvavidyādharādhipaḥjarāmāṇanirmukto bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥsvayamevahiniryāṃtiryānipurāṇasmṛtayopi cayogamaṣṭāmgamāsādyaśriyaṃ cāṣṭhaguṇānvitāakṣayānsakalānbhogānbhuṅe kalyāṃtamapyasauśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāṃ samastanyāsasaṃyutāṃvāsudevarmahāvidyāṃ vaiṣṇuvīṃ ca ṣaḍakṣarīḥśatamāvartayedvīmānnaḍāvadraśmimalikāhutvāya daśasāhasraṃ trisāhasraṃ śriyā hunetviprāṇaṃ dviśataṃ bhojyaṃ nārīṇaṃ ca śatadvayaṃsaṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaṃ yuktā dātavyāvaśyamādarātsākṣātpaśyati cakṣurbhyāmidirāsahitaṃ vibhurāmaṇanimuktovimānaṃ sarvakāmadaṃkāṃcīnagaramāsādyanityaṃ triṣavaṇerataḥśrīmadaṣṭhākṣarīvidyāṃ samastanyāsasaṃyutatājapedvādaśa sāhasraṃ vāsudeva mahāmanuṃśatamāvartayepaścādbhagavadraśmimālikāṃhutvā dvādaśasāhasraṃ śriyā ca trisahasrakaṃhutvā sahasraṃ pratyekaṃ ghṛtenaiva mahīyate

sanskrit: brahmārpaṇahutiṃ kṛtvā śatamaṣṭautaraṃ dvijānasamarpya pitvā svacāryakārṇayoḥ kuṃḍaladvayaṃśataniṣkasuvarṇaṃ vā tadadhavātadardhakaṃtasminnevadine sākṣātkāṃvīnagaranāyakaṃpaśyatyeva svacakṣubhyo brahmeśādibhirarcitaṃnirāmayaścirāyuśca śriyamaṣṭhaguṇanvitaṃiṃdrārdvāsanamāsādya daivatairapi pūjitaḥkhecaratvamanuprāpyadevaṣitviprayātyasaunarasiṃhasya sannidhye svācāryājñāpurassaraṃśrāvaṇemārgaśīrṣe vā vaddhaṃ bhāskaraparvaṇihutvātha bhagavadraśmi maṃtraisredhāghṛtaṃ hunettata ācāryayāhājvayugalapraṇiyavya caśataniṣkasuvarṇaṃ vā tadardhavitadardhakaṃparedyurbrāhmaṇānśatmābhojayeccasuvāsinīḥācārye dūradeśasthe pādukādvitayoriācāryapatnīputrebhyaḥ preṣayedvastu tatparavidhivatyaṃvadhākṛtvā sāṃgāṃ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaṃbrahmādaṃ paśyati kṣipraṃ daityasāmrājyanāyakaṃprahlādānugrahātsadyoharibhaktima caṃcaloprapaśyati mahālakṣmīsahitaṃ daivataivṛtaṃvāsāṃsiva mahārhaṇi śriyamaṣṭaguṇamapianugrahānnaraharermahārṣirjāyate nṛpaācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ natvā sāṣṭīgamādarāttadeva sumatyoṭaṃ mahālakṣmāyaśaskaṃmahāsiddhipradaṃ sadyo mahāpātakabhaṃjanaṃ

sanskrit: dyarmārthakāmamokṣadi caturvargaphalāthinaḥyajeddhīmān mahālakṣmīlakṣmīhṛdayavidyayākollāpure mahākṣetre svācāryājñāpurassaraṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāṃ japtvaikalakṣamādarātdvādaśākṣaralakṣmīvaṃ śrīṣaḍarṇamathapi vājaptvā dvādaśasāhasraṃ bhagavadraśmimālikīghṛtamrimadhusammiśraistilairvilvadalānvitaiḥatha prasannalakṣmya ca trisahasraṃ hunevilaiḥhutvā sahasramājyena pratyekaṃ jvalitenaletat japādihomaṃ kṛtvātha kṛtvā brahmāryaṇāhutisāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatyotha ṣaṣṭicihvakahemajaapi codaravaṃdhādi bhūṣaṇani samarpayetpaṃcārvaśatinikaṃ vāsyācaryaraṇeryayetsvarṇalaṃkaranaivastrairviśeṣeṇa prapūjayettasmin dine svacakṣubhyaṃ mahālakṣmīsamanvitaṃjagajaratnadhanāśvaudyasaṃkulāmacalāṃ śriyaṃadhiyaṃ sarvasiddhānāṃ kapilaṃ ca prapaśyatisaṃprāpyayogamaṣṭāṃgasaṃyutaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃanenaiva śarīreṇa jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥkapilānugrahānnityasasauviharatisvaryaparakāyapraveśādi sāmartha ca vrajatyasaumārkaṃḍeyasaraḥ snātaḥ snātvā siṃdhau tataḥ paraṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japtavalakṣamerkayatavrataḥdaśasāhasrakaṃ japtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca ṣaḍakṣaraṃtilaistrimadhugavyājyamiśritairayutaṃ hutvā

sanskrit: japetyaṃ ca śataṃ vāpi catuśatamathāpi vāaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ japtvā brāhmaṇaḥ syāddinedinesahasra kṛtvo gāyatrīṃ japaṃtaṃ pratpadaṃ śucina vedapāṭhādbrāhmaṇyaṃ na śāstrapaṭhanādapiaśaktaḥ prajapennityaṃ tiṣṭhannāsī na eva vāudite tu sahasrāṃśau tanmaṃḍala lagataṃ vibhuṃdhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śriyāsahitamacyutaṃdiśāmapi namaskuryāddi devebhyastataḥ paraṃpunarācamaśuddhātmā ravimaṃḍalamadhyagaṃśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ saṃdhyāṃ kṛtvā sidhyarthamādarātśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ nyāsādi rahitāmapiaṣṭāviṃśatidhā vāpi noce*(?)rddharna jāyatekṛtāṃjali puṭo bhūtvā sūktaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ japetgāyatryā vāhya tanmadhye yajñeśaṃ śrīpatiṃ vibhuṃśrīmaddaṣṭākṣareṇāthagavyamājyaṃ tadnahīpatehutvā dvādaśadhā vahnāvaddhaṃga śrīpaterathaṛksrāmayajuṣāṃ pāṭhaṃ brahmayajñārthamācaretravau śukre trayodaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ niśisaṃdhyayoḥkāmya vrateṣu juhuyādraśmividyābhirekadhāācāryacaraṇāṃ bhojadvayaṃ brahmavile śubheprāṇā nārāyamya saṃkalpya samastanyāsasaṃyutāṃjapenpaṃcaśataṃ vāpi catuḥśatamathāpi vānārāyaṇena sūktena stutvā devaṃ śriyaḥ patiḥupeyādatharājānaṃ yogakṣemārthasiddhayesaṃdhyāṃ māhnikīṃ kuryādādityābhimukhaḥ śuciḥ

sanskrit: kṛtvā brahmārpaṇāhutiṃpraṇamya daṃḍavatasya karṇayoḥ kuṃḍaladvayaṃpadmarāgamutaṃ sūkṣmavāsau yuktaṃ samarpya camahastaṃ dakṣiṇa dadyātadardhavātadardhakaṃśrenniyārṇāśataṃ sārgrasannaṃ bhojayecca suvāsinīḥsadya eva jagannāthaṃ subhadrāsahitaṃ vibhuṃpaśyatyeva svacakṣubhyā tejomaṃḍalamadhyagaṃbhavatyasya sakhānityaṃ mṛkaṃḍutanayomuniḥmahepuraṃ sāmrājyamatha brahmapudaṃ tu vāayodhyā puramāsādyasrātvāthaśarayūjaleravṛhatrakrasamabhyarcya śrīśamāvaraṇanvitaṃlakṣameka prajaptvātha lakṣamekaṃje yacchriyaṃpratyekamayutaṃ japtvāmālāmaṃtraṃ śriyaḥpateḥvidhivatsīskṛte vahnau śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayāguyadvāgavyaghṛtaṃ śrīmadaṣṭārṇe kṣaryāyutaṃ hunetvaiṣṇavakāpilājyena sādaraṃ guvadvāgavyaghṛtaṃśrīmadaṣṭhārākṣaryāyutaṃ hunetvaiṣṇavyā ca śataṃ hutvā śrīrāmamanunā tataḥbhavadraśmibhihutvāṃ paṃcadhāgoghṛtena caagniṃ pradahakṣiṇīkṛtya svācārya caraṇadvayaṃpadmarāgasamāyuktaṃ kuṃḍadvitayaṃ śubhaṃvahukṣīraṃ samarpyāthaniṣkasāhasramādarātdatvācaryapriyāyai ca datvālaṃkaraṇadikayaṃtasmin dine mahārājaṃ bharatādibhiracitaṃsākṣātpaśyati cakṣubhyāṃ śrīrāmajānakīpatiṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhīṣṭaṃ savalaṃ datvā śrīsamījagatīpatiḥhanūmataḥ prabhāvena siddhayoṣṭhāsimādayaḥjarāmaraṇarāhityamapi dīrghāpurakṣayaṃvārāṇasī samāsādya viśvanāthasya sannidhoviṃdumādhavamabhyarcya natvā svācāryapādukāṃlakṣamekaṃ prajaptvātha bhagavatsannidhau śuciḥvāsudevamanupaścādvaiṣṇavaṃ ca ṣaḍakṣarājaptvā dvādaśasāhasraṃmayutaṃ brahmavidyayātataḥ paraṃ hunedagnau śrīmadaṣṭāṇīvidyayātilākṣatasamayuktairvitvapatrairghṛtaplutaiḥvāsudevasya maṃtreṇa vaiṣṇavyā ca ṣaḍarṇayāmaṃtreṇa juhuyādagnau sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃjapadihomaṃ kṛtvātha praṇamyagnimataḥ pareṣaṣṭhicihukasaṃtaptahāṭakena vinirmitaṃmuddikādyairalaṃkāraissamabhyarcya ca sādaraṃtriśataṃ śataniṣka vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakaṃmahālakṣmīdhiyāpaścātatpatnyā api bhūṣāṇīdukūlamathavā sarścakaṃ kaṃcukaṃ ca samarpyayetdatvātha dakṣiṇadyaiścasaṃtoṣyavapathāmatibhūtvā padeṣu bhuṃjīta brāhmāṇaissahavaṃdhuniḥpaśyatyevasvacakṣurbhyāṃ viśveśvara samanvitaṃbhūtvā mūkopimahatī śriyā yamaṣṭha guṇanvitāṃbhūtvāṃte yāti sānnidhyaṃ kulakoṭi samanvitaḥprātaḥsnātvānvahaṃbhatmānityakarma samāpya caśrīmadaṣṭhāksarīvidyāṃ samastanyāsasaṃyutī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahālakṣmī manuṃ japtvā vāsudevamadyatmanuṃvidhivat saṃskṛte vahau śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayātrisahasraṃ tilaidevaghṛtamiśraiḥ śriyāhunethutvā sahasra pratyekaṃ bhagavadraśmibhistridhākuṃḍalādyairalaṃkārairācāryamatha pūjayettriśataṃ śataniṣka vā tadarthaṃ vā tadardhakaṃalaṃkāraiścavāsebhissaṃtoṣyatva tataḥ paraṃśrīśrīpatidhiyāpaścātoye dakṣiṇādibhiḥśrīśrīśāvardhayeddhīmānsahastaṃ triśatādhikaṃsākṣātsvapneyi vā paśyatyasau devaṃ śriyaḥ ratiṃśrīpate rājñayātasya śakrādyālokapālakāḥkalpahunaṃ kāmadhenuṃvitāratnamabhutamaṃpītvā mṛtamasau divyamajaraśca marastathāviharatyakhilānlokānsasiddhagaṃdharvasevitaḥcālakanadāyānivyakarmasamāpya calakṣamekaṃ prajaptvātha svācāryājñāpurassaraṃjaptvātha vāsudevākhyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca ṣaḍakṣaraṃaṣṭhottaraśataṃ japtvāvidhivat saṃskṛtenalehunedgavyājyamathavā bhānusāhasramādarātvāsudevasya manunāmanunā vaiṣṇavena cahutvājvaṃjyaline vahnau homaṃ kṛtvā japādibhiḥnaranārāyaṇaṃ vidyāṃ japedakaṃ sahasrakaṃbhūyojapādihomaṃ ca kṛtvā brahmārpaṇāhutiṃkuṃḍaladvitayaṃ ramyaṃ datvācāryasya karṇayīḥpītāṃvarayugaṃ datvā svācāryacaraṇadvaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nniśataṃ śataniṣka vā tādardha vā tadardhakaṃācāryapatnyai datvā yathā solaṃ karaṇādikaṃnaranārāyaṇīvidhā prajepatadine śuciḥbrahmarudrādibhirvedyaṃ niśimāṃ saṃprayaśyatiajarāmaraṇonityaṃ paṃcaviṃśati vārṣikaḥmahāyogitvamathavā brahmatvaṃ vā maheśanāṃkṣaṇaṃkṛśaḥ kṣaṇasthūlaḥ śriyamaṣṭaguṇāṃ punaḥtiraśībhāṣitaṃ veti sarvajñatvaṃ ca saṃtatakulakoṭiyutodhīmān praviśatyeva matpadaṃkṣetraṇibhūtale saṃti sadyassiddhikarāsayapiācāryānujñayā kṛtvā siddhimiṣṭhāṃ vrajatyapitatpatnīputrapautrāṇāṃ sānnidhyamathavā nṛpakāryaṃ tadakṣiṇadānaṃ pādukādvitayopadianena vidhināvapi siddhimiṣṭāṃ vrajatyathaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyaṃ syānmāyadhātrāpirśabhutanāsamājñātvātha tatparonityaṃ modate brahmarūpabhāketasmādadhikaṃ nāsti satyaṃ satyaṃ mahīyatevasudharādividyānāṃ pravakṣyate sāvanaṃ tataḥnīādhidyāvidhāna ca śṛṇuśva śraddhayānvitaḥmaheṃdrārūṭhagaṇapaviṃdunādasamanvitaṃtadeva viṃduhīnaṃ ca bhṛguṃ paṃcamasaṃyutaṃvāyuṃ dvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ hṛdayena samanvitaṃsarvatīrthamayī sarvakṣetraratnādisiddhidāvarāhosya muniḥ prokto vairājaṃ chaṃda ucyatedvitīyaṃ vījamityuktaṃ hṛtchaktiḥ samudīritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śukaṃ dadhānāṃ vasudhāṃ bhajāmahesarpiṣapāyasena juhuyā tadvaśāṃśataḥtragāni pūjayedādau bhūvahni jalamārutānjvaliṣmājvālinīcadhūmrārcirititā kalāḥsarvasiddhamanormaṃtrī sādhayet samanorayānekasminnevadivase prajasrātha parodyapigauvarmasammitāṃ bhūmiṃ pakvasusya samanvitāṃmahī pratinidhidravyamathavāguraverpayetmadhutritayasaṃyuktairjuhuyādaruṇotpalaiḥpriyaṃgupuṣpairmadhvaktaihutvā paṃcasahasrakaṃavirāllabhate maṃtrīnidhānāni ca paśyatinityaṃ dvādaśadhā hutvā maṃḍāatsyādvarāpatiḥtāmaṃbhāsivinikṣipyaśovinetracaruṃ pacetṣaṇmāsaṃśukravāreṣu hutverthaprāmuyādvarāṃdharādhidyāṃ prajaptyaikaṃ lakṣaṃ vidhivadarcikteśuddhātmā ravisāhasraṃ dhanaratnaughasaṃkulāvarāmevaṃ bhajanmaṃtrī paśuraladhanādibhiḥdharāyāṃ maṃtramahātmyamiti kiṃcinmayeritaṃtrapīvījaṃ vṃduyutaṃ caturthasvaramapyathāmukhavṛtamutāṃ bhūmidhyāṃtyaṃ rudrasamanvitaṃhṛdayena samāsuktāṃ nīlāvidyoyamīritāsarvakṣetramayīsarvalokatrayavaśaṃkarīnīlādevīdevatāsyādvojaṃ syādvāmalocanaṃkālāṃvudasamākārāṃkasuritilakāṃkitāṃdivyādacaṃdanaliptāgīṃ divyapuṣpasraganvitāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kamalaṃ dadhanīṃ hasteśaraccaṃdrasāmānanāṃnīlādevīmiti dhyātvā lakṣamekaṃ japetvaciṃācāryadākṣiṇaṃ datvāvidyāsiddhimavāpnuyātjaptyāhutvātrisāhasraṃ paredyuḥ kamalaisitaiḥdatvācārya yadadvaṃdve siddhiṃ prāpnotyanujamāṃvasuṃdharāvatpūjāsyārnnīlāyāpibhūyateḥghṛtatrimadhusammiśraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāddhaviḥpalāśakusumairhukhā paṃcasāhasramādarātaruṇairutpalairhutvā ṣaṭsahasraṃjiteṃdriyajaptvā lakṣamimaṃ vidyāṃ tulasīvanamdhyataḥlabhate sarvasāmrājyaṃ saṃpatimacalāmayaṃkanyāmiṣṭhāmavāpnoti rūpaśīlaguṇānvitāṃdhanaṃdhānye caralānividyāṃ ca mahatīṃ labhetvāsudevādividyānyaṃ māhātmyamathavakṣyateparabrahmātmakasyādyāvidyāṃ sakalāsiddhidāṃvateyadamayoccāryamukhavṛtayutāṃ sudhāṃvaruṇaṃ dīrghasahitaṃ mārutākṣaramapyathāsamastavedavedāṃtasārabhūtārthasaṃgrahāsvāyaṃbhuvādayaḥ pūrvaṃ vāsudevamahāmanuṃdhuvopināradādeśādvādaśārṇaṃ śriyaḥ pateḥāyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ yaśarthāvanasaṃvayāḥdvādaśārṇamanorjāyātsidhyatyakhilasiddhayaḥdvādaśārṇanusaṃvānānnityamasya prakāśatevāsudevamahāvidyājasavyādvādaśākṣarīvāsudevābhidhaṃ brahmakathyate daivataṃ vudhaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇavena hṛdinyasya namasāśirasinyasetkavacaṃ paṃcamirvarṇaiḥ samaste nāstramācaretvalayāgadahārakirīṭadharaṃ navakuṃdanirbhapraṇatāmi sadāarvaviraṇāsaṃyuktaṃ vāptyapīṭhe prapūjayetaṣṭapatre vāsudevaṃ śriyaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tataḥprītirdvādaśapatre jvetkeśavamāditaḥmadhusūdanamabhyarcyatrikramāmathaḥ paraṃpadmanābhaṃ samabhyarcyadāmodaramataḥ paraṃitthamabhyarcyaviśveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagatpatiṃhutvā śubhratilairgavyaghṛtannimadhumiśritaiḥvāsudeva mahāvidyāsiddhimāpnoti śāśvatīṃdvādaśyāṃ ca samabhyasyā divārātramananyadhīḥvisahasraṃ śubhatilairvarṣāśanamitaṃ vasukṣīrāktāmirasyakṣīrasamidbhirjvalite nalegoṣṭhe vṛṃdāvanevāpi lakṣajāpī payovrataḥpāragaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ bhagavatpatra na saṃśayaḥhutvā dvādaśa sāhasraṃ havirājya madhuplutaṃkaṃdrpasadṛśaḥ kāṃtyā jīveccaśaradāṃśataṃmirāmapaścirāpuṣpalabhate nātrasaṃśayaḥayunatritayaṃ hutvā bhagavatkalayānvitaḥāyurārogyamatulabhadvi putrādi saṃyutāṃpathurāyāyāmadhaḥ śāyīhaviṣyāśī jiteṃdriyāḥkimanena japenāśunāsādhayatimaṃtravit***** siddhaṃ tvaṃ khecaratvamathāpi vādyadaśākṣaravidyāpāyakrakukrapi vā japāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kulānāṃ śatamudhatyaṃ modate paramepadeyasya vijñānamātreṇa palāyaṃte mahāpadaḥudvaredvaiṣṇavovidyāṣaḍarṇeyasudīritāmahāpātakasaṃhartrī bhuktimukti phalapradādevatā śrīmahāviṣṇuparamātmā śriyaḥpatiḥekena ca tribhirdvābhyāṃ dvirāvṛtyāṣaḍaṃgakaṃmūle kalmatarordivyaratnasiṃhāsane śubhośaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ śrīvatsavakṣasaṃpadmapatraviśālākṣaṃ kāmakoṭi samadyutiṃsahitaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve dhatacāmarahastayāvimalotkarṣiragījñānādyaṣṭhaśaktibhirāvṛtaṃviṣṇuṃ viśvaṃbharavaṃdejajattrāṇāparāyaṇāṃjayet ṣaḍakṣarīṃ vidyāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ sarvasiddhidāṃācāryasannidhīkṛtya daśāṃśaṃtarpayetyayaḥācāryacaraṇadvaṃdve datvā vahuladakṣiṇāṃlakṣmīnārāyaṇeyoge paṃcaviṃśatsahasrakaṃhutvātilairghṛtābhyaktaiḥ strisahasraṃ samāhitaḥvidyāsiddhimavāpnoti sadya eva mahartarājatvālakṣannayaṃ vidyāṃ vidhivat saṃskṛte naleaṇimādi guṇānprāpya sarvajño bhavati dhruvaṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ hutvāgrau vidhivacchuciḥpāragaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ bhavatyatra na saṃśayaḥataḥ paramasaunityaṃ maheṃdrādīnprapaśyatianenaivaśarīreṇa tejomapatanurbhṛśaṃṣaḍakṣarī mahāvidyāmanvahaṃ prajapatrimāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇavaṃ nāma sāyuktaṃ viṣṇaveśabdamapyathāvaruṇaṃ dakṣanetrārghā dvitīyoṣmāṇamapyathaekādaśākṣrīvidyā vaiṣṇuvīyamudāhṛtāāyurārogyasaṃpatikāriṇī bhuktumuktidāmahāpātakasaṃhatrīṃ mahāritaghātinīpraṇavena māyuktā japtavyā satataṃ dvijaiḥicchatā satataṃ japyā viṣṇyaurekādaśākṣarītraiṣṭumacchaṃda ukraṃsyānmahāviṣuśriyaḥ patiḥhṛtdyakriruktālakṣmīśaprītaye viniyujyatepunastrivarṇevasubhiḥ ṣaḍaṃganyāsa īritaḥpaṃcalakṣaṃtuyenmonīpuraścaryārthamādarāttadvaśāṃśaṃ hunedagnau tilairājyamadhuplutaiḥsadya eva labhedvidvāsiddhiṃ sumahatīmapiārabhya paurṇamāsyaṃtaṃ paṃcaviśatsahasrakaṃtrisahasraṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ niśitvāyatavrataḥprāpnotyatra na saṃdeho vidyāsiddhiṃ mahatarāṃsuṃdarīlabhetaṃ kanyārūpaśīlaguṇanvitaṃmahadārogyamāsādyajīvedvarṣasahasrakaṃarkasāhasrekaṃ sākṣātkaṃdarpaśatasatibhaḥghṛtannimadhusaṃmiśraṃ pāyasaṃ jvalite nalegrahaṇe sparśamārabhyamokṣakālāṃtamādarātpivedvāpāyayedvāpi sarvavidyāprakāśanaṃskhalahrīspaṣṭa vāgbhūtvā sakṛddhā śravaṇādapiniṣkāṇāṃ paṃcakaṃ vāpi diniṣkaṃ vāpi kāṃcanaṃaṣṭhāṃgayogasidhyarthaṃ tulasīvanamadhyagaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ghṛtatrimadhusaṃmmiśrerhutvātha jvalite nalejapādekādaśākṣaryā vaiṣṇavyānityamādarātyaṃtrapūjādikaṃ sarvamanayorvāsudevavatguṇavaṃtaṃ śriyāyuktaṃ māyuṣmāṃtaṃ labhesutaṃbhūtvā jñānīlatenmuktiṃ kulānāṃ śatasaṃyutaḥkathitaṃte mayā bhūyamāhātmyaṃ kiṃcidiṣṭhadaṃyajñeśavidyāmahātmyamakhila śrutisaṃgrahaṃyajñeśavidyā mahātmyaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi bhūyataihṛdayena samāyuktaṃ viduhīnaṃ śriyīkṣaraṃvasuṃdharākṣarapaścānmārutena samanvitaṃkṣetraiśākṣaramuccārya śrīmadaṣṭārṇamuccaretaṣṭādaśākṣarī proktā sarvajñā'jñaparelapradāādhivyādhi harīnṛṇāṃ sarvasāmrājyā saṃddhidāsarvalokahitodyuktā devairāpi sadārcitāḥdṛṣṭā praṇamya sāṣṭhāṃgaṃ papraccharidamāhṛtānamaskurmovayaṃ yuṣmatpādābjebhyomaharṣayaḥbhaviṣyāmonṛlokesmin kathaṃ vā brahmarūpiṇaḥavunanvātaraśanānṛṣīndīrghatapasvinaḥjagatohitaṃ vedāṃteṣvaṣavedeṣu sārabhūtaṃ sanātanaṃdevatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanāṃyāgairakhiladevānābhaṃ bhavenmukte kaṇatrayātkathyate sarvavedeṣu vedāṃteṣvapi bhūyetaṛṇatrapavimuktiḥ syāttānubherbhūridukṣiṇaiḥdvijaḥ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaṃ yāgaṃ kṛtvaikamapi vā bhuvipaurṇamāsyāṃ tathā darśakṛtveṣṭimadyanāśinī

sanskrit: prātarmadhyāhnavelāyāṃ snāśaktopi satataṃmadhyāhnepi yathā śaktyā gāyatrīṃ samupāsya caācāryapādukāyugmaṃ yadi tiṣṭhati maṃdirepādukā sannidhau nityaṃ kiṃcidārpadakṣiṇāṃvatsaratritarpanaiva pādukārcanato guṇaiḥprāpnoti mahatīṃ siddhiṃ maṃtrāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥliṃge vā pūjayennityaṃ pārvatīparameśvarauhutvā dvādaśadhā vahnāvannaṃgavyaghṛtaplutaṃācāryaṃ bhojayetasya patnīmapi sutānapiyadvā varṣāśanamitaṃ dhanamācāryapādayoḥtathāpyaharahaḥ kiṃciddeyamācāryapādayoḥrudreṇa bhuṃktaṃ nirmālāmabhojyamiti kathyateācāryabhuktaśiṣṭaṃ syādamṛtaṃ pāpanāśanaṃpavitraṃ kathyate vedeno cedaśuci tatsmṛtaṃahutvāśī kṛmīnbhuṃkte adatvā viṣabhugbhavetatithiṃtaṃ vijānīyādbhojayetaṃ prayatnataḥṣaḍeneharaharbhojyā annairbahuvidhairapiaparāmṛśyayobhuṃkte sabhuṃkte narakaṃ dhruvaṃaparāmṛśyate bhuṃkte sabhuṃkte kilviṣaṃ dhruvaṃbhojayedaśanādyaiśca coṣyalehyādibhistathābhuktvā yatheṣṭaṃ hastau ca prakṣālyacaraṇau mukhaṃsaṃsārayogakṣemāṃtamathagacchedvahiḥ pumānkṛtvā sāyaṃtanaṃ homamarddhāṃgaṃ śrīpatermanuṃcakrarvyūhātmakasyātha maṃtrāmānuṣṭumaṃ paraṃtāṃbūlāmodivadano gurupādāṃvujadvayaṃ
