sanskrit: itthaṃ pavitroyajvāsau brahmāryaśādhipabhuviḥatyatyadakṣiṇe yagopanamānaṃ vināśayetniḥphalānātra sasaṃdehaḥ kiṃcanārakaduḥkhadāḥbrahmārpaṇadhiyāt yasya brahmasya brahmasālokyasiddhidaḥvedahīno vṛthā vipro vṛthā vidyāpya vaidikīnāmadhādakāviprosāvayajyāsaṃmudīritaḥpunāti sakalaṃ vaśaṃ daśapūrvaṃ daśāvaraṃpūrṇāyāmathadaśavāvaiśākhe kārtikepi vātasyā puṇyaphalaṃ vaktaṃ nāhaṃ śaktomibhūyateyāgārtha dravyadānasya phalaṃ dhānnāmayātpi vāmahādānaśataṃdataṃ kurukṣetre ravigraheśrotriyāyadaridrāyadrāvya vaivāhikaṃ dadanvivāhārthaṃ dhanaṃ datvā viparvaṇivaiṇivairavesāhasraśassamutvātyāsahitasraiḥ pitāmahaiḥahutāgnirayajvā ca durbrāhmaṇa iti smṛtaḥtasrādavaśyaṃ kartavyoyāgassaṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥyāgeṣvanadhikarīyassu ācārya yadāṃvujevedavidyuḥ śrotriyebhyaḥ suvarṇaṃ śatakoṭiśaḥphalamāsādya tejasvī sahasrakulasaṃyutaḥbrahmaṇāsahasāyujyaṃ prāpnovaśriyaḥpateḥpuṣpabhyaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmah. suguptamapi vaidikaṃyajñanāyaṇīnāmnā śrīmadaṣṭādaśākṣarīācārya kṛpapālabdhā sarvaṛtuphalapradāyajñanārāyaṇīvidyāṃ prajeyā susamāhitaḥhutvācārya padāṃbhoje datvā śaktyā ca dakṣiṇaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahatīṃ supuraścaryā laghīvāṃ pūrṇadakṣiṇaṃsamastavidyāsramrājñī śrīmadaṣṭādaśākṣarīanayāsadaśīvidyā jagatotra yayāvanīśatakoṭimitasvarṇadakṣiṇasahitān ṛtūnaṣṭādaśārovidyāpuraścaraṇo nṛpauddhātyānparakemagrānpitṛnathapitāmahānaṣṭādaśākṣarīvidyāmunirbrahmā prajāpatiḥarddhāṃgaśrīyuto devaḥ kathyate jagatīpatiḥtrapyādyayāśriyā kuryāt paścāvyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṃgakaṃnyasya vānyasā vādhīmān dhyāyet svahṛdavāvujeāsīnaṃ jagadābhāsaṃ vīdālasamadyutiṃkarjamuktāphalābhadaṃtāliṃ sasmitā dharavidumaṃvibhrāṇaṃ ca gadāṃ ghaurāṃ vāmāṃge vidyudāvṛtiṃkirīṭahārakeyūrakuṃḍalādivibhūṣitāṃsahitaṃ vimalādyaṣṭamahiṣībhissamanvitaṃsunaṃdanaṃdapramukhaiḥ pārṣaderūpaśobhitaṃvidājitapadadvaṃdvamāpannārtiharehariṃnārāyaṇaṃ bhajenityaṃ paramātmānmacyutaṃaṣṭādaśākṣarīvidyā japtvā ṛtuphalaṃ labhetpāvano jagatyasmin sarvādyaudya vivarjitaḥmahāpātakayuktāśca nityamaṣṭādakṣmaṇakṣarīaṣṭādāśākṣarīvidyā japtyeyamepivatśrīmadaṣṭārṇavatproktamasyāyaṃnnārcanādikaṃjiteṃdriyo haviṣyāśī kṣīrāśī vā phalāśanaḥdaśāstrārcanāśa juhuyātpatyairutpalairvādyutaplutaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryacaraṇardvadvedatvā saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāṃathaṇa vā kārtikemāsivaiśākheśrāvaṇopi vāpaṃśaviṃśati sāhasraṃ prajaptvāṣṭā daśākṣārīśataniṣkaṃ tadardha vā vaṣīśanamitaṃ tu vāpaṃcaśitisaṃkhyākamithunānyapi bhojayetatha kāmyāni karmaṇi sādhe yadatayādvijāḥdaśāśakamalairhutvā ghṛtatrimadhumiśritaiḥpaścimahāraliṃgetha vṛṣabhūnyevivālayetatra vilvadalairhutvā gavyājya madhumiśritaiḥmuktāratnasamākīrṇamacalāṃ ca parāṃ śriyaṃnābhidaghrajalesthitvāmaṃḍalaṃ triśatādhikaṃśriyādhanadasaṃkāśo vidyayādhiṣaṇayametriśatādhikasāhasraṃ japtvākṛtvā ghṛtaṃ śataṃsvacchaṃdamaraṇe bhūtvā vyādhibhirnabhibhūyateaṣṭonaraśataṃ nityaṃ hutvā prajvalite nalekarva āṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ laghubhiḥ kadalīphalaiḥmaṃḍala dvitayenā sau saptadvīpādhināyakaṃmadhukaiṭamahaṃ tāraṃ dhyātvārdvāgaśriyaḥpatiṃduṣṭānajñabhayāti kṣipraṃ nigṛhṇātyapi rājasānagnau dvādaśasāhasraṃ saṃprāpya mahatī śriyaṃamāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ ghṛtaṃsuvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ datvātatpalyaitatsutāyavāpūjyatepi mahedyaiḥ kimumartyermahītalevṛhaspati samaḥ sākṣādatvāṃ vidyāsusādhakaḥsatyalokevasatyaṃte kulānāṃśatasaṃyutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yajñanārāyaṇī japtvā paṃcavimśatsahasrakaṃsahasratritayaṃ hutvā varṣāśanamitaṃ dhanaṃavaśyaṃ hayamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamaṃmaheṃdrasadṛśo lakṣmyavidyayādhiṣaṇa prabhaḥbhuktvā suvipulānbhogān divyānapyatha mānuṣānsvīḍugrahaṇe sarvasaṃkrāṃniṣṭapi saṃtataṃjaptvā ca vidhivatilairājyavimiśritaiḥna śataśopi samuddhatya satyaloke nayatyasauarddhāṃgaṃ śrīpati vahnau dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃjapet paṃcaśataṃ vāpi catuḥśātamathāpi vāsāyāṃ kṛśānusānnidhye śatamaṣṭottarajapetcaturṇamapivedānāṃ phalāṃ pārāyaṇodbhavaṃsāṃgadakṣiṇayāyuktahayamedhaphalaḥ tathāyaduktaṃ maṃtramāhātmyaṃ maṃtramāhātmyaṃ mayātatubhyamīritaṃyeṣāṃ vijñānamātreṇa palāyaṃte vipadgaṇaḥbrahmanārāyaṇīvidyā saṃproktā paramarṣibhiḥnavākṣarīyaṃ saṃproktā brahmanārāyaṇī śubhābrahmadarśanasidhyarmyamāśuvijñānasiddhayeārṣadyaṃdādikaṃ cāsyāḥ sarvamaṣṭārṇamaṃtravatśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīyaṃścadvaṃ sa nārāyaṇīritāhaṃsanārāyaṇīvidyā japtavyāmuktisiddhayeprādhānyena na japtavyaṃ vidyādūyamidaṃ gṛhegṛhasthai ca vanasthaiścapatibhirbrahmacaribhiḥasyapi śrīmadaṣṭārṇamaṃtravatsarvamīritaṃnārāyaṇapadaṃ paścādvidyeyaṃ dvādaśākṣarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ārṣādikamapi proktamasyā aṣṭārṇamaṃtravatśropapadaṃ namasāyuktaṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ tataḥpraṇākamalāvījaṃ caturthyaṃ samanvitaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīpaścādvidyeṣā ṣoḍaśākṣarīaṣṭādaśārṇatvadvidyādvayāsvarṣādikaṃ smṛtaṃvakṣyethayājuṣīrghā lakṣmīnārāyaṇī śubhākurvāṇavīramityuktvāpadamātmana uccaretannapātre ca śabdaṃ ca sarvadā padasapyathalomaṇaṃ paśubhiḥ paścāt sahasvāhonamaḥ padaṃayamadhīgalakṣmīśamaṃtroyājuṣa ucyateyājuṣīyaṃ mahāvidyālakṣmīnārāyaṇī smṛtālakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥsvāmīdeva ukto maharṣibhiḥpuṃḍarīkākṣalakṣmyoḥpuraścaryā viśoṣonnakṣyate vasudhāyateghṛtatrimadhuyuktena haviṣā juhuyādathavidyāyāssiddhimāpnoti śāśvatī nātrasaṃśayaḥghṛtatriadhusaṃmiśraṃ havihutvā sahasrakaṃprāpnoti mahatī siddhiṃ dadyāyā nātrasaṃśayaḥmṛṣṭānnārāśilabhate vipinepi na saṃśayaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā vidyāmenāṃ śriyaḥpateḥācārye sannidhīkṛtya tulasīvanamadhyagaḥsvabhāvavaidikīvidyā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī śubhāgāyatryādi mahāvidyā asyārasmaya īritāḥsakṛtsmaraṇatopyetāḥ siddhidāssadya ehiācāryacaraṇādvaṃdvaṃ sevāpratyahamādarāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: calācatvarpitāni bhagavātsānnidhyaṃ prāpayaṃti hihayagrīvādi vidyānāṃ māhātmyanayakṣyateyasya vijñānamātreṇa vācāṃ siddhirbhavet parāsarvavāgīśvaretyaṃte pravadedīśvaretyathavodhayadvitayotoyaṃ maṃtrastārādirīritaḥtādeṇayādairmaṃtasya paṃcāṃgāni pravinyasetrathāṃgasaṃkhāṃcita vāhuyagmaṃ jānudvayanyastakaraṃbhajāmaḥdaśāṃśaṃ vaiṣṇuve vahnau hātvācārya padāṃvujevidyāsiddhimāvāpnoti yadvāvarṇasvahasrakaṃtrisahasraṃ hunedagnau triśādhikamādarātpraṇama vā datvā svācāryakarapaṃkajeaṣṭākṣarodite yaṃtre hayagrīvaṃ prapūjayetvipadbhagusthamaghośavidrumadvījamīritaṃvidikṣvaṃgasmṛtinyāya sarvaṇasrāṇi pūjyetvādyetlokeśvārāsteṣī vajrādyastrīṇiyaṃ yajetvailvaiḥ phalaiḥ kṛto homaḥ śrīkaraḥpati kīrtitaṃmanunānena saṃyuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ brāhmī rasānvitaṃvacāmanena saṃjaptvāṃ bhakṣayet prātaranvahaṃmanorasya samonāsti jñānaiśvāryapradāyakaḥvedāharaṇaśabdaṃ ca hetubhūtāyaśavṛtaḥmatsyā kṛteripavidyāśrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥaṃgironni prabhṛtayojayaṃtī mahāmanuṃdharmārthakāmamokṣākhya puruṣārtha phalapradāchaṃdogāyatramevoktaṃ mahāmatsyā kṛtirhariḥvījaṃnnayīmape proktaṃ hṛcchaktiḥ samudīritā

sanskrit: śaratpūrṇedasaṃkāśaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaṃkuṃḍaladvayasaṃśobhimukhābjaṃ matsyarūpiṇāṃskaśaṃkhacakradharaṃ mudrocinmayī dakṣiṇe karevidhātre sakalānvedānprayacchaṃtaṃ jagatpatiṃbhagavaṃtaṃ bhajeviṣṇuṃ sarvadevemarpa vibhuṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ japtvā prāpnoti vāchitaṃkutaryaye tadṛśīśena kṣīreṇekṣurasena vāācāryacaraṇadvaṃdve datvā vahuladakṣiṇāṃhutvā nīllotpalaisṣta sahasrāṇi ghṛtaplutaiḥjaptva vidhāmimāṃ lakṣaṃ tato raktāṃvujai hunetmahārṇaveni magnopi smṛtve maṃtramādarātjapteyaṃ lakṣamātreṇamūkaṃ maṃdadhiyaṃ tu vāvilvapatrairghṛtābhyaktairhutvā bhānusahasrakaṃtatprasādena labhate vāṃchitaṃ sarvamakṣayaṃkuṣvāsahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃ nityaṃ haviṣyabhuksamastābhīvṛsaṃpraptihaitu bhūtomanūjamaḥoṃ namaḥ padamābhāṣyapadaṃ bhagavate tataḥvidyāsaptadaśārṇoyaṃ śrīpateḥ kūrmārūpiṇaḥśrīpateḥ kūrmarūpasya brahmasāyujyasiddhidākūrmarūpimahāviṣṇurdevatājagatāṃpatiḥśyāmavarṇa caturvāhukaṭamaṭhākṛtimacyutaṃāsīnamāsanedivye hemaratnamayeśubhedivyāmaraṇasaṃyuktāṃ divyasragvastradhāriṇīvaṃdyamiṃdrādibhirdevaiḥ prasannavadanaṃ vibhuṃasyāśca matsyavidyāyāyaṃtrapīṭhārcanādikaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣameka prajaptvādau daśāśaṃkaravīrakaiḥvahulāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ datvā maṃtrasiddhimavāpnuyātśvāyānugrahasāmarthyaṃ labhate nātrasaṃśayaḥprāpnoti mahatīṃ lakṣmīdhanadhānyādi saṃkulāṃsarvābhīṣṭamavāpnoti muktiṃ cāpnotyanuttamāṃanvahaṃ salabhedbrahmasāyujyamapidurlabhaṃiti kiṃcinmayāproktaṃ varāhasyātha vakṣyeteyaṃtrārcanaṃ bhūyayatkṛtvā siddhimānbhavetyacchutvāpi na rodhīmānumucyatapāpadāśibhiḥrūpāyabhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ syātpatayetadanaṃtaraṃvahni jāyāvadhirmaṃtraḥ syāccatustriṃśadakṣaraḥbhūpatitvādisaṃsiddhiprado duḥkhaudyabhedataḥdevātādivārāhātmā bhagavāniṃdiśapatiḥśikhātejodhipataye viśvarūpāvarma camahādaṃṣṭrā paṃcāstrasyā paṃcāga kalpayet punaḥkṣitidharaṇalasadaṃṣtamādyaṃ varāhaṃjuhudyāmadaśāṃśena svācāryacaraṇadveyavahudakṣiṇaṃ pāyuktāṃ datvā siddhimavāpnuyātmārgaśīrṣābhidhemasikamalaistrimadhuchutaiḥsadakṣiṇaṃ mahīdatvā siddhamaṃtraḥ prajāpatemūrtimūlena saṃkalpya vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥastraṃ kīṇeṣvadhaścordhā cakrādyastrāṇi tadvahiḥsaṃpūjya vādyet lokeśānvahirastraṇi pūjayetprayacchatyeva pūjādyairdhanadhānyamahīśriyaḥpaṃcagavyeṣu nikṣipya spṛṣṭātāmayutaṃ japet

sanskrit: śatrucoramahābhūtaiḥ kṛtāṃ vādhāvi nāśayetmṛtikāṃsajapenmaṃtratāṃ punarvibhanennidhāgodugdhe paramālopraśodhitaṃ taṃḍulaṃ kṣipetavatārya caruṃ paścādagnaudevaṃ yathāvidhijuhuyā udite vahnau yāvadaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃprātaḥ kāle bhagorvāremṛdaṃ sādhyamahītalātvirodho naśyati kṣetre sahacārādyupadravaiḥtrisahahṛstraṃ prajuhuyātasyasyussarvasaṃpadaḥsamṛddhadhānyasaṃghātaiḥ śābhate tasya maṃdiraṃkanyāmavāpnoti madhvaktairnijavāṃchitāṃatha yajñavarāhasya yaṃtraṃ vakṣye phalapradaṃparastādvasuhalakamalaikesarastha svarādyebhūviṃvenāsya koṇeṣu bhūvījaṃ sādhyaṃ saṃyutaṃsādyīśarvidugaganaṃ vījaṃ vārāhamīritaṃgomayāṃbhasi saṃpiṣṭairlikhedyaṃtraṃ śubhe dinesvarṇapīṭe likhedyaṃtraṃ rājyaśrīsamavāhyeyabhūrjapatrainijeṣṭāsyaikṣaumebhūsiddhayelikhetkṣudrāya mṛtyucaurādibhūtavyālamahābhayaiḥyasya śravaṇamātreṇa layaṃ yāṃti vipadgaṇaḥmahāviṣṇuṃ tṛtīyasyā jvalaṃtaṃ padamapyathabhīṣaṇaṃ bhadramuktvātha mṛtyumathoccaretmaṃtrādau praṇavaṃ vāmalocanakhaṃ samuccaretāhuṣṭabha mahāvidyāmirtthakecijjapaṃti hiśuddhamānunuṣṭabhaṃ maṃtraṃ japaṃti bhuvikecananānayā sadṛśī vidyādaṣṭā sakalasiddhidā

sanskrit: chaṃda ānuṣṭamaṃ proktaṃ paramātmāsanātanaḥanaṃtāvījamityuktaṃ śaktiḥ śaktirūdīritātataḥ paraṃ punaḥ padadvāyenāpi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasetataḥśirolalāṭadāyugmamukheṣu karasaṃdhiṣugalapārśvāsakakudikramādvaṇīnnyasenmanoḥdīptajihvadaṃṣṭograṃ bhūtakeśaṃvadanamapivahanyātumānārasiṃhaḥyadvā śāṃtākṛtiṃ dhyāyennārasiṃhaṃ jagatpatiṃidhavalaṃ lakṣmī nṛsiṃhaṃ bhajemūtiṃ mūlena saṃkalpya pūjayītvepacārakaiḥpakṣīdraṃśaṃkarānaṃtaudiṣu brahmāṇamarghayetbhaskārīvaśyakārītathāmāṇākāryapividyetpāvaraṇe pūjyāstṛtīye vasudhāpateśaṃkhaṃ kheṭhaṃ gadāṃpāśamarcayedevamataḥśrīvatsaṃ dkṣiṇe madhye vanamālāṃ ca pūjayetbhūṣaṇāni ca sarvāṇi purībhāge tu pūjayetbhayānakāṃ ārdradīptiṃ cāṣṭadikṣupūrvādi kramato yajetyadvā śivāvṛtiṃ dhyātvā nṛsiṃha prajapenmanuāṃtramālādharaṃ raudrakaṃṭhahoraṇaśobhitaṃdhanuśramuśalaṃ caiva tathā cakraṃ ca bhinnataṃiṃdraṃ gopakanīlābhaṃ caṃdrasvārṇasannibhaṃeva mugrahari dhyāyet sarvavyādhinivṛtayeyoryayahāmahatkarmatṛdāṣoḍaśahastakāndvauvihahaṇakarmāḍhyaudau cāṃtroddhrāraṇocitaukhaḍgakheṭadharau dvau gadāpadmadhāriṇaiiti ṣoḍaśakodaḍaṃmaṃḍinaṃ nṛhariṃ vibhuṃ

sanskrit: smṛtvā śriyaḥ patiṃ devamāṃjaneyaṃ tataḥ paraṃkurvannitya mahorātraṃ karmavaidikamādarātyatkṛtvā manujoloke śreyo mahadavāpnuyātvaidikācārahīnoyojīvanneva sa paṃcamaḥhiraṇyābhyudayaśrāddhaṃ kuryādācamya yatnataḥtāṃvūlagaṃdhamālyānibhūṣaṇānyapi suvrataḥjātake mṛtake cāpi saṃdhyākarma na saṃtyajetekādaśehni kurvītanāma karma tataḥparaṃgarbhāṣṭamemāvdevābrāhmaṇasyoyanāthanaṃbrahmacārī tadāramya vedādhyana siddhayeājñāṃnollaṃghaye tasya samitpuṣpakuśādikānkṛtvā bhikṣādanaṃ nityaṃ gurave vinivedayettatpūśūnyālayennityaṃ tadgṛhaṃ mārjayet sadāvedānadhītyavedau vā vedaṃ vā śaktito dvijaḥananyapūrvikāṃ suptāṃ niṣkrāṃtāṃrudatīmapiraktakeśaśmaśumatīṃpiṃgākṣīṃ vikṛtastavīṃvarjayedvaraṇe kanyārātārājanmahāmateśrotriyānvaya saṃbhūtāṃ gṛhārcanaratāṃ sadāgṛhasaukhyasamṛdhyarthaṃ lakṣaṇyāṃ striyamudvahetpratikūlaṃ kalatraṃ cetkiṃduḥkhaṃ narakobhavetdharmeratiḥ sajjanasaṃgatiścaduḥsvasya mūloddharaṇāni paṃcaca tasro rātrayaḥ styājyā viṣamāsuna saṃviśetekādaśīparvavarjaṃ strīṣu saṃgamamācaretanṛtaṃ madyagaṃdha ca divāhyā paṃcamaithunaṃdevāścapitaronityaṃ gṛhastha mṛṣayopi ca
