sanskrit: dhyeyomahatamekāryeṣoḍaśadvayahastanāndakṣiṇe cakrapameva paraśuṃpākṣameva casatathāpadiśaṃtidiyātaṃ cakhe'muhuratomarānśūlakaṃ agniṃ ca varadaśaktiṃ kuṃḍikāṃ ca tataḥ paraṃkarābhyāṃ ca riporjānumastapīḍanaṃaṃdhasthitābhyāṃ vāhubhyāṃ hiraṇyakavidāraṇaṃnṛsiṃhaṃ saṃsmaderedittha mahāmṛtyubhavāyahaṃkṣudraviṣagrahāmapariyupradhaṃsanaṃ śrīkaraṃsutīrthātoyasaṃpūrṇanyastraralauṣadhānvitānnṛsiṃhaṃ pūjayeṣṭau pūrvādiṣu yathā kramaṃabhiragrahonmādāvinaśyaṃtyiribhissahayathāvatpūjayedbhaktyāśaktyācārya padadvayaṃlakṣamekaṃ puraścaryādayutadvitayottaraṃtrisahasraṃ hunedagnau ghṛtamiśraiḥ kuśeśayaiḥkuṃḍaladvitayaṃtvā vidyasiddhimavāpnuyāttrisahasraṃ hunedagnau ghṛtamiśraiḥ kuśeśayaiḥvarṣārānamitaṃ durvyadatvācāryasya dakṣiṇāṃjuhuyādathāpsuśāṃtipraṣātyeva tathopasargā ayohiśāṃtā iti ca śrutiḥ syātprāprotyakhilajanatriyaścābhūyātjapamātamaṃtraśaktyāsusvaprobhavati kṣaṇodevaasādhitaṃ sadhitameva tasya bhavatyavaśyaṃ mithileśabhūyaativiṣonabhṛṇapiviṣeṇāpyasau vimuktaḥ sukhī bhavatyavaśyaṃ mithileśabhatiaṣṭottaraśatajapenābhimaṃtritaṃ ca bhasmādyaṃ sa śiroṣṇimaṃtrauṣadhābhicārakṛtānvikārānayaṃ manuḥ śamayetsaṃprāpyamedhāsaṃtudharmaśāstrairiṣṭārthasiddhiṃ labhate varṣāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ayutaṃ nāmadhunāktaiśca daridro na bhavetkuleaṣṭapalakṣahomenadena samogbhavetśatādyonairmalyamāpnoti prasādaṃ cādhigacchatimadhūkapuṣpahomena sarvābhīṣṭaprajapetasaktuhomenaśālāgnau jagadvaśyaṃ prajāpatekadalīphalahomena sarvavighnaurvimucyetajuhuyādayutaṃ yo sauśataṃ jivati roḍājitjaptvā jihvāsau yamṛtyuśaṃtaṃ vārṣāṇi jīvativāṃkasthitayālakṣmyāliṃgitaṃ padmahastayāsiddho bhūtve hasataṃtaṃ sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavetpadmamaṣṭadalapūrvaṃ viracapya samāhitaḥṣaṭkoṇaṃ sumanoharaṃ vilikhet praṇavaṃ tatra nṛsiṃhaikādarṇagarbhitaḥmāpayāveṣṭhayitvātha vasupatraimanohare likhitvādvātriṃśāraṃ mahāpadmaṃ tadvahirveṣṭayedathedvātriṃśadatpadmapatrāṇiśatmātātyapiveṣṭhayettataḥ tatpūrvabhāge saṃlikhyahādīnekā daśākṣarāntadanataravarṇānapyaṣṭau tatra samālikhetvṛtasya pārśvayorarṇadvalekhyaṃ prapalataḥpūjayeddhārayedyadvāsarvapāpaivirmucyetaavāpya mahatīmedhāmaṃte brahmamayo bhavetāyurārogyasaṃpatikāraṇaṃ putravarddhanaṃiti kiṃcinmayā proktaṃ vāmatasyātha vakṣyatepathīpadiṣṭāṃ vakṣyamividyāṃ sakalasiddhidāṃdakṣaśrotrayutaṃ ṣāṃtyaṃ dvitīyāṃ tasya mapyathavāyurudrasamāyuktamaṃtasthādyamataḥ paraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛṣirdhanadaputrosya nalakūvā ucyetavinyaseddhīmān varṇanyāsamathanyesan mūrdhnikeṭeca vāhuyugale nābhau pṛṣṭhai ca guhyakejānvopādayuge varṇannyasediti yathākramaṃvibhracchrī vāmanākhyaḥ satatamavatunoviriṣṭorthadāyīsavyasahasre dadhānaṃtarati sakalaḍaḥ khādvāmanaṃ bhāvayedyaḥmūlenamūrtisaṃkalpya vāmanaṃ viṣṇumarcayetprītistuṣṭiśca puṣṭiścavṛddhirṣṭatistataḥ paraṃśaśinī durmātā caiva lakṣmī chāyā tathaiva caetābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ proktaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śubhaṃtṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ proktakumudaḥ kumudekṣaṇaḥsarpanetraśca sumukhassupratiṣṭhita ityapiyamaṃkhaḍgaṃ ca muśalaṃ śārṅavāṇānataḥ paraṃitthamabhyarvyasatataṃ vāmanaṃ viṣṇumacyutaṃturlakṣaṃ japedādau daśāṃśaṃ tarpatyayaḥgośataṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dadyādāthāryasya padadveyepaṃciviṃśati sāhasramaya vāmrāvaṇe japetvarṣāśanamitadravyasahitaṃ ca sa vatsakaṃinityaṃ dvādaśadhā vahnau hutvā dadhyannamādarātsahasraṃ prajayeprastunityaṃ niyamataḥ śuciḥatra kāmohunennityamaṣṭhāviṃśati saṃkhyayāapūyaṣaḍgasoṣetamannameṣṭa sahasrakaṃdadhyannaṃ śarkamarāyuktaṃ hutvā daśasahasrakaṃhunedvilvasamīpasthaḥ padmākṣairayutaṃ śuciḥvidyāthī prajapellakṣaṃ dhyātvā devaṃ janārdanaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: putrakāmo hunellakṣaṃ putrajīvī phalai hunetdhyātvā trivikramadevaṃ raktābhaṃ karavīrakaiḥrājyakāmoyikamalairhutvā daśasahasrakaṃapārmāgedalairhutvālaivaṃgairvāmadhuplutaiḥārogyakāmo juhuyādayāmāgaissahasrakaṃāyuṣkāmastrimadhaktaistiladūrvākuśakṣataiḥsmṛtvā trivikramaṃ devaṃ japtvā daśasahasrakaṃmuktovadhaṃ na tassadyobhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥśiṣṭārāyijñīllasitāṃtyapatramaṣṭhākṣaraihṛjvalapatrakārthaṃdarṇamakhaṃḍa viṃveyaṃtraṃtvidaṃ śrīmadamīṣṭada caihabhuktvārivalānbhogābhaṃte vahyapadaṃ vrajetyasyā vijñānamātreṇa vinaśyaṃti vipadgaṇāḥjāmadagnyāyaduṣṭeti kṣānniyeti padaṃ tataḥreṇukāputraśabdaṃ ca hṛdayena samanvitaṃsamastaduḥkhaśamanīvairivargavidāriṇītrayīvījaṃ hṛcchaktiḥ samuddīritāṣaḍbhirdvābhyāṃ ṣaḍaṃgāninyasediti samāhitaḥjamadagnisutaṃ vīraṃ dadhānaṃ paraśuṃ śubhaṃnamāmibhārgavaṃ rāmaṃ śiṣyaṃ gaurīyetarvibhuṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā śāśvatīṃ siddhimaśnutedaśāṃśaṃ pāyasaṃ hutvā ghṛtatrimadhumiśritaṃlabhate mahatī siddhiṃ samastaphalāsiddhirddātriśatādhikasāhasraṃ hunetyāya samādarātsiddhiprāpnoti mahatī vidyāyānātrasaṃśayaḥsiṃhavyāghrādibhītauvarakṣaḥ kūrṣmādujebhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vimuktassakalāyadbhyaḥ sadya eva bhavatyasaujaptvā vidyāmimāṃ nityaṃ sahasratrayamādarātgīṣṭhe samudgatīre vā guroścaraṇasannidhauhutvā palāśakusumairdatvācāryasya dakṣiṇāṃsākṣāddhiṣaṇasaṃkāśo bhavatpatra na saṃśayaḥarkasāhasramāprīti vipulāṃśriyamakṣayāṃsākṣātpaśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ bhārgavaṃ rāmamavyayaṃāyuṇarogyamaiśvaryaṃ vasūni paśavopi camūrtimūnaṃ na saṃsakalpyapūjayedbhārgavaṃ vibhuṃatrimapyanasūryā ca datātreyaṃ śriyaṃ tathāiṃdrādīnaṣṭadikālāṃścaturasrāṣṭadiśvapivijayī satataṃ bhūtvā ramate brahmāṇathadekiṃ citsādhanamuktaṃte śrīrāmasyāthavakṣyatepravakṣyāmi mahāvidyāṃ sarvavedāṃtasaṃgrahāṃraghunaṃdanaśabdaṃ ca caturthyamta samanvitaṃ** prasannavadanāyāmite tajesa udītmukhavṛtayutayādyayārghrātastha tataḥ paraṃuccarejjānakonāthavidyeyaṃ samudīritāmahādāridya śamanīrājyaiśvarya kalapradāsamastasaṃyatsāmrājyahetubhūtāśivaṃkarīsamastaiśvarya phaladāsarvavidyāpradāyinīvālmīki mukhyāḥ kavayoḥ nāradādyā purātanāḥtārakabrahmavidyeyamakhilānaṃdasiddhidārājyābhiṣiktaḥ śrīrāmaḥ paramātmā jagatpatiḥpraṇavākhyaṃ mahavījaṃ śaktirnatirūdīritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptavarṇaiḥ hyataḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samabhidaṃ śabhistadyāayodhyānagareramyekalpadumavanāṃtaresamāsīnaṃ trijagatāṃ pītanīlāṃvudadyutiṃakalaṃkaśaraccaṃdrasamavakraṃ madvīpatiṃdadhānaṃ cinmayīṃ mudrājānvāsaktamujaṃ vibhuṃvaktrāraṃ sarvavidyānāṃdātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadāṃvāmāṃkāsūṭajanakakanyayādivyabhūṣayāvibhīṣaṇāṃ janeyādyaiḥ kiṃkarairnityamarcitaṃsugrīvādyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ sumaṃtrādyaṣṭamaṃtribhiḥśaraṇyaṃ sarvajagatāṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalaṃṣaṭkāṇaṃ padmamaṣṭāraṃ caturasra samacitaṃtanmadhye vilikhet sādhyaṃ vījaṃ kāmasamanvitaṃdaśākṣareṇabhūyopitahlonaṃ keṣṭhayennṛpahuṃvījaṃ pratikoṇāgraṃ kesarāgresuvasvarāndaledale likhitvāṃtyayatre paṃcākṣarān likhetcaturasrasya saṃproktaṃ yaṃtrametadramāyateḥupacāraiḥ samabhyarcya tadvāme janakātmajāṃātmāṃtarātmaparamajñānātmānastataḥparaṃpradyumnotharatiḥ paścādatiruddhastata'paraṃāgrehanūmānsugrovo bharatītha vibhīṣaṇadhṛṣṭirjapaṃto vijayaḥ siddhārthaḥścārthasādhanaḥsamabhyarcya vaśiṣṭhau vāmadevastataḥpareviśvāmitrothavālmīki nīdadaścāmahān ṛṣiḥśarabhaśca tatormedodvividovitataḥ paraṃgurutmaṃtaṃ samabhyarcya viṣkakasenaṃ samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityabhyarcya punardhūpadīpādyairapitoṣāyetvidyaiśvaryanidhirbhūtvā modate bhagavasadeācyaryaṃ sannidhīkṛtya ghṛtatrimadhumiśritaṃsamarpya vahulaṃvitaṃ maṃtrasiddhimavāpnuyātekabhaktāśino bhūtvā tatyurvadivasatrayaṃhutvā kṛṣṇatilairagraughṛtannimadhumiśritaiḥdatvā varṣaśanaṃ dravyaṃ vidyāsiddhimāvāpnuyātārogyaṃ mahadasādyasarvavidyānidhirbhavetrājyalakṣmīmavāproti daśasāhasrato nṛpapāyasenājyayuktena hutvā viṣvānidhi bhavetjadyāt paṃcāgnimadhyasthaḥ kamalairmadhumiśritaiḥdūrvābhirājyasiktāmirhutvā daśasahasrakaṃhutvā nīlotpalaiḥ samyagayutaṃ sādhakottamaḥhutvā raktāṃvuje ragrāvayutaṃ ghṛtamiśritaiḥghṛtamiśraṃ yayo hutvā ṣaṭsahasraṃ yatavrataḥvilvaprasūtairjuhuyādābjatrimadhumiśritaiḥkaravīrakusumai hutvā lakṣannimadhumiśritaiḥaṣṭāviṃśādhikaṃ nityaṃ cirāśataṃ yojayetchutiḥrājyābhiṣiktā śrīsamavidyeyasamudīritāyadanuṣṭānamātreṇa sarvasaubhāgyasiddhibhākgoviṃdāyadaṃ paścāduteyījan padaṃ tastataḥkṛṣṇavidyeyamākhyātāmahāsaubhāgyasiddhibhākaināṃ vidyāṃ purādhyā nārado bhagavānapijagatritaya sāmrājyahetubhūtāsanātanīṛṣirasya vidhirbrahmāgāyatraṃ chaṃda ucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmarājaṃ vījamuktaṃ śaktiḥ pāvakavallabhāpunaścaturbhirdvābhyāṃ ca ṣaḍāṃganyāsa īritaḥkalyātarostriṃbhagilalitadhyāyejjaganmohanaṃcaturlakṣaṃ puraścaryātsādhakaḥ śuddhamānasaḥtadaśāṃśaṃ hunedagnau paṃkajairmadhumiśritaiḥācāryacaruṇadvaṃdve daśāṃśaṃ suvarṇakaṃyadvāṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ nabhomāsi japcchuciḥhutvā saranuvarargena nirmitaṃ kuṃḍaladvayaṃdatvācāryayadadvaṃdegoyugmaṃca savatsakaṃvilikhya ṣaḍaraṃ pūrvaṃ vasupatrāṇyataḥ paraṃcaturviṃśati patrāṇi vilikhyātha mahīyatekāmavījaṃ likhenmandhye sādhyakarmasamanvitaṃkṛṣṇāṣṭākṣaravarṇaśca vasupatreṣvatho likhetaṣṭādaśasuyameṣu maṃtrarājākṣarāstrathatadvataṃ kāmarājena veṣṭayitvā tataḥ paraṃtadvataṃṣiṃḍagopālāmaṃtreṇa pariveṣṭayetpāśenāṃ kuśavījena tṛtīyamatha veṣṭayetsarvaduḥkhaharaṃ sarvadāridryaudyavibhedanaṃmūlenāja samāvādyat yajetkṛṣṇaṃ jagamaṃdvitīyaṃ vāsudevādyaiḥ svasvaśakti samanvitaiḥsutaṃdāmapi kāliṃdī tato jāṃvavatīmapivalabhadraṃ revatīṃ ca ca sudevakīcatuthaviraṇebhyarcya śakrādīnatha pūjayetsaṃprāpya sakalābhīṣṭaṃ devavanmodatenvahedhyātvārddarātre saptāhaṃ sahasratritayaṃ japan
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: goṣṭe gopayasāhutvā sahasratritayaṃ śuciḥdadhyodanaṃ hunedyastu nityamaṣṭottaraśataṃkadaṃvadumamūlakṣyo dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ jagatpatiaṇimādi guṇaiśvaryaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥmurkadaḥdhyāyanamaṃtrīmaṃtrajāpī ca nityaṃ pāpādvidvyaṃnmatratraprayātidevavanmānuṣeṣu *********ayutaṃ subhurcirbhūtvā saptarātraṃ dvijo jayetbhikṣāhārojayenmaṃtra saṃvatsaramataṃdritaḥkanyārthī khādirai hutvā daśasāhasramādarātdadhimadyājayukūlājerpadvā hutvā yutaṃ vudhaḥnavanītāśanaṃ kṛṣṇa dhyātvo lūkhaladhanaṃśatamaṣṭottaraṃ jatvāpivaṃtaṃ pūjanāstanaṃsamastaviṣanāśārthaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ kālīyamardanaṃvimatātanapārūḍhaṃ haraṃtaṃ pārijātakaṃvijayīsatataṃ bhūtvā devavadbhuvimodateaṣṭottaraśataṃ śuddhomiyate nāyamatyubhiḥāyurāṇopamāsādyāvalaṃ tejañcāviṃśatikaṃdarpasadṛśaḥ kāṃtyāvidyayādhiṣaṇaprabhaḥbhūtvā bhuktveha sakalān bhogānapi manoramānetate kṛṣṇavidyāyāmāhātmyamadhnāśanaṃpāsāvijñānajīvāpi pāparāśirvinaśyativedamārga pratiṣṭhāṇakartre padaṃ tataḥbuddharūpasya vidyeyaṃ viṣṇostrijagatīpateḥmunirasyerito brahmāchaṃdogāyatramīritaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tribhīrvarṇeścaturvaṇairekāda daśabhirakṣeraiḥśyāmaṃ prasannavadanaṃ catuvāhuṃ kirīṭinaṃbuddharūpaṃ mahāviṣṇumiti dhyātvā manuṃ japetdaśāṃśaṃ kamalairddhatvāghṛtannimadhumitiśrataiḥvidyāsiddhimavāpnoti mucyate pātakairapimanumāhāpātakasaṃdyaiśca sadya eva vimucyatenārāyaṇa jagannāthāṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ vibhuṃpravakṣyāmi mahāvidyāṃ mahāsiddhipradāpinīṃkalkirūpapadaṃ paścāccaturyyāṃta samanvitaṃviṣṇave padamābhāṣya namaḥ śabdaṃ tato vadetsamastakāmaphalaptamāhāyākabhedinīpaṅktiḥ chaṃdaḥ kalkirūpī śrīviṣṇurdevarucyateekenākṣarayugmena caturbhiḥ paṃcabhistayānīlameṣvanibhaṃ divyaratnasiṃhāsena śrutesarvaduṣṭaharaṃ yogimunisiddhaniṣevitaṃkalkisvarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ sarvalokahiterataṃjātvā lakṣaṃ mahāvidyāṃ daśāṃśaṃ tulasīdalaiḥdakṣiraṇāṃ vasudhāṃ datvā vahusasyaudyasaṃkulāṃaṣṭākṣarodite pīṭhe pūjayet kalkimacyutaṃdaśāṃśaṃ kamalairhutvā śvetāśvaṃ sa paricchaṃdaṃbhūtvehasārvabhaumausaudehāṃte muktimāpnuyātdhyātvā kalkiṃ mahātmānaṃ jatvā lakṣamataḥ paraṃpuccakāmo hunet putrajīvairayutamādarātvidyākāmaścahaviṣābhogakāmastāthotpalaiḥsahasraṃ triśataṃ vāpi jatvā vā śatamanvahaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvāśrama variṣṭhoyaṃ gṛsthāśrama ucyateśrāddhakṛtsadyavādī ca gṛhasthomuktamucyatevedapārāyaṇaṃ kurvanvedasyārthaṃ vicāra*(?)śrotriyānvayasaṃbhūtāṃ gṛhārcanaratāṃ sadāgṛhasaukhyasamṛdhyarthaṃ lakṣaṇyāṃ striyamudvahetpratikūlaṃ kalatraṃ cetkiṃduḥkhaṃ narake bhavetdharmeratiḥ sajjanasaṃgatiśca duḥkhasya mūloddharaṇāni paṃcacatasrorātrayaḥ styājyā viṣamāsunasaṃviśetekādaśīparvavarjaṃ strīṣu saṃgamamācaretanṛtaṃ madyagaṃdhaṃ ca divāsvāyaṃ paṃcamaithunaṃdevāścapitaronityaṃ gṛhasthamṛṣayopi casarvāśramavariṣṭhoyaṃ gṛsthāśrama ucyateśrāddhakṛtsadyavādī ca gṛhastho mukta ucyateviprajanmaśatenāsau brahmaloke mahīyatekalyāṃtaṃ satyalokepi bhuktvā bhogānmanoharānsadācāraratonityaṃ vedapārāyaṇerataḥkṣayaṃ mahatsaukhyaṃ kalpasahasramādarātācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja śuśrūṣaṇarataḥ śuciḥśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ samastanyā saṃyutāṃpunarāratirahitaṃ prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥna tena prāpyate vidyā śrīmaddaṣṭākṣarī śubhāmaheṃdralokemādaṃte kalpāṃtaṃ divyabhoginaḥkṛtvā sukṛtakarmāṇi punaḥsvargasukhānvitāḥpunarjanma punarmṛtyuḥ punarduḥkhaṃ punassukhaṃpāpe narakeduḥkhaṃ puṇye na tridive sukhaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāmatrayamahyavidyāmathavakṣyāmi bhūyateacyutānaṃtagoviṃdāścaturthīṃ nati saṃyutāḥnāmātrayāmi proktā duritaudya vibhedinīvaśiṣṭho nāradoyogī kaśyapopyaṣayaḥ smṛtāḥvāmanodevatā prokto viniyogastu siddhayedhyātvā nāma trayaṃ nityaṃ japtvāsiddhimavāpnuyātācāryadakṣiṇaivāsyāpuraścaryāsamīritāsajapecchatasāhasramadhaḥśāyī jiteṃdriyaḥviṣamajvarayuktopi śatasāhasraṃmādarātkārayitvā tato homaṃ mamṛtāmirathāpi vādīrghamāyuṣmamanvicchanūdūrvāmirayutaṃ śuciḥhunetrimadhusammistilairmehasyaśāṃtayerājitaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ datvā sāṃgadakṣiṇayānvitaṃājīrṇarogaśāṃtyarthaṃ japtvā śatasahasrakaṃsauvarṇāṃ dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ datvā tasmādimucyatedaśāṃśaṃ goghṛtaṃ hutvā maṃtrauṣadharasāyanāmatrayamahāvidyāṇ japannanvahamādarātputrapautrābhivṛddhiṃ ca bhogānapi sudurlabhānepraṇarvanamasāyuktaṃ padaṃtagavate tataḥanaṃtāpadaṃ paścādavyaktāya namaḥ padaṃuktāśaṃkarajapteyaṃ mahābhāgyasamṛddhidāgāyātrameva chaṃdosya sākṣātsaṃkarṣarṇagevibhuḥśritiścaturbhiraṣṭābhiścaturbhiścaturakṣaraiḥsahasraṃ śirasaṃ devaṃ pharṇasāhasraśobhitaṃvāsukyādi mahānāgaiḥ sarvataḥ parivāritaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ānaṃtaṃ paramātmānaṃbhajāmi jagatīdyatiṃvidyānāṃ pāragobhūtvā parāṃ muktimupetyasaumūrtimūlena saṃkalpya samabhyarcyopacārakaiḥabhyarcya vasukitakṣakaṃ karkoṭakamapyathākumudaṃ ca tataścitraketuṃ nāradaparvatauitthaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ devabhyarcya trijagasatihutvātha daśasāhasraṃ tilaiḥ śukermahīyatevidyāsiddhimavāmmāsau sarvavidyānidhirbhavetna sarpabhayamāpnoti na bhayaṃ viṣasabhavaṃsamṛddhimahatīprāpyadhanadhānyādisaṃkulāṃityanaṃta mahāvidyāviddhānaṃ kiṃcidīritaṃmamavidyāṃ pravakṣyāmi sadyaḥ sakalasiddhidāṃbhagavatpadadamābhāṣya caturthyaṃta samanvitaṃnātmyāyāviṃcanapdaṃti tāyapadamapyathaparametyatha haṃsāyaparameti padaṃ tataḥhṛdayadvitayaṃ paścādvidyaiṣā samudīritābhedīnī sarvapāānāduḥkhasaṃdyanivāriṇīnāradāyapurāproktāmayaiva karuṇāvatāahaṃ samastaloddhanāmācāryaḥ parikīrtitaḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī dātā sohameva mahīyateteṣāṃ bhuktiṃ ca pradāsyāmina saṃśayaḥvadarīkāṃtanenityaṃ nivasāminaranvitaṃbrahmaviṣṇumaheśedradaivatākṛtiracyutaḥdharmeṇa prārthitasya putratvaṃgatavānahāṃbhūtvāhaṃ sarvabhaktānāṃ dāsyāmi paramapadaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: matparigrahatobhūyadarśanānmokṣasiddhidaṃsrātvai vālakanaṃdāyāṃ sakṛdṛddhāpimāṃ vibhuṃṣaṣkakṣarīmimāṃ vidyāṃ naranārāyaṇīṃ mamasaṃprāpya mahatī siddhite matpadamavāpnuyuḥcaturvidhamāhāmuktisiddhideyaṃ sanātanītasyāhaṃ pitṛvannityaṃ pradāsye sarvavāṃchitaṃsiddhavidyāmomāṃ prāhuryogino vījakaṣmamadvidyā siddhiruditāgurudakṣiṇayaiva himamavidyāṃ japedetāṃ naranārāyaṇī śubhāṃaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmādhiyatyaṃma caṃcalaṃādhipatyaṃ maharṣīṇaṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ ca yogināṃnaranārāyaṇīṃ vidyāṃ nityaṃ mama japan śuciḥaṣṭākṣarādividhānāṃ mayisiddhiṃ parāṃ vrajetmadvidhāyājayenaiva sidhyasaṣṭākṣarīmamāekāmapi muhāvidyāṃ mamajaptyānvahaṃ śuciḥaṣṭhāṃgayogasahitojarāmaraṇavarjitaḥnāradobhagavānasya munirukto maharṣibhiḥnaranārāyaṇāṃ svāmī devatā procyate vudheḥtāṃganyāsa karanyāsau nāpi nyāsāṃtaraṃ nṛpāsuramyelakanaṃdāyāstare vadarikāśramevaśiṣṭavedavyāsādimaharṣimirabhiṣṭutenavanīlāṃvudaśmāmaṃjaṭhāmaṃḍaladhāriṇaṃdhanurvāṇadharaṃ divyapītāṃvaravirājitaṃdivyaratnākitaḥ svamakuṭāvṛtamāstakaṃsmitakaṣkaṃviśālākṣaṃ koṭimanmathasuṃdaraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryaṃ sarvalokānāṃ gurūṇaṃ paramaguruṃnārāyaṇaṃ jagadvaṃdyaṃ bhagavaṃtāmupāsmehenaranārāyaṇīvivāmāmanityaṃ japedbudhaḥaṣṭhākṣarādividyānāṃ na siddhiṃ labhate kvacitnaranārayaṇoṃ vidyāmajatvā matavallabhāṃlabhate na parāṃ siddhimiti vedānuśāsanaṃdvayameva mahāsiddhipradaṃ lokaṃ ṣubhūyatemahādānāni kṛtvāpi puraścaryā śataṃ tu vāsudarśanamahāvidyāṃ pravakṣyami tataḥ paraṃcaṃdravījavyomayarṇaṃ caṃdraṃ dīrghā gnisaṃyutasudarśanimahāvidyā ṣaḍarṇeyamudīritājatavyeyaṃ mahāvidyāvighnasaṃghanivāriṇīsarvaśatukṣayakarīviṣadāridryaghātinīsudarśanātmābhagavāndevoviṣṇurūdīritaḥsudarśanān hariprītyarthaṃ viniyujyateśūlapāśāṃkuśāgrīn vibhrāṇāṃ vajrākheṭaṃṣaṭkoṇe saṃsthaṃ sakalaripugaṇaprāṇasaṃhāracakraṃdhyātvā japtvā yathā śaktāvighnasadyavivarjitaḥvimuktaḥ sakalāpadyaḥ puruṣārtha catuṣṭayaṃataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vāyuputramahāmanuṃpraṇavaṃ namasāyuktaṃ padaṃ bhagavate tataḥpadaṃ mahāvalāyeti padaṃ hanumate tataḥmaṃtrarāja iti khyāta āṃjaneyasyamāruteḥvijayaśrīpradonityaṃ lokatrayavaśaṃkaraḥchaṃdogāyatramityuktaṃ maṃjanānaṃdanovibhuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vījaṃ trayīmayaṃ proktaṃ śaktirnati rudīritātribhi aśuturbhiṣaṃcārṇaiḥ paṃcabhiścaturakṣaraiḥdvābhyāmiti ṣaḍaṃgāni kṛtvā dhyāyenmarutsutaṃdevedrapramukhāmarastutivahaṃ sītāviśokāyaharmojīratadhyātvetthamaṃjanātyanūṃ nityaṃ vijayasiddhidaṃ jatvāvijayamāmotidivivāṇepuraścaraṇasaṃsiddhikaro proktā maharṣibhiḥjayalakṣmīpradonṛṇāmaṇimāṣaṣṭasiddhidaḥaṃjanātanapasyāmaṃmupratyahaṃ maṃtranayakaṃjvallāvijayamāsodyesarvasiddhiyuto bhavetaṇimādiguṇeyetātahuheśrīracaṃcalāyakṣarākṣasevetālayeśācādi mahābhayeaṣṭaviṃśādhikaṃ maṃtraṃ japtvā triśatamanvahaṃviṃdasavala saubhāgyaṃ saprāpnotyanvahaṃ japaṃrājānoyāṃtidā satvaṃ śatravomitratāṃ tathāsamṛddhiṃ mahatī labdhvā muktiṃ prāpnoti śāśvatīyāmupāsya vimuktasyātkālakūṭabhayādapimahāgaruḍaśabdaṃ ca caturthyaṃta samanvitaṃvajrayakṣaliṃ kṛtādyaśarīrāya padaṃ tataḥduṣṭānnāgān chidhi padaṃ duṣṭānaśroccaretvadohu phaṭ padaṃ paścaduccarediyamiṣṭhadaṛṣirbrahmāsyamaṃtrasya gāyatraṃ chaṃda īritaṃhemādriśikharākāraṃpūrṇacaṃdranibhānaṃanaṃto vāmakaṭakoyajñasūtraṃ tu vāsukipadmastu dakṣiṇe karṇe mahāpadmastuvāmataḥdhyātve devaṃ trisaṃdhyādāvātmānaṃ garuḍānmakaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ājānuhemavarṇabhamānābhatestu hinaprabhaṃsvarṇavarṇaṃ suparṇaṃgaruḍasya mahāvidyāṃ japtvānityaṃ phalapradāṃgāruḍasyāthagāyatrīṃ vaṃdāmi sakaleṣṭadāṃcaturthyaṃ samanvitaṃ dhīmahīti padīyetaṃ tatrogaruḍa ityathāpraṇavādyā samastādyabhedinī vivanāśinīchaṃdogāyatramityuktaṃ devatāgaruḍasmṛtaḥjadyātgaruḍagāyatrīsaṃharet sakalaṃ viṣaṃjadyānvahaṃ paurṇimāsyā mamoyāṃ vā sammahitaḥtataṃ tat putrapautrādinapi pādahatā apiyaṣṭottaraśataṃ hunet || kārayedathavānyena cakṣūrogairvimucyateāyurārogyamacalamaiśvaryamaṇimādikaṃtadviṣṇoḥ paramāṃdhāmayātyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥgotrayaṃ dakṣiṇā proktā tanmūlyaṃ vā sadakṣiṇaṃviprādvādaśasaṃkhyākābhojanīyāḥ prayatnataḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīsubhāyasyasiddhābhavetsvasyanāsādhyaṃ vidyate bhuvitatkṛtaṃ cenmahāsiddhirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥbhūyopi śrīmadaṣṭārṇasādhanaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃśṛṇurājanpravakṣyāmi sādhanāṃtaramiṣṭadaraṃsarvamaṃtramahārājñī śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīśubhāśṛṇurājanpravakṣyāmi śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥbhānuvāsarasaṃyuktāsāsaṃsīmāyānigadyateravisaṃkramaṇaṃ tatra jāyate yadi suvrataāstive tatra saṃkrāṃtiḥ śatakratu phalapradaḥbrāhmekāle yadi bhavetkratukoṭiphalapradaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ravisaṃkrāmaṇaṃ vājimedhakoṭiphalapradaṃbhavedyadihārājatatpurāyaphalamakṣayaṃtutrāpi raviṇacāparāśisaṃkramaṇaṃdapadiāśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ vaktu hi śakyatemahādānasahasrasya rājasūyāyutasya cayadi brāhme muhūrte syādavisaṃkramaṇaṃ śubhaṃmahācūḍāmaṇirnāmnāyogolabhyo yamuttamaḥsomena raviṇavāpi sahitaṃ hastasaṃyutaṃsamastapāpaudyavināsaṃhetulakṣmīrāsaṃpūrṇakaṭhākṣahetuṃvāpi tatrāpi kadikubhānusaṃkramoyogādhirājyo bhuvi kathyate sauraviṇavedunāyuktāmadhyāhnavasuvāpatecāpasaṃkramaṇaṃ noryadi brāhmemuhūrtakeekaikasmin dine tatra japahomādikaṃ kṛtaṃmahādānasahasrasya phalaṃ vaktu hi śakyateekaikasmindinenatra śrīśārcanajaṃ phalaṃekaikasminhite tatra kṛsaṇohutiṃ śutāṃmāse trīśrīmadaṣṭārṇapuraścaraṇamāharātśrīmadaṣṭhārṇavidyāyāmāsetravasudhāyateutthāyāyararātrāṃnedhanuḥsaṃkramaṇeraveḥācāryaṃ samalaṃkṛtyavāsolaṃkāracaṃdanaiḥśālagrāmasilāvakre śrīyetervasudhāpateḥuccaranniṃdirānāthabrahmavidyāphalapradāṃāthāmalakaparteyodūrvāgraiḥ kusumānvitaiḥjīrakīrdrakasaṃyuktaṃ mudgatraṃ ghṛtasaṃyutaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāṃsahasraṃpratyahaṃ japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japet paṃcaśataṃ vāpi dvādaśārṇāṃ śriyothavājīrakārdrakasaṃyuktaṃ goghṛtena samanvitaṃtathaivāṣṭotāraśataṃ hunecchī hṛdyena cabhagavadraśmividyābhirekaikāmāhutiṃ hunetūṣāsaṃkramaṇe prāpte tatrābhyarcādipūrvavatvilvapatrasamāyuktaṃ tilagavyājyasaṃyutaṃprasannalakṣmīmaṃtreṇa dvādaśārṇā śriyā vidhāhutvātharaśividyābhirjuhuyāhoghṛtaṃ tridhāagniṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya bhagavaṃtaṃ śriyaḥ patiṃācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ sāṣāṃgaṃ daṃḍavannametpadmarāga samāyuktaṃ vajraviṃdu samanvitaṃkuṃḍaladvitaṃ padadyādavaśyaṃ tasya karṇayoḥācāryāyārdyayedvīmānmahatīsuvasuṃdharāṃpaṃcāṭhakamitāmudgādeyā ācāryamaṃdiregrāmasya dakṣiṇā proktātiṣkasāhasrakāṃcanaṃnālpasasyāmahodeyānakaklośāvaduḥkhadāmahādānāni kurvīta rājāvārājaputrakaḥputrapautrābhivṛdhyarthaṃ dadyātyāyanikaṃuṣasaṃkramaṇe tasminnekāhatyānaleśubhetatrācārya yadāṃbhoje datvā sasyayutāṃmahīṃdatvā yatphalamāprātitadavaśyamavāpnuyātākalpakoṭi dānasya phalamakṣayamaśrutedivyavastradharaḥsragvījarāmaraṇavarjitaḥnāṃśatamudvatyasudharṇadhvajabhūṣitaṃbhagavatsadṛśākāromodate paramepade
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahādānasahasrasya phalamakṣayamakṣutaiviśeṣahomaṃ kṛtvātra datvācārya padakṣiṇasaṃprāpya sākṣātsvapnevāpaśyatyeva śriyapatiṃkulātanmaṃdirenivasanimahālakṣmīracaṃcalāsaṃprāpya putrapautrādi samṛddhi mahatomaviavāśyamuktimāpnoti sahasrakulasaṃyutaḥdānārthaṃ śasyate bhūya vahudakṣiṇayānvitāvasuṃdhūrā sahsradhenudānāścahaya sāhasradānataḥmahīdānaṃ mahādāna sahasrādapi siddhidaṃaśaktomaṃdabhāgvaśrodbhiśitvā śūdrakānapiācāryapatnīmabhyarcyapaṃcāniṣkamitaṃ dhanaṃdhenuṃ payasvinī datvā caturviṣkamitaṃ dhanaṃavaśyaṃ siddhimāpnoti daridropi na saṃśayaḥkūṣmāṃḍaṃ saphalaṃ datvā śrotriyāya kuṭuṃvineprāpyaṃ vaśābhivṛddhiṃ ca maheṃdrayadabhāgbhavetkūṣmāṃḍaṃ saṃpradāyāśubhaphalaṃ sumahadaśrutedhyatīpāta samāyuktā mahatī tithirucyatesrātvā ca hutvā ca guroḥ padābje datvā parāṃsiddhimupaiti martyaḥyogeṣu ca vyatīyāto mahāsiddhiṃ prayacchatisnātvā mahānvidyāṃ śrīmadāṣṭākṣarośubhāṃhutvā paṃcaśataṃ śrīmadaṣṭārnenāditaḥ śuciḥvilvapatrairghṛtābhyaktairmadhutritayamiśritaiḥgavyājye na tridha hutvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇahutiṃṣaṇniṣkaṃ vā triniṣkaṃ vā niṣkadvayamitaṃ tu vāalaṃkāra tathā dadyādyathā svaktidhanaṃ tu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrotriyāyadaridrāyakūṣmāṃḍaphalamuttamaṃvimukto mahatīṃ siddhiṃ prāpnotyeva mahīyatemāsimāsihariṃ sākṣāsvapreyāpi prapaśyatiavāpya mahatī lakṣmī dhanaṃdhānyādisaṃkulāṃputrapautrābhivṛddhiṃ ca bhogānapi sudullībhātnārī vā puruṣo vāpi kārtike paurṇamīdinesaubhāgyamakṣayaṃ lakṣmīdhanadhānyādi saṃkulāṃbharturāpuṣpamicchaṃto saubhāgyaṃ ca manoramaṃdadyādavaśyaṃ kūṣmāṃḍaṃ kārtike paurṇamīdinebhūyopi saṃpravakṣyāmi navārātravrataṃ śubhaṃnavarātra maharatparvavarṣamadhyāmaṇivrataṃekaikaṃ ca dinaṃ tatra cūḍāmaṇi samaṃ viduḥtatra dataṃ kataṃjatyaṃ śreyorāśikalapradaṃsvargāpavargadaṃ sadyassamastepsitasiddhidaṃācāryānujñāyātatra vrataṃ kṛtyāmahannaraṃāśvinemāsi saṃprāpte pratipadivaseśubhesahasraṃ prajayedvedamātaraṃ triśalatuvāvidhivatsaṃskṛte vahnau dvādaśākṣaravidyayāaṣṭautraraśataṃ hutvā ghṛtamaṣṭhārṇavidyayāaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā ṣaḍarśona śriyopi vājapecchī dvādaśārṇāṃ ca saṃkalpārka sahasrakaṃekottaraṃ japellakṣmīhṛdayaṃ sarvakāmadaṃmahābhavamyāṃ trimadhughṛtavilvadalānvitaṃvṛhadābharaṇairhutvā ghṛtena purataḥ śuciḥpūrvoktaṃ pāpasaṃhutvā dvādaśārṇaśriyāpi ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svargepi duḥkhasaṃmitaṃśraṃ viṣayuktānnavatsukhaṃbrahmānaṃdābhidhaṃ prāhurbrahmatatvavidomalāḥbrahmavidyānusaṃdhānācchīmadaṣṭākṣarī japātācāryacaraṇāṃbhojadakṣiṇārahitaṃ dinaṃyadyekajanmanā brahmatādātmyapadamicchatibrahmavidyā samāyuktāṃ raśmividyāsamanvitāṃgṛhastha eva sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃvara smṛtaḥgṛhasthāśramamāsādya sadācāreṇa saṃyutaṃdevarṣi pitṛsaṃtoṣātatprāsādāpta vaibhavaḥmodate apramedhāmni daśapūrvairdaśāparaiḥsatyapūtaṃ vadedvākyaṃ nyāyapūtaṃ dhanaṃ grahetaṃtyajānapibhikṣitvā dadyādācārya dakṣiṇāṃsuvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ datvā yāgasya phalamaśnutevahuśo dakṣiṇādeyātasmādyāgasamṛddhayedatvāśvamedhasāhasradakṣiṇāphalāmaśru*(?)rocate caṃdrabhaumādyā ahāpi divisthitāḥsatyena lokān jayati muktiḥ satyena pratiṣṭhitāyoginaḥ sanakādyāśca vaśiṣṭhādyā maharṣayaḥmaheṃdrādyāśca dikpālāḥ pūrvabhūtapatayopi cabhagavadvacanaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ vedoditaṃ tathābrahmatatvavidonityaṃ vedavedāṃtapāraṇāḥetannārāyaṇīyākhyaṃ satyamevocyate mayāahaṃdāśarathirbhūtvā rudrāya paripṛcchatetaṃtraṃ dāśarathīyākhyaṃ tadārabhya maharṣayaḥasmindāśarathīyākhye taṃtre yadyadudīritaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhagavadraśmibhirhutvā tridhā ghṛtamataḥ paraṃnityaṃ paṃcaśataṃ brahmavidyāyā pūjayet vratīvimalādidhiyācaikāmarcayenna suvāsusinīsuvāsinī rūpaṃ pūjyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragaṃtāṃkulairdakṣiṇabhiścatoṣayeścasuvāsinīḥphalāśanodhaḥ śāpī ca jiteṃdriyayutopi capradadyādakṣiṇadravyaṃ vāso laṃkaraṇādikaṃśrīśadvādaśākṣaryālakṣmīnārāyaṇau vibhūṣaṣṭhicihrukasauvarṇānarmitaṃ kuṃḍaladvayaṃsauvarṇamudrikādyaiśca samabhyarvya tataḥparaṃdadyādvasudhārāyaścādvahusāsyaudya saṃkulāṃdeyā anadruhaḥ paścāccaturobhāravāhekāḥaśvayugmāsi mahatī navamīyā prakīrtitāekaikaṃ dinamapyatra navarātravrate śubhemahatī navamīpātra tatsamaṃ parvasiddhidaṃmahānavamyāṃ vijayalakṣmīmicchatracaṃcatmasamarpya vahulāṃ nityaṃ japalakṣmīmavāpnuyāavaśyaṃ phalamāpnoti viprāṇaṃ koṭibhojanātsuvāsīno sahasrāṇāṃ mūjāphalamavāpnuyātdatvā dvādaśadhā bhūmiṃ dhanaratnaudya saṃkulāṃavaśyaṃ matphalaṃ sāṃgaṃ labhate nātrasaṃśayaḥdhenukoṭiprādānasyaphalaṃ sīgaṃ vrajatyarthaphalamāsādyaśuddhātmījīvanmuktaḥyusukhī bhavetgrāmadvādakṣakaṃ datvāścetāśvaṃchatrasaṃyutaṃsālakṛtāṃ svaputrīcaṃ svācāryāya samarpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryapatnīmabhyarcya siddhimāpnoti śāśvatīkoṭi satāhutiphalaṃ samagraṃ puruṣoplutetatanmerusamaṃdānaṃ prāhurdivyāmaharṣayaḥācāryāya ṛtudravyaṃ tatra nikṣipyasādhakaḥdahaivatasyetejīśaṃ mamadāsyāmi suvrataaṃtepi samahedrādipadaṃ kṛtvā tṛṇopamaṃśrīmadaṣṭakṣarī siddhidvādaśārṇaśriyopi capuraścaryā sahasrastha sāṃgasya phalamakṣayaṃnārāyaṇamanādyaṃtaṃ paśyatyevaściyaḥ patiḥdhanadhyanyapaśuvrānayuktāralaughaṃ saṃkulaṃsaṃprāpya sarvaśreyāṃsi vidyāṃ ca mahatīśubhāṃsahasrakulaṃ yuktasradviṣṇoḥ paramaṃpadaṃlakṣmīhayāvidyāyāviśeṣotra pravakṣyatesrātvā prātarviśuddhītmānityasaṃdhyāmupāsya caāṣṭhojaraśataṃ hutvā madaṣṭhārṇavidyayāpaṃcaśataṃ nityamaṣṭārṇāṃ sarvasiddhidīaṣṭamyataṃ japecchudraḥ phalāśīvāhaviṣyabhukavaśyamevatāṃ vṛlabhakṣyako bhūṣaṇānvitaḥsaṃtoṣya sakalairarthe hṛdayaṃ śriya ādarātsuvāsinyaḥ samabhyarcyāḥ pūrvoktavidhinānṛpamahālakṣmīvidyā sākṣādathavādvādaśārcayetācāryapatnīḥ śrīvudhyāṃ vāsolaṃkaraṇādibhiḥmahānavamyāṃ jvalite jātavedasisādhakaḥśrīśrīpatīsamāvādyatatrāgrau brahmavidyayāprasannayā mahālakṣmyāvidyayā trimadhuplutaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gavyājyasahitaṃ hutvā pāyasaṃ jvalite nalevaiṣṇuvairīśmibhisredhāghṛtaṃ hutvā tataḥ paraṃpradakṣiṇaṃ namaskṛtya jātavedasamādarāttatrāryapadāṃbhojadvitayaṃ praṇipatya cakuṃḍalādvitayaṃ datvā tatkarṇayugale śubhesūkṣmavāso yugaṃ datvā varṣāśanamitaṃ tu vātatrāpya śaktomati mānadaśaniṣkamitaṃ dhanaṃpradadyādgodvayaṃ vatsavahukṣīrasamanvitaṃdatvā siddhimavāpnoti mahatīṃ nātra saṃśayaḥsakṛtkṛtvāpi vā sākṣādbhagavatkalayānvitaḥtamanvahaṃ pālayati mahālakṣmīssvaputravatbhagavat kalayāyukto jīvanneva vimucyateniṣṭaṃti bhṛtyavatatsyasākṣātsakalasiddhidāḥprasannalakṣmīsahitāśrīmaṣṭhākṣarasyavavarṣāśanamitadravyamathavādakṣiṇoktamādakṣiṇāsahitā sarvasiddhidoktāvasuṃdharāśriyamaṣṭhaguṇeyatāmicchatāni yatātmanālakṣmīnārāyaṇeyogeyogepyarvodayen sasiṃharāśisthite jīveyogepuṣkaranāmakejapahomādikaṃ sākṣātparaṃbrahmaprapaśyatiārdvodaya sahasraṃ vānatatrāsadṛśaṃ bhavetmahāsiddhikarī proktā japahomādibhirnṛpadhanurmāsavratenapi mahatī siddhirīritādina dvayamidaṃ śreṣṭaṃ sadyassiddhipradāyakaṃbhīṣmapaṃcakamityuktaṃ mahāsiddhikaraṃ smṛtaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karukṣārya śukraṣāṃ saivasiddhikarī smṛtāācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ śarīrāṃtepinatyajetkartavyācāryapyu śrūṣā prāṇairapi dhanairapiitthaṃ viditvā satataṃ kṛtvāpi vasudhāpateācāryājñāṃ samullaṃpya sakṛdapyavanīyateākalyaṃ narake bhūyanimajjati na saṃśayaḥprajaptvā mahāvidyābhogasvargāpavargadānārāyaṇe mahāyogī jannaivāṃtaravīyatarāmo dāśarathiḥ prāharudrāya paripṛcchatetaṃtre dāśarathīyākhye pūrvīśassamudīritaḥśṛṇavanvāyi vimuktosau mahāpātakarāśibhiḥśrīmadaṣṭārṇamāhātmyaṃśrutaṃsāgarahasyakaṃsāmrājyalakṣmīḥ paṃcetisāmrājyaśriyaīritāḥtasyā māhātmamakhrlaṃvadanaḥ karuṇānidheprāhasītāpratimrudroḍauryāsaha jagatpatiḥbrahmāparokṣavijñānarahasyaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīmānnamāhātmyamakhilaśrutaṃmāhātmyamakhilaṃ tasyā vadamahyaṃ jagatyetamāhātmyamakhilaṃ śabho śrīvidyāyā vadāmyahaṃtaṃtre nārāyaṇīye smin sahasyaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃpunardāśarathīyākhyaṃ taṃtraṃ vakṣyāmi sādaraṃsaubhāgyodayanāmaitacchaṇurājan mahīyatebhūtvā sakalabhāgyānāmādhāromuktimetyaṣiparamātmā parānaṃdaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥpūrvaśca paścimaścaivadakṣiṇaścottarastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvāmnāyastu ṛgvedo yajurvedastu dakṣiṇaḥsarvopaniṣadāṃjālamūrddhāmnāyaḥ prakīrtitaḥśaṭiṃśatiḥ sāstatvāniśarīraṃ viśvaramaiśvaraṃ***** jagaddhātā śrīśonārāṇobhivaācāryavadanobhūtavacaneṣu pramāṇatāācāryavatsadācāryapatnīputreṣu saṃtataṃgurudevatamaṃtrāṇāmaikyaṃ dhyāyet sadā dhiyāayameva hi siddhāṃta ukto vedāṃtavādibhiḥiyaṃ śrīlālitā vidyāyoṣyākulavadhūrivaśarīraprāṇavittānāmapyācāryasasarpakaḥparasto vimukho mānī satyadhāgatasūyakāḥetādṛśāyaśiṣyāya vidyādeyāśubhārthinaṃpāalayet sakalāyabhyorahasyamapivodhayanśrīvidyāṃ prajapeddhīmānbrahmānaṃdasmāptayeādyāyāśuyato dīkṣāvaiṣṇavīvataḥ paroekatradīkṣito vāpi śucirbhavati saṃtataṃdīkṣānnitayasaṃyuktaḥ srimūrtirbhagavāvetjasasakalavidyātāmadhikārī bhavecchruciḥdīyate sakalaṃ vastu gurevaprāṇasaṃyutaṃmūrkhāyatīrthadveṣaparāyabhaktiyuktāyaśuddhāya nārāyaṇa kalātmanesarvaśāstrārthavedārthajñānine suvratāya camaṃḍapaṃ vedikāṃ kṛtvā puṣpavaitānamaṃḍitāṃsiṃdūraragamālābhirmaṃḍitaṃ ca vicitrakaṃsiṃdūrarajasāvāpilikhitaṃ cakrumattamaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturastaṃ ca vilikhet suvarṇakalśānnavajalapūrṇānviśeṣāḍhyānratnakharṇādibhūṣitānvaśinyādyaṣṭakaṃ tatra kalāḥ kuṃbheṣu pūjayetkramasamastamabhyarcyavidhivatsaṃskṛtenalehutvāthavīmata śiṣyaṃ svāsanesthāpayecchaciḥṣaḍadhvarūpaṃ śrīcakraṃ tasya mūrdhni viciṃtayeājñā saṃkramaṇaṃ kuryādyāvaliścalūtā bhavetśūnyāśevamayaṃ vastu puruṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ***** gvusthaulyaṃ saṃyogāśivayoryadāśaktijognariti khyātā śivoniścalatā tathāguṇānnayaṃ tu kathitā jāgnatkhapnaguṇa **śivādhikya duṇātītaṃ vastu jānī hi bhūyatetadātuyaṃ vijānī hi sarvadranikṛṃjanaṃśrīvidyāvojasaṃlīmāḥ śiṣyadehe prakāśayet *taddhyānānmanasasthairyamumnānīti nigadyatesaṃkalpena vikalpena prakṣābhyāṃ caṃcalassadāsannadvapiva ūlaḥ kṛtyākṛtya yadadvāyaḥavidyāviśmṛte niṃdāstuti śākhāsuśobhiteparṇamahīpāla pāpapuṇya phalānvitekṣisāṃta samākramya jñānapāśena pāśanutsarvarsakalparahitā kalā saptadaśī bhavettena pakṣadvayaṃ bhinnaṃ yadā bhavati niścayaḥunmanyāsahito yogīnonmanīyogināṃ parāata eva mahīpāladṛṣṭyāsaṃkramarṇa yajetjādaukaracca saṃyojyasya śanairamahīṣatte
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svarṇādyāghātavaḥ sarvelohāthā vasudhīyatekarasparśena mūpālaprapaṃcamānilādikaṃkerapuṣpaphalānkṛtvā brahmaraṃdhre tataḥ kṣipetanirvācyopadeśoyaṃ sparśanādbrahmaraṃdhrakevarābhayakaronityo brahmarūpī sadānaghaḥpaścāgra ṣaṭ cakra vijñānaṃ śiṣyāyaprātivodhayetvādisāṃtaiścaturvarṇaṃstaptahamasamaprabhaiiṃdragopapratīkāśaispharādvidumasannibhaiḥnīlavarṇā tṛtīyaṃ himaṇipūrakaṃ daśārakaṃgadādharaharipraucchaṃ caturthaṃ vasudhāyetapiṃgābhaṃ dvādaśāṃkhamnavarṇakalāsrakaṃjīvātmanādhiṣṭitaṃ tajjārnahitadanaṃtaraṃdvidalaṃ hakṣavarṇābhyām āmrābhyāṃ parimaṃḍitaṃnādīvilīnoyasmānnutasmādbrahma taducyanādaḥ paramasayogātkalinyāmutoyādāpaṃcāśadvarṇarūpatvaṃ prāptāvān parameśvaraḥitthaṃ sarvajñatāṃ tasmaiśiṣyāyasadguruḥratnābharaṇaśobhādyāyadṛvastadhanānvitāṃkṣitignāmamahārāmaramyavedī śatānvitāṃgurusaṃtoṣyavidhivatprasādaṃ prītisaṃṣutavālāṃ prakāśayet karṇedakṣiṇepūrvamādarātsarvavidyāmayodadyāt sarvasiṃhāsaneśvarīna dadyātprāṇādāyāpinidhānamiva saṃsmaratathābrahmamayometāṃ vidviśāstreṣuṇāpinīsāmrājyanāyikā vidyāṃ datvā paṃcadaśarakṣaro
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anena dīkṣāvidhinādīkṣiteyābhavedbuvinnidhādokṣeyamākhyātāplujamādhyamādhamāuttamāsā samākhyātā dīkṣāsaṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāśubhamāseśubhadine dīkṣāsyādayamānṛpaavaśyaṃ mahatīṃ siddhiṃ prāptotyanna na saṃśayaḥmahārahasye saṃprokta ekodhyāyo mahīpatemāhātmyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaduktaṃ śaṃbhunā purāginijāparipapracchaśaṃkaraṃ lokanākaraṃcatuṣyaṣṭiśva taṃtrāṇi mātṛṇāmuttamāni catatvaśavarakaṃ caiva bhainavāṣṭakameva camahochuṣaṃ mahādeva lātulātuḥ lobhanaṃkalāvādaṃ kalāsāraṃ tathānyatkubjikāmatāṃpaṃcāmṛtaṃ rūpabhedaṃ bhūtaḍāmarameva casarvajñānottanadevamahāpicumaṃta tathākulodrīśaṃkulacūḍāmaṇistathā sarvajñānottanaṃdevamahāgnicumattaṃ tathākumānīkāmadaṃ devarūpikāmatameva caaruṇeśaṃ mohaneśaṃ viśuddhīśvarameva cabhavatoktyānimedevasarvajñānamayāni catasyā māhātmyamakhilaṃ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ prabhotriśaktilakṣmīvidyāyāḥ sāmrājyaśrīmattorapiśṛṇudevimahāvidyā māhātmyamadyanāśanaṃyasyasmaraṇamātreṇa vinaśyaṃtya tritayamoritaṃśrīmahāsutīvarṇā etatitakathitāṃ śivedvitīyaṃ kāmarājākhyaṃ lokannayadhaśaṃkaraṃtṛtīyaṃ syāt parākhaṃḍaṃ jarāmṛtyuvināśanaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ikaṃ śrīvidyānāmakaṃ vastu viṃdunnayavibhūṣitaṃśrīvidyākhyeyane tatve vidunnayavibhūṣitevedaśāstrapurāṇādyā vidyāḥ sarvāḥ sanātanāḥmātṛkā sarvavidyānāṃ paṃcadvarṇarūpiṇīpraṇavarivyā brahmāvidyāyaṃ cāśadvarṇamātṛkābrahmatādātmyasisadvipradā etānasaṃśayaḥekaikamasyakhaḍaṃvāya upāste dṛḍhavrataḥvedānānnitayānhinnayaṃ kālannayaṃ tathāpuṣkarannitayaṃ varṇannayāmātmannayaṃ tathāhṛllekhātritayaṃ yatra viṃdutritayamiṣṭadaṃbhanyannammopadaṃ gaurāyāvṛtyaiva kathiteiyameva gireḥ ṣunnidevīśaṃkaravallabhāiyameva jaganmātāturīyā paramākalāstrīpunnapuṃsakākāraṃ yadbhūtamudaṃcitaṃiyaṃ nārāyaṇīlakṣmīgaudurgāsarasvatīsarvavidyāmayo sarvakṣetratīrthasvarūpiṇīsarvajñānamayo sarvapāpaghnīmaṃgalamamayasyanopavimaṃ janmayaṃ yo vā na śaṃkaraḥvaktrakoṭi samāpi dātavyaṃ śipihasrairvījīhvākoṭiśatairapisājyapradā yajñevāsvasutāyāpivaṃdhaveśriyaḥ paṃcadaśārṇoyaṃ na dātavyā kathaṃcanaṃnayāṇāmapi vedānāṃ pārāyaṇaśaṃtu vāaśvamedha sahasrāṇi vā japeyasya koṭayaḥkāśyāditpatīrthayānnāścatulāṃ nāyāṃti ṣoḍaśīṃsa nāmārādhyadhātāsau sṛṣṭeḥ kartāpurābhavat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmāmiyimāṃ rudramohaṣāmāsaṃ śailajesarvāsāmapi vidyātāmīśvaratvamavāptavānsargasthityupasahārākartārājaigataḥ śivetrailokyaṃ mohayāmāsanaranārī guṇairyutaṃsidhyanmaharṣisaṃghāśca munivayoścakinnarānśivasuṃdarīrdevagaṃdharvakanyā api manoharāḥraṃbhorvaśyādivyāśarasopi mama priyeyaḥ paraḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣādbrahmarudrādisaṃjñitaḥtasya śaktiriyaṃdevīsuṃdarīnāmacitkalāsṛṣṭisthililayātkartumahaśaktaḥ śakta eva hiasyā saṃśasamudbhūtā vedamātāpiśailajevidyācatuṣṭayaṃ sarvāvidyāsihāsaneśvaraṃśriyaḥ paṃcadaśārṇoyaṃ vedamātāpiśailajecaturvagepradānityamaṇimādyaṣṭāsiddhidāsamastaviṣṇudyāsāmrājñī sarvasaṃpattihetukīmahākālātmikā vidyātithinakṣatrarūpiṇīca bhūtamayī saptalokādhārāsanātanojahasrakoṭiyoginyaptvā pratyahanekāṃte svācāryānugnahāchiveviputratparirakṣaṃtitaṃ brahmīṇyādimārataḥamarā āpi śakrādyāḥ samakoṭi maharṣayaḥsahasrayojanaṃ vāpi gatvācāryaṃ śivātmakaṃsadāsarvakhamapi vā datvā prāṇānputrāṃśca kanyakaḥlalitājapakarbhṛṇāṃ gṛhyasvargāyate bhuvistrīṃ sagamopi kaivalyaheturasya na saṃśayaḥmokṣāye ca saṃsāro lalitāṃ vā muvāsituḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmādgṛhasthaḥ satataṃ devānāṃ tṛptiḥmācaranbrahmavidyānusaṃdhātā śrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīrataḥnārāyaṇamayo bhūtvā modate paramepadeprāpteṣva labhyayogeṣu navarātrāpratepi cadātavyaṃ ca mahīdānaṃ godānaṃ cāvaśeṣataḥācāryakarṇayorddevamavaśyaṃ kuṃḍaladvayaṃvāsare bhārgavevaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ śrīsamṛddhayetryācāryapatnīsatataṃ vahulaṃ karaṇādibhiḥmahālakṣmīdhiyā śiṣyaiścaturvargaphalāptayeācārya eva pātrāṇāmuttamaṃ pātramucyatepātramityucyate vedeśāstreṣu ca mahīpateṣaṇmāse vatsare vāpi dehasaṃśuddhi hetaveācāryadakṣiṇādravyaṃ yācayennāpi tatkuledatvā yāgadhanaṃ sākṣāttaddarṣe brahma paśyatipaṭhanaṃ dharmaśāstrāṇāmitihāsapurāṇayoḥācāryadakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vaṃdhyamityucyate dinaṃsamastavidyā sidhyarthaṃ brahmajñā phalāptayepurāṇapustakaṃ vāpi dadhānmuktiphalāptayeaviyogavatīmṛddhiṃpatnīputrāditissadāpaṃcayajñāḥ sadākāryā brāhmaṇaiḥ śaṃsitavrataiḥtato manuṣyayajñaḥ syādbrahmayajñastataḥ paraṃdevayajña iti proktaḥ svargaḥ sādhana īritaḥpitṛyajña iti proktaḥ kālavādhānivārakaḥyadvijebhyonnadānaṃ syānnarayajñaṃ sa ucyateyodhīte brahmayajñoyaṃ sa ukto brahmavittamaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīsuṃdarītarpaṇa tatparāṇāṃ bhogaśnamokṣaścakarasya evaekoccāraṇavidyāyāstulānārhatiṣoḍaśīyattonirakṣaraṃ vastu parātannatukāraṇaṃbrahmavidyā svarūpayaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradāgopitavyā sadā bhadresvayonirivasaṃ tatavedyatannabhavetyaṃ icchiyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣarīdṛṣṭā prajapate yastu samākṣoyoginogaṇaiḥbhuvanatrayasmaubhāgyaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ śriyaṃsudhātaṃragiṇīvegaścavṛcāturyadāyinīparabrahmaṇilīnatvaṃ dadāti yaśaṭhannataṃkaṭhākṣanodevibhuvanāni caturdaśacatussāgaraparyaṃtamahīsāmrājyapālanaṃbrahmāṃḍakoṭijanaṃ bhūyo vācāṃ vijṛṃbhaṇaṃśrīvidyājapakṛtpuṃsonāsādhyaṃ bhavati priyeśrīvidyākṛtpuṃsonadurlabhamihapriyenārāyaṇe na cāpyuktaṃ śrutvā guptikarābhavaviduyuktaṃ śriyo vījamidaṃ saṃyojyayoginaḥdātavyāṃ khapriyādārādeyāḥ punnāśca kanyakāḥyasyopadeśaḥ kriyatejayādijatitaṃ phalaṃsaṃpūrṇadakṣiṇādānātpuraścaryādikaṃ vinācatvāraṃ ihyibhratikṣemayaṃta iti saṃtataṃnityāyaṃ ca śākhyātā mahānityā tu ṣoḍaśīciṃtāmarāyādi ratnāni kalpavṛkṣādibhūruhāḥśrīvidyāṃ prajayedyastu satataṃ sādhakottamaḥtadvaṃśa saṃbhavā purāyāḥ pūtāstanmitravāṃdhavāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīvidyājāpiṃ na natvā tulādānaphalalabhetvājapeyaphalaprāpyabhuktiṃ muktica viṃdatitaddivyakṣennamuddiṣṭaṃ samaṃtādyo janāyataṃdharmārthakāmamokṣāstatkaretiṣṭaṃti saṃtataṃgopitavyaṃ prayatnenayadīcchedātmanohitaṃvaśiṣṭavāmadevādyādivyādaharṣayogyamīsanakādyāśca yogośāmārka upādayopi casamprāpya sakalābhīṣṭaṃ japatyadyāpimatpriyeayameva paroyoga idameva paraṃ phalaṃiti matvā śriyo vidyāmanvahaṃ prajapecchiveithameva mahāvidyānānyoktā paramaṣibhiḥmahārṣatvaṃ śaktatva ca vidhātṛtāṃśrīvidyaiva prajaptavyā nānyā vidyā varānaneavaśyamicchatājapyā śrīnidyava varānanejaptvā sakalabhāgyānāmādhorādevavadbhavetśrīvidyājāpakonityaṃ bhavatyeva jaḍātpatiḥsamastādyaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasisaubhāgyavidyodaya uttarabhāge dvitīyodhyāyaḥkṛtāṃjali puṭā bhūtvā punārāha girīṃdrajāśriyaḥ paṃcadaśārṇoyaṃ śrutā sarvasamṛddhidāśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ śriya ādarātśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā śrīvidyaivatataḥ paraṃvedāṃteṣvapi vedeṣu rahasyaṃ mahadbhutaṃbrāhmemuhūrte utthāya brahmaraṃdhre nijaṃ guruṃnārādhaṇā kṛtivāṃpikhaśaktisahitaṃ vibhuṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhyātvā plāvitamātmānaṃ smaredācāryapādukāṃudyatvaḍūryasahasrābhāṃ tejorūpāmatha smaretbrahmavidyāṃ prajaptvādau bhagavadraśmimālikāṃdvādaśadhā vidyāṃ śriyaḥ sakalasiddhidāmukhaprakṣālanādīni kṛtvā campa prayatnataḥparaṃtoyāṃjaliṃ tridhā mūlamuccāryā śirasi kṣipettridhā sutartha mūlena lalitāṃ vānnayīmayonityasaṃdhyāmupāsyātha drāṁ hrīṁ draṁ sa itīrayetbhaktyādya sahitāyeti vahijāyāmathoccaretravimaṃḍalamadhyetha smṛtvā śrīcakramādarātvidmeha padamuccārya kāmarāja mataḥ paraṃśaktivījaṃ samuccārya tannaḥ klinna pracodayātathācārya padāṃbhoja dvitayaṃ sarvakāmadaṃkumārīṃ prajapadādau yathā śaktyā girīṃdrajepādukā saṃsmaret paścānmūlācāryasya siddhidāsa eva saccidānanṃdanātha ācārya īśvaraḥkalpakoṭi śatenāpi na siddhistasya jāyatevogaṃvaśinī tatpādukā manusmṛtya śrīvidyāmanvahaṃ japetśrīvidyājasakalpaṃ kuryādādau yatavrataḥchaṃdaḥ pāḍūmiti prāhurdevatā vinmayī parāśrīmahātripuretyutktāsuṃdarī paradevatālalitā śrīmahābhaṭṭārikā lakṣmīrūpayīmayīdevatā kathitā sarvajagabhyātā maheśvarīvāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ khaṃḍavījamuktaṃ trayīmayaṃśaktyādyaṃ śaktikhaṃḍaṃ ca śaktirityucyate śriyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmādyaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca kīlakaṃ samudāhṛtaṃśrīkaṃṭhānaṃtatātoyai dvirāvṛtyāṃgulīṣvathaśrīcakramaṃtrāṇāṃ vāṅmāyāyā kamalāpuraḥkumārikā dvirāvṛtyā ṣaḍaṃganyā samācaretvaśinyādyaṣṭa kanyā saṃtataḥ kuryādananyadhīḥuccāryābhāgaṃtyaṃ bhūsaṃsthaṃ vāmakarṇa samānvitaṃuccārya vaśinoti padaṃ tataḥanena śirasi nyasyaka varga proccaredathapaścāccaturthī hṛdagdevatā padaṃ paścāccaturthyaṃtaṃ namonvitaṃmātabhūmi sudhārūḍhaṃ vidruvāmākṣi saṃyutaṃṭadhargovasudhārūḍhaṃ vāyuṃ ṣaṣṭa samanvitaṃtavargaṃ cakravagāṃtyiṃ vaikuṃṭhārūṭhamapyathavāgdevatā padaṃ paścāccaturthyaṃtaṃ namonvitaṃjayinī vārgdevatāyai namo nābhauma vinyasetsaviṭharuvākarṇa ca tataḥ sarveśvaropadaṃliṃgenyasya śakarādi ṣaṭkakṣmīmiti vījakaṃvaśinyādyaṣṭakanyāsa uktoyaṃ sarvasiddhidaḥvācāṃ siddhi samāsādya saṃpadāmāśrayo bhavetśrutidvaye ca vadane bhujayugme tataḥ paraṃmūlavidyākṣarāntyasma sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavetsarvepi mātrā uccāryā devatābhāva siddhayemūlavidyākṣaranyāsaṃ nyasya sākṣājjagātpatiḥṣoḍānyāsama kṛtvāpi śrocanyāsamapyathaṣoḍā śrīcakra vinyāsau durlabhau bhuvanatrayenaitya kanyā sa ukroyaṃ samastaphalasiddhidaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viyāmimāṃ sākṣātparabrahmasvarūpiṇīitthaṃ vinyasya vidhivannyāsajālaṃ dine dinepadmanibhādevīṃ vālārkakiraṇāruṇāṃpadmarāga pratīkāśāṃ kuṃkumādarasannibhīkolāli kulasakāśa kuṭilāla kaṣaluvīṃkiṃcidardedu kuṭilalalāṭa mḍupaṭṭikāānaṃdamuditollāsa līlāṃdolita locanāṃkhaṃgaḍamaṃḍitā bhogajitedvamṛtaṃ kuṃḍalāṃtāmravidrumaviṃvābha raktāmṛtarasādhanāṃraktayā jagadbhāsi jihvāṃ madhurabhāṣiṇīṃanūpama guṇopeta cuvukoddeśa śobhitāṃraktotpala dalākāra sukumāra karāṃvujīmuktā hāralatopeta samunnatayodharīlavaṇya sa tilāvartākāranābhi vibhūṣitāṃvitaṃ varvivadviradaromaṇajī varāṃśukāṃkaṃdarpa kadalītulya jaṃghāyugalamaṃḍitītanudīrghāṃgulībhokhannakha caṃdravirājitāṃśītāṃśu śatasaṃkāśakāṃti saṃtānahāsinīraktavastraparīdhānāṃ pāśāṃkuśa karāghanāṃcaturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca vāṇadhanurddharāṃmahāmṛgamadoddāma kuṃkumāruṇavignahāṃjagadāhvādajatojadraṃjanakāriṇīsarvamaṃtramayī devīṃ sarvasaubhāgyasuṃdarīvaṃde pāśāṃkuśābhīṣṭyaṃ ca vāṇadhabhurddharāṃvālārkamaṃḍalābhāsāṃ catuvuddhi trilocana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāśāṃkuśarāṃścāpaṃ dhārayaṃtī śivāśrayeyudekṣu cāpāṃkuśapāśavāṇahaste namaste jagodakamātaḥaṇidibhirāvṛtāṃ mayūkhairaharmityevavimā bhāvayebhavānītripurasuṃdarīmāśrayesmarāmyaṃvikāṃudyat sūryanibhāṃ vaṃde mahātripurasuṃdarīamṛtānaṃda saṃdoha sayutyaitā bhajāmyahaṃyavoya cārān kṛtvātha daśamudrāḥ pradarśyamaṣṭauttaraśataṃ tu vāmahatī siddhimāsādya sākṣadvratyamayo bhavetnārāyaṇālaye vāpi parvatāgnetha vā śuciḥācārya sannidhau vāpi japellakṣatrayaśriyaṃdaśāṃśatarpayedvidvān kiṃśukairājyalolitaiḥācāryacaraṇāṃbhoje datvā sasyayutāṃ mahokuḍaladvitayaṃ datvā śrīvidyāyāḥ phalapradāathavāgnahaṇe prāpte savituḥ śaśinī pivājaptvā tatsparśa samaye snātvā nadyāṃ samāhitaḥācārya sannidhāvagnau vidhivat saskṛte śubhemadhu tritaya saṃmiśraghṛta saṃmiśra kiṃśukaiḥbrahmāpāṇāhutiṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtyāgnimādarātṣaṣṭi cihnuka sauvarṇa kuṃḍala dvitayaṃ śubhaṃvasudhāṃsasya saṃpūrṇaṃ datvā dakṣiṇayānvitāṃnidhissakalavidyānāmādhārassarvasaṃpadāṃaṇimādyaṣṭa siddhīnye nāyako jagatīpatiḥācāryapatnī śrīvudhyāvāsolaṃkaraṇādibhiḥitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryā lalitāyāṃ mama priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtvāṃte paramadhīmayātiṃvaśa samanvitaḥtṛtīyodhyāyaḥyacchatvāpi narasyarva saubhāgyaibhāgyaikanidhirbhavetjapyate lalitā vidyā śriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣarīsasnaṃ cakramabhyarvya madhyacakramathāpivājvalatkāmāgni saṃtāpa pratamāstaptamānasāḥmaṃtrasaṃṣūḍha hṛdayoḥ sphuratjaghanamaṃḍalāḥekāmapi puraścaryā kṛtvā sāgā mama priyemadhyaṃ vā cakramabhyarcya vaidike jātavedasigurubhiśca sakṛcchrutvā hyaṣṭāviṃśatidhā śriyākaṃdarpasadṛśīkātirjāthotanyakalevonavaratna samāyukta mukuṭhāvṛtamastakāḥjvalatkāmāgni saṃtaptāḥ sauṃdaryamadagarvitāḥsaṃpadasmakalā divyā mānuṣā api saṃpadaḥjaḍastādho maṃdamatirapi prajñā vivarjitaḥgaṃgāpravāhavattasyavāgvibhūtirvijṛṃbhatevyāsavālmīki sadṛśaḥ sarakhatyā bhavatyasauvaṃśābhivṛddhi sahito bhavatyā caṃdatārakaṃvaśīkaroti trailokyaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥkṣamātreyaṃ japte tu kṣubhyate bhūte leṃganaḥyadi na kṣubhyate davi sādhakasya manāmanāktāsāmapi yadā nāsau kṣobhaneti manāgapigaṃdharvakanyākinnarayorūpavatyau manoharāḥsaṃkṣobhayati viśveśīnnaikyaṃ sa carācaraṃdivyaratna śamāyuktaṃ kuṃḍalayamuttamaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahudakṣiṇayā yuktāṃ pradatvātha vasuṃdharāṃsūkṣmaṃ vāso yugaṃ datvā kṣauma kāryāsakaṃ tu vāprāpnotpanna na saṃdehasmatyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyahaṃsiddhimāsādya mahatīṃ sarvabhāgya nidhirbhavetkathita sarvadeṣursavaśāstreṣvapi priyesarvasiddhipradaṃ sadyo mahāsaubhāgya siddhidaṃcaitrepi navarātrākhyaṃ vratamasti mahattaraṃsaṃprāpya nahatī siddhi daivatairāye pūjyatenavarātravrataṃ proktaṃ samastābhīṣṭa siddhidaṃsāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṃḍavannatvā tadanujñā purasmaraṃācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ natvā brahmavile śubheaṣṭāviṃśatidhā vāpi na raptvādau niyatavrataḥvarṇasāhasraṃkhyāka saṃkalpa navarātrakejaptvā samastācaraṇasahitaṃ cakramarcayetaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃn hunecchī vidyayānalapiye ekaiko vā samabhyarkanityamatra suvāsinitāṃvūla carvaṇarato nityamādhāryapūjakaḥvidhivat saṃskṛte vahau raśmimaṃtrai sakṛddhunetkiṃśukairhṛtasamiśraiḥ kamalairvāghṛtaplutaiḥathavā pāyasenāgnau madhvājya sahitena cahutvā śrīvidyayā lakṣmīvidyayāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃsāmrājya lakṣmīmanunāpyaṣṭottaraśaṃ hunethutvā japādibhirhutvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇāktyāṃ hutiṃsvācārya caraṇadvaṃdvaṃ natvā sāṣṭāṃgamādarātkuṃḍaladvitayaṃ kṛtvā divyaratna samanvitaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahudakṣiṇayā yuktāmācāryāya samarpayetdukūlaṃ vātha kāryā sasūkṣma vā sasmamarpyatāṭaṃka svarṇaciṃtākādyalaṃkaraissuśobhanaiḥaśaktena daridreṇāpyavaśyaṃ niṣkapaṃcakaṃācāryapatnyai niṣkaṃ vā su varṇa vā sasārpayetitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryā navarātravate śubhepaladvayamitaṃ raupyapātraṃ ṣalamitaṃ tu vāyāgadavyaṃ pradadyādyaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥbrahmaloke ca satyeva magnāśca narakārṇavemahānavamyāṃ tatpuṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyatetulāpuruṣasāhasraṃ kṛtaṃ tena na saṃśayaḥvivāhārthaṃ dhanaṃ datvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhettāvatkasahesrāṇi kulānāṃ śatasaṃprutaḥavaśyaṃ vasudhādānaṃ kuṃḍaladayasaṃyutaṃācāryapatnyalaṃkāradānamāvaśyakaṃ smṛtaṃpuraścaryā śataphalaṃ prāpnotyakhilasiddhidaṃdatvāya phalamāpnoti svācāryacaraṇadvayemahīpratinidhirdravyamathavā guraverpayetmahīpratinidhi dravyaṃ śataniṣkamudāhṛtaṃdakṣiṇādravyadravyamayuktaṃ tathaiva girikanyokemaheṃdrasadṛśī lakṣmī prāpnotyavana saṃśayaḥsubhagaḥ suṃdarovāgmīśriyaḥ putro bhavatyasausākṣādbrahmamayaḥ siddho bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥdaṃdarpa śatasaubhāgyaṃ jaga ayavaśaṃkaraṃvahukālamaiso jīvatyāpurorāgyaṃsataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prārthyate divyakanyābhiraharniśamesau priyesa evāhaṃ na saṃdehasya eva hariracyutaḥyasyā vārye dṛḍhā bhaktiḥ śrīvidyāyāṃ ca saṃtataṃnavarātravrate vidyā siddhirbhavṛtiyādṛśīācāryaniṃdākartāramapi svapitaraṃ guruṃācāryaniṃdā śravaṇāddevatāśāpa bhāgasauācāryaniṃdākartāraṃ daṃḍayaida vicārayanitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryāṃ japet sāhasramanvahaṃsahasraṃ prajapennityaṃ triśataṃ vā catuḥśataṃdṛṣṭyā karoti dāridyai sahitaṃ ca śriyaḥ patiṃdṛṣṭyā vināśayatyāśu jvarānogāśca dāruṇānsvacchaṃdamṛtyuḥ sarvatra siddho bhūtvā jagattrayeiti śrījānakīnātha vadanāṃbhojanisṛtaṃita ūrdhvaṃ mayā devi kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasiṣoḍhānyāsa vidhāna ca cakranyāsavidhiṃ tathāśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃtvaṃ pariṣṭacchasiajñātvā samayācāra maya*(?) gurupādukābrahmatādātmyasaṃ siddhikāraṇaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃyasya vijñāna mātreṇa jīvanmuktaḥ prammeteparācāpya parāgauri tṛtīyā ca parā parādvitīyāhya parā pūjā sadā niṣpādyate mayouttamāsā parā proktā vidhānaṃ śṛṇu sāṃprataṃvidhānaṃ śṛṇu sāṃprataṃāpyāyī tajajadrūpāṃ paramāmṛtavarṣiṇīṃdahanāṃtaraṃ sa sarvannādāloka na tatparaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ kiṃcidyathā śakta*(?)marpayetsadguṇaiśvaryasaṃpatiḥ patiḥ padbhiryāgaiḥ prājāyatedevarṣipitṛpītyarthaṃ pacayajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥmadhyāhnakāle saṃprāpte datvā bhūtavaliṃ bhuviatithiṃ tatra saṃprāptaṃ pūjayet svagatādināśraddhayānna pradānena priyamaśrotareṇa caajñātakulanāmācadūradeśāddumāgataḥsvādhyāyaṃgotracaraṇamapṛṣṭāṃ ca tathākulaṃatithināṃ sahasrāṇi yasya bhuktānimaṃdireārcācaraṇāṃbhojadvayaprakṣālitaṃ jalaṃsamastatīrthasnānasya phalasiddhan mahīpateyatiśca brahmacārī ca pakvānnasvāmināvubhauyatihaste jalaṃ dadyāt bhaikṣyaṃ dadyātyubharjalaṃācāryo vimukho gṛhṇāngṛhānpratinivartateācāryapatniputrāṇāmavaśyaṃ poṣaṇaṃ vudhaiḥpratijñātaṃ manovāgbhyāṃ daridrāya kuṭuṃvineśīghrameva pradātavyaṃ tadṛṇaṃ svargasaukhyadaṃapi merusamājñeyāmāsādūrdhvamṛṇaṃ mahatmāsābhyaṃtarattodeyaṃ dvimāsābhyaṃtarepivāyatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sadācāryasya pādayoḥtrīṇyāhuratidānāni kanyāpṛthvīsarasvatībrahmalokaṃ vrajatyaṃte pitaraḥ svargabhāginaḥvipraṃ vivāhapitvaikaṃ daridraṃ vedapāragaṃkachṛtyupuṣpakaṃ divyamāruhya pitṛbhissahagaṇyaṃ tepāṃśavobhūmergaṇyaṃte divitārakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vitkallolābhi dalitasaṃkocastvati suṃdaraḥnyāsaṃ vivartayeheha ṣoḍhānyāsa puraḥsaraṃaṃtarvahirmātṛkākhyasṛtīyonyāsa ucyatemūlaṃ vidyākṣaranyāsaṃ paṃcama phaladāyakaḥṣḍhā cakrādikanyāsaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvāpi vānvahaṣoḍhānyāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmarūpa phalapradaṃṣoḍhānyāsaṃ nāḥ kuryādyena brahmāṃḍanāyakaḥgaṇeśai prathamonyāso dvitīyastugnahairmataḥrāśibhiḥ paṃcamonyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭa pīṭhairnigadyateevaṃ yonyastagātraḥ syāt sapūjyaḥ sarvayogitiḥsa eva pūjyaṃ sarveṣāṃ sa svayaṃ parameśvaraḥsocirāt mṛtyumāpnoti narakaṃ ca prapadyateācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ dhyātvā kuryānnatiṃ sadāśravaṇādapi yasyā śujāyaṃte sarvasiddhayaḥpāśāṃkuśa vā bhītikarān śakti samanvitānvighneśvarastathā śrīśca vighnarājastathā hriyāvighnakṛtyuṣṭi yuktaśca vighnacca sarasvatīekadaṃtaścakāṃtiścāddidaṃtaḥ kāmino yutaḥkapardabhṛttathā tīvrādīrghavaktrastataḥ priyepṛṣa dhvajaśca subhagāgaṇanāthena saṃyutāsūyaṃ karṇaścajayinī trinetraḥ satyayānvitaḥcaturmūtiḥ kāmadā ca sadāśivayutā tataḥdurmadaśca tathā ghūrṇī sumukhā bhūtimāṃstataḥdvijihvaścaramāyuktaḥ śūraścaiva tu mānuṣīṣaṇmukhaśca vivarṇā ca varadā bhrukuṭīlatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: doghaṃ ghoṇānvitā paścādviraṃḍā vā dhanurdharaṃmataśca caṃdrikāyukto vimalaśca śaśiprabhāmuṃḍī paścāpaddaṃḍī durbhayānvitaḥbhakṣya priyaśca durgā ca meghanādaśca kālikāetāstu vinyasaddevi mātṛkā varṇavatpriyeraktaṃ śvetaṃ tathā raktaṃ śyāmaṃ pītaṃ ca pāṃḍuraṃdravi mukhyān kāmarūpānkansarvābharaṇabhūṣitānśrūmadhye ca ca vargeṇa bhaumaṃ netra trayenyasethṛdayoparideveśipargeṇa gale bhṛguṃlakṣābhyāṃ tu gude ketuṃ nyasedevaṃ varānanejvalat kālāgni saṃkāśāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥyugmaṃ yugmaṃ tathā yugmaṃ yugma yugma sarohiṇīlaluṭo netrayoḥ paścādvāmadakṣiṇakarṇayoḥpuṣpāṃtaṃ ca pravinyasyaṃ khagārṇābhyāṃ tu sāryakaṃpūrvāphalgunī dakṣe carparecchaja pūrvikāṃjha ña varṇasthitaṃ hastaṃ maṇivaṃdhetha dakṣiṇekāreṇayutāṃ svātiṃ dakṣahaste pravinyasettathadasthāmanūrādhāṃ nābhau vinyasya pārvatitapayūsyaṃ tathā mūlaṃ nyased vāmakaṭau priyebhakoraṇottarāṣāḍāṃ vāmorau tadanaṃtaraṃparasthitāṃ dhaniṣṭāṃ tu vāmajānuni vinyasetdakṣajaṃghogatāṃ paścāt pūrvābhādra padāṃ tataḥṣasahasthottarā bhādrapadāṃ dakṣiṇapādakevāmapāde pravinyasya yoginī nyāsamāttarecaturbhujāsaṃmairvaktrauḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmakarṇedunādāḍhyaṃ ḍākinyai nama ityapitvagātmane kaṃṭhadeśe viśuddhau vinyaset priyepūrvavadvīja saṃyuktai rasṛṇāt mātra saṃvadetlākinī ca tathā devi māṃsātmā maṇipūkebhedasvarūpā vinyasya vasavarṇaistu yākinīhakṣavarṇa sthitāṃ tadvaddhākinī dvidale nyasetbrahmaraṃdhre maheśāni nyāsoyaṃ yoginī yutaḥraktaṃ śvetaharidvarṇaṃ pāṃḍacitrāsitān smaretakārādi caturvaṇairvinyaset sukhaṃditenyasejjānu nivedaistu mithunaṃ vṛṣaṇe tataḥsiṃhakaṃ anusvāra visargābhyāṃ śavargeṇa ca kanyakāṃtathā dāma śirobhāge kavargeṇa tu lābhṛtāca vargeṇa tathārgeṇa tathā skaṃdhe vṛścikaṃ nityaset priyemakaraṃ tu tavargeṇa vinyasedvṛṣaṇe kramātyadargeṇa kṣakāreṇa mīnaṃ gulphetha vinyasetteṣā nāmāni kaṣathyaṃte śṛṇuthā vahitā priyevarasthiraṃ kanyākubjaṃ pūrṇaśailaṃ tathārvudaṃkailāsaṃ bhṛgunagaraṃ kaṃdāraṃ caṃdrapūjakaṃkulūtthaṃ devakūaṃ ca gokarṇamārukteśvaraṃkollāpuramelāpuramoṃkāraṃ svajayāṃtikaṃuḍḍīśaṃ ca prayāgākhyaṃ vilvaṃ māyāpuraṃ tathāmaheṃdravāmanaṃ caiva hiraṇyapurameva caete pīṭhāsmaddiṣṭā mātṛkārūpamāsthitākṛtvā ṣoḍābhidhaṃ nyāsāṃ virāḍatmāhariskhayaṃṣoḍānyāsamimaṃ kṛtvā śrīcakranyāsamācarebhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navayonyabhidhaṃ nyasedādauma priyehṛṃsadvaye ca hṛdayenyaset kūrparakukṣiṣusakaṃṭhe navayonyākhyaṃ nyasedvīja trayātmakaṃpunarvālāṃ samuccārya caturasraṃ viciṃtayetṣaṭcakreṣu lalāṭe ca sīmaṃte ca nirāvileśrīvidyāṃ brahmaraṃdhre ca pṛṣṭatto guravaḥ kramātkharaparvenyasedvakte sarvasaubhāgyadāyakaḥaṃtaḥ śrīcakra vinyāsa uktoyaṃ sarvasiddhidaḥbrahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairapi lokeṣu pūjyateyasya vijñānatṇe vāpi brahmarūpī bhavatyasaughannavusya vidākhyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ paraṃdakṣā sa pṛṣṭhaṣṭha pārāyagrasthitapārāgulodyathasamūlatala pṛṣṭhayuvyāpakakatvena suṃdarisiddhāṃstadaṃtaśca tanu vyāpakatvena suṃdarivinyasya tasyā sthāneṣu brāhmāṇyādyāstathāṣṭasuvāmadakṣiṇa jānvośca vahiraṃsadvaye tathāvinyased vyāpakatvena pūrvoktā tasya vigrahebrahmāṇyādyaṣṭa sthānītasthā mānaṣṭānnyasedathatadaṃtaḥ ṣoḍaśadala padmāya nama ityapidalāni dakṣiṇa śrotra pṛsṭamaṃsaṃ ca kūrparaṃvāmapādatalādyevameva devāṣṭakaṃ mataṃvinyasetra daleṣveṣu dakṣaśaṃkhe ca jatrukeanekusumādyāśca śaktīraṣṭāraṣṭā ca vinyasetvinyaset tasya koṇeṣu nyasecchakrīścaturdaśalalāhdakṣabhāgaṃ ca dakṣagaṃḍī sa madhyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmorvatarvāna pārśva vāmāsaṃ vāmagaṃḍakaṃtatādaśoracakrāya nama ityapi pārvatikukṣīśa vāyukoṇeṣu jātu dvaya gudeṣu casarvasiddhipradādyānāṃ śaktīnāṃ daśakaṃ tathāvinyaset tasya koṇeṣu sarvājñādyaḥ pravinyasetśivanī vāmamuṣka ca stanaṃ sakviṇi nāsiketadaṃtara vṛṣṭakoṇādi cakrāya nama ityapicuvukaṃ kaṃṭha hṛdayanābhīnāṃ caiva dakṣiṇaṃcatuṣṭayaṃ ca pārśvānāme tatkoṇāṣṭakaṃ punaḥśaracāyau pāśāsṛṇī trikoṇāya namastathākāmeśvaryādi devīnāṃ madhye devīṃ ca vinyasetetadguptatarakāryatvayāmat prāṇavallabheguptāguptataraṃ cai tattavādya prakaṭīkṛtaṃśirastrikoṇe pūrvādi kāmeśvaryādika nyasetsṛṇidvayaṃ tu nyānāsāgne dakṣiṇādyaṃ tu vinyasetdavādīni cakrāṇinyastavyāni varānanecūḍādike ca nimnorddha śikhorddhakarṇapṛṣṭakesarvasidhyādikaṃ ye ca prādakṣiṇyena vinyasetnābhau tvaṣṭadalattuvaṃśe vāme ca pārśvakevaṃśabhavāmāṃtarādinyanyedanya"ca catuṣṭayaṃmūlādhāre nyasenmudrā daśakaṃ sādhakottamaḥūrdhvādho daśamudrāśca ūrddhvādho varjitaṃ punabrahmaṇyādyaṣṭakaṃ tatra tadyāyāṃ tāsu pūrvavatvāmajaṃghāṃ samārabhya vāmādi kramatopi caitthaṃ vinyasya deveśi svābhedena viciṃtayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrdhni guhye ca hṛdaye netra tritaya eva capṛṣṭhe jānuni nābhau ca vidyānyāsaṃ samācaretśrīkaṃṭhādi ca vāgdevī rādhā **daye punaḥcalatrayaiḥ samasta ca vidyāvīna trayānvitaṃvyāpakaṃ caiva nyasya khālī kṛtya prasyuṃnaḥṣoḍhānyāsoṇimādiśca mūladevyādikaḥ priyeṣoḍānyāsa samāyuktaṃ śrīcakranyāsamiṣṭadaṃtejomaya tanurbhūtvā jīvanmuktaḥ sukhī bhavetsiddhāṣṭaka manuprāpya trailoke viharatyasaukṛtvā ṣoḍābhidhaṃ nyāsaṃ śrīcakranyāsamapyathatejomaya tanurbhūtvā śriyamaṣṭaguṇānvitāṃkartānyāsa dvayasyāsya tadajñaṃ pitaraṃ tu vāpraṇamennāpi daivaṃ vā vinā svācāryamīśvaraṃsiddhakṣetraṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ samaṃtā yojanatrayaṃtatra gaṃgāgayākāśīkurukṣetraṃ dhanaimisvaṃājñā siddhikaraṃnyāsa dvayame tatsūdurlabhaṃṣaṇmāsābhyā sa yogena vidhiviṣṇu śivātmakaḥna vaktavyamidaṃ nyāsa sa dvayaṃ sakalasiddhidaṃśrīviyāyā japo nityanitya samācāryayoṣaṇaṃhṛdanyāsadvayaṃ nityaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvāpi kāśuciḥcidrūpaṃ paramaṃdhāmaṃtraipurī kṛtā vigrahaḥnyāsa jātamidaṃ tubhyaṃ kathitaṃ girikanyakeśrīsuṃdaryā mahādevyā yajaṃ saṃpravakṣyateuttarabhāge saubhāgyavidyodaye paṃcamodhyāyaḥdhyātvā devaṃ vījagadvātrīṃ śriyaṃ saubhāgyadevatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maunena praviśedyāgamanuṃ parasyamīśvariādhāraśakti kamalāsanāya nama uccarettṛṇāsaneya śohādbhirdaurbhāgyaṃ dārukāsanevicitrakaṃ valesiddhirmokṣa śrīrvyāghracarmaṇikuśāsane bhavedgānaṃ ratnapīṭheṣṭa siddhayaḥuccāryatā ratritayaṃ raktā vā daśataḥ petharauccāryahṛdayaścādbhūmau puṣpāṃjalīḥ kṣipetmānasālaṃkṛto vāpi śuklāṃvaradharaḥ śuciḥpaṃcaśakti catuḥśaṃbhurūpaṃ cakraṃ manoharaṃvasukoṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā daśāra dvitayaṃ tataḥtataḥ ṣoḍaśa patrāṇi likhedvattayutānyapisamastayātakahara samastaphalasiddhidaṃmohanaṃ sarvajagatāṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradaṃnityānaṃdakaraṃ bhaktabhoigare vargāpavargadaṃsarvadharmamayaṃ sarvaratnavittaphalapradaṃbhūtapretapiśādi sarvabhīti nivārakaṃāyurārogpadaṃ svasti putrapautrābhivṛddhikaṃlokāyavādabhītighnaṃ mayamṛtyu vināśanaṃalakṣmīnāśanaṃ dhanyaṃ ciṃtāmarāyādi siddhidaṃvedavedāṃtaśāstraudya sārabhūtaṃ yaśaskaraṃākarṣaṇakaraṃ sarvastaṃbhanaṃ jaṃbhanaṃ tathāśāṃti vṛṣṭi dhanārogya maṃtrasiddhikaraṃ paraṃsarvasiddhikaraṃ śreyaskara manuptayaṃsarvajñānamayaṃ sarvavācāṃ siddhitvapradaṃsarvavratamayaṃ devi sarvāmṛtamayaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvonmādakaraṃ devi sarvāhlādakānarekaṃraudrāmicārako daṃḍa paramaṃtraugha bhakṣaṇaṃparasainyastaṃbhakaraṃ śastrastaṃbhanakārakaṃmahājvaraharaṃ devi mahāmṛtyuvināśanaṃmahālakṣmīmayaṃ devi mahāmāṃgalyasiddhidaṃitthame tasya cakrasya prabhāvo varṇito mayāśrīcakrameta devoktaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidhaṃśaktāśyakti vinirbhiya punarvahni purena vaināmādi cakrādhaḥ śaktiṃ vahninorddhvaṃ vibhedayetūrdhvaśaktimadho vahni madhyavahni vivarjitaṃtato madhyādi śaktyardhaṃ śaktivistārayedadhaḥvācatena maheśāni vahnicakrecaṇa bhedayetmadhyodhvarśati paryaṃtamādirā avadhipriyetato vikāśayecchaktimādyāmapyūrddhamīśvaravistārya vāhyaśaktiṃ tu sarvāṣastādvi bhedayettadvāhyatopi deveśi ṣoḍaśāraṃ tataḥ paraṃtataḥ sṛṣṭe mahācakraṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu hutāśanaḥevametanmahācakraṃ śriyo devyā udīritaṃagnīṣomātmakamidaṃ sarvavidyāmayaṃ priyemātṛkāvarṇayustūjyamatha tadrahitaṃ tu vācakresmin sa viśeṣāstāsmādhakaṃ mānayaṃti himuktāmāṇikyaghaṭita samasthala virājitaṃṣoḍaśāraṃ caṃdraviṃvarūpaṃ tu sakalālayaaṣṭapatraṃ maheśāni japākusuma sannibhaṃetat trayaṃ maheśāni sṛṣṭicakraṃ sukhapradaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvitīyamapi padmapyaṃ japākusuma sānnibhaṃcaturdaśāraṃ devevaśidādimī kusumaprabhaṃetat trayaṃ maheśāni sthiticakraṃ sthitipradaṃaṣṭapatraṃ varārohe vālārka kiraṇāruṇaṃupatsūrya sahasrābhaṃ vaṃdhūka kusumaprabhaṃtrikoṇaṃ sarvasaṃbhūtikāraṇabhūtidaṃ sadāsadāśivamayaṃ camranāyakaṃ parameśvaripaścimāmrāya saṃsevyaṃ trayāmuttarapūjitaṃcakrapatreṣu deveśi padādhvātu nigadyatevarṇādhvā mātṛkārūpī kathayāmita vā nadyepārthivaṃ tanmayaṃ viddhi ṣoḍaśāṃskalāśrakaṃkādiśaṃtāḥ śakraparṇāḥ śakrakoṇeṣu saṃsthitāḥmakārādi kṣakārāṃtān dvitīyepi daśārakeakathādi trikoṇāṃtaṃ hākṣayugmaṃ tu madhyagaṃṣaṭtriṃśattatvabharituṃ cakraṃ mūlānusārataḥsa kālā bharavīyuktā mahātripurasuṃdarīmaṃtrādhvāyaṃ samākhyātau niścayena sadānaghemerurūpaṃ mahīrūpaṃ dvidhā pūjārthamīṣyateyadā suvarṇa lekhinyā likhitaṃ saṃprapūjayetayodhyānagaraṃ cakrarājaṃ nitya samarcayet*śri māśāttayā jñeyā pūrvā śaiva nigadyatedakṣiṇāśāmukho devi yathā cakraṃ samarcayetuttarāśā mukhye devi yathācakraṃ samarcayetīśānakoṇaṃ deveśi tadāgreyaṃ na saṃśayaḥsarvāgamamayaṃ devi kathitaṃ vīravaṃdite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ viśvamarcidaṃ tasyānnaṃ saṃśayaḥabhyarcātha gṛhītvaitaccakraṃ sakalasiddhidaḥajarāmaraṇo bhūtvā siddhiṃ prāprauti śāśvatīṃśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi pūjāvidhi mataḥ paraṃpratiṣṭhāpyārcayeddhīmān sādhakaḥ śuddhamānasaḥamṛtāṃbho nidhiḥ pūvaṃ ratnadvīpa mataḥ paraṃsaṃtānavāṭikā paścāddhari caṃdanavāṭikākadevavanavāṭī ca vāṭikā paṃcakīrtitāḥuccāryāḥ sakalārmatrā japahomārcanīdiṣudaṃpadmarāga mahāratna prākaraśca tataḥ paraṃvaiḍūryaratna prākāra iṃdranīlābhidhastathāvidrumākhya mahāratnaprākāro navamaṃ smṛtaḥatha mṛtākhyavāṭīsyāttata ānaṃdavāṭikācaṃdrikoddhāramabhyarcya tataḥ śaileṃdra kanyakeciṃtāmaṇi mahāratna gṛharājastataḥ paraṃdakṣiṇāmrāya rūpaṃ taddakṣiṇadvāramapyathauttarāmnāya rūpaṃ cottaradvāraṃ tatocayetatha brahmamayaṃ madhva pādamekaṃ samarcayettato rudramayaṃ maṃca pādamekaṃ samarcayetsadāśivamayamaṃ ca phalakaṃ ca tataḥ paraṃhaṃtūla mahopādyadhānamabhyarcayedarthamahāyavanikāṃ paścāddevī medirapūjakāḥbhāvayanmaṃdiraṃ devyāmatraitaiḥ samarcayetdatvābhitastatodīpāṃścakraṃ mūlena pūjayetvādyagni jalasaṃyukta prāṇāyāmaistribhi priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viprāya vedaviduṣe daridrāya mahīpateḥāṃcaṃdratārakaṃ prāpya brahmalokevasatyasauśrotriyātha daridrāya caturvṛṣayutāṃ dadanpakvasasyayutāṃ pṛthvī catuḥpuṃgavasaṃyutāṃpitṛṇāmapi sāhasraṃ nimagnaṃ narakārṇavebhagavatsadṛśākāromodate bhagavatpadebrāhmaṇaḥ pūjyatāṃ prāpya brahmaṇā sahamodatepradattvā pustakaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ pārago bhavetśālagrāmaśilādānavamīvamahaṃdaṃtaraṃśālagrāma śilāmekāmapi dakṣidāyānvitāṃbrahmāṃḍakoṭidānena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥannaṃ nityaṃ pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥpayasvinīṃ savatsāṃgāṃkāṃsyarohasamanvitāṃalaṃkṛtya daridrā yayo dadāti kuṭuṃvinepatrakṣīravahānadyo yatra pāpa sakarddamāḥācāryāya viśeṣeṇa savatsāṃgāṃ payasvinīṃsamarpya bhagavaddhāmni pitṛbhiḥ sahamodatetaddātāpitṛsāhasrasahito bhagavatyadegavāṃvikrayakṛdviprāḥ gṛhītānāṃ mahīpatetryalaṃkāreṣu sarveṣu padmarāga samanvitaṃdivyāṃ laṃkaraṇaṃ proktaṃ tadatvācāryakarṇayoḥbhagavatsadṛśākāro vaikuṃṭheva sati dhruvaṃaśvadānākuvereṇa sāmyaṃ prāpnoti tatpadeāṃdolikāṃ pradadyādya ācāryāya viśeṣataḥgaruḍadhvajamāruhyavimānaṃ divyabhogayuk
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlavidyāṃ samuccāya prāṇānāyamya ca tridhāaya sarpaṃtuye bhūtāye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥiti maṃtreṇa savyānya pārśvāṣṇi pātena śailajedevyahaṃ bhāvanāyuktaḥ saśarīre tataḥ priyekaraśuddhiṃ puraḥ kṛtvā kumārīmuccaredathaātmānaṃ rakṣkṣetimikṣipya hṛdayeṃñjaliṃdevyātmāsa na śadaṃ ca caturthyaṃta namonvitaṃśriyaṃ māyāṃ kumārīṃ ca proccārya manunāmunāuccārya bhuvaneśānī parāvījaṃ kumārikāṃtrilokeśī kāmarājaṃ klamakṣaramataḥ paraṃuccāryānena maṃtrāṇāṃ tritayena ca sādhakuḥvinyasya mātṛkāṃ paścadviśinyādyavakuṃ tataḥṣoḍhā cakrābhidhanyāsa dvitayaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃśuddhāṃbhasā vāmabhāge savṛtta caturasrakaṃpratiṣṭhāpya ṣaḍaṃgena samabhyarcya tataḥ paraṃtena saṃprokṣeyadarcā ityamātmona tathathakṛtvā tatra viśeṣārghyaṃ kṛtvāpyarvayecchrityāṃtvāmalena madhye ca vidyā ** trikoṇakeathavā bhava muccārya caturthyaṃta samāśvitaṃarghyapātrāyāraśakaṃ caturthī nati saṃyutaṃdhūmrārcirūṣmājvalinī jvālinī visphurliṃginīvahnerdaśakalāṃ proktāyādi varṇasamudbhavāḥsūryamaṃḍala śabdaṃ ca caturthī sahitaṃ tataḥarghyapātrapadaṃ paścāccaturthī hṛdayanvitaṃdhūmrāmarīcirapi ca jvālinī rucirapyatha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalā dvādaśa saṃproktā etāḥ mavituriṣṭadāḥparāṃ somapadaṃ paścānmaṃḍalāya paraṃ tataḥarghyā mṛtā yadā kaṃcanamaskāra samanvitaṃamṛtāmānadā pūṣā tuṣṭiṃtpuṣṭiratirdhṛtiḥpūrṇāpūrṇā mṛtākā sadāyinyaḥ ṣoḍaśeṣṭadāḥtatrābhyārcyā namaskāryā akathāyakṣarātmakaṃ*kkāma śaktisahita koṇe tritayamupyathakṛtvā dhyātvā ṣaḍaṃgena samabhyarcya tataḥ paraṃcaturnavati saṃkhyākān maṃtrān spṛṣṭvā japedathaaṣṭatriṃśati saṃkhyākā uktāḥ parvata kanyakesthitiśca siddhirityuktā daśabrahmakalā imāḥvaradāndrādinī prīti dīrghā viṣṇukalā imāḥutkārī mṛtyurityuktā daśarudrakalā imāḥcatvāra uktā etāśca kalāḥ sarvaphalapradāḥnivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāṃtistathaiva casūkṣmā tato sūkṣmāmṛtā jñānā tataḥ paraṃsadāśiva kalā etāḥ ṣoḍaśasthara saṃbhavāḥsaḥśuciṣadityuktvā vasuraṃ tadekṣetyāthataduroṇū sadatha prokta nṛṣadvarasadityathamaṃtrāṃte ca pratadviṣṇusrapyaṃvakaṃ manustataḥmūlavidyātha saṃproktāścaturtavati maṃtrakāḥcaturnavati maṃtraṃti pravadaṃtyibhi maṃtraṇaṃchaṃda sphuraṇāmātranidhehya kulavanāyikeamṛtatvaṃ nidhehyasmin vastuvitkinmarūpiṇībhūtvā parāmṛtākāraṃmayī citsphuraṇaṃ kuru
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amṛte padamuccārya padamapya mṛtodbhāveamṛtaṃ srāvaya yugaṃ vahni jñātayā samānvitaṃvāgbhavaṃ vadayugmaṃ ca padaṃ vāgvādinītyathakledaya dvitayaṃ paścāt mahākṣobhaṃ kuru dvayaṃanaṃtaṃ caṃdramavanaṃ manusvara samanvitaṃmanusvara visargādhyamuccarediti paṃcamīetābhissarvavidyābhirabhimaṃtryāmitaṃ śivātadviṃdubhirbrahmaraṃdhre guru tritayapādukāḥātmanaḥ kuṃḍalinyāṃ ca tadviṃduṃ vodhasiddhidaṃiti kṛtvā viśeṣārghyaṃ vatsarevatsarepi vāsarvajñaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥsyājjīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥśrīcakraṃ pūjayitvāśu sarvabhāgyabhidhirbhavatyatkṛtvāpi śucinirtyarbhahā saubhāgyavān bhavetdhyādhatvā saṃvinmayī devī mahātripurasuṃdarīaṃtaḥ suṣumṇā kamalādi vinirbhedana kṣamāṃsamastaloka dīpasya dīptibhutī sanātanījñānāṃ sāpuṭe nirgamayya līlā saṃkalpitā kṛtiṃtrikhaṃḍamudrāsahito khāṃjalau kusumānviteśrīmahātripuret yuktvā suṃdarīti padaṃ tataḥtato mūrtikalpaṣāmi nama ityamunā śivevījatrayamidaṃ bhūyopyuccārya girikanyakemahāpadmavanāṃtasthe kāraṇānaṃtavigraheiti maṃtreṇa paramāmicchā kalpitavigrahāṃcatuḥṣaṣṭyupacārāṃśca kuryāddaivyai tataḥ paraṃyāmīti namasāyuktā upacāsmanūttamāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīdevyai pādyamuccārya kalpayāmi namaḥ **ityādi maṃtrān sakulānupacārābhidhānusmaretatha maṃjanamaṃḍapaṇi pīṭhopaveśanaṃtata ullodakasnānaṃ kanaketi pada tataḥrthota vastraparītyuktvāmārjanaṃta tataḥ paraṃaruṇena dukūlenottarīyamathaṃ kalpayetathālepana maṃḍapamaṇapīṭhopaveśanaṃatha śaṃkumadetyuktvā padaṃ mṛgamadetyathadivyagaṃdha padaṃ sarvāgāṇāṃtace vilepanaṃmallikā mālatī jāti caṃpakāśoka śabdataḥpunnāgatyatha kahlāramukhya savartuśabdataḥatha bhūṣaṇa śabdāṃte maṃḍapāte praveśanaṃpīṭhopavaiśarna paścādupacāra prakalpayeatha sīmetā siṃdūraṃ tatastilaka ratnakaṃmaṇikuṃdulayugmaṃ ca nāsābharaṇamathasaṃtapta hemaciṃtākaṃvarakaṃ ca tataḥ paraṃekāvalī tato devicchanna vīramataḥvalayāvalimapyatra kalpayitvomikāvalīkalpayet pādakaṭekaṃ ratnanūpuramapyathaanyahasteṃkuśaṃ paścādapya pradrakṣu saṃbhavaṃśrīmanmāṇikya śabdāṃte pāduke kalpayedathadevatābhissahetyuktvā mahācakrādhiṇehṛṇaṃsudhā savākhya caṣakaṃ tata ānamanīyakaṃparaṃ vilāsahāsaṃcamaṃgalā rātrika tataḥgaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpanaivedyāni ca kalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samarpayitvā śrī devyai navamudrāḥ pradarśya caagnīśāsura vāyavya madhyādikṣu girīdraṃjeatha nityārcana vakṣye śṛṇuthaikāgnamānasāvā ca sakalaśabdaṃ ca bhuvaneśī mataḥ paraṃeṣā kāmeśvarī vidyā sarvakāma samṛddhidāādau vidyāṃ samuccārya padaṃ kāmeśvrītyathavācaṃ bhagabhuge śabdaṃ bhaginīti bhagodaribhagaguhye bhagetyuktvā yoginī ca bhagetyathabhagarūpetha nityādya klinne bhaga pada tataḥmehyānaya padaṃ paścādvarade pāmapyarthakledayadrāvayet yuktvā śramodye padamapyathasarvasarvānathoccārya bhageśvari padaṃ tataḥparayektadomityathoccārya klinne sarvāṇi śabdataḥpadaharapalaṃ māyāṃ nityaiṣā bhagamālinīvahnijāyeti nityoktvā nityaklinnābhidhā parājrauṁ svāheti caturthyeṣābhe rudrāṃ sarvasiddhidāpadaṃ ca vahni vāsinyai namasānvitamapyathahrī klinne vā ca muccārya vījamaṃkuśanāmakaṃmahāvajreśvarī nityā ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ sarvadvidāśivādūtyabhidhā nityā saptamī samuvīritākṣuśrī hūṃ kṣetrilokeśī padamastra mataḥ paraṃkumāryeva tataḥ proktā nityātha kulasuṃdarīhasāyakatrāretyuktvādārṇa viṃdusmarānvitaṃnityābhidhe yamuddiṣṭānitthā sarvaśubhapradāmukhavṛtta kāmarājaṃ vācyaglmāmityathoccaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pre jrauṁ nīlapatākeyaṃ nityā sarvaphalapradāviṃdvaṃ kitamiyaṃ nityā vijayāśu phalapradāuktā samastaphaladā nittheyaṃ sarvamaṃgalājvālāmāliniśakāṃte devadeva pada tataḥjātavedasi śabdāṃte jvaladvitayamapyatharaphasamakamuccārya jvālāmālinyathādritesamastaiśvarya phaladā rogaśokanikṛṃtanāklinnā paṃcadaśī nityāmā mahāsiddhipradā smṛtāśrīvidyaiva mahāvidyā lalitā parameśvarīnityā paṃcaśa prāktāyā etā girikanyakeṣoḍaśīyā mahānityā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarīpratipatyaurṇamāsyaṃta divaseṣva khileṣvapinityā paṃcadaśārcāṃta maṃtramuccārya yatnataḥnityā maṃtra japaṃ homamarcanaṃ yodite dinenityā paṃcadaśātyarcya tithi nityā phalapradāṃmahadbhāgyama vāpnoti devānāmapi dullābhaṃjanabhyacyātha vā nityaṃ śrīdevī lalitāṃ parāṃgururpāduḥ samabhyarcya śreyo rāśi mavāpnuyātgurupaṅkti manabhyarcya na vṛddhiṃ yāti bhūtaleśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmītyaṣṭārṇaṃ yojayestriyepareśa parameśyaṃvāṃ gururūpāṃ purorcayatparacaryānātha tato lopāmudrāṃ vāgastya saṃjñakausarvatrā naṃdanātha śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāni caānaṃdanātha śabdo na lopāmudrā gurau śivepati brahmāmukhāllabdhā vidyā salasiddhidāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dinedinesya śreyāṃsi varddhate sarvasaṃpadaḥtāmabhyarcya naro nityaṃ śrīdhiyā sarvasiddhibhākjaganmāt dhiyābhyayā viśepeṇa mahotsavedivyaughamādāvabhyarcya siddhauyamatha pūjaptenamuktakeśīśvaraṃ dīpakalānāthamathoryayetsiddhauyamiti saṃpūjya mānavaughamathārcayettejodevamathābhyarcya manojaṃ ca tataḥ priyeparaṃ śrīrāmānaṃdanāthākhyamarcayejjagatāṃ guruṃviśeṣatārcayettredhā tataḥ svagurupādukāṃkṛtvālayogapūjāṃ vā pratyahaṃ sādhakottamaḥbhogāṃgākhyaṃ mahādevi bhogasvargāpavargadaṃvaśitva siddhiṃ prākāmya siddhiṃ bhuktimataḥ paraṃcaturasre prāthamike pūjyā etā mama priyekaumārī vaiṣṇavīmaṃ vā vārāhī ca tataḥ paraṃtṛtīye caturasretha mudrāṃ saṃkṣobhiṇīyapisarvavaśyābhidhāṃ mudrāṃ sarvonmādanikāṃ tathāsarvatrikhaṃḍamudrāṃ ca pūjeyadiri kanyakepūrvādi kramatobhyarcyā brāhmādyāḥ sarvamātaraḥetāḥ stritārī vījādyāḥ pādukāṃtāḥ prapūjayetyoginyaḥ padamābhāṣya padaṃ trailokya mohanaisāyudhāḥ padamābhāṣya padapaścāt saśaktayaḥvāraismapūjitāssaṃtu maṃtreṇānena suṃdaritāratritayamuccārya karaśuddhikaramatuṃuccārya tripurācakreśvarya vā śrīpadaṃ tataḥsarvaṃ saṃkṣobhiṇī mudrāṃ vījapūrvāṃ pradarśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalāsretha mahāpadme vakṣye pūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇupūjayet sakalānityāṃ kalā ṣoḍaśaśailajekāmākarṣiṇikā vudhyākarṣiṇī ca tataḥ paraṃsparśākarṣaṇikā rūpākarṣiṇī ca tataḥ paraṃcittākarṣaṇikā dhairyākarṣiṇī ca tataḥ paraṃvījākārṣeṇikācātmākarṣiṇī ca tataḥ paraṃetānityā kalāṃtāḥ syuḥ ṣoḍaśārādhi devatāḥetā guptapadāṃte ca yoginyaḥ padamuccaretcakre samudrā ityādi śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaretcakreśvaryai namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccārya tataḥ paraṃśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmītyuktvā cakreśvarīṃ yajetsarvaviṇīmudrāṃ vījapūrvaṃ pradarśayettāratritayamuccārya kavargādyaṣṭakaṃ tataḥanaṃga kusumānaṃga mekhalā ca tataḥ paraṃanaṃgarekhācānaṃgaveginī yamalocanedevī śrīpādukā muktvā pūjayāmīti yojayetsarvasaṃkṣobhaṇe cakre śiṣṭaṃ pūrvavaduccaretcakreśvaryai namaḥ paścātpunastripurasuṃdarīitthaṃ tṛtīyāvaraṇaiśvarī tripurasuṃdarīdevatā arthayet paścāt sarvasaubhāgyadāyakesarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī śaktissarvavidrāviṇī tathāsarvasammohinī sarvastaṃbhinī ca tataḥ paraṃsarvaraṃjanikā sarvonmādinī ca tataḥ śivesarvamaṃtramayīśakti sarvadvaṃdva kṣayaṃkarītritāraitāssaṃpradāya yogibhyaśca tataḥ paraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śiṣṭaṃ pūrvavaduccārya cakre saubhāgyakecayevāsinīti padaṃ cakreśvarye śabdaṃ namonvitaṃcakreśvarī padaṃ paścādvasuvarṇaṃ samuccaretsarvārthasādhake cakre devatārcā pravakṣyetasarvapriyaṃkarī devī sarvamaṃgalakāriṇīsarvamṛtyupraśamanī sarvavighnanivāriṇīṇakārādi phakārāṃtā etā devīssamarcayetśrīpādukā pūjayāmītyuktvā cakreśvarī yajetsarvarakṣākare cakre devatā pūjayedathasarvajñānmayī devī sarvavyādhi vināśinīsarvānaṃdamayī devī sarvarakṣā svarūpiṇītretāryātāni garbhādya yoginyaḥ padamapyathasamaṣṭi pūjā kṛtvātha sādhya siddhāsanātparaṃuccārya tripuret yuktvā mālinī padamapyathauccārya pūjayeccakrarājñī tripuramālinīsarvaṇyo hare cakre devatā arghayedathapūjāmaṃtra samāyuktaṃ namaḥ sthāne sayaccāyatcakre śeṣamathoccārya tritārādyāssamarcayetvīmathoyāryamudrāṃ kuryācca khecarīdrāṁ drīṁ klī ṣṇū mathoccāryasaḥ sarvapadamapyathaatha tretārinādyaṃte sarvasaṃmohanīya cavaśīkaraṇaśabdaṃ ca caturthī hṛdayānvitaṃnama uktvā caturdikṣu vāṇādīniti pūrayetmahāvajreśvarī paścānmahāśrībhagamālinīmahāśrīsuṃdarī paṃścāt khaṃḍatritayapūrvikāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yoginī navamī cakradevī ca navamī tathāatha vaidava cakrasthā lalitā paradevatāna maṃtra devatā bhedo vidye tatra samapriyesarvasiddhipradecakre śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaretuccārya tripurāvāṃ cakraiśvaryai nama uccaretśrīpākā pūjayāmītyuktvā cakreśvarīṃ yajetvaidaṃvetha mahācakre sāmrājī saṃvidaṃ yajetsuṃdari śrīmahāśabdaṃ tataśca parameśvarīuktvābhyacyotratāryaiṣā parāpara padaṃ tataḥcakre samudrā śabdaṃ ca sa siddhissāyudhā padaṃpadaṃ sadyarivārā sarvopacārairataḥ paraṃuktvātha śrīmahāśabdaṃ tripureti padātparaṃuktvātha śrīmahāśabdaṃ tripuretyatha suṃdarīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmītyarcayesaradevatāṃdhūpaṃ dīpanivedyātha navamudrāḥ pradarśayettarpayitvātha naivedya bhagavatyai samarpayethastā prakṣālane datvā tāṃvūlaṃ ca nivedayetyoniṃ dhyātvā **dhenaṃ ciṃtayettaradhomasyaṃjapet saubhāgya hṛdayaṃ bhogamokṣa phalapradaṃkalāpaṃcadaśārabdhaṃ namanīyaṃ paraṃ mahaḥaśeṣa viśvamedātmā pūrṇahṛtātmakaṃ śivaṃekasmaimahatye tasmai namassakala cakṣuṣenānāvidha mahākārasānu bhavakāraṇaṃtattadrūpeṇayābhātitāṃ śrayehaṃvidho kalāṃyā tanustenaḍit prakhyātāṃ bhajebhavaśālinīṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāpnoti pitṛbhiḥ sākaṃ nārāyaṇasasākṛtiḥnityasaṃpūjito brahmapade saramate dhruvaṃbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ samarpyārtha svācāryāya viśeṣataḥśākarūpa ghṛtādīniyodadyādguravenvahaṃannaṃ niveditaṃ viṣṇorhaviḥ śeṣeṇa saṃyutaṃbhuktvā sakṛtaiḥ pāpaistatkṣaṇādevamucyatepaṃcagrāsaṃmahāmaunaṃ prāṇādyāpyāyanaṃ yataḥnoparaktaṃ navāristhaṃ na nagnāṃ ca parastriyaṃnoccāsane ca nivasennaśamyāyāṃ guroḥ svapetdivāpādukamāruhya na codgrāma madhyamaipradāṃ puṃsāṃ divāpāpapradāṃ puṃsāṃ tadyoniṃ na nirīkṣapetupatiṣṭhedyathānyāyaṃ samyagā campakpārthivaanyatra sūtakāśau ca vibhramāturabhītitaḥprāyaścitāyate bhūmāvapi viprottayo nṛpaupatiṣṭhennaraḥ saṃdhyāya svayaṃścadināṃtyajāṃvrajamtite durātmānastāmisraṃ narakaṃ dhruvaṃavaśyaṃ muktimāpnoti daśapūrvairdaśatparaiḥjñānaṃ ca vimalīkurvannabhyāsenanuyācayetanāśramī na tiṣṭhetakṣaṇamekamapi kvacitcatvāra āśramā ete dvijānāmavanīpateputreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya kalatrasahitopi vāhutvā sāyaṃ tathā prātaḥ kṛtvā cāṃdrāyaṇādikaṃdevatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṛṇāṃ tṛptimācaransmarannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ padaṃ viṣṇoravāpnuyātviśeṣaṇa sadācārya śuśrūṣāmeva saṃtataṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ājñāyāṃ caṃdrasaṃkāśaṃ mahasta ca maheśvaribhavāni bhavaśītyaitvāṃ bhāvayāmya mṛteśvariityaṣva ṣaṣṭiṃ deveśi bhātitvapi cidātmaniuśrīlayasimātastva prakāśa vapuṣitvapiprakāśavapuṣastva ca tatsarvaṃ nātiricyatevāraṃvāraṃtvayā devi rūpādi madhusevyateyogīnāṃ prīṣayatvāryatva pūjārthaṃ hi sarvadāsamārādhana pūrvarthaṃ smṛtaṃ sakalakāmadaṃsaubhāgya hṛdayaṃ japtvā vāmabhāge tataḥ paraṃvāgmarva paścādvayakāṃte tataḥ paraṃtatra pātraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya praṇavaṃ bhuvaneśvarī* vahni bhāminī mityaṃ triruccārya tataḥ paraṃmūlavidyāṃ samuccārya tāratritayamapyathaārātrikamidaṃ dīpaṃ gṛhāṇā mama siddhayedatvā puṣpāṃjaliṃ samyak tridhā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃśrīvidyābhyarcya gaṃdhādyaistāṃvūlādyaissuvāsinīkṣamasveti śriyaṃ devīmātmanyudvāsanettataḥśriyamaṣṭaguṇāṃ prāpya brahmarūpo bhavatyasauśravaṇādapi yasyasyussiddhayoṣṭāṇimādayaḥmāsapūjādhamā proktā pātakaudya vibhedinīṣaṇmāsamanvahaṃ bhaktyā cakrarājārcanā śubhaṃyaḥ kuryādvatsaranityāṃ navāvaraṇapūjanaṃvedaśāstrapurāṇādi vidyā api sudurlabhāḥdharmārtha kāmokṣāthi prakṣavārthā sudurlabhāḥādau maṃdirapūjāsyāllayāṃgāryā tataḥ paraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: layāṃgā pūjā kṛtvā vā satataṃ sādhakottamaḥarghayan sarvasaubhāgyasaṃpannassiddhimātravetvāhvahvā triśapte makātejayanyaṃ vadaśākṣarīāṇimādyaṣṭa siddhīnāṃ nāyako jagatītalecakrasihāsanaṃ devi deśe vā nagarepi vāsvagṛhe vā vane grāme jagatkṣobhaḥ prajāyatepipīlikādinyāyena dūrādāyāṃtiyoṣitaḥtaddarśanān mahādevi jāyaṃte sarvayoṣitaḥtasyāpi siddhirmahatī jāyate na cirādihadadāti sakalānarthānvatsaravrittayesmahisāṃgaṃ prapūjyate yatra dhanadhānyādi saṃkulādhiṣaṇādhiya sādṛśyaṃ vidyābhiścāsya sidhyatiputrapautrādi saṃpattiracirādasya sidhyatibhavatyasya na saṃdeho viśvāsaṃ kurubhāminivījagarbhamavījaṃ vā yena mityaṃ prapūjyatekiṃkarādavaniṣṭaṃti mūrtimatyo mama triyegajāśvaratha saṃyuktā paśubhṛtya gaṇānvitātiṣṭhatye vā valā lakṣmīrdaivatairapi durlabhāputrapautrābhivṛthyāsau kaśyapa pratimo bhavetrājāno rājamāścattadbhṛtyāḥ sacivā apinivasaṃti gṛhe yasya teṣāmapi naro gatāsvacchaṃdamaraṇaṃ tasya vaśyānāmapi jāyateśrapacānāgṛhaṃ vāpita uktaṃ vadarīvanaṃcakrarājārcanaṃ samya kurvannanvahamādarāthaima cakrārcanaṃ nityaṃ kṛtvā pratyahamādarāt
