sanskrit: maṃḍala dvitayādvarddhaṃ rājānaṃ nagaraṃ tu vāṣaṇmāsaṃ pūjayedyastu varṇa cakranāyakaṃbrahmaṣīnapi devaṣīnyatragānu surānapiśrīcakra manvahaṃ haimaṃ sāṃśaṃ varṇaṃ prapūjayanvaśīkaroti trailokyaṃ sa devā surarākṣasaṃraṃbhorvaśyādikā divyākṣarasopi manoharāvaśībhūtā bhavaṃtyasyadāsīvannātra saṃśayaḥsarvavidyādhipatyaṃ ca jarāmṛtyu nivartanaṃmuktāratna samṛddhiśca śreyo vṛddhirdine dineatha vakṣye maheśāni śrīvidyāpūjanaṃ mahatbrahmapuṣpairmaheśāni sāṃgaṃ śrīcakramanvahaṃvimukto mahatīṃ lakṣmī dhanadhānyādi saṃkulāṃjapāpuṣpaissamabhyarcya śrīkraṃsāṃgamanvahaṃvimukto nātra saṃdeho dhanavāna jāyate vudhaḥupapātakasaṃghāṃśca māsamātreṇa nāśayetkaravīrai samabhyarcya śrīcakraṃ sāṃgamanvahaṃvidhayājīva saṃkāśodhanena dhanadopamaḥśatapatrairmanoramyairmāsamadhaṃ samarcayansaubhāgyamatulaṃ prāpya śriyaṃ prāpnotya caṃcalāṃmāsamātreṇa muktosau mahāpāpopapātakaiḥadhiyassarvavidyānāṃ bhūtvā kāma samaprabhaḥvaṃdhūka kusumairnityaṃ māsamātraṃ samarjayanvilvapatraissamabhyarcya māsamātraṃ niraṃtaraṃvilvapatraiśca jalajasahitaiḥ paripūjyanāpuṣpaṃ mahṛdārogyaṃ samṛddhiṃ ca mahattarāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mallikā kusumaiścakrarājamabhyarcyasādaraṃsaṃprāpya vipulā lakṣmīṃ prāpnotyaṃte paraṃ padaṃśaitotvalairvā miśraiśca pratyahaṃ cakramarcayanmāsādvardhamavāpnoti śriyaṃ vidyāṃ ca durlabhāṃcakrarājaṃ samābhyarcya māsaṃ sāṃgaṃ prasannadhīḥtejasā ravisaṃkāśo bhūtvā pātaka varjitaḥjaṃvūpravālairabhyarcya cakrarājaṃ dine dineavalāṃ śriya māsādya putrapautra sakhānvitaḥśamī dūrvāṃ kurairvāpi cakrarājaṃ samarcayansaubhāgyamatulaṃ prāpya śriyamā protya caṃcalāṃvimuktaḥ sakalaiḥ pāpairlabhate kṣayasaṃpadaḥcakrarājaṃ samabhyarcya māsamekaṃ prasannadhīḥsugaṃdhi kusumairnityaṃ pallavairvā sugaṃdhibhiḥsamasta pāparāśibhyo vimuktaḥ śriyamakṣayaṃratnapūjāvidhānaṃ ca kathayāmita vā nayenānāpuṣpaissugaṃdhaiśca karpūrakṣoda caṃdanaiḥdāsabhūtā karotyeva mahārogāṃścānāśāyetmuktāralaiśca racayet svarṇa puṣpāṇi suṃdariekaviṃśati rātreṇa paśya bhūyāna saṃśayaḥpravālaghaṭitaiḥ svarṇapuṣpaiḥ śrīcakramarcayanvaśyā bhavaṃti duṣṭāśca bhūpālā nātra saṃśayaḥvināśayati śakraṃśca vivudhānvaśamānayetkusumaiḥ pūjayeccakraṃ trisaptāhāt sureśvarividyayā jīva sadṛśo bhavatyatra na saṃśayaḥekaviṃśati rātreṇayorcayeccakranāyakaiṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaśīkaroti trailokyaṃ sa devāsuramānavaṃtrailokyaṃ staṃbhayannyeva trisamādānna saṃśayaḥdāsībhūtāstaruropāpināryo yauvanagarvitāḥsaptāhādvairiṇo vaśyā rājānopi na saṃśayaḥvaiḍūryaghaṭitaiḥ svarṇapuṣpaiścakraṃ samarcayansarvevaśyā bhavaṃtyeva pāpaudyaiśca vimucyatenirmālya bhūtaiḥ kusumairucchiṣṭhaiḥ parameśvaritadā devāsuranarāḥ pannagā rākṣasā apijanmakoṭi kṛtaiyā pairapi māsādvinucyatedaśāśvamaṃdhajatitaṃ phalamāpnonmanuttamaṃtairiva puṣpaiḥ pūjādi kartavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥtatra tatra pradātavyaṃ na dātavyaṃ yathecchayokoṭijanmakṛtaiḥ pāpairapi māsādimucyatesugaṃdhi puṣpayuktairvāsujaṃ kṛpallavaistuvāḥcakrarāja samābhyarcya nimuktassarvapātakaiḥsaṃprāpya śāśvatā puṣpaṃ putrapautrevatīṃ śriyaṃkārtike mārgaśīṣe vā māghe vā phālgunepi vāsaṃprārthya vahudhācāryaṃ śrīcakraṃ sarvasiddhidaṃpūjitaṃ yena sauvarṇa śrīcakraṃ sarvasiddhidaṃtadeva meruśikharaṃ kailāsasthāna mucyateyasmindine sau gṛhṇāti svācārya karayaṃkajātācāryapatnyai śrīvudhyā dadyādābharaṇa śubhaṃyathāśaktatā samabhyarcya svācāryamapi bhūṣaṇaiḥtaṃ pālayaṃti sutavadyoginyo mātaropi capadmahastāḥ subhūṣaṇāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arcayitvā śaṃkhapadmaunidhī ca dhṛta cāmaraupaścādbhāge svarṇaṃ daṃḍayuta chatradharaṃ yajetarkamiṃduṃkujaṃ saimyaṃ jīvabhārgavamapyathaarcayeddimājān dikṣu caturdaja vibhūṣitānpuṣpadaṃtaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ supratīkamiti kramātbrahmaṇa mūrdhvādigbhāgeyattedviṣṇumadhopi caitthamāvaraṇopetāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ haripriyāṃsaṃprāpnoti mahadbhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥdatvā siṃhāsanādīni samabhyarcyātha vidyayāśrīdharaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ vaikuṃṭhaṃ viśvarūpakaṃpatramūleṣu saṃpūjya dalamadhye tataḥ paraṃtadannetha ca yedvārṇān mahālakṣmyāḥ kramādamūnpoṣaṃ calaṃ ca tejaśca maheṃdrādidigīśvarānanena vidhinarevī mahālakṣmī yajaṃtiyeyena kenāpi vidhinā pratyahaṃ sādhakottamaḥbhūtvā sakalavidyāmā māśrayo durlabhānapiathavānyanmahadbhuptamarcanaṃ śṛṇu vallabhesamastavedataṃtreṣu guptā tatvārthavedibhiḥtāṃtrivāraṃ sayuccārya lakṣmīmetāṃ samuccaranśrīpatī samāvāhya dvādaśākṣaraviyayākeśavādi caturviśannāmabhiḥ sādaraṃ vibhuṃsamabhyarcya mahālakṣmīvratya vidyāmataḥ paraṃuccārya pūjayitvātha datvā naivedyamādarātjaśvāmedhaśa tasyāsau pratyahaṃ phalamaśruteprāpnoti ca mahadbhāgyamāyurārogyamakṣayaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: avāpya śāśvataṃ dhāma vratyaṃtena saṃśayaḥprakāśiteyaṃ kalyāṇi na kutrāpi prakāśayaaṣṭāviṃśākṣarī vidyāmapi guptāṃ ca śailajerājyalakṣmī mahāvidyāṃ yojayatyanvahaśuciḥsāṃga dakṣiṇayā bhuktaṃ pratyahaṃ bhavati dhruvaṃkṛtaṃ tena na saṃdeho bhū prādakṣiṇyamapyathaśrīpīṭhamathavābhyarcya pratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ śuciḥsmṛtvā prasannalakṣmīṃ ca śālāgrāma śilānvitesamabhyarcya viśuddhātmā pratyahaṃ sādhakottamaḥaṣṭāviṃśatidhā smṛtvā vidyāṃ śrīhṛdayābhidhāṃmahādāna sahasrasyadājimedhaśa tasyaphalaṃ prāpya viśuddhātvā dhanadena samaḥ priyākaśya yena samobhūtvā kāṃtyā kaṃdarpasannibhaḥsvacchaṃdamaraṇo bhūtvā kulasāhatprasaṃyuta*satra lakṣmīvidyāyā māhātmyamadyanāsanaṃyatra tiṣṭhati sā lakṣmīstatraiva satataṃ sukhaṃnityaṃ dharmābhivṛddhiśca tasmāllakṣmī sadārcayetśreyaskaramihāmutra kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasikulasāhasrasahito labhate parame padaṃyasya vijñānataḥ sākṣātkartāhartā bhavet svaryapūjyate tatra sakataṃvaśī kuryānna saṃśayaḥpoṣitassakalāvaśyā jvalatkāmāgnipīḍitātaddarśanātra saṃdeho jāyaṃte sarvayoṣitaḥjapedavaśyaṃ śreyothī śrīvidyāṃ viśvamātṛkāṃsarvasiddhipradā nityaṃ sarvarājavaśaṃkarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudrākṣa mālikā mokṣa sarvakāma samṛddhidāmohinī sarvajagatāṃ sarvasaṃpat samṛddhidāputrajīvakamālātu vidyālakṣmīpradāsatāṃraktacaṃdanamālā tu sarvabhogamadāmatāakṣamālāṃ samabhyarcya ca senānulepitāṃyoṣito bhrāmayaṃtyeva mano yadi suniścalaṃpātālatala nāgeṃdra kanyakāḥ kṣobhayaṃtitaṃtadā lakṣatrayaṃ kuryāt sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥabhimānena sauṃdarya saubhāgyamadasaṃyutāḥjaptena kṣatrayaṃ sadyo mahāpāpaudya bhedanaṃitthaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥpūruṣā yośitovaśyāścarācaragatāḥ priyeatīvasuṃrarīramyāṃ tanmadhye pratimāṃ parāṃciṃtayedyāṃta tasmānu yojanānāṃ śatādapirājakanyātha vā patnī bhayalajjā vivarjitācakra madhyagato bhūtvā sādhakaściṃtayedyadisādhyamapya rūṇībhūtaṃ ciṃtayitvā japecchriyaṃsarvasauṃdarya subhagaḥ kāminī vallabho bhavetdāsabhūtā karotyeva naranārī nṛpādikāncakraṃ samarcayeyastu yasya nāma vidarbhitaṃcakra madhyagataṃ kurvannāma yasyāstu yoṣitaḥtadānate śīghraṃ yakṣiṇī rājakanyakāṃvidyādharī divyakanyāṣu kanyāṃ ripu striyaṃkāmavāṇaprabhinnāṃtaḥ karaṇāṃ divyasuṃdarīsaṃkṣobhayati bhūloka pātāla jaṭāyoṣitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ devi caṃdanaṃmaranet sudhīḥjagattrayaṃ vaśīkayīnnaranārī kulānvitaṃdugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ ruṇamagnaṃ vastraṃ karpūramapyathasavaśyo jāyate devi nātra kāyā vivāraṇāākarṣaṇamidaṃ proktaṃ niścitaṃ lokamohanaṃcāruthaṃ gāraveṣāḍhyāṃ savarlikāraka śobhitāṃtadvāla kaṃṭhahṛnnābhi janmamaṃḍalayoṣitāṃsarvasaṃdhiṣu dehasya madanākṣaramālikhettadāśābhi mukho bhūtvā svayaṃ devīsvarūpavānniyojya dahanāṃgāre caṃdrasūryakalātmakeananya mānasāṃ premabhrāmyamāṇāṃ tadātmanāmātṛkāṃ vilikheccakre vāhyasassakalāṃ priyetaddhārayedgaledakṣakoravāmetha vā priyetathaiva mātṛkāyuktamanvahaṃ cakramarcayananena vidhinā devirocanāgara kuṃkumaiḥvidarbhitaṃ tvanāmnāpi yasminkasminnapi sthitaṃvaśīkuryān maheśāni pādākrāṃtaṃ na saṃśayaḥekanekamavaṣṭabhya sādhyanāmākṣā priyaṃhema madhyagataṃ kṛtvā śikhāyāṃ vā bhujadvayeeteṃdramapi deveśi dāsabhūtaṃ karoti hivyāghrāḥ kesariṇo duṣṭā api vaśyā bhavaṃti himadhye datuṣyathe vāpi caturdikṣu nidhāpayettathaiva sarvaduṣṭābhāṃpura sthānāṃ ca jāyetajvalaṃtī sarvarājeṃdramaṃḍitāṃ sāgarāṃ varāṃkaṭākṣākṣepamātreṇa tārpastasyavaśāḥ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dṛṣṭaivākarcayeddevi trailokyaṃ sa carācaraṃbhūtapretapiśācāśca jvarāṃścāturthikānapietatsiṃdūra subhagaṃ rātrau saṃpūjitaṃ priyeyadā dikṣu vidikṣvaivaṃ vidhiva kṛtamīśvaribhūrjapatre samālikhya rocanāgaru kuṃkumaiḥnāmnā vidarbhitaṃ samyaṅmāṃsamātraṃ prapūjayanathavādhārayet kaṃṭhe śikhāyāṃ vā bhujadvayearkakṣīreṇa sahitaṃ dhuttūrakarasaṃtathākastūrī camṃdrasaṃyuktamekīkṛtya tataḥ paraṃtasya vyāghari puṣpādhi jagata sarpa bhayādikaṃna jāyate mahādevi paramaṃtrābhicārataṃathavā madhyagāṃ devi trikoṇo bhayapārśvagāṃnidhāpayecca saptāhāṭṭāsavāt kiṃ karo bhavatpūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvāstaṃ bhayet paravāditaḥsaṃvādādari saṃghosya mūko bhavati tatkṣaṇātcakraṃ vilikhya deveśi mahānīla rasena canāma saṃyojya vidhivaddakṣiṇāśāmurayovudhaḥmāhiṣyasya purīṣasya cassamākṛṣyaśaulajekṣiptvāra nāla madhyeri vidveṣaṇakaraṃ bhavetlaṃvamāne tadākāśe śaktraccāṭana kāravāṃvilikhya dhārayanmaṃtrī sarvavarṇānvaśenayetanenaiva vidhānena sthāpayedvāri madhyargasaubhāgyaṃ jāyate tasya yānī yena na saṃśayaḥsamāhātho bhayet samyājvalamānāṃ viciṃtayetmahāpāpopapāpauḥ yairapi māsādvivarjitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vibhūte sannamusalevyaṃgorebhuktavartitesadānārāyaṇecittaṃ kṛtvācāryasya vaṃdanaṃśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāmavaśyaṃ prajapan śuciḥekavastra dhanodaṃḍa kamaṃḍalu dhanastathāadhomukhaḥ sadāstrīṣu vedāṃtaśrayaṇerajaḥācārya eva sarveṣāṃ gatirnānyo vidhīyateraviḥ somo mahendraśca pitāmātāguruḥsakhāācāryacaraṇāṃbhoje dvayameva satāṃgatiḥataḥ paraṃ mahīpāla kiṃbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasivedoditaḥ sadācāraḥ śruttastavamukhāṃvujātbrāhmaṃ samayamārabhya kiṃ vā kartavyamādarātraśmimālā prajapyeti tvayoktaṃ bhagavanmamaśṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasiutthāya samaye brāhme sāvadhānamanādvijaḥpraṇavaṃ citkalāvījamuccāryādau samāhitaḥrūpācāryapadaṃ paścāchrī pūrvācārya nāma caācāryapādukāvidyāguptatarāśubhāmahāpātakaṃ saṃhartrīvidyānāṃ siddhidāyinīchaṃdogāyatramityaktamācāryo bhagavanmayaḥācāryakaruṇāsiddhai viniyoga udāhṛtaḥtadabhidhānapūrvaṃ guruṃkaruṇāpūrṇanetrāṃtaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajaṃśuklavastraparidhānaṃ divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃdātāraṃ sarvavidyānāṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalaṃdhyātvetthaṃ samaye brāhme japedācāryapādukāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃprāpya dīrghamāyuṣyaṃ śriyaṃ cāṣṭaguṇānvitāṃputrapautrādi saṃpattisahito divyabhogavānrātritaṃ cakramabhyarcya rājyalakṣmīmacaṃcalāṃputrapautra samṛddhiṃ ca saṃprāpyāṃ ca paraṃ padaṃtāmracakraṃ samabhyarcya vimuktaḥ sarvapātakaiḥmukteha sakalānbhogānaṃte brahmapadaṃ labhetśreyo rāśimiha prāpya dhanadena samaśriyācirāyurvipulā bhogānbhuktāṃte muktimāpnuyātpītadravyaissamabhyarcyastaṃbhayet sarvavādinaḥpūjayanvidhivadvidvān sarvalokaṃ vaśaṃ nayetsaṃpūjya vidhivadvidvān yoṣitāṃ vallabho bhavetyasya nāmāṃkitaṃ tasya maṃtrahāniḥ prajāyetavidveṣaṇavyādhi śatrūccāṭanakārakaṃlikhitaṃ pūjitaṃ nityaṃ mahāsiddhimadaṃ smṛtaṃsarvavaśyakaraṃ devi bhavatyatra na saṃśayaḥtailasthaṃ cakrarājaṃ tu śatruviddeṣakārakaṃyadaikāṃte ca dhurmārge siṃdūra satasā likhetgirāvekatarau tadvadavayan cakrarājakaṃśmaśani pūjayeccakraṃ mahābhūta dine vudhaḥlabhate sadya evāsau cuṭikāṃ janapādukāḥmahāvivarasiddhiṃ ca yakṣiṇī siddhimapyathamahābhūta dine bhaumavārayukteyamānvitejaptvā ca triśataṃ paścāsādyaṃ saṃdhyāmupāsya caśrīcakraṃ sāgamudvṛtya patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā gāyatryā purataḥ śuciḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navyavaraṇadevīnāṃ sakṛdevaghṛta harethutvā śrīvidyayā vahnau catuḥśrīmanubhistataḥjapādibhistato hutvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇāhutiṃsāṣṭāṃga daṃḍavannatvā vāso laṃkāraṇādibhiḥsarvasvamarpayeddravyamācārya caraṇadvayaḥsamarpyacāryapatnyai ca dadyādākalpasaṃcayaṃkhaḍgaṃ ca pādukā yugmadivyāṃ janamanuttamaṃkehasiddhi manuprāpya vā siddhiṃ mahatīmapipaṃcaviṃśati varṣausau bhūtvā kaṃdarpasannibhaḥkrīḍāte divyakanyābhirbhuṃjanbhogānyathepsitānśrīcakrasadṛśaṃ pūjyaṃ nāsti lokatrayepi cavījatrayasya kathayasādhanaṃ me jagatpateyettānuṣṭhitamātreṇa bhavādhauta nimajjatisthūla sūkṣmavibhāgena trailokyetyattimātṛkātasyāṃ pariṇatāyāṃ tu na ka"cit paradṛṣyateśaktaḥ syāt parameśāni śaktiyukto yadā bhavetjñātenāpirmahaśani karmaśarma na kiṃcanapraviśya paramāgaṃtu sūkṣmākāra svarūpiṇīvāmā śivā tathā jyeṣṭhā śṛṃgāṭikāratāṃgatāevaṃ sā jparamāśaktirekaiva parameśvarījñānaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktiriricchāśaktitmikā priyeyadollasati śṛṃgāṭa pīṭhāt kuṭilarūpiṇītadudbhavāmṛtā svāda paramānaṃdanaṃditānirlakṣyaṃ nirguṇaṃ caiva kūlarūpa vivarjitaṃtena mārgeṇa saṃtuṣṭā punare kākinī satī

sanskrit: mahātīṃ siddhimāsādya bhavatyevedaṃ sannibhaḥācāryānujñayāvaṇa sāhasraṃ śriyamiṣṭadāṃdadhi madhvājya sahitodanena yanasodbhavaiḥsahasraṃ vidhayā hutvā raśmi vidyāpurassaraṃcakrarājaṃ samabhyarcya sāṃgāvaraṇamanvahaṃguḍodakena dadhyannaiḥ phalairapi manoharaiḥśrīcakra sannidhau paścādācāryaṃ daṃḍavannasetalaṃkārairalaṃkṛtya vāso yugamaṃ samarpya casannidhau paścādādhāryaṃ daṃḍavannasetalaṃkārairalaṃ kṛtya vāso yugmaṃ samarpya capaṃcaniṣkamitaṃ vāpi pradadyād dakṣiṇādhanaṃvāsopi ca samarpyāthā taccheṣaṃ bhojayedvratīmahadā puṣpamārogyaṃ śrīrapyaṣṭa guṇānvitākaṃdarpa samasaubhāgyaṃ vidyā vahuvidhāpi casiddhiṃ vinā na kāsyānāṃ siddhiruktā manīṣibhiḥyena kenāśupāyena pūrṇānugrahato guroḥdhyātvātha vā cakrarājamanaḥ pūjā samanvitaṃnigadeno pāṃśunā vāmana sā vā japet sadāavyaktataḥ sphurānane upāṃśuḥ parikīrtitaḥjihvāyā japyate yena sopi mānasa ucyateupāṃśu smaraṇenai tulyaṃ bhavati śailajemānasoccāraṇe naiva tulyamekena suṃdarijapyeta sa japaḥ prokto mānaso kṣaya siddhidaḥlakṣamātraṃ japedyastu cakrarājaṃ samarcayanvārdhake yauvane vālye jāgrat svapnasuṣuptiṣu

sanskrit: upapātaka saṃyaiśca mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥbrahmahatyā surāyā nasvarṇasteyādikairapimucyate nātra saṃdeha koṭi janmakṛtairapijaptvā lakṣatrayaṃ maṃtrī hayamedha sahasrajaṃcaturlakṣaṃ japedyastu yakrarājaṃ samarcayanjaḍopi sarvavidyā api bhāṃtyasya cakratahḥpaṃcalakṣaṃ japedyastu niyataḥ śriyamiṣṭadāṃbhūtvā dhanadasaṃkāśaḥ śriyā bhavati saṃtataḥajaraṇo bhūtvā prāpnotyā puṣpamakṣayolakṣa ṣaṭkaṃ japedyastu cakrarājaṃ samarcayansarvajñatva manuprāpya cirā puṣpamahattaraṃprāpnoti mahadaiśvaryaṃ muktāratnādi saṃkulaṃsaptalakṣaṃ japedyastu śriyo vidyāṃ phalapradāṃsaubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labdhvā dhanadhānyādi saṃkulāṃaṣṭalakṣaṃ japedyastu mahātripurasuṃdarīsaṃprāpya kālamṛtyu ca vinirjityā jarāmaraḥciṃtāmaṇigaṇākīrṇe kāmadhenu samanvitekrīḍate divyakanyābhiḥ kaṃdarpa iva suṃdaraḥadhiyassarvasiddhānāṃ bhūtvā viṃśati vārṣikaḥaṇimādi guśvaṇaiśvaryaṃ labdhā khecaratāmapivarṇalakṣaṃ japedyastu śriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣarīṃsarvajñaḥ subhago vāgmī sarvavidyāsu pāragapaṃcaviṃśati varṣaśca śriyamaṣṭa guṇānvitāṃpūjiṭato yogamaṣṭāṃgaṃ labdhvā khecaratāmapiparakāyaṃ praviśati jāyate divyabhogavān

sanskrit: mukhasya pārśvayoḥ pāṇīdvayaṃ jānī hi pārvatitataḥ pādadvayaṃ viddhi tadaṃte pucchamīritaṃkarasthāne mahākleśaḥ sarvakārya vināśakṛtpucchetu dhanahāniśca jāyate nānyathā priyedīpasthānaṃ purekṣetre grāmepi viṣayepi vākuryādanaṃta phaladaṃ viddhi parvata kanyakekāmanāhauma karmāṇi vakṣyāmi phaladānyathacaitramāse pūrṇimāyāṃ sahasra tritayaṃ hunetbhavatyeva varārohe mahāvāgmī mahākaviḥsahasra tritayaṃ hutvā gaukṣīra trimadhusutaiḥvasorājakule vāpi viladvāre vanepi vāsaubhāgyena vilāsena sāmarthyenāpi suvratesaṃmohayati bhūpānāṃ kanyā api manoharāḥlaghukolasamaṃ hutvā sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃcaṃpakaiḥ pāṭalairhutvā yata trimadhumiśritaiḥdhanadhānyā kulāṃ muktāralarāśi samākulāṃśrīkhaṃḍaṃ guguluṃ caṃdranāgaraṃ juhuyā yadirājanājeṃdradevānāṃpuraṃ *rvaśamānayetghṛta trimadhu sasmiśralākṣāṃ hutvā sahasraśaḥmabhutritathadvometa sahasra tritayaṃ śuciḥkṣīraṃ madhu ca dadhyājyaṃ pṛthagdyutvā sahasraśaḥkṣīreṇa madhutā hutvā pratyekaṃ trisahasrakaṃmahadāpuṣpamāpnoti sarvādhinyādhikartitaḥsaubhāgyaṃ mahadā sādya dhanamakṣayamāpnuyātmahatīṃ śriyamāsādya vairiṇastaṃbhayatyasau

sanskrit: vimuktassarvarogaiśca svacchaṃdamaraṇo bhavettrisahasraṃ viśuddhātmā dvitīya ivayakṣarāṭsamāhaṃ sarvabhūyālā dāsabhūtā bhavati hiayaṃ dhanayavāpnoti vīchitaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥhutvā samāhamātreṇa krūrā bhūpanayopi caśvetātpalai strimadhvaktaiṃ śatādhika sahasrakaṃsaṃprāpya sarvavidyānāṃ pārago bhavati dhruvaṃhutvā samāhamātreṇa kāṃtiṃ kaṃdarpa sannibhāṃkahlāra havanānmaṃtrī triśatādhika sahasrakaṃmānuluṃga phalairhutvā sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃnāraṃga phalahomena sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃkuṣmāṃḍa phalahomena sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃmānuluṃgaphalairhutvā sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃnāraṃgaphalahomena sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃkūṣmāṃḍaphalahomena sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃdrākṣā phalaistrimadhvaktaissahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃkadalīphala homena lakṣamātreṇa bhūbhujaḥkharjūraphalaho na lakṣamātreṇabhūjaḥrikelayūlairhutvā lakṣaṃ trimadhumiśritaiḥpakvānna pūla homena lakṣamātreṇa suṃdaripanasasya phalai vījarahitai strimadhuplutaiḥvaśīkaroti bhūyālan kiṃkarā iva saṃtataṃtriśatādhika sāhasraṃ pakṣamekaṃ niraṃtaraṃguggulasya ca hāmena ṣaṭhastreṇa suṃdarikuṃkumadyata saṃyuktaṃ madhu tritayamiśritaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaśīkaroti trailokyaṃ yāvajīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥsahasratritayaṃ hutvā vairiṇo śamānayetstriyo vaśyā bhavaṃtyasya puruṣā api saṃtatatriśatādhika sāhasraṃdita tritayamīśvarivācaspati saptaḥ sākṣādvidyayehāpi jāyateekaṃ na divase naiva vaśyāḥ sphurrājamaṃtriṇaḥsarvapāpa nivṛttiḥ syāddroga śāṃtiśca jāyetatriśatādhika sāhasraṃ saptāha sādhakottamaḥghṛta trimadhusaṃmiśra pāyasaṃ juhuyādyaditrailokyaṃ svavaśīkṛtya śriyamaṣṭaguṇānvitāṃnānāvidhānnā homena māsi māsi śatrayaṃsopaskaraiśca kaṭukaissahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃapanetu maśakyaiśca matrauṣadhassāyanaiḥjapāpuṣpaistrimadhuktaissaptāhaṃ juhuyādyadisrvavidyānidhirbhūtvā kāmavatsuṃdaro bhavetsaubhāgyaṃ mahadāsāpavṛddhoṣi taruṇāyatejaṃbūphalaistrimadhvaktaistrisahasraṃ śatādhikaṃdāsībhūtā bhavatyeva rājakanyā api dhruvaṃsaptāhārdetya kanyāśca dāsībhūtā bhavaṃti hitriśatādhika sāhasraṃ rājyalakṣmīrmahīyasīikṣu khaṃḍaiścaturaha śatādhika sahasrakaṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityamaṣṭāviṃśatidhāpivāvidyāsiddhimavāpnoti śreyosi suvahūnyapisamastābhīṣṭa saṃsiddhiṃ prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥpuṣpaṃ magraṃ juhuyādūtyailaṃ kamalaṃ tu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śatasaṃkhyāstilā proktāstaṃḍulāśca tathaiva hiculukārddhamatakṣīramaṃtravādarasammitaṃmanaḥ prītikaraiḥ khaṃḍairjuhuyān manalocanenārikelaṃ catuḥkhaṃḍamuktaṃ śāstreṣu suṃdāridrākṣāphalaṃ samagrasyāṃ nāraṃgaṃ ca dvidhā smṛtaṃguṃjā samaṃ ca karpūraṃ kastūrī kuṃkumaṃ tathālākṣā guggula saṃkhyāśyādyadvastu sumanoharaṃetadā huti mānaṃte kathitaṃ sarvavighnahṛtśriyaṃ saṃtoṣayennityaṃ japahomārcanādibhiḥādau kuṃḍaṃ samutpādya caturasraṃ sulakṣaṇaṃsahasre hastamātraṃ syādvisahasre dvihastakaṃkoṭi homeṣṭa hastaṃ ca kṛtvā kuṃḍasya lakṣaṇaṃṣaṭkoṇaṃ staṃbhane proktaṃ māraṇe tadvadevahinānāsiddhikaraṃ proktaṃ padmakoṇaṃ maheśvarimāraṇe dakṣiṇa proktā paścimārvakṣyakarmaṇitathā muccāṭanaṃ syādvāyanve īśānye sarvasiddhidaṃkṛttikākarṣaṇe proktā maraṇī māraṇe tathāvidveṣe śatatārāsyādahi vundhyaṃ tu śāṃtidaṃvudhe ca staṃbhanaṃ kāryaṃ guruvāre ca pauṣṭikaṃrājavṛttasya samidho hottavyāḥ staṃbhane śivedāḍimī samidho home praśastā māraṇādikevidveṣe caiva hotavyā unmatta samidhastathāsarvakāryārthasiddhiśca sarvavighnanivāraṇaṃbhārgave vāsare vāpi navamyāṃ pūrṇimāsuvāpaṃcamavarṣamārabhya yāvadvādaśavatsaraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kanyakāḥ pūjitā yena trailokyaṃ tena pūjitaṃkanyakā iti saṃproktā yāvadvādaśavatsaraṃsuvāsinyopi saṃpūjyā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥsaiva lakṣmīrjajammātā saiva gaurī sarasvatīsaiva sākṣānmahālakṣmīdhiyā pūjyā vibhūvaṇaiḥdamapnāropaṇaṃ vakṣye sādhakānāṃ hitāya catapobhagāṃyamadannomaya śailasute yadāsaṃtuṣṭa manasā tābhyāṃ varodato mayāptiyetatsauramya samudbhūta saukhyamāsīt sulocanedamanena tuyo maṃtrī var'madhye sa pūjayetitisyai varodato mayaiva sukhaṃditeśrīśrīśapūjāniratairgaurīśaṃkara pūjakaiḥśrīcakrapūjānirataiḥ śālagrāmārcakairapimaheṃdrā yaṣṭā dikpāla pūjanā saktamānasaiḥvatsare vatsare vaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ damanārcanaṃcaitrādayastrayomāsāpakṣausitasitetarauaṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyā madhyāpi vāsvayamutyādyadamanaṃ samūlaṃ pūrvastu kāllarveyutaṃvāmataḥ sthāpayeddevi sarvatau bhadraje vujeśriyaṃ kāmamataḥ paraṃpūrvavījñānicoddhārya praremātmanamuccaretprītiṃ vade iti sthāne prīti maṃtroṣṭa varṇakaḥpūrvoktāyāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi siṃhāsanoparivadhvā stri śūlakuṃdrā ca bhrāmayeddamanopariprathame divase kuryādadhivāsanamuttamaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāle mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā yodhyā purābhidhekalaśānnavasaṃsthāpya hemaralādi pūritāndakṣiṇe maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā kuṃkumādyairvicipatritaṃtanmadhye pūjayet kāmaṃ taruṇaṃ cāruṇaprabhaṃratiprīti viśobhāḍhyaṃ paṃcavāṇa dhanurdharaṃpūrvokti manunā samyagarcayot siddhi hetavepadmatāṃvūlahaste ca raktavastra virājitevāmadakṣiṇayordhyātvā kāmasya tadanaṃtaraṃgauravarṇa vāmahaste sudhāpūrṇa ghaṭānvitaṃsāṃgaṃ kāmaṃ prapūjyātha mahātripurasuṃdarīsvarṇabhāra sahasraiśca divyasragvastrabhūṣaṇaiḥācārya pūjyate yatra tatkarma sa phalaṃ smṛtaṃguṇe bhāve tatputraṃ tatpatnīṃ vā samarpayetteṣāmabhāve tadbhātṛnatha vā saṃprapūjayetśrīvidyayā hunedājyamatha triśatamādarātitthaṃ kṛtvā narastyamyagdamanāropaṇa vrataṃkṛtvā sāṃgamavāpnoti phalaṃ nātra vicāraṇāanyathā madanāyaiva kṛtaṃ syādiri kanyakebhakṣayennekṣu khaṃḍāni na bhavet strīṣu niṣṭhuraḥnānṛtaṃ kasya ciddhayādviśeṣeṇa guroḥ śivedaridro vā dhanāḍhyo vā mūrkho ca paṃḍitopi vākimatra vahunoktena parameśvara macyutaṃbhaktimānnāja vidyāyāṃ lakṣmyādīnapi sanmanūnmāhātmyate tacchrī devyā sāgare culukāṃvuvatkiṃciduktaṃ mayā devi kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturlakṣmī sevyamānā śriyo vidyātvaparitāśrīdevīlalitā sarvajagatkāraṇārūpiṇīcaturlakṣmī sevyamānā sākṣātkāmadudyāsmṛtātriśaktiḥ sarvasāmrājyalakṣmīḥ paṃcaprakīrtitāḥśriyastrijagadaṃvāyā mūlavidyāgarīyasīekākṣarī mahāvidyāṃ lakṣmīmatha vadāmyahaṃviṃdunādayutaṃ lakṣmī vījame tadudāhṛtaṃsamasta saṃpat sukhadā vidhātrā pūjitā purālakṣmī vījametadudāhṛtaṃ mārādhya lokānāmādhiyatyaṃ prayedireśrīlakṣmīrdevatā proktā sarvasaṃyat samṛddhidādvitīyena tṛtīyena ṣasṭhenārṇena caimitiṣaḍaṃgāni nyasenmaṃtrī hacchiraśca śikhāṃ tataḥvaṣaḍhuṃ vauṣaḍaṃtaṃ ca puṭebhiryojayet kramātmadhye puṣpaṃ vinikṣipye pīṭhaśaktīḥ samarcayetvyuṣṭirutkṛṣṭi ṛddhaśca vasu dikṣu prapūjayetdhyāyettataḥ śriyaṃ ramyāṃ sarvadeva namaskṛtāṃāsiṃcya mānāmamṛtairmuktāratna dravairapiratnaudya vahu makuṭā śuddha saumāṃgarāgiṇīevaṃ dhyātvā yajeddevī padmayugmadharāṃ sadāāvāhanādi mudrāśca krameṇaiva pradarśayetiyaṃ tu viparītāsyāttadā vai sthāpanī bhavetaṃtaraṃguṣṭhamuṣṭibhyāṃ tatheyaṃ tannirodhanīaṃjaliṃ cārghyavat kṛtvā paramīkaraṇaṃ bhavetmadhyamānāmikā yugme sthāpayettu parasparaṃetāssādhāraṇamudrādarśayitvā japet priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agnīśāsura vāyavya madhyadikṣvaṃgapūjanaṃvibhīṣikā mālikā ca śāṃkarī vasumālikāiṃdrāgni yamarakṣorādvaruṇāni na saṃjñakānbrahmāviṣṇuśca lokeśāvūrddhādi kramato yajettapetyayasāsamyakkamalairājyatolitaiḥpalamāna suvarṇena racitaṃ kamalaṃ kṣubhaṃ śubhaṃcaturviṃśati sāhasramathavā sādhakottamaḥtrisaharaṃ hunedagnaupamairgavyājyatolitaiḥvilvapatrairghṛtaplutaiḥ triśattādhika sāhasraṃ juhuyāt saṃskṛtenalevatsarān mahatī lakṣmīṃ labhate vanasaṃkulāṃsahasrapaṃcakaṃ vāpi sahasra tritayaṃ tu vāacalāṃ mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ dhanavānyādi saṃkulāṃekākṣaramikāṃmimāṃ lakṣmī japannavahamādarātśromicchasiprasannalakṣmīvidyāyāḥ pārvatyai parameśvaraḥyadāha bhagavākto mahālakṣmīmanoḥ śubhaṃdevadeva namastestu maheśa karuṇādhidhemahālakṣmī mahāvidyāvidhānaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃsamyak pṛṣṭaṃ mahābhāge lokābhāmupakārakaṃpurā nārāyaṇe noktaṃ janakāya mahātmaneahamapyatra vakṣyāmi tubhyaṃ rājīvalocaneprasannalakṣmī māhātmyamadhunā kathayāmitesparśādyaṃ brahmapūrvaṃ ca mahīṃ rudra samanvitāṃvalānujaṃ tato vāyuṃ rudrasvara samanvitaṃmahālakṣmī padapaścāccaturthāyānvitaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣasiṃhāsaneśānī viṣṇunā pūjitā purāayodhyāpura vaikuṃṭha sarvasāmrājyanāyikāprasannaśrīritikhyātā vedavetāṃtavedibhiḥupāsakānāṃ viprāṇāṃ māheṃdra śrīphalapradāvedavedāṃgavedāṃta pūrvavāksiddhikāriṇīsarvatīrthamayī sarvapātakaudyavidyātinīyoginassatakathāśca vaśiṣṭāyā maharṣayaḥvasavoṣṭau mahābhāgāruhā ekāaśāpi caārādhyāṣṭa uṇaiśvaryamavāpyādyāpi pārvatialakāpurasāmrājyaṃ maheṃdrapurasaṃpadaṃalakāpurasāmrājyaṃ maheṃdrapurasaṃpadaṃ uyatātmanājñātu śaṃdhanyā mahālakṣmīrācāryānugrahaṃvinājapet sayoginī vṛṃdairbhakṣyate māsaṣaṭkataḥaṇimāṇi guṇaiśvaryaṃ muktāralaudyamakṣayaṃmattānanekāmātaṃgānvājinopi vahnūn paśūnsamṛddhiṃ mahatī labdhvā vaikuṃṭheva satiṃ labhetsāmrājyalakṣmīkāmena bhogamokṣārthinā sadāacalaṃ mahadaiśvaryaṃ mahāsiddhima caṃcalāṃdevāviyatyanirdraṇatiyaṃ hṛdayamena catejasvitvaṃ sa vitrā ca sucāśutvamathedunāagninā tāpaśaktitvamoṣadhīśatvamiṃdunālokaiśvaryarca saṃprāptamacalaṃ bhayavarjitaṃgaṇaiśvarya gaṇeśena naṃdinā śivatulyatāyatra yatra mahadbhāgyaṃ prāptaṃ devarṣisiḥ purāprasannalakṣmīmāhātmyaṃ brahmāpi jagatāṃpatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadā urvāsasaḥ śāpācchakropya naranāyakaḥtadanugrahataḥ prāpya mahālakṣmīmimāṃ śiveanuttamaṃ mahadbhāgyaṃ prāptavāna marādhipaḥtrayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ māvipatyamavānhayaratnaṃ manovegamuccaiḥ śravasamānivamānpakṣarākṣasarājatvaṃ prāpyālakāpurī śubhāṃprasannaśrīmahāvidyāṃ japtvā hutvā tataḥ paraṃalakāpurasāmrājyaṃ prāptvān girikanyakeprasannalakṣmīrvikhyātā samastāmīṣṭasiddhidāmūrkhāya lubdhāyā mahālakṣmīriti smṛtā prasanṛtavādinevedanidāparāyāpiyaṇa niṃdā parāya camaṃdabuddhiṃ jaḍaṃ mūrkhaṃ durācārarataṃ tathāśrutyuktācāra rahitaṃ śiṣyatve parivarjayetparadravya parastrīṣu parāṅmukhamataṃdritaṃśāṃtaṃ niṣkalmaṣaṃ śuddhaṃ haripūjā parāyaṇaṃdayādimāṃ mahālakṣmīvidyāṃ sakalasiddhidaṃāgatya brāhmaṇaṃ prāha prasannā śriyamiṣṭadāṃasūyakāyānṛjave jaḍāyānṛjavādinerakṣaṇī yātvāyā nitya madatvā pāpakāriṇetadā maheṃdrasadṛśaṃ padaṃ dāsyamite dvijatasmādeṣā mahālakṣmīnaṃ prakāśyāpi kutracitjapedimāṃ mahālakṣmīmācāryānugrahācchivesarvasve nāpi kartavyā bhogamokṣa phalāptayepūjyamācārya pādābja dvayameva dine dinecajyajetsvapi naraṃ patnīmātaraṃ ca sutānapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato bhārgavarāmasya vidyādāśarathestataḥvidyāthakalkirūpasya śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥsudarśanamahāvidyā samastabhayanāśinībhagavadraśmi mālepaṃ proktā sakalasiddhidāādau mayaiva kathita brahmaṇe parameṣṭinevakṣyate sarvadevānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sannidhauarddhāṃga śrīpatebhirvighāṣoḍaśārṇā taponidhevinā vasuṃdharā vidyāṃ japyate kaiścidapyathaḥvidyāmetāṃ vijānī hi saṃpūrṇāṃ raśmimālikāṃekaikasyāśca vidyāyāvarṇituṃ phalamuttamaṃraśmisrajamimāṃ vidyāṃ samastaphalasiddhidāṃācāryakaruṇāpūrṇā yasya viprasya jāyatevahusaṃvatsaraṃ vāpi svācāryaṃ karuṇānidhiṃraśmimālāpradaḥ svāmīraśmimālāpradaḥ pitāayameva sadācāryo vijñeyaḥ śāstravittamaiḥātharvaṇa mahāvedesārabhūtā manūttamāḥimāmātharvaṇīṃ vidyāmācāryaṃ bahuvārṣikaṃsaṃprāpya satataṃ brāhme samayeśaṃsitavrataḥprajñaptvā sarvavidyānāṃ puraścaryā phalaṃ labhetācāryakaruṇāpūrṇāḥ prajapedraśmimālikāṃsarvavedemayastasmādbhagavadraśmimālikāṃyena prajapyate nityaṃ bhagavadraśmimalikāsamastadevatā asya varadāḥ syurnasaṃśayaḥraśmimālā prajaptavyā paṃcadhā vā tridhāpi vāśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīvidyāmapinyāsa samanvitāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sevyamācārya pāābja dvayameva dine dinebrahmānaṃda rasāvāpti maṇimādi guṇāṃ śriyaṃetadeva paraśreya ena detadeva paraṃstapaḥayameva mahāyāga iyameva gatiḥ parāyojanānāṃ sahasraṃ vā gatvācāryaṃ dvijottamaṃprasannakamalāvidyāṃ tadanugrahato japetradyurdaśaratho rājā duṣṣaṃttobharatopi carājyalakṣmīmimāṃ japtvā saṃsevyācāryamādarātśvetadvīpādhi yatvaṃ vā suvarṇagirisaṃpadaṃbrahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā api trailokyanāyakāḥnāstu śaktirmahaṣīṇāmasyā māhātmyavarṇaneprasannalakṣmīvidyeyaṃ nimivaṃśa samudbhavaiḥprasannalakṣmistadvaṃśe janakasyā bhavat sutājanakā iti vikhyātā muktā jīvaṃta evateiyameva mahāvāṇī sāvitrī ca sarasvatīataḥ paraṃ samudbhūta purāṇaṃ ca mahattaraṃetat samādhikā vidyāna dṛṣṭā kutracicchrutārājyalakṣmī na labdhāste bhogasvargāyavargadāṃiyaṃ kalpalatā sākṣānmataḥ saṃkalpasiddhidāye siddhā munayopīha divyabhoga samanvitaḥvācaḥ padāni catvāri parākhyaṃ prathamaṃ padaṃjānāratīśvara evaitatsarvasvatyāḥ padatrayaṃvaidavarīnāmakaṃ paścāccaturthaṃ vāmadaṃ vibhuḥmaharṣayopi jānaṃti tapasā dagdha kilviṣāḥprasīddhameta devānna bhūtale girikanyake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pipīlikā sunāgeṣu sarveṣu ca mṛteṣu cavidyājālamidaṃ sarvaṃ nirgacchalyasya vaktrataḥadhikaṃ sadṛśaṃ vāpi vastu vidhātmakaṃ nāhiupāsya dharmaṃ ca na bhogamokṣāna vā purutkṛṣṭapadaṃ cardovaanuṣṭhānavidhiṃ samyag yatkatvā siddhimāpnuyātgāyatraṃ chaṃda ityuktaṃ samasta jagadaṃvikāmahālakṣmīrjaganmātādevatā kathitā śivehṛdevaśaktiruddiṣṭā viniyogaruvabhīṣṭadaḥśikhā prasīdate naiva kavacaṃ tribhirakṣaraiḥnetramastraṃ ca śeṣe vā śrīvījapuṭitaṃ pṛthakhareḥ kāṃtāṃ kāṃkṣita pārijātalatikāṃ vaṃde sarojananāṃputrāga pāṭalāśoka caṃpakairūpaśobhitaṃsamerumādhavī vilva devadārulavaṃgakaiḥmātuluṃgaiḥ karṇikāraiścaṃdanairvuṃjulairapisarvartu puṣṭyasahitairnamadbhiḥ suvirājitasugaṃdhibhiśca kahlāraiḥ phullaiḥ kuvalayairapitānmadhye puline rasme mahāsurasita śobhitecaturdvārayuta divyahemaprākāra śobhitaṃdivyaratna samāyukta kapāṭāṣṭaka śobhitaṃhemadaṃ uśilālavidvija paṃṅkti pariṣkṛtaṃdivyasāhasra saṃśobhidīptastaṃbha virājitaṃvicitrāṃśuka saṃvarddhakāṃcanairapi koṭiśaḥmālatīkaṃtakījātī ca yakotpalakesaraiḥdivyairanyaiḥ puṣpageṇeralaṃkṛta mahītalaṃcaṃdanaṇarukarpūrairāmoditadigaṃtaraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tanmaṃḍapasya madhyastha pārijātaṃ suradrumaṃtatrāsīnaṃ jagannāthaṃ kāla nīlāṃvuda prabhaṃpadmarāga mahāratna vajramāṇikyaviṃdubhiḥkirīṭa hārakeyūra kaṭakādi vibhūṣitaṃśobhitaṃ pārijātādi puṣpamālya virājitaṃśaṃkhacakrā bhayavaradharaṃ yogini ṣevitaṃprācīnā nāmapi girāgocaramanūpamaṃnārāyaṇaṃ purānaṃda satyacidvanamacyutaṃdāḍimī kusumaprakhyāṃ japāṃ puṣpa samaprabhāṃdṛśaṃ jannūpuraṃ saṃśobhipādayaṃ kaṇamaṃḍitāṃsthalā raviṃda pratima padābjayugaśobhitāvirājita padāṃbhojāṃ bhaktārti haraṇo ghṛtāṃtanu mādhyāṃ pṛthu śroṇī nimnanābhi samanvitāṃviśālorusthalāṃ rājatkaustubheta virājitāṃratnamuktāphaloyetta svarṇaciṃtākaśobhitāṃmuktāvalī samāyuktāmekāvalikhirājitīsvarṇakeyūrasahitāṃ valayāvaliśobhitāṃprathamābharaṇoyeta kaṃvugrīva virājitāṃsmitavaktrāṃ viśālākṣyaṃ pakvaviṃvaphalādharāṃvāṇī vilāsanilaparakta jihvāgraśobhitāṃtaptasauvarṇatāṭaṃkṛvālī yugalaśobhitākāmako daṃḍasaudarvanirjitabhrūtatāyugāṃjātī caṃpaka punnāga puṣpatālya vibhūṣitāṃnavamāṇikyasaṃvaddha kirīṭāvṛtamastakāṃvibhratīvaṃ supātraṃ ca muktāratnamayīṃ srajaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: akalaṃkaśarat pūrṇacaṃdraṃ viṃva samānanāṃvāṇī gaurīṃdrapatnyādi sevitāṃ pārśvayordvayoḥsuvarṇasrāviṇā mūrdhni śvetachatreṇa śobhitāṃśakrādi maulimāṇikya virājita padāṃvujāṃdevatāvṛṃda saṃsevyāṃ mahāsiddhaughavaṃditāṃtrailokyākarṣaṇakarīṃ trailokya hlādakāriṇīaṇimādi guṇādhārāṃ sarvasāmrājyasiddhidāṃdivyacaṃdanaliptāṃgī divyakanyā pariṣṭutāṃtrilocanī catuhasrī suprasannānanāṃvujāṃmahālakṣmīmahaṃ nitya bhajāmya khilasiddhidāṃyadvā mūlādhādi raṃdhrāṃtaṃ vālārkayuta sannibhāṃnirguṇāṃ saguṇāṃ vāpi mahālakṣmī haripriyāṃjaptvā nityaṃ viśuddhātmā saṃpadāṃ māśreyā bhavetmahālakṣmīṃ trayī rūpāṃ divyālaṃkāraśobhitāṃdhyātvā nārāyaṇadhiyādhyāyedācāryamacyutaṃsamastābhīṣṭa phaladā bhavatyusya haripriyāmahālakṣmīṃ vijānī himā kurudyātraṃ saṃśayaḥmahālakṣmīdhiyābhyarcyā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥācāryapatnīmabhyarcya bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥtāṭaṃkābharaṇa dvaṃdvavālī yugalamuttamaaṃgulīyaka mukhyāni divyānyā bharaṇāni cadatvā prāpnoti mahatī siddhiṃ cāmara durlabhāṃācāryapatnyai śrīvudhyā pradatvā kalpasaṃnayaṃācāryapatnyo vadvyaścet putriṇī tatrayā bhavetanyā ācāryapatnyaśca vijñeyā sā tṛptannibhāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahudūrasthitā vāpi māyāssannidhau śiveācāryaputrapatnyai vā pradadyāt sādhakottamaḥācāryapatnīmabhyarcya purato bhūṣaṇādibhiḥitthaṃ dhyātvā mahālakṣmīṃ vidyāṃ śrīhṛdayābhidhāṃtṛśataṃ vā japaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ hutvā dine dinesamasta duritaudyāstena spṛśaṃti kadācanatadgrahe paśuvṛddhiḥ syāt vanavṛddhirdine dinemuktā ratnaudya saṃkīrṇā dhanadhānya samākulāacalā tadvahe lakṣmīstiṣṭhatyā caṃdratārakaṃśreyo rāśi samākīrṇā āyurārogya saṃyutāḥsa yatra vasane devi kṣetreyā pālayepi vāihāmutrāpi lakṣmī vā trirguṇopi guṇānvitāḥtadvaṃśyāvāmupi śive bhavenmuktissanātanīsarvaduḥkhaharaṃ dhanyaṃ pūjanaṃ cātha vakṣyateyatkṛtvā maṃda bhāgyamibhāgya vā tihajāyateācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja dvitayaṃ sarvasiddhidaḥācāryapādukā vidyāṃ daśadvādaśadhāpi vārātritaṃ śatitaṃ vā svacakṣurbhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā natvā ca sādaraṃācāryavadanāṃ dṛṣṭvā pūrvamācārya pādayoḥsnātvā saṃdhyāmupāsyātha prajaptvā vedamātaraṃyathā śaktyā prajaptvātha vidyāṃ śrīharayābhidhāṃprasannalakṣmīstotreṇa stutvā śrīhṛdayena vāprasannalakṣmī hṛdayaṃ koratrāṣṭakamudīritaṃārtharvaṇa mahadguhyaṃ lakṣmī hṛdayamiṣṭadaṃnityahomaṃ samāpyātha jvalitaṃ vedasi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāgāmāraṃ praviśyātha smṛtvācārya padadvayaṃkṣīraṃ vā śarkarāmājyaṃ datvā naivedyamādarāttadardhe vā tadardha vā cihnuka vā tadardhakaṃrajitaṃ vā yathā śaktyā tāmraṃ tāṃvūlameva vāudvāsyātha mahālakṣmī cakre saṃpūjayet sudhīḥyaduttaṃ tanmalla kramayodhyā nagarābhidhaṃsamastaduritadhvasiptavapurāya phalapradaṃaṇimādi guṇā vāptikaraṃ trailokyamohanaṃputraprapautra tatpautrādyabhi vṛddhikaraṃ sadāsamastopa dravaharaṃ samastabhayanāśanaṃsarvāśubhaharaṃ puṃsāṃ samastādya vibhedanaṃapamṛtyu praśamanaṃ kāṃti medhā vivardhanaṃārogyajananaṃ puṃsāṃ rogaśokanivāraṇaṃśrīcakraṃ tanmahadguptamarcayitvā dine dinesarvavidyāmayaṃ yasmācchrīcakraṃ sarvasiddhidaṃpradhya prapūjanaṃ vāpi kṛtvā saṃtatamādarātlakṣmīhṛdayavidyāṃ ca japtvā paṃcaśataṃ śuciḥaṇimādi guṇaiśvaryaṃ dhanasaṃpattimakṣayāṃdivyānapi mahābhogāni hāpyā sādyasādhakaḥayodhyānagare tiṣṭhatyaṃte nātra vicāraṇāśakrādyā aṣṭadikpālāstvaṃ ca lakṣmīssarasvatīpūjitā api saṃtuṣṭā bhavatyaṃsya phalapradāyena saṃpūjyate nityaṃ trailokyaṃ yena pūjitaṃpūjyate satataṃ yena sa sarvajño jagatpatiḥsāmrājyalakṣmīmathavā pūjayikta dine dine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣmīnārāyaṇā vacasāṃgāvaṇa saṃyutaubhavānīśaṃkaro yadvā sāṃgāvaraṇa saṃyutauamahālakṣmīṃ samabhyarcya pratyekamathavā śiveatrāśakto mahālakṣmīṃ pīṭhenyatrātha vārcayettrikoṇamatha ṣaṭkoṇaṃ dvādaśāramataḥ paraṃpraṇavaṃ vilikhenmadhye sādhyakarma vidarbhitiṣaḍaṃgānyagni koṇādikoṇā ṣaṭke kramāllikhetṣoḍaśasvara saṃyuktaṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśa patrakaṃdvidhā dvitīyamapi bhūgehaṃta tathaiva pariveṣṭhayetuktame tanmahālakṣmyā yaṃtra duritabhedanaṃsarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ samastaśubhasiddhidaṃatra mūrti samanvitaṃ agrataḥ puṣpadhanvānaṃ rati devyā samanvitaṃutthāni pūrvamukteṣu sthāneṣudhidhiva yajetgāyatrī devyuṣāvetirapi mahālakṣmīstriśaktyākhyaṃ jagatpatesarvadyā mayaṃ prokta mayo dhyānagaṇabhidhaṃvadame kṛpayānātha yadinesti kṛpāmayimahītalesyānāmāni śṛṇuṣvā vahitā bhavatathā sannati pīṭhasthā mahālakṣmīrharipriyāpāṃduraṃge triśaktyākhyā lakṣmī viṭṭhala vallabhāyoginyalaṃ purakhyātā yogasiddhipradāyinīmīnākṣīti samākhyātā dakṣiṇe mathurāpureśeṣā cale mahālakṣmīrvikhyātā girikanyakelaṃkāpurercitā nityaṃ śāṃkarī śaṃkarapriyāmaheṃdra parvate durgā mahiṣāsuramardinīgaṃgāsāgaraṃ sargopa vikhyātā kamalālaya
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlācale samākhyātā subhadrā bhuktidāvārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣīttattu mṛṣṭānna siddhidāprayābhagemādhavī tāmrākhyātā nārāyaṇapriyārukmiṇī dvārakāyāṃ ca rāmamā mā haripriyāyaśodāgokule proktā rādhāvṛṃdāvane vanedurgādevīti vikhyāviṃdhyādriśikheraśubhesīgaṃgādvāre mahokṣetre sītā janakakanyakāvikhyātā śrīpure sākṣān mahātripurasuṃdarīmataṃgaparvatekhyātā śrīdevīmaṃtriṇī smṛtākurukṣetrepi vikhyātā pārvatī śaṃkarapriyāśrīraṃgaparvate khyātā śrīdevī kamalālayātryaṃvaka girau khyātā rudrāṇī śaṃkarapriyācakrarājātmakānyāsāṃ pīṭhāni giri kanyakeetāni siddhakṣetrāṇi saṃtyanyānyapi bhūtaleprasannalakṣmī pīṭhāni sarvāṇyetāni suṃdariśucirjiteṃdriyo nityaṃ guru śuśrūṣaṇerataḥdivasatriteyanaiva mahatī siddhimāpnuyāttātitubhyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudyā vahitā śiveparaṃ anaṃtaśayana puṇyaṃ caṃdra prakāriṇī taṭaṃāhovalaṃ mahākṣetramalāpuramataḥ paraṃkanyākubja mahadgāma vedāraṇyamataḥ paraṃvarāha śikharaṃ puṇyavedāri śikharaṃ tataḥratnādri śikhaṃ puṇyaṃ lakṣmīśa kṣetramapyathadākṣāṇyābhidha kṣetraṃ brahmeśvarama mataḥ paraṃśrīkūrmapadamadyuktaṃ mārkaṃḍeya padābhidhaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃcaprayogakṣetrāṇi kedārakṣetramapyathajaṃjṛmārgaṃ mahākṣetraṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamaḥnaṃdigrāmābhidhakṣetra mahadatyaṃta pāvanaṃyatrāste bhagavān sākṣādyogarūḍhaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥpālayanna khilaṃ lokaṃ śiṣṭānāṃ hitamācaranbhāgyodayena tatkṣetraṃ labhyāte sukṛtātmabhiḥsadya eva vimuktaḥ syān mahāpātakavānapivaikuṃṭhalokādāgahā siddhikarāṣvapitīrthāni saṃpravakṣyāmi siddhidāni mahītalegodāvarī kṛṣṇuveṇī kāverī saritāṃvarāyoṣṇī ca tathā siṃdhunadī paramapāvatībhadrādri śikharasvāmi sānnidhyaṃ gautamī taṭaṃrāmahūdaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ rāmatīrtha manuttamaṃlakṣmīsarovaraṃ puṇyaṃ phalgunī tīrthamapyathamaṃdākinā tadaṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ vāśiṣṭa saṃjñitaṃśivagaṃgā mahāpuṇyā dhanuṣkoṭirataḥ paraṃtulasīkānanaṃ puṇyaṃ vilvadrumavījaṃ paraṃkamalālayatīrtha ca sāvitrī tīrthamuttamaṃtīrthābhīmuttamaṃ śive sā lagnāma silācakrasānnidhye śrīdyayaṃ viduḥvilvavṛkṣavanaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāsiddhikaraṃ smṛtaṃdarśanādapyathai teṣā bhavet siddhiśca śāśvatīekāhamapi jadhvā vā vidyāṃ śrīhṛdayābhidhāṃyada kṛtvā naro vidyā siddhiṃ na labhate kvacittrilakṣadvaṃ pare proktaṃ cāturlakṣaṃ kalauyugekalauyuge sadāmartyāḥ parastrī dhanalolupāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puroditeṣu pītīpyeṣvaṃpi mama priyetulasīvana madhye vā vinvadrumavanepi vābhavānī maṃdire vāpi kamalalāyatanepi vāācāryaṃ sannidhīkṛtya puraścaraṇamāsmatvadarīkānanaṃ proktaṃ tadevāśu phalapradaṃśātodāṃtojita krodho maunī saṃdhyā su saṃyataḥnāstikairvedavāhyairvani saṃbhāṣāpara kvacitrajasvalāṃtyajādīnāma saṃbhāṣaṇa tatparaḥtapta kṛcchra paro cāpi paṃcagavyāśanopi vākaṃdamūla phalāśī vā havira annathāpi vāmahālakṣmyā jape dvidyāṃ śuddho nirmalamānasaḥasadgoṣṭhīma saṃvaddhālāyaṃ paiśūnyameva caavadaśāstraniṣṭhāṃ ca varjayenmatimānnaraḥśṛṇu yānna kvacidyāga niṃdāṃ ca duritapradāṃsamadaśī ca sarvatra mitrāritanayeṣucakrarājārcanaṃ nityaṃ kurvāṇo niyatavrataḥdaśāṃśaṃ tarpayeddhīmānyayasekṣurasenadhātaddaśāṃśaṃ hunedagnau kamalairghṛtamiśritaiḥsuvāsinyaḥ śataṃ bhījyāstāvaṃto brāhmaṇājapiniṣkasāhasramatha vā śataniṣkamathapi vārājyalakṣmyā avāpnoti dehāṃtepi paṇātiṃasādhyamapi devānāmapi dvīpāṃtaraṇyitaṃatrāśaktaḥ puraścaryāṃ kuryāllaghvīṃ yata vrataṃśaradādyāśvine māsi vrataṃ paramapāvanaṃsarvakalmaṣarogaghna sarvaduḥkhavibhedanaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekasyā api vidyāyāssaptadvīpavatī mahītasmādavaśyamācāryaṃ gatvāpi bahuyojanaṃsaṃsarasāgaraṃ tartumicchanne kena janmanābrahmavidyā japāṃte vā tatpūrvamatha vā sadāśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japatvā brahmānaṃdasukhī bhavetidaṃ dāsarathīyākhyaṃ taṃtraṃ vedārthasammitaṃsaṃprāpya bahudūraṃ vātamevācāryamāśrayetta eva mahatīṃ siddhiṃ vrajaṃtīha paratra caācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja dvayameva dine dineihāpi mahatīṃ siddhiṃ prāpyaṃte muktimāpnuyātitaḥ paraṃ mahārāja kiṃ punaḥ śrotusicchasibhagavadraśmimāleyaṃśutā tavamukhāṃvujātekaikasyāśca vidyāyā māhātmyaṃ kramaśo vadatasya śravaṇamātreṇa mahatīṃ siddhimaśnuteśriyaḥpaterbhagavattoraśmimālāttataḥ paraṃtatrādau saṃpravakṣyāmi gāyatrīṃ vedamātaraṃpraṇavo bhūrbhuvaḥ paścātsuvarītyakṣaradvayaṃbhargodevasya śabdaṃ ca dhīmahīti tataḥ paraṃvyāhṛtitrayasaṃyuktāgāyatrī triṃśadakṣarāmahāpāpopapāpaugha saṃhatrī siddhidāyinītulitā brahmaṇā pūrvamadhikābhūdiyaṃ parābrāhmaṇyaṃ jāyate rājan sāvitrya dhyayanaṃ vināśriyaḥpaterbhagavato devasya jagatāṃ pateḥvayaṃ dhīmahi hṛtpadme sohameveti sattataṃasmākaṃ nodhiyo nityamaṃtarpyātmyānāsthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājyalakṣmī mahāvidyā sidhyarthāninata vrataḥduḥkha pranāśanaṃ dhanye tuṣṭipuṣṭikaraṃ paraṃtadvidhā namatho vakṣye śṛṇudhvā vahitā śiveraviparvasamaṃ prakurāgamārtha viśāradāḥaddhaudaya samaṃ prāhurvedavedātavedinaḥmahatīti samākhyātā mahāsiddhi phalapradāsarvasiddhikarī proktā bhoga svargāpavargadākṛtvādau maṃgata snānamāryājñā purassaraṃgaṇādhipaṃ vāpi saṃkalpya prajapecchuciḥsahasraṃ prajapennityaṃ yadvāyaṃ ca śatādikaṃsālegrāmaśilācakramathavā girikanyakeaṣṭāviṃśatidhā nityaṃ śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayāaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā nataḥ paṃcadaśārṇayāekaikaśastahutvāstotramārtharvaṇaṃ śubhaṃnavarātre yedekottara vṛddhikramoṇaśrīśrīśāvarcayeddhīmānbhojayecca suvāsinīḥśrīśrīpatidhiyā yadvā bhojayenmithunaṃ śiveyadvācārya priyāṃ sākṣān mahālakṣmīdhiyā śiveaśakto maṃdabhāgyopiyācidhvā śūdrakānapiardhayitvā viśeṣeṇa tata ācāryamarcayetmahānavamyāṃ prāptāyī prātarudvāda bhāgyataḥaṣṭāviṃśati hutvā gāyatryā jātavedasihutvā prasannalakṣmyātha sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃgavyājya saṃplutaṃ hutvā bhagavadraśmibhirghṛtehutvā paṃcadaśākṣathīghṛtaṃ triśatamamādarāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣmyā prasannalakṣmyārtha triśaktyā ca tataḥ paraṃjapādi homaṃ kṛtvātha prāyaścittāhutīstataḥatha paṃcaśataṃ lakṣmī lakṣmīśau kusumairyajetācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ praṇipatya samāhisaḥvajraviṃdu samāyuktaṃ kuṃḍala dvaya marpayetsvarṇa niṣka sahasraṃ vā śataniṣkamathāpi vāsūkṣmaṃ vastrayugāṃ dadyāhṛhṇīyādāṣi śiṣaḥ śibhāḥkanakat na kacitākaṃ nāsābharaṇamapyathatāṭaṃkābharaṇaṃ vāpi ciṃtākaṃ haimajaṃ tu vāsūkṣmaṃ vā sastato dadyān mahālakṣmīdhiyā tataḥyadvā paṃcadaśābhyarcāssuvāsinyona vāpi vādakṣiṇābhiścatāṃ kūlairbrāhmaṇānapi nāpayetdaridropi vrataṃ kṛtvā svācārya varaṇadvayedakṣiṇāmarpyaṣṭajīta vāgyataḥitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryāṃ navarātravrate śubheagniṣṭhoma sahasrasya vājapayeyakṣatasya caphalaṃ prāpya viśuddhātmā nārāyaṇasanvitāṃjanmakoṭi amudbhūtairmahāpāpaiścadāruṇaiḥavāpya ca na dhānyaudya muktāratnasamākulāṃsaṃtati vyāpinīṃ labdhvā sarvasaubhāgyasaṃyutaḥbhūtvā samṛddhiṃ mahatīṃ putrapautrādi saṃkulāṃbhuktvātha mānuyā divyān bhogānapi sudurlabhāndivyakanyā śatayutaṃ vimānaṃ kāmagaṃ śubhaṃnavarātravratamida sarvasiddhikaraṃ śubhaṃsaptamyāṃ ravisaṃkrāṃtirbhānuvāsara saṃyutā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arkasaṃkramaṇaṃ tatra brāhmekāse bhavedyadinakṣatraṃ bhagadaivatyaṃ bhavatyatra yadi priyeathacottara saṃkrāṃtissaptamyārmiduvāsarevijayākhyaṃ mahāyogevaraṃtīmaṃ maharṣayaḥdhanussaṃkramaṇaṃ bhānoryayaṃ tadasamanvitaṃmadhyāhne hṛṣasaṃkrāṃtiryadi sāvitra saṃyutāsamasta saṃpatsamavāpti hetuṃ samastapāpaudya vināśahetuṃpavitraṃ ciṃtāmaṇiṃ yogamudāharaṃti dharmārthakāmā divyamarthahetuṃyoga samāyuktaṃ tanmāsaṃ ca sakalaṃ śivehṛṣasaṃkrāṃti paryaṃtaṃ prathametra pravakṣyatetatrotthāya viśuddhātmā śrīśrīśadvādaśākṣarīśālagrāma śilācakrecakrarāja samanvitetriśataṃ vā śataṃ nityamarcayedbrahmavidyayājaṃvū pravālairdūrvāgnaiḥ śamīpatrairathāpi vākṛsaraṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ sārdrakaṃ goghṛtaplutaṃvidhivat saṃkṛskṛte vahnau tadeva kṛsaraṃ śubhaṃjuhuyādveda mātrādāvaṣṭā viśatidhā śivekevalena ghṛtenātha lakṣmī hṛdaya vidyayāaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā catuḥ śrīmanubhistataḥjapetyaṃ ca śataṃ nityaṃ japtvāṣṭākṣaramāditaḥgavyakoṭī sahasrāyuta homa puṇyaṃ dine dine sau labhate girīṃdrajekṛtvetthaṃ makaraṃ bhānuryathā saṃkramate śivetriśataṃ juhuyādagnau ramā hṛdayavidyayāghṛtaṃ ca triśataṃ hutvā bhagavadraśmibhistataḥhutvaikadhā śriyo devyā vidyayāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ***** hutvā śrīmaṣṭā viṃśatidhāpi vāūṣa saṃkramaṇe kālestātvācārya padadvayaṃācārya sannidhāvagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tataḥ paraṃaṣṭā viṃśatidhā brahmavidyayāpi hunedghṛtaṃśrīmadaṣṭārṇayā paścāt triśataṃ juhuyād ghṛtaṃmahālakṣmī mathā vāhya jvaliṃte jātavedasiprasannayā mahālakṣmyā sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃmadhu tritaya saṃyuktairhutvācāryasya sannidhauśriyā paṃcadaśākṣaryā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ ghṛtaṃtriśakti lakṣmyā sāmrājya lakṣmyā ca ghṛtamīśvarijapādibhiḥ paścāt kṛtvā brahmārpaṇahutiācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja dvitayaṃ praṇipatya vaikuṃḍaladvitayaṃ dadyāt karṇayugme tataḥ paraṃvarṣāśanamitaṃ dravyaṃ dātavyaṃ caraṇadvayetadardhaṃ vārpayeddhīmān vittalobhaṃ varityajetārdrakaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ paṃcāḍhakamitaṃ śivedhenudvayaṃ pradātavyaṃ vahukṣīraṃ saṃvatsakaṃācāryacaraṇadvaṃdve dadyāt sidhyarthamāśvarikanatkunaka ciṃtākamarghyayedatha vā śivedatvā vastreṇa saṃmoṣya bhojayecca suvāsinīḥkarayugmerpayeddhrīmān paladvaya vinirmitaṃatannāśaktotha raupyeṇa suśubhreṇa vinirmitisuvāsinī śataṃ bhojyaṃ tadadhāṃ vā tadardhakaṃkūṣmāṃḍaṃ vahuvītāḍhyaṃ śrotriyāya dvijātayesthalaṃ sudīrgha kūṣmāṃḍaṃ tasminkāle mama priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ bhūmau sadyaḥpyata karāśibhitāvat kalpa sahasrāṇi vaikuṃṭhe nivasatyasaudhenudvādaśakaṃ dadyāttilarāśiṃ sudakṣiṇaṃyadyaddattaṃ mahāyoge tasminkāle maheśvariitthaṃ kṛtvānna havanaṃ varṣa sāhasramādarāttatphalaṃ labhataṃ nātra saṃdehomīnalaudhaneuktenānena vidhinā vājimadhān sahasraśaḥphalamāpnoti tejasvī lakṣmīścāsya prasīdatisamarpyābharaṇaṃ haimaṃ sūkṣmavstra samanvitaṃitthaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryāmatra yogeti durlabhevimukto hayamadhānāṃ sahasrajanitaṃ phalaṃlabdhvā nityaṃ viśuddhātmā mahadārogyāmakṣayaṃhastyaścarathasaṃkīrṇaṃ mahatīṃ śriyamakṣayāṃbhūtvā sidhyaṣṭakaṃ prāpya putrapautravatīṃ śriyadivyakatyā sahasreṇa sahitaṃ sarvabhogadaṃajarāmaraṇo bhūtvā paṃcaviṃśati vārṣikaḥṣaḍtriṃśadvatsarairyogarājoyaṃ labhyate śivephalaṃ vaktuṃ satyaṃ paṃkaja locaneyacchrutvā sādhako bhūmau kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyatiekādaśīdine somavāsareṇa samanviteati ṣaḍayute vāpi divā saṃdhyāstu vā niśialabhyaḥ kathito loke sarvakalyāṇasiddhidaḥnānena sadṛśo yaugaḥ kathyate paramarṣibhiḥjapahomādikahṛṇāṃ mahālakṣmīḥ prasīdatialabhyayoge saṃprāpte divā vā saṃdhyayorniśi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṃḍavannametcaturviśati saṃkhyākairupacāraissamarcayanyājvaline saṃskṛte vahnau gurupādābja sannidhaumadhutritayasaṃmiśraiḥ śatādhika sahasrakaṃbhagavadvidya pāpaścā daṣṭāviṃśati varṇayāekaikaśastato hutvā śriyāyaḥ ca daśārṇayāaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā pratyekaṃ jātavedasiprāyaścittāhutīḥ kṛtvā kuryādbrahmārpaṇāhutiṃṣaṣṭi cihuka sauvarṇaṃ padmarāga samanvitaṃaṃkitaṃ svaguṇṭhe karṇayuge dātavyamādarātbhūṣitavyā prayatnena sūkṣmaṃ vā sassamarpya capaṃcāḍhakamitā vāpi caturāḍhakasasmitāḥśataniṣka suvarṇa vā tadardhyaṃ vā tadardhakaṃdatvettha dakṣiṇā dravyaṃ kuṃḍala dvitayānvitaṃdadyādavaśyaṃgiri medhanādhyaścet pravakṣatepāritoṣika dānena saṃtoṣyācārya mādarātdatvoktaṃ dakṣiṇādravyaṃ kuṃḍala dvitayānvitaṃpaurāṇikaṃ vrataṃ yena kṛtaṃ tatra mama priyetasmin dine nirāhāraḥ kṣīrāśī vā phalāśanaḥprātarutthitaḥ snātvā kṛtāhnikobhyarnya lakṣmīnārāyaṇau vibhūyadvā dvādaśasaṃkhyākāmṛṣṭāśrairbhojayedvratīācāryā dāśiṣaḥ prāpya bhuṃjīyādvaṃdhūbhissahakaroti viśuddhātmā sa siddho bhavati dhruvaṃkāyena manasā vācā jñānājñāna kṛtainapisāṃga dakṣiṇayāyukta puraścaryā śatodbhavaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atrāvaśyaṃ pradātavyā śālagrāmaśilā śubhābrahmāṃḍakoṭi dānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti śāśvataṃkoṭī sahasra homasya phalamakṣaya maśnutetadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā vittalobhaṃ parityajetniṣka dvādaśakaṃ vāpi datvācārya padāṃvujephalamāsādya śuddhātmā bhagavat kiṃ karo bhavetācārya karṇayugale datvā svarṇā calārpaṇātyatphalaṃ labhate bhūmau tatmāprotyakṣayaṃ phalaṃuddhṛtya prāpayatyāśau satyalokaṃ sanātanaṃśriyaṃ paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ sākṣā bhagavadanvitīgavāmayutadānasya samagraṃ phalamaśrutekṛtvācāryasya sānnidhye śriyamaṣṭa guṇānvitāṃmuktāratnādi saṃpūrṇā kaṃdarpasadṛśaḥ śriyāsamastasaṃpadādhāro bhūtvā putrādi saṃyutaṃciramāyuṣya māsādya sarvabhoga samanvitaḥdehāṃte paramaṃ dhāma yogināmapi durlabhaṃlakṣmīnārāyaṇa samo yogo labhyo na vidyatebhūyopi saṃpravakṣyāmi vidyāsiddhikaraṃ śivebhūyopi siddhidaṃ kṛtyaṃ yatkṛtvā siddhimma bhavetvāsaṃtaṃ tava rātrākhyaṃ kṣatamasti mahatpuraṃputrapautrādi saṃpatti phaladaṃ japasiddhidaṃmuktāratma suvarṇādi dravyarāśikaraṃ gṛhemāsi caitrābhicai prāpte pratipadinamāditaḥekaikadivasaṃ tatra mahodaya samaprabhaṃtāraṃ vāditi daivatyaṃ vārhasyatyamathāpi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatphalaṃ na mayāvaktuṃ śakyate vedhasāpi cajapahomādijanitaṃ phala tatra mahattaraṃśrīrāmajanmadivasaṃ yāvaṃdhyaṃ kurute bhuviśrīrāmajanmadivase yatkiṃcidapi kāṃcanaṃphalamāpya viśuddhātmā brahmasāyujya yaśruteśrīrāmajanmadivase datvācārya padāṃvujeśrīmadaṣṭārṇa maṃtreṇa rājyalakṣmyāpitadinevidhānaṃ tatra vakṣyāmi vāsaṭena varānnakenavarātra yadā proktaṃ vāsaṃtaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃsnātvā tatra viśuddhātmā kṛta pūrvāhnika kriyaḥcatuḥśataṃta vā triśataṃ jvalite jātavedasiaṣṭā viṃśatidhā hutvā dvādaśa brahmavidyayātataḥ prasannalakṣmyāpi hunedaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃjapet paṃcaśataṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃsaṃkalpārka sahasrāṇi japecchrī hṛdayaṃ śivesiṃhāṃsaneścarī paṃcadaśārṇāmadri kanyakeaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityamaṣṭā viṃśatidhāpi vājapet paṃcādhikaṃ catvāriṃśadā vṛttimādarātmahālakṣmīdhiyā nityaṃ bhojayecca suvāsinītataḥ śrīrāmacaṃdrasya navamyāṃ prātarutthitaḥācāryasannidhau paścāt saṃskṛte jātavedasiaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā śrīśrīśabdā daśārṇayāmahālakṣmīmathā vāhya tasminnagrau trayīmayīṃtadā varaṇadevī nāmekaikāmāhuti hunetyajñanāśayaṇāṃ kasthāṃ dhyātvānna niyatavrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kadalīphala saṃmiśraṃ kapilājya samanvitaṃūṣatvā prasannalakṣmyātha gavyenājyena tatparaṃatha śriyo mahārājñā raśmividyāmirādaśataṣṭottaraśataṃ gavyenājyena juhuyādathahunedaṣṭottara śatamaṣṭā viṃśatidhā pivājuhuyāt parvakāleya ekāmapyāhutiṃ ghṛtiṃpuraścaraṇa homāṃte hutvāṣṭā viṃśadarṇayātasmādavaśyaṃ homāṃtaṃvyamaṣṭā viṃśati varṇayāagniṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya namaskṛtya girīṃdrajekuṃḍala dvitayaṃ haimaṃ ṣaṣṭi cihnuka nirmitaṃdadyādavaśyamācārya karṇayugmegni sanmidhaujānakīsahitastasya puraścaryā śatodbhavāṃdukūla yugalaṃ vāpi kāryā samatha vāmadudatvā dhanāḍhyo bhūyo vā svarṇasāhasramarpayettarāśaktopi ṣaṇinaṣkāṃnniniṣkaṃ vā samarpayetikṣu daṃḍagaṇopetaṃ nārikela phalānvitaṃdaridro maṃdabhāgyopi bhikṣitvā sarvavarṇajānkanyāṃ rūpavatī dadyācchīlaudārya guṇāvitāṃsūkṣmaṃ vā sassamarpyādau phalarāśi mataḥ paraṃdādāti yadi tanmūnaṃ na siddhimadhi gacchatimahālakṣmīdhiyācāryapatnī mākalpasaṃcayaiḥśrīrāmajanmadivaseya itthaṃ samācaretjānakīśa prasādena śriyaṃ maiṃdrīma caṃcalāṃputrapautra samṛddhiṃ ca kalyāṇāni dine dinetasmindine nirāhāraḥ kṣīrāśī vā phalāśanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paredyuḥ śrīdhiyābhyarcyamṛṣṭarannaiḥ suvāsinīḥbhuṃjīta vaṃdhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ vipraśeṣānnamādarātkaroti sa bhavedrāma caṃdrānu grahato bhuviputrapautrā śriyā yukto dīrghāpuṣpa samanvitaḥbhūtvā jātismaraḥ paścādgrāmaṃ daṣṭvā jagatatisamastasaṃpat sāmrājya hetubhūtaṃ girīṃdrajevudhena bhṛguṇā vāpi sahitā vahi saṃyutāsamastādyau ghṛśamanī sarvapuṇya phalapradāanayā sadṛśī nāsti tithissakalasiddhidāatra jāgarti satataṃ lakṣmīśaḥ karuṇānidhiḥsvadarśanotsukānṛṣṭvājanān paramadhārmikānakṣayākhya tṛtīyāyāṃ yo māmatrā gajājanaḥavaśyaṃ mama sāyujyaṃ dāsyāmya saṃśayaḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī vidyāṃ japedye niyatavrataḥtasyākṣayā mahāsiddhimihadatvā maha āṃakṣayāṃ saṃpradāsyāni vaikuṃṭha mamasmannidhausunaṇīṃ ca hukumasya dadāsyasyā calāśriyaṃatrākṣayavine kṛtvā madanagrahato bhuviityāha bhagavān yogī harinārāyaṇo vibhuḥtasmādavaśyaṃ vaiśākhe divase kṣayasaṃjñiteyadyakṣa ca mahāsiddhimicchatyatra narā bhuvietadvratasamaṃ nānyadvratanāstipālapradaṃakṣaye brahmasāyujya pradātṛtvena cākṣayaṃakṣayāyā tṛtīyāyāṃ prasannakamalāmanoḥbrāhmekāle samutthāya brahmavidyāṃ prajapya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedamātturayaṃ proktaḥ śrutyukto yo mahāmatenārāyaṇo vedamayo mahāpuruṣa īśvaraḥna gāyatrī samosaṃtronāyodhyā sadṛśī purīnācārya caraṇāṃbhojadvayena sadṛśī gatiḥsāvitrīmanupāsyāddauyonyatra kurute matiṃanupāsyānvahaṃ vedamātaraṃ vahuśo nṛpatasmādvaśyaṃ gāyatrīṃ prajaptvā vahuśotvahaṃsahasraṇe japedyastu sāvitrīmanvahaṃ śuciḥbahuyojana sāhasramapi saṃprāpyataṃ dvijaṃekataḥ sakalā vedāyāgāstīrthavratādayaḥsāhasrakṛtvo gāyatrīmavaśyaṃ pratyahaṃ japetvā triśataṃ dviśataṃ cāpi japedaṣṭottaraṃśataṃgāyatryeva paraṃbrahmagāyatryevaparohariḥgāyatryevatrayī sākṣācchabdabrahmasvarūpiṇīrājarṣitvaṃ parityajya brahmarṣi padamāptavānchaṃdo gāyatrame tasyāḥ savitā parameśvaraḥmukhamagniḥ śirobrahmāśikhārudroṃvikāpatiḥviniyogaścaturvargāphalasiddhyarthamīritaḥprāṇāyāme prajaptavyākulaṃbhakena tridhānvahaṃgāyatrī vācamādyaṃtarahitaṃ sarvakāraṇaṃdhyātvā samastavedānāṃmātaraṃ pūjayetparāṃpuraścaryāsya kathitā bhagavadrūpasiddhidāmahāpāpopapāpaudyairapimāsena mucyateprajaptvā bhagavadrūpīsiddhānāmadhiyo bhavetbrahmaghnaśca surāyaśca svarṇastepī ca mucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛta śaucastataḥ snātvā kṛtasaṃdhyā japakriyaḥnityahomaṃ samāpyātha śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuśuciḥ paṃcaśataṃ japtvā gurupādābja sannidhauaṣṭāviṃśati bhāgavyamājya hutvā girīṃdrajehutvā paṃcaśataṃ devi lakṣmīhṛdayavidyayāghṛtaplutairhunedagnau sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ gavyenājyena juhuyadathaagniṃ prayakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskṛtya ca sādaraṃśrīśrīśa dvādaśākṣayapijet paṃcaśataṃ śivedadhyannasahitaṃ devi naivedyaṃ ca samarpayetdatvā go dvitayaṃ vatsa vahukṣīra samanvitaṃtriniṣkamathavā datvā gurupatnyai ramādhiyāsuvāsinīśca saṃbhojya siddhimāpnotyanuttamāsaṃtati vyāpinīṃ lakṣmīṃ dhanadhānyādisaṃkulāṃakṣayāmapi vāksiddhimakṣayāṃ putrasaṃtatiakṣayaṃ brahmasāyujyaṃ dehāṃtesya prayacchativaiśākhemāsi kartavyaṃ vratame tadanuttamaṃniṣkamekaṃ pradatvā svācārya caraṇadvayeakṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛtvetthaṃ homamādarātācāryapatnyai niṣkārvalakṣmī vudhyā samarpya caśrīmadhyannaṃ ghṛtamiśritaṃdadhyannameva juhuyācchuddhadhenughṛta ghṛtaṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā tatoṣṭā viśaṃdarṇayāaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā śriyaḥ paṃcadaśārṇayāpūrṇimāṃtamidaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇimādiva saṃtataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samāpyāvaśyakaṃ karma saṃskṛte jātavedasidadhyannaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayādadhyannameva juhuyātyanepsamya phalānvitabhagavadraśmividyābhirekaikāmāhutiṃ hunetaṣṭāviṃśatidhā paścācchriyo raśmibhirapyathaaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā ghṛtenaiva girīṃdrajebrahmārpaṇāhutiṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtvātha pāvakaṃavaśyamapi dātavyaṃ kuṃḍaladvayamādarātmuktālaṃkaraṇaṃ vāpi ratnālaṃkaraṇaṃ tu vāpalameka suvarṇaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakaṃavaśyaṃgauḥ pradātavyā vahukṣmīrā savatsakāvahūsthūlāni dīrghāṇi phalasaṃdyayutānyapikadalīphalasaṃdyaṃ ca dadyāt svagurave śivedadhyannāpūya bhakṣyādyairbhojayakṣa suvāsinīḥarcāyedatha vā lakṣmī sannidhau vā samarpayettatpatnyai vā tatsutāyai tatpautrāyātha vārpayetpuraścaryā vratamidaṃ vaiśākhemāsi pārvatisiddhimāpnoti mahatīsaṃdyaḥ pratyayakāriṇīdhanaiśca dhānyairmaṇimiśca saṃkulāṃ lakṣmīmavāpnoti ramāprasādātrathāśvamatto bhayadāti pūrṇāṃ rājyaśriyaṃ viṃdati vatseratraāyuṣyamārogya dhanābhivṛddhiṃ vaṃśābhivṛddhiṃ ca maheṃdra tulyāṃkalevarāṃte haripār"vatī niraṃjanassāmyamupaiti divyaṃdhātuḥ padayāṃtyati bhogayuktā āruhyanaṃgirirājakanyesmṛtau vātha purāṇa saṃcaye saghoramānu grahadāyakenakiṃ kiṃ varamiṣṭajātaṃ śriyeḥ prasādādirijeṃdrakanye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvā vratvaṃ prāpya mahārthasiddhiṃ caraṃ tilokeṣu vimuktavaṃdhāḥkṛtvā vaśyaṃ naraḥ sākṣān mahālakṣmī prapaśyatibrahmarṣayo vaśiṣṭādyāḥ śakrādyāścādegīśvrāḥmahālakṣmīprasādena lakṣmīśānugrahādapisaṃprāpya bhagavatsāmye satataṃ sukhino bhavanmahāpāpaudya dalanaṃ śatakratu phalapradaṃtatrārkadivasaṃ vādāvaṃte puṣkara saṃyutaṃkoti tritayā tīrthāni sārdhakoṭi yutāni cadinadvādaśakaṃ tatra puṣkarastīrthanāyakaḥbhikṣvānnamapi datvā vā gautamyāṃ puṣkarāgamebrahmapno vā surāpāyīsteyī vā gurutalpakaḥviśvastaviṣadātāragarbhaḥ ghātī sahasraśaḥahāraniyamaṃ kṛtvā yoge puṣkaranāmakedinadvādaśakānmuktaḥ sarvapāpairbhavavyasautānugrahaṃ prāpya siddhimiṣṭāṃ vrajatyasaudatvā meru sahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamāṃkoṭihoma phalanityaṃ prāpnoti girikanyakegodāvarī taṭe ramye nānyatra bhuvi pāvatitatra vakṣyāmi girije śṛṇuṣva su samāhitāgodāvarītaṭaṃ ganvātamaskṛtyāthagautatamīgodāvadyatitaḥ snātvā kṛta pūrvāhnika kriyaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā gāyatryājyaṃ dine dinekṣīṇannaṃ madhusaṃmiśraṃ kapilājyena saṃplutaṃapi paṃcaśataṃ hutvā śrīyuktāṣṭāṇayopyathaghṛtamekaikaśo hutvā suṃdarī raśmibhistata
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā prāyaścittāhutīrhudhvetabhojayenmithuna dvaṃdvaṃ śriyaṃ paṃcaśataṃ japandānakramaṃ pravakṣyāmi dineṣu dvādaśāsvathapakva samyayutāṃ bhūmiṃ dvitīye divasepayetsahasradakṣiṇāduktaṃ varṣadravyayutaṃ tu vādukūladyugalaṃ vāpi kāryā sa dvitayaṃ tu vākhāsadvādaśakaṃ dhānyaṃ yadvā khārī catuṣṭayaṃsaptame divase dadyādguḍaṃdakṣiṇayunvitepaladvādaśakaṃ raupyaṃ catuḥpalamitaṃ tu vāpaṃcācchakamitaṃ vāpi pradadyānnavame dineahastyaścaratha saṃpūrṇī navame divaserpyayetdaśame divase dadyādvāsona karaṇānvitaṃdvādaśe divase dadyāt suvarṇāni sahasraśaḥathavācārya pādābje dadyādekottaraṃ dhanaṃkuṃḍalādīnalaṃkārān tasminyoge samarpayatācāryāyāryayet svarṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ dvādaśe dinetatrāpa śaktastasyārthavitalobhaṃ parityajetācāryāyāryayitvapi syādṛṇī pratyahaṃ śivevastra prakṣālanādyaiśca pāda saṃvāhanādibhiḥśuśrūṣāṃ niyataḥ kuryādavaśyaṃ pratyahaṃ vudhaḥācāryapatnīṃ vāsobhirbhūṣayeddivyabhūṣaṇaiḥitthaṃ puṣkarayogesmin kṛtvā godāvarī taṭesāṃgadakṣiṇayāyukta puraścaryā sahasrajaṃdhanadhānya gajāśvādi saṃpūrṇāṃ ratnasaṃkulīprāpya śakradhaneśakradhaneśādi śriyaṃ tṛṇagaṇāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navarāga śiroratna dviguṇī kṛtarociṣaḥmaṃdabuddhirjaḍo vāpi vidyā svaṣṭādaśasvapisvacchaṃdamaraṇo bhūtvāyamaṃ tatkiṃ karāna pitṛṇīpiturmātuśca bhāryā yāni magraṃ nararakārṇavevaṃśābhi vṛddhi mākalyaṃ prāpnoti śrīsamanvitāṃanugrahakarī lakṣmyānā parāsti śrutau smṛtaubhūyopi saṃpravakṣyāmi śrotuṃtvaṃ niyatā bhavaamāpratipadossaṃdhau rāhugrasto raviryadipūrṇāpratipadossaṃdhaurāhuṇā ketunā apibhānuvāsara saṃyuktarmiduvāra yutaṃ tu vāprakṣaṃ sarvalokānāṃ dugrahaṇāṃ śubhaṃapamṛtyu praśamanaṃ vijayaśrī phalapradaṃyatkiṃcidapi japtaṃ vāhutaṃdattamathāpi vājātakaṃ mṛtakaṃ vātra sūtrakaṃ naiva vidyatesrākyanamācarītaṃ yena sa sadyaḥ pāparāśibhiḥgocarma sasmitā bhūmiryena tatra pradīyatesaptadvīpavatī pṛthvīṃ dhanādhānyādi saṃkulātadavaśyaṃ phalaṃ martyaḥ prāpnoti tu visādhakaḥhemādri sadṛśa svarṇadānasya phalamaśrutegokoṭidānaṃ japuṇyaṃ prāpnot yatra na saṃśayaḥduttāstrayaste na bhavaṃ tilokāyaḥ kāṃcanaṃgāṃ ca mahīṃ pradadyātmahāphalaḥ kālo brahmavidbhirudīritaḥhutvā japtvātravācārya pādābja yugale śiveācāryasiddhimāpnoti śrīprasādaṃ vrajatyapiyacca yāvacca sarvasvaṃ ravīṃdu grahaṇe śubhe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vāpi samuddiśya mṛtānapimahāpāpaudya sahitā apite pitaraḥ śiveprayāṃti sadya evairate satyalokaṃ sanātanaṃsadyaḥ siddhikaraṃ noktaṃ tasmādatra pravakṣyatedinatrayaṃ vā prayato brahmacārī phalāśanaḥyadvā ghṛtaplutairvilvapatraistila samanvitaiḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ rājyalakṣmyāpi juhuyādathadurvalo rogapīḍitaḥ gurupādābjayugalaṃ praṇamya bhuvi daṃḍavatutpalairjuhudyādagnau tilagavyājyamiśritaiḥatha prasannalakṣmyāpi prātādhika sahasrakaṃutpalānāma bhāvetu vilvapatrairghṛtaplutaiḥhunecchudgatilairevaghṛta trimadhumiśritaiḥlalitā raśmividyābhirekaikāmāhutiṃ ghṛtaṃprāyaścittāhutīḥ kṛtvā kuryādbrahmārpaṇāhutiṃśriyoṣṭā viṃśatīrhunet prāyaścittānnatvā tata ākalpa saṃcayaiḥsamarpayedgrāmamekaṃ vahudhānyadhanānvitaṃapyosoyaskarāṃ dadyājajānaśvān paśūnapitulā hiraṇyagarbhādi dānānyapi samarpayetkuṃḍala dvitayaṃ datvā guroḥ karṇayuga śiveḥratnāsalaṃkaraṇaṃ yadvā rudrākṣābharaṇaṃ tu vāgocarmasammitā bhūmirvahusasya samanvitātasyā abhāve tanmūlyaṃ vaṣārśanamitaṃ smṛtaṃvārānadyūmatha vā dadyādvittalobhaṃ parityajettanmūlyamathavā dadyājataḥ sākṣādramādhiyāyugma dvādaśakaṃ bhojyaṃ maṣṭānnena tataḥ paraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāpnoti mahatīṃ siddhiṃ yogināmapi durlabhāmuktāratnagaṇākīrṇāmacalāṃ prāpnuyādasaudāsabhūtā bhavatyasya prayacchaṃtya vivāṃchitaṃputrapautra prayautrādyaurbhogānbhuṅkte khilānapidīrghamāyuṣyamāsādya vimukto rogarāga saṃciyaiajaraścāmaro bhūtvā bhagavat sadṛśā kṛtiḥāruhyabhagaṃ vaddhvānniva satyaṃ tena saṃśayaḥpuraścaryāmimāṃ devi mahālakṣmīṃ haripriyāṃaṇimādi guṇā āpyajātiṃ smṛtvātha paurvikībrahmeṃdrādyamarānnityaṃ paśya har' samanvitaḥsaṃprāpya brahmasāyujyaṃ prāpnotyeva suniścitaṃmādyamāsādyamāvāsya bhānuvāsara saṃyutāalabhya yoga uktoyaṃ labhyate vahuvatsaraiḥyogadvayamidaṃ prāhuralabhyaṃ bhuvi durlabhaṃsamastaduḥkha śamanaṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakaṃsnātvā mahoradhau nadyāṃ taḍādhe vā gṛhepi vāaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā vedamātrā ghṛtaṃ gavāmadhutritaya saṃyuktaṃ gavyājyena vimiśritaṃhutvātha bhagavadraśmi vidyābhirjuhuyādvataṃśriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣaryā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ ghṛtaṃsuṃdarī bhagavadvidyayāṣṭā viṃśatidhāpyathamahāvyāhṛtimirhutvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇā hutiṃsādaraṃ praṇipatyātha svarṇālaṃkaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥśatamānaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakaṃsavatsāṃ sukuhukṣīrāṃ dadyādrāṃ ca payasvinīṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navavastra samāyuktaṃ bhūṣaṇādibhiranvitaṃsuvāsinīśca virpāśca yathā śaktyātha toṣayetmahātripurasuṃdaryāḥ saṃdaryāḥ saṃsiddhiṃ prāśūyātparāṃitthaṃ kuryāt puraścaryāṃ vidhinānena sādhakaḥavāpya mahatīṃ lakṣmīpuraścryā śatodbhavāṃaiśvaryā rogyasaṃtānaiḥ kaśyaṣena samaprabhaḥkulasāhasradvatya bhagavaddhāmni modateśaktaścet sarvadānāni dadyādviprebhya ādarāttiladhenuṃ dudhidhenuṃ guḍadhenumathāpi vādhanāḍhyo lavaṇādyādi giridānamathā caretsuvarṇaṃ raṃjitaṃgāṃ ca lavaṇaṃ ca tilānyapidānānyetāni viprebhyaḥ śrotriyebhyaḥ samarpayetsuvarṇaracitaṃ pātraṃ dhanāḍhyaścet samarpya casahasraṃ triśataṃ vāpi śataṃ vā dvādaśadhikaṃyatpuṇyāṃ samavāpnoti tadvaktuṃ naiva śakyatesāṃgaṃ yāgadhanaṃ datvā kulakoṭi samanvitaḥbrāhmemuhūrte utthāya śrīśrīśādvādaśākṣarīraśmimālā manusmṛtya kṛtvā saṃdhyādikāḥ kriyāḥatha paṃcaśataṃ cāpi japtvā vā triśataṃ śivebhṛguvarā vrataṃ kurvan cakrarājaṃ samarcayatsaṃprāpya ciramāyuṣyamārogyaṃ ca mahattaraṃbhūtvā bhūpāla sānnidhye mānya ācāryavat sadāputrapautrādi sahito bhogān divyāṃśca mānuṣātyastu dvādaśa saṃkhyā kalakṣaṃ śrīhṛdayaṃ japetākāśagamanaṃ yogamaṣṭāṃgasahitaṃ śubhaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛṣitvamatha siddhatvaṃ gaṃdharvatvaṃ ca yogitāṃanenaiva śarīreṇa kaṃdarpa śatasannibhaḥtejomaya tanurdivya kanyābhiḥ prārthitonvahaṃprasannalakṣmīvidyāyā dakṣiṇāmūrtināpurāanyepi yogā atraiva pūrṇaśa samudīritāḥpratyahaṃ prajapan sākṣānnārāyaṇa ivāparaḥtadvaṃśe maṃdabhāgyo vā dāridro vā na jāyatetadanvayeva satyeva satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥtriśakti lakṣmīvidyāyāstato vakṣyāmi sādhanaṃtriśaktilakṣmīvidyāyāvidhānaṃ vada sāṃ sāṃprataṃyasyā vijñānataḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇamayaḥ pumānādyaṃ vījamiti proktaṃ vyoma vāmākṣi saṃyutaṃvyaṃjanāṣaṃ mahīyuktaṃ caturthasvara saṃyutaṃtriśaktyākhyā mahālakṣmīriyaṃ vidyā samīritāsarvapāpaudya saṃhartrī sarvapuṇya phalapradābrahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairapi nityamupāsitāsāmrājyasiddhidā dharmavittakāma phalapradātriśakti lakṣmyāṃ siddhāyāṃ nāsādhyaṃ trijarāt svapiśrīdevyāḥ paścime bhāge mahāsiṃhāsaneśvarisammohana ṛṣirvāsyāḥ kathito brahmavittamaiḥtriśaktyākhyā mahālakṣmīrdevatā harivalābhākīakaṃ kāmarājaṃ syādviniyogastu siddhayesudhāṃbho nidhi madhyastharalaṃ dvīpe manoharepārijātavanāṃtasthe sarvatassamalaṃkṛtenārāyaṇāṃ kanilayāṃ vidyutkoṭi samaprabhāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sphuradratnalasat svarṇakirīṭāvṛtamastakāṃvālī yugala tāṭaṃka svarṇa ciṃtākaṭaka hemakāṃcī guṇānvitāṃkolāṃkuśābja yugalapāśacāpāni vibhraṃtīvījyamānāṃ surastrībhirmāṇikyā daśaryāṇibhiḥhastābhyāṃ sakhībhyāṃ suvarṇapāda kaṭaka hemakāṃcī guṇānvitāṃvālāṃkuśābja yugalapāśa cāpāni vibhratīṃvījyamānāṃ surastrībhirmāṇikyā darśayāṇibhiḥdivyaratnamaya svarṇapeyaṃ hastābhirādarātsaṃpūjita padāṃ nityaṃ bhaktatrāṇaṃ parāyaṇāṃtrayīmayī mahaṃ vaṃdeśaraṇāgata vatsalāṃtrisahasraṃ japedvidyāṃ sahasra dvitayaṃ tu vāaṣṭā viṃśatidhā vāpi japtvā siddhimavāpnuyātdvirāvṛtyā trivījāni koṇa ṣaṭke kramāllikhetcaturasraṃ caturdvāra bhūṣitaṃ maṃḍalaṃ likhetupacāraissamārādhya tatoṃgāvaraṇaṃ yajetagrakoṇaṃ samārabhya mahālakṣmī hripriyāṃṣaṭkoṇa pārśvayugale śaṃkhapapranidhī yajetkaumārī vaiṣṇuvīṃ paścādvarāhamadanāmathamaheṃdrādyāḥ samaparvāścaturasrāṣṭadikṣvathavījatraya mahāvidyāṃ japet sarvājamṛddhayecakrarāje samabhyarcya siddhimiṣṭāṃ vrajatyasausarvepicorairādhya śrīdevīcakranāyakeavaśyaṃ phalamāpnoti cakrarājasya sannidhauavaśyaṃ mahatīṃ siddhi prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥbrahmaviṣṇu maheśādyāḥ śakrādyāścadigīśvarāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasraṃ sahaṇe hutvā tilaistatphalamaśnutebhānumaṃḍala madhyasthaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ prapaśyatimātaraṃ sarvavedānāmanvahaṃ bahuśo japetpuraścaraṇā koṭyāpi maṃtrasiddhiṃ na viṃdatihutvādau sarvavidyānāṃ homasya phalamaśnutesarveṣāṃ mahasāṃ rāśiḥ kalātmākālanāyakaḥbhagavānsavitetktaḥ śrīśonārāyaṇocyutaḥayameva parorudrastrayīrūpoyamacyutaḥtaṃ vijānī hi hṛtpadmamadhyagaṃ sarvadehināṃnārāyaṇaṃ jagannāthaṃ stuvaṃti satataṃ vibhuṃyajūṃṣi trijagadvaṃdyaṃ viśvarūpaṃ parātparaṃsāmāni saṃstuvaṃtyenaṃ śriyaḥ patimanīśvaraṃsavitābhagavānsākṣāttriguṇostrijagatpatiḥtrayāṇāmapi vedānāṃ phalamadhyayanāllabhetjāyakaḥ sarvavidyānāmapi nityamasau bhavetsāvitrāśaṣṭākṣaraṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvā vahito nṛpapraṇavaṃ ghṛṇirityuktvā sūrya ityakṣaradvayaṃsarvādhivyādhisaṃhartrī sarvaroganivarhiṇīdevabhāgosya saṃprokto munirbrahmavidāṃvaraḥbhagavatprītaye prokto viniyogo maharṣibhiḥtejojvālāmaṇipadaṃ huṃ phaṭ vāhnipriyāmathadhṛtapadmadvayaṃ bhānuṃ tejomaṃḍalamadhyagaṃdhyātvetthaṃ prajapeddāstu sāvitrāṣṭākṣarīṃ śubhāṃpratyekaṃ sarvaraśmīnāṃ japahomādikarmasubhagavadraśmividyānāṃ mālikādhyayanenvahaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāṃgaṃ saṃpūjitātastuṣṭā bhavaṃti pratyahaṃ śivesarvavidyāpīṭhamayaṃ śrīcakraṃ kathitaṃ vudhaiḥsamasta devatācāryāḥ sāṃgaṃ sukṛtamaśrutelakṣatrayaṃ japedvidyāṃ vijiteṃdriyamānasaḥdaśāṃśaṃ kiṃśukairhutvā gavyājya trimadhulutaiḥmakarastheravaumādye yadvārka dinamāditaḥekādaśyāṃ hunedājya madhutritayamiśritaiathavā vilvapatraiśca pāyasenātha vā hunetvidyāsiddhimavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāṃaṇimādi guṇaiśvaryapradā pāpaudyabhejanīnābhidaghnajale sthitvā sūryamaṃḍalamavyaṇaṃmaṃḍalāṃtya dine sākṣān mahālakṣmīṃ prapaśyatimuktāralaughasahitāṃ saṃtati vyāpinīṃ śriyaṃtilairājyaplutairhutvā ṣadvahasraṃ yata vrataḥmadhu tritapasammiśraṃ pāyasaṃ jvalitenalesarvavidyā nidhirayaṃ sarvaiśvarya nidhirbhavetmanuṃ pāyasaṃ juhuyādagnai triśataṃ trimadhuplutaṃhuta śiṣṭāśī tasyāṃ niśībharvadvratīpuraścaryā vratamidaṃ kṛtvā sādhaka puṃgavaḥsevyāte pratyarhasākṣāddha naralaughavarṣiḥsahasra tritayaṃ japtvā triśataṃ juhuyādvrataṃraktotpalairhunedagnau pūrṇimāyāṃ śatatrayaṃavāpya mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ maheṃdra dhanadaprabhāṃavāpya sakalālokānnaranāru nṛpādikāngaṃgāpravāhasadṛśīṃ vāgvibhūtimavāpyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āśvine navarātre vā vāsaṃte vā samāhitaḥmahāmadhamyāṃ jvalite vahnau madhughṛtaplutaṃācāryapatnīmācāryamabhyarcyā bharaṇīdibhiḥācāryāyā vālmīki sadṛśo vidyābhirdhana saṃpadādhanadapratimo bhūtvā kāṃtyā madanasannibhatriśakti lakṣmīvidyāyāmeva bhaktiyutonvahaṃsahasra tritayaṃ jātvā sahasradvitayaṃ tu vātriśatādhikāhasre japtvā yadvānvahaṃ śuciḥsamastapāparāśibhyo vimukto bhāgya saṃpadāṃādhārassarvavidyānāmapi pautra sukhānvitaḥcirāyustyakalānbhogān bhuktvā divyāṃśca mānuṣānsarvārthasiddhidaṃ vakṣye samastaduritāyahaṃkṣamāvījaṃ śivavījaṃ ca vahni vāmākṣi maṃḍitaṃśrīruddheyaṃ mahāvidyā saptavarṇājvalocaneupāsakānāṃ sāmrājya śrīkarī bhuktimuktidāmahāsārasvatakarī mahāsaubhāgyasiddhidādadyādrupāsakastheyaṃ bhūtale girikanyakeprajaptā sakalābhīṣṭapradogdhī kāmadhugyathādharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca kaivayaṃ cāṇimādikaṃṛṣirnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣācchaṃdo gāyatramīritaṃmahālakṣmī jaganmātā devatānna samīritāśriyā ṣaḍdīrghayutayā ṣaḍaṃgajanyā samācaretsaṃtāna pārijātā dikṣuradrumavanāvṛttenavamāṇikya khacite mukta vidrumabhūṣiteaṃkevāme samāsīnāmattasī kusumaprabhāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vālāditya śataprakhyāṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṃsanāna pārijātādi pravyamālya virājitāṃabhayaṃ ca prayacchaṃtīvarā niṣṭāśca vibhratīcāmarādarśahastābhiḥ chatrahastābhirādarātśakrādi maulimāṇikya virājita padāṃvujāṃtrayīmayīṃ mahālakṣmīṃbhaje siṃhāsaneśvarīṃdhyātvā saṃpūjya satataṃ cakrarāje manoharetatrā śaktotha yaṃtresminnarcayet sādhakottamaḥcatudvari samāyuktaṃ yaṃtraṃ sāmrājya siddhideāvāhyopacaret sarvairupacārairmanoharaiḥtrikoṇa madhye sāmrājya śriya mamyacya sādaraṃaṣṭadīrgha svarayutā brāhmyādyā aṣṭarmātaraḥiṃdrādīnatha dikpālān caturasrāṣṭa dikṣvapilakṣatrayaṃ puraścaryāt sāmrājya śrīphalāptayetadvaśāṃśaṃ hunedagnau kiṃjukairājyamiśritaiḥmaṃtrasiddhimavāpnoti labhate vāṃchitaphalaṃjaptvā palāśa kusumai rājya trimadhutolitaiḥsamarthya dhenudaśākaṃ vidyāsiddhimavāpnuyāthutvā raktāṃvujai ratnau sārvabaumau bhaveddhruvaṃhutvā dvādaśa sāhasraṃ rājyalakṣmīmacaṃcalāṃsālibhirtudvato nityamaṣṭottara sahasrakaṃavāpya maṃḍale nāsau dhanadena samo bhavetrājyaśriyamavāpnoti sarvavidyānivirbhavetkaṃdarpa sadṛśaḥ kātyānaranārī nṛpādikānkimatra vahunoktena savarmasmāda vāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrotumicchasi kiṃbhūyo vadamaṣāṇavakṣubheraśmimālābhidhaṃ sūktaṃ śriyaḥ pravūhime prabhoyasmāḥ smaraṇa mātreṇa nityaṃ prātassamāhitaḥādyā sakalavedānāṃ mātā sakalasiddhidāsāvitrāṣṭākṣarī vidyā tṛtīyā kāṃtivarddhanītatasturīyagā patrī sāyujya phaladāyinīgaṃdharvarājavidyāva vivāha phaladāyinītatastārā mahāvidyā jalāyacchamanī smṛtāmahāgaṇeśavidyāva prayūhagaṇabhedinīmṛtyuṃjaya daśārṇātha mṛtyubhīti nivāriṇīmatṛkākhyā mahāvidyā sarvajñatva phalapradāsaṃpatsarasvatīvidyā mahāsaṃyatpradāyinīparaśaṃbhu mahāvidyā nityānaṃda sukhapradākumārikāvidyā samastepsitasiddhidāaśvārūṭhā mahāvidyā sarvalokavaśaṃkarīśrīdevyā mūlaviyāthā samastaphalabhogadāvāgvādinī tato vidyā vācāṃ siddhikarī parāśyāmalā pādukā paścāśyāmāvidyā phalapradāvidyātha laghu vārāhī sarvavairinikṛṃtanītiraskaraṇa vārāhī tiraskaraṇakāriṇividyātha rājavārtālī bhaktānu grahakāriṇīmahatī pādukāpaścāccaturvarga phalapradārājaśyāmā mahāvidyā vighnadevī tataḥ paraṃraśmimāeti saṃproktā śrīdevyā sarvasiddhidāsakṛddhedhā tridhā vāpi yonusmati sādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: avāpya mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ vāksiddhimatulāmapibrahmasāyujyamāpnoti dehāṃte nātra saṃśayaḥsa mahābhāgyasīhitassamastābhīṣṭa bhāgbhavetsakṛt dvedhā tridhā vāpismartavyā sarvasiddhidātatra taṃtreṣu munibhistattanmāhātmyamīritaṃśrīdevyāssarva rājñitvādraśmibhūtasmṛtā imāḥraśmimālā manusmṛtya sakṛdvādhi dine dinejagattriya sāmrājñī śrīdevī parameśvarīraśmimālā pradatāramācāryaṃ paramaṃ guruśrīdevī raśmimālāyāḥ pradātaivapi tāṃvikāsa eva vaṃdhussasakhā sa ācāryo mahānguruḥityeva mavyā satataṃ raśmimālāpradaṃ guruṃitaḥ paraṃ girisute kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasisuguptamapi vededeṣupurāṇeṣva khileṣvapisāṃprataṃ praṣṭumicchāmi hṛdaye kiṃcidastimeyāgānuṣvāna hīnāśca viprāḥ sādhāraṇāḥ smṛtāḥtepi sādhāraṇāḥ proktā viprā vedavidopivasaṃprāpya na hi varttaṃta cehu janmaśatairapitatrāpi raśmividyānīmālā sūkta mudīritaṃśrīdevyuyāmanā proktā raśmimālā samanvitaḥjaḍānāṃ madavuddhīnāṃ vidyāgrahaṇadhāraṇevedādhyayana hīnīścayāgānuṣṭhānavarjitāḥsaṃsārasāgarottārahe tu bhūtaṃ sanātanaṃvedārtha vodhaphalaṃ sarvakratu phalapradaṃsāṃgānuṣṭhānajanita phaladaṃ smṛti mātrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityukto girijā devyāśaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥśṛṇuṣvā vahitā devi bhadre kalyāṇi suṃdarikṛpayāte pravakṣyāmi rāmeṇa yadudīritaṃsuramye maṃdire hemaratnaharya suśobhitenavaratnamaye svarṇa divyasiṃhāsane śubhekirīṭahārakeyūra kūṃḍalādi vibhūṣitaṃsmitavaktraṃ vijaśālākṣavīrāsana samāśritaṃsaumitri bharatādyaiśca saṃsevita padāṃvujaṃvaśiṣṭa vāmadevādyaissevitaṃ ca maharṣibhiḥlīlā na dainarākṛti devaṃ trijagadrakṣaṇodyataṃsanakādyairmahāyogināyavairmānasaissutaiḥvedairmūrtidharaissākṣādvāgdevyā ca samanvitaḥmāyāmānuṣadehatvāt pratyutthāyārghyamādadedadau hiraṇyagarbhāya putrebhyopi yathāktamaṃsaumitri bharatādyaiśca vidhātā lokanāyakaḥamūrtaṃ yatparadhāmanirguṇaṃ ca niraṃjanaṃvedāṃtavedyaṃ vimalaṃ paraṃbrahmeti kathyateyadā pityātmakaṃ vahni caṃdrarūpaṃ sanātanaṃtrayīmayaṃ trayīvedyaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagato bhavānvirāṭ svarāṭvasaṃmrāddhatvame varadyunaṃdanapurāṇa dharmaśāstrāṇitvanuñjāvirbhavasutatatvameva mahāvāhoṣiśvarūpaṃ parātparaṃtvaṃ pitā sarvajagatāṃ svatassarvamidaṃ tataṃtvanmukhyādagniriṃdraśca caṃdramā manaso bhavatbrāhmaṇāstvammukhājjātā vāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyāstathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ahaṃ tvannābhi saṃbhūto rudromanyu sadbhavaḥvedā api ca vedāṃtā ahahaṃ rudropi devatāḥtavāyutāyuktaṃ śāṃśā māhātmyarmāya tatvataḥmadyā śaṃkaraśakrādyairapi saṃprārthito bhavānavatīrṇosi kauśalyāgarbhādaśārathānnṛpātrāmastvaṃ sarvalokānāmabhirāmosi bhūtaleramaṃte satataṃ tasmādrāmosi brahmatūpadhṛtsatvaṃ dāśarathirbhūtvā koṭiśo rajanīcarānābhiṣiktosya yodhyāyāṃ śriyā devyā na yānvitaḥprasīda satataṃ mahyaṃ jānakīnāyaka prabhobrahmāṇamavravīdvātmaṃdhātāraṃ parameśvaraḥagnihotreṣutvatsuteṣu mahātmasukimarthamāgatositvaṃ putrairetairsyahātmabhiḥittha bhagavatā brahmāpreritastapasāṃ nidhiḥeta siddhā mahābhāgāṃjita krodhā jiteṃdriyāḥdevarṣayo nāradāyā vā lakhilyā api prabhokratvanuṣṭhāna rahitā vadādhyayana varjitāḥtiṣṭaṃti vahavo viprā aśakto api karmasueteṣāṃ narakānmuktiḥ kalpāṃtepi na vidyateavaśyamapirtavyā yāgāssaṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥabhyastavyo mahāyogo nityamaṣṭāṃga saṃyutaḥsaṃsāratārako pāyo bhavatyetaissu karmabhiḥsaṃsāratāraṇopāyaḥ kathaṃ narakamocanaṃekana janmanā muktiruktā sarvaśrutiṣvapinyāsajālaṃ tathā pūjāsatra vākulyamastyapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhrmārtha kāmamokṣādiyumarthāḥ sakalā apiguruśuśrūṣayā vidyā smaraṇādapi kevalaṃsaptakoṭi mahāmaṃtra puraścaryā phalaṃ tathārājavidyāṃ mama vrūhi matsutebhyaśca sādaraṃtasmāra sarvasiddhānāmadhiyaṃ kapilaṃ vibhuyogābhyāsarataṃ śāṃtaṃ jagatryā hitaiṣiṇaṃtatrāgatastathaivāsau siddhayogi gaṇāvṛtaḥtaṃdṛṣṭā vismitassarve sahasosthāya vāyatāḥjānukīyatinā tatra pādyārghyairap pūjitaḥjāhūtosmitvayā sākṣānnārāyaṇa raghūttamakiṃ vaktavyaṃ mayā svāminnājñāpaya jagatpateuvāca svā"a saṃbhūtaṃ kapilaṃ kardamātmanaṃsarvayogavidācāryassarvalokahiterataḥpitāmahena sahitā atri bhṛtvādayopyamīahaṃ mānuṣa yonistho rājāsanagatohaṃnārāyaṇosi vidyānāṃ hetu stvamasivratamatsannidhau bhavānebhyaḥ kathaya svagururbhavānvisyasya kiṃcisrovā ca rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ vibhuṃādi madhyāṃtarahi tassatyānaṃda cidātmakaḥarūpo viśvarūpastvaṃ puruṣaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥbrahmaviṣṇu maheśānāmapyācāryo bhavānasidharmasaṃsthāpanārthyā paraghoranvaya saṃbhavaḥdevatā ṛṣayassiddhāvayaṃ brahmādayopyamītvadaśaṃ saṃbhavatvena sarvajñosmi sanātanaḥetebhyo brahmaputrebhyo rahasyaṃ kathayāmyahaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃtuṣṭā vismitā bhūtvā praṇemuḥ kapilaṃ vibhuṃsaṃsārataraṇoyāya ajāyāsādbhavennavāyadi sidhyatyanāyā sā tadupāyaṃvada svataḥsanakādīn mahābhāgānuvāca kapilaḥ prabhuḥyūyaṃ sakalavidyānāṃ pāragā dīrghadarśinaḥbhajadyamenaṃ saṃsāratāraka brahmasaṃjñitaṃasya niśvasitaṃ vedāssa rahasyāssanātanāḥetat kṛṭākṣaleśena viśvaṃ sarvamudetyapiguhāsu sarvabhūtānāṃ niviṣṭaḥ parameśvaraḥvedānadhītya sakalā niṣṭāyāgan sa dakṣiṇānetatkaikarya sidhyartaṃ prārthayaṃti mahaṣvapiḥyoginaḥ prārthayaṃtyetatsāyujyaṃ sarvāsaiddhikhyaṃmānuṣākṛti māyannaṃtadetaddrāmanāmakaṃijyoyamakhilairyāgaissaṃpūrṇavaradakṣiṇaiḥayaṃ vedamayo maṃtramūrtiryajñamayo vibhuḥiyaṃ sīmā mahābhāgācicchaktiḥ śrīrudīritāetadaṃśāṃśa saṃbhūto brahmāyaṃ viśvasargakṛtyajvāno dakṣiṇā yuktā vedādhyayana tatpurāḥadhītya sakalācedāniṣṭāpi sakalānkratūnbrahma tādātmya saṃsiddhi rācāryānugrahaṃ vinārāmābhidhaṃ mahat dhāma samupāsya vicakṣaṇāḥpuṇyaṃ pāpamiti proktaṃ dvividhaṃ karmabhūtalevedasyādhyayanaṃ puṇyaṃ vedānāmarthaciṃtanaṃsaṃpūrṇadakṣiṇā yuktaṃ yāgakarma phalapradaṃjapaḥ vaṃśakaravidyāyā vedamāturjayonvahaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīvidyāyā jayo nityaṃ brahmavidyā japonvahaṃśrīmaṣṭārṇavidyāyānyāsa raśmi samanvitaṃkṣīṇe samastayāyaudy vahujanmabhirjitedharmeṣvevācalā vuddhirjāyate dvijapuṃgavāḥtataḥ śivatvaṃ nārāyaṇāṃ yāsti ratobhyupaiti tataḥparaṃ śāśvatamacyutatvaṃtatsaṃyogīrti vikhyātāḥ paṃcapātakinastvamīviśvasta viṣadātā ca vālaghrogarbhapātakaḥekādaśasyurmadyāni tālajādīni bhūtaleācāryapatnī tatputrī svamātā svabhaginyapietāmātaradratyuktāstatsaṃgāduruttalyaṃgaḥvidyācauryaṃ dukūlānāṃ cauryaṃsteyamudīritaṃācāryaniṃdā śravaṇaṃ svayamācārya dvaḍhyaṇaṃbrahmahatyā samānisyuḥ pātakāni dvijottamāḥākalyaṃ narake duḥkhameteṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ phaletatkṛtvaiva vimuktaḥ syāt pāpebhyo nānyathā dvijātadaiva paramaṃ jñānamutyatsyati kalevareutpatsyati mahahānamapavargapradāyakaṃpituḥ putrasya saṃvādaṃ pāpe kalvedvijṛrṣabhāḥkṛto yanayanaṃ śāṃtaṃ sumatiṃ jaḍarūpiṇaṃguruśuśrūṣaṇa vyagro bhikṣānnakṛta bhojanaḥiṣṭamutpādayāpatyamāśrayethā vanaṃ tataḥevamāṣṭyasitahya yatra gatvā na śocatipitāputrasu vahuśaḥ prāhaprītyā punaḥ punaḥsaṃcodya māno vahuśaḥ prahasyedamathāvravīt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
