sanskrit: bhagavadraśmi vidyānāṃ samudāyasya bhūpategāyatryādīnicchaṃdāṃsi viśvāmitrādayodvijāḥtatrāpi nānāchaṃdāṃsi sarvatejomayo vibhuḥharirnārāyaṇaḥsvāmīdevatāsamudīritaḥasaṃkhyātamaḥ puṃjapijarīkṛtadiṅmukhaṃraśmimālāṃ japitvaivamārṣachaṃdādikaṃ nyasetpratyekamārṣaṃ chaṃdaśca vinyasyātha ṣaḍaṃgakaṃsāvitrāṣṭākṣarī vidyāmahāsiddhipradāyinīaṣṭalakṣaṃ puraścaryāddaśāṃśaṃtaparyayetpayaḥathavāravivāreṇasahiteraviparvaṇitilairgavyājyasahitairhutvāgnau saṃskṛte śubhevahusasyayutāṃ pṛthvīṃ datvā dakṣiṇayānvitāṃjaptvā dvādaśalakṣāṇi tarpayitvā gavāṃ payaḥkuṣṭharogāt pramucyate tadurvicitrādanekaśaḥpāyasānnamatho hutvā vātarogādvimucyatebhagaṃdarānmeharogādagnimāṃdyācca mucyatesahasrayāddhuvaṃajīrṇarogānmucyete netrarogāccadāruṇātśirorogādvimucyetamūlarogāccaduḥsahātnānāvidhānnalarogānmaṃḍalena vimucyateprakṣālyamukharogebhyo vimukto bhavati dhruvaṃasādhyairapi mukto saurogajālaiḥ suduḥsahaiḥsaṃprāpyamahatīṃ lakṣmīmaṇimādi guṇānvitāmaṣṭottara sahasraṃyaḥ prātaḥ snātvānvahaṃ japetdehāṃte samavāpnoti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathaivānya niśāstrāṇi śilpāni vividhāninirvedāḥ paritoyāścaye ca vṛdhnudayetathāmātaro vahudhā hṛṣāḥ pitaro vahavastathāvādhavāhavaḥ prāptāḥ pitaraśca pṛthagvidhāḥgarbhaduḥkhānyanekāni vālatve yovane tathābrāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ caiva yoniṣutathaiva rājabhṛtyānāṃ rājñāmāhavaśālināṃbhṛtyatāṃdātatāṃ cāpi gatosmi vahuśo nṛṇāṃhṛtaṃ mayāhṛtaṃ cānyairhatavānūdyātitastathāpitṛmātṛsuta bhrātṛ kalatrādi kṛtena caitthayaṃ sāracakresmin bhramatānāta saṃkaṭevijñāte yatra sarvoyamṛgyayuḥ sāmasaṃjñitaḥtasmādutyanna vodhesya vedaiḥ kiṃ me prayojaneguṇaiśca varjitaṃ brahman tatmākṣyāmi paraṃ padaṃvijñātānya mṛgagrāhī saṃgapāśa śatākulātrayī dharmamadharmākhyaṃ kiṃ pākaphalasannibhaḥpitā prāha mahābhāgaṃ svasutaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥkena teja utā pūrvamidānīṃ ca prabuddhatāyatte jñāṃtiro bhūtamāvirbhāvamupāgataṃyaścā hṛmā samanyasmin janmanyasmāt yasmāt yasra tatātmaniṣṭhā vicāreṣu yaniṣṭhāṃ parāṃgataḥsatsaṃyogāt satsvabhāvā dvicāraṇā gati vodhanātācāryatī ca saṃprāptaḥ śiṣyasaṃdehahṛttamaḥathāyāto prahāyogī sākṣācchiṣyo vivasvataḥtadṛṣṭvā tithimāyāṃtaṃ yājñavalkyaṃ mahāmati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmasāyujya sidhyarthaṃ yācāṃ ca kṛtavānahaṃgomahiṣyādikaṃ muktāralarāśiṃ gṛhe sthitaṃviyājñānaṃ mama vrūhītyevaṃ prārthitavānahaṃrājarājeśvarīṃ vidyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇīṃ parāṃtāmevānusmaran vidyāṃ taddine pārameśvarīṃhṛdi ajñātāniṣṭa sadbhāvo vipannaśca prasādataḥutkrāṃti kālādārabhya smṛti lopo name bhavatpūrvābhyāse na tenaiva sāhaṃtāta jiteṃdriyaḥjñānadāna phalaṃ hyeta ghṛjjāti smaraṇaṃ mamasohaṃ pūrvāśramā devabhiṣṭhā dharmamupāgataḥekāṃtatvamupāśritya yatiṣyāmyātmamokṣaṇetadvrūhitvaṃ mahābhāgatyaṃ yatesaṃśaṃśamitaṃ hṛdietāvatāpite prīti mutyāyān rāghamāmuyāṃbhavatā yadvayaṃṣṭāssaṃsāragahanāśrayaṃsaṃsāracakra sataraṃ sthitiryatra na vidyateutkrāṃti kālādārabhyathā nānyo vadiṣyatianubhūtaṃ mahat karmaphalaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇubhinatri marmasthānāni dīvyamānoniriṃdhanaḥbhuktānāmaṃvu bhakṣāṇā madhogati nirodhakṛtdattāssatasyāmāhlādamāyadi pratipadyatesoti tṛpti mavāpnoti vināpyannena vai tadāāstikaḥ śraddhadānaśca sa sukhaṃ mṛtyumṛcchatiśuklā vadāmyāhrī maṃtaste narāssukhamṛtyavaḥyathoktakārī saumya"ca sa sukhaṃ mṛtyumacchatiprāpnuvaṃti narāḥ kāle tasmin mṛtyāvupasthite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇighnā vedanāṃ kaṣṭāṃyenye codvega kāriṇaḥkūṭasākṣī mṛṣāvādī āśāsyānanuśāstiyaḥvibhīṣaṇāḥ pūtigaṃdhāḥ kūṭamuharapāṇayaḥprāteṣu kūpathaṃ teṣu jāyate tasyavpathuḥsāsya vāgasphuṭā tata ekavarṇā vibhāvyatetatassavedanāviṣṭastaccharīraṃ vimuṃcatitatkarma japātanotthaṃ samātṛtṛ saṃbhavetatodvatāyamasyāśupāśairvadhvāti dāruṇaiḥkuśakaṃṭaka valmīkaśaṃku pāṣāṇakarkaśepradīptāditya tapte ca datvamānastadaṃ śubhiḥvikṛṣyamāṇastairdyorai bhakṣyamāṇaḥ śivāśataiḥchatroyānat pradātmaroye ca veśma pradā narāḥevaṃ kṛśānanu bhavannavaśaḥ pāpapīḍitaḥkalevare dahyamāne mahāṃtaṃ dāhamṛcchatisidyamāneṣya virataṃ jaṃturduḥkhamupāśrutetatra yadvāṃ dhavāstoyaṃ prayacchaṃti tilaissahatailābhyaṃgaṃ vāṃdhavānāmaṃga saṃvāhanaṃ ca yatbhūmau svapadbhirnātyartha kleśamāpnoti vāṃdhavaiḥtasmādannāni deyāni pretatṛptyārthamādarātnīyamānaḥ svavaṃgohaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ sa paśyatidvādaśāhāt paraṃ ghoraṃ vāya saṃbhīṣaṇā kṛtiṃgattamātrātirakākṣaṃ bhinnāṃjana samaprabhaṃdaṃṣṭrā karālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭī kuṭilākṛtiṃdaṃḍāsakta mahāvāhuṃ pāśahastaṃ su bhairavaṃraurave kūṭasākṣī tu yāti paścānṛto naraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yojanānāṃ sahasredve rauravopi pramāṇataḥtatrāṃgāra cayopetaṃ kṛtaṃ cadvaraṇī samaṃtanmadhye pāpakarmāṇaṃ vimuṃcaṃti yamānugāḥpadeṣade ca pādosyaśīryate jāyate punaḥevaṃ sahasraṃ vistīrṇaṃ yojajanānāṃ vimucyatetataḥ sarveṣu nistīrṇaḥ pāpītiryakṛmaśrutegatvādumagajādyeṣu gośvaśveṣu tathaiva camānuṣyaṃ prāpya kubjo vā kutsito vāmanopi vāavaśiṣṭena pāpena puṇyena ca samanvitaḥtataścārohiṇīṃ yoniṃ śūdravaiśyatṛvādikāṃevaṃ hi pāpakarmāṇo narakeṣu yataṃtyadhaḥteya mena vinirdiṣṭā yāṃti puṇyāṃ gatiṃ narāḥhāranūpuramādhuryaśobhitānya malāni catessācca pracyutā rājñā manyeṣā ca mahātmanaṃbhogān saṃprāsuvaṃtyagryāt tathāyāṃtyūrddhamanyathāetatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā jaṃturvipadyateniṣekemāna vastrīṇāṃ vīje prāpte rajasyathanāmisūle tataḥ sthairyaṃ yāti vījadvayaṃ hhi tatpeśyāṃ yathāṇu vījasya aṃvurastadva ucyateauyogānyaṃgulīnetranāsāsya śraṇāni catvagamyo romāṇi jāsaṃte keśāścaiva tataḥ paraṃnārikela phalayaṃ itsakośaṃ vṛddhimṛcchatitaletu jānu pārśvābhyāṃ varayornyasyavarddhatejānupṛṣṭhe tathā netre jānumadhye ca nāsikāeva mṛddhiṃ kramādyāti jaṃtu strīgarbhasaṃsthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāṭhinyamagnināyāti bhuktapīte na jīvatināḍī cāpyāpinī nāmanābhyāṃtasya nivadhyatekrāmaṃti bhuktapītāni strīṇā garbhodare tayāsthitiṃ tatra prayāṃtyasya vasvaḥ saṃsārabhūmayaḥpunanairva kariṣyāmi muktamātra ihodarātśaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ pītavā sa samacyutaṃciṃtayabhavaduḥkhaudyādbhaviṣyāmi vimocitaḥyāni pūrdhānu bhūtāni daivabhūtātmakāni vaibhavamedaśameṣāpi māsi saṃjāyate tataḥniṣkampate ca vilayan tadā duḥkhena pīḍitaḥprāpnoti cetanāṃ vāsau vāyusparśāyute punaḥtapāṣi mohitātmāsau jñānabhraṃśamavāpnuterudanmatkuṇavādhādi pīḍito bhṛśamāturaḥprāpya kāmāturo nityaṃ taruṇī saṃgalolupaḥvṛddhatāmapi saṃprāpya śleṣmavānādipīḍitaḥsaṃsāracakresminnāmyate ghāṭī yaṃtravatsvargaṃ ca bharakaṃ caiva kadācidvayamaśrutekadācidvyutakarmā ca itaḥ svalpena gacchatisvargaloke ca narake bhukta prāyairdvijottamaidṛśyaṃte tātamodaṃtaḥ pātya mānaistu nārakaiḥprabhṛtyahaṃ patiṣyāmītye tanmanasi vartateetāṃ yati mahagaṃtetyaharniśa manirvṛtaḥjātasya vā labhāve ca vṛddhatve duḥkhameva caduḥkhaprāyāvṛddhatā ca maraṇo duḥkhamuttamaṃpunaśca garbhe janmātha maraṇaṃ narakaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhrāmyaṃte prākṛtairvaṃdhairvaddhvāvatyaṃticā sakṛtevaṃ mokṣāya yatatā kathaṃ sevyā trayī mayījñānapradāna saṃbhūtaṃ samāśrityu mahatphalaṃvarṇitastanmahācakṣye vistareṇa mahāmatemahārauravasaṃjñaṃ tu śṛṇuṣva narakaṃ pitaḥtatra tāmramayī bhūmiradhastasyā hutāśanaḥvibhāsyati mahāraudrādarśana sparśanādiṣumucyate pāpakṛnmadhye luṭhasānassa gacchatibhakṣamāṇastathāgṛdhraidaṃtāmārge vikṛṣyatevadatya sakṛdudvignonaśāṃtimupagacchativarṣāyutāyuta pāpayaiḥ kṛtaṃ duṣṭavuddhibhiḥmahārauravavaddīrghastathāṃdhamahasāvṛtaḥparaspadaṃ samāsādya parirabhyāśrayaṃtikṣudraṣṇāti valodignāstathā cānyepyupa ivāḥmajjāsṛgālitaṃ tasmādaśraṃte cakṣudhānvitāḥevaṃ tatrāpi sumahākleśastamasi mānavaiḥnikṛṃta iti khyātastatonyo narakottamaḥteṣvāropya nikṛsyaṃte kālasūtrenamānavāḥna teṣāṃ jīvita bhraṃśo jayate dvijasattamaevaṃ vārṣa sahasrāṇi bhrāmyaṃte pāpakarmiṇaḥapratiṣṭhaṃ ca narakaṃ śṛṇuṣvagadato mamatānyeva tatra cakrāṇi ghaṭī yaṃtrāṇi cāpyutacakreṣvā ropitāḥ kecidbhrāmyaṃte tatra mānavāḥyaṃtreṣu caivānyevadvāstoya ghaṭī yathāāṃtrairmukheṣu nighnāṃtairnetrairāṃ śrāvalaṃvibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asipatravanaṃ nāma naraka śṛṇu cāparayojanānāṃsaptasūrya karaiḥ channaiḥ kalpāṃtānaladāruṇaiḥtanmadhye ca vanaṃ śītamapi patraṃ vibhāvyateśvānaśca tatra śavalāḥ svanaṃtyayutaśobhitaḥtattastadvanamālokya śiśiracchāyamagrātaḥhātātahāmātaritikraṃdaṃtotīvaduḥkhitāḥteṣāṃ gatānāṃ tatrāpi patrapātī samīraṇaḥpataṃtite bhūmau jvalatyākūka saṃcayesārameyāstataḥ śīghrīśātayaṃti śarīriṇaḥasi yatradyanaṃ tatra mayai tatkīrtitaṃ tavasamaṃ tatasta sa kuṃbhā vahni jvālā samāvṛtāḥteṣu duṣṭata karmāṇebhyāmyaiḥ kṣiptādyadho mukhāḥsphuṭat kapālanetrāsthi vidyamānā vibhīṣaṇaipunaḥ śimiśimāyaṃte tailenaikyaṃ vrajaṃtitetatoyāmyairbhadūrā pradavīghanavattathāpṛṣate visteraṇoktastapta kuṃbho mayāpitaḥsamatīte gavārodhaṃ vipāne kṛtavātpurāmaṃprāptosmi śivādyo ramayo mukha khagākulaṃvikṛṣyamāṇoduṣkarmastanitartikhākulaṃmahātvāyārtitaptasya tṛṣṇādāvārddhi tasya cakaraṃ bhavālukā taptamadhyasthassamupāgataḥmama cāpi yathā svarge svargiṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ parāḥiṣṭamasmābhirāsannaṃ nararatnamanuttamaṃpurato darśayanmārgamiti ehīti mānadanarakaṃ prāhataṃ yāmyaṃ kiṃ karaṃ kṛpayānvitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dumayāyenedaṃ yātanānīṣmaṃ prāptosmi narakaṃ paraṃjāto videha viṣaye samyaṅmanujapālakaḥnotsṛṣṭaścaiva saṃgrāmo nātiyirvimukho gataḥkṛttāspṛhā na ca mayā parastrī vidhāvādiṣupuruṣaṃ svayamāyāṃtimipānamivadhe navaḥtasmādiṣṭaśca pūrtaśca dharmau dvāvapi naśyataḥtrijanmasaṃbhavaṃ devaniśvāsohaṃtya saṃśayaḥsohaṃ kathamimaṃ prāpto narakaṃ mṛśadāruṇaṃuvāca puruṣo yāmyo ghorotha prastutaṃ vacakistusvalpaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpe bhavatāsmārayāmi tatmahādānāni dattāni śrotriyebhyastvayādarātśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā tvayā samyagupāsitācaṃdrasūryagrahabhānu saṃkrameṣu bhṛgordinedatvā sahasraśaḥ svarṇapaśuratna samākulāmahālakṣmīdhiyā sākṣāt pūjitā māsimāsyapiupāsitāstvayā samyaka pautrā na tṛmukhā apiācāryaniṃdā karuṇāṃ samyak śikṣātvayā kṛtādīnārāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi paṃcadehītite guruḥdāruṇaṃ narakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tena pāpena bhūyatetadehigaccha puṇyānāsupabho vajrattugāyapārthivacitpṛcchāmi tatnmetvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasipunaḥ punaśca netrāṇi tadvadeṣāṃ bhavaṃti caharaṃ tyeṣāṃ tathā jihvāṃ jāyamānāṃ punastathākarapatreṇayātyaṃte tasmādeteti duḥkhitāḥayo mukhaiḥ khagaiścaiva kṛṣyaṃte kiṃ vidhau vada
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āpaścaṃcu nipātena sarvāṃgakṣatiduḥkhitāḥetā eścānyāśca dṛśyaṃte yojanāḥ pāpakarmaṇāṃyanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhūpāla pāpakarma phalodayaṃpuṇyā puṇye tu puruṣaḥ paryāyesā samaśrutena tu bhogādṛte pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ vā karmamābhavaṃdurbhikṣā devadurbhikṣaṃ kleśākleśaṃ bhayādayaṃutsavādut savaṃ yāṃti svargāt svargaṃ sūkhātsukhaṃvyālakuṃjara durgāṇikhyaṃ ghorabhayāni casugaṃdhimālyaṃ dvastra sādhuyānāṃ śubhāsanāḥanekajanma sāhasrajanma saṃcayasaṃcitaṃyathā hi vījaṃ bhūpālayayāṃsi samavīkṣatesvalpaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ puṃsāṃ deśo kālopapāditaṃtatprabhūtataraṃ sthūlaṃ śaṃku kīlakasaṃbhavaṃapathyāśana śītolla śramatāpādditārakaṃevaṃ mahāṃti pāpāni dīrgharogādika kramealpaṃ puṇyaṃ śubhaṃ gaṃdhaṃ helayā saṃprayacchativirādgurutaraṃ yadvanmahāṃtamapi kālajaṃbhuṃjānoneka saṃsāre saṃbhavannihatiṣṭhatitiṣṭhaṃti kiṃ tatra pakvāni ligamātretaṣvarātmaniakurvan pātarkakamu puṇyaṃ vāpya vatiṣṭhateprabhūta mathavā svalpaṃ vikriyākāracetasaḥupabhogākṣayaṃ yāti bhajyamānamivāśanaṃkṣapayaṃti narāghoraṃ narakāṃtaravartinaḥgaṃdharva siddhāpsarasī gītāthairuparbhujatepuṇyapāpodbharvabhuṅkte sukhaduḥkhopalakṣaṇaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kena kena vipākena tanne vakṣyāśestataḥmānasena ca dṛṣṭena paradravyaṃ ca saspṛhaiḥpunaṣpunaśca saṃbhūti rakṣṇoreṣāṃ bhavatyapitāvadvarṣāṇi netrārtimete prāptyāṃtyavāritāṃsamyak pṛṣṭe vināśāparipūṇāmapi mānavaitadame parvatasyāgrātyataṃtyeva punaḥ punaḥharaṃti teṣāṃ jihvāṃjajāyamānāṃ punaḥ punaḥśrīsadaṣṭārṇavidyāyā ācāryasya mahātmanaḥtāvat kalpasahasrāṇi jihvāmeṣāṃ punaḥ punaḥśrīyadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ śriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣarītasyodaraṃ khaḍgapatrairbhāgaśaḥ khaṃdarpatyapiācāryama parāmṛśya gṛhastheyo dine dinevivāha yāgakāryeṣu puraścaryādi karmasubhikṣitvāpi nayairdartā patnīputrādipoṣakaiḥetatkalpasāhasraṃ majjaṃti narakārṇaveyājyoyādhyāyayormātrāsutasya sahacāriṇaḥtadrame paśyayātyaṃte karapatreṇa pārthivaḥtālavṛṃtānisra snānacaṃdanośīrahāriṇaḥkaraṃ bhavālukā saṃsthāsta ime pāpabhoginaḥdaivevāpyatha vā pitrye sa dvidhā kṛṣyate khagaiḥtamevamadyamānāstu khagastiṣṭhaṃtyavāritāḥpādyate hṛdvidhā jihvā tasya tanni hitaiḥ kṣuraiḥtadramepūya viṇmūtra garte marjatyadho mukhāḥabhuktavatsuyeśraṃti tadvalpitrāgni yakṣiṣujāyate girivarṣmāṇaḥ paśyaite yādṛśā narāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: idamuktamathātreyavyāsayorapi vakṣyatemāhātmyaṃ yasyavijñānaranmahatīṃ siddhimaśnuteaiṃdrasvaraṃ vyomavījaṃ tṛtīyasvarasaṃyutaṃityekoktāmahāvidyādattātreyasyayoginaḥdattātreyapadaṃ paścāccaturthāṃtasamanvitaṃpratyekaṃ vājapedvidyāṃmilitaṃ vā dvayaṃ japetsamastavidyāsāmrājyasiddhidāmuktidāyinīdattātreya mahāvidyā japtavyāttairmahīyateaṣṭāṃgasahitaṃ yogaṃ brahmajñānaṃ sanātanaṃpādukāṃjana khaḍgādi siddhāṣṭakamamīpsatācorāriduṣṭasaṃdhebhyomahābhayanivāraṇaṃicchratādattatavidyeyaṃ prajaptavyā mahīpatejāgataṃ chaṃdaṃ ityuktaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥśaktirmāyāpāśavījamaṃkuśaṃkīlakaṃ smṛtaṃnattiṃ śaktimiti prāhurbrahmatādātmyasiddhayeṣaḍdīrghayutamāyārṇāṃ kuśārṇābhyāṃ ṣaḍaṃkaṃnīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ jarāmaṃḍalaśomitaṃpārijātatarormūledivyasiṃhāsanāśritaṃmudrāṃ jñānamaryāṃ dakṣahaste vāme'bhayaṃ tathāprasannavadanaṃ śāṃtaṃ susmitāna na paṃkajaṃsiddhavidyādharagaṇaiḥ sevitaṃ ca maharṣibhiḥsahitaṃ nāradādyaiśca sevitaṃ trijagatpatiṃdattātreya mahāvidyāmiti dhyātvā japat śuciḥlakṣatrayaṃ puraścaryādekaikasya manornṛpaguravedakṣiṇāṃ datvā sarvasvamapi sādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣamaṃ bhojayaṃtī havidbhujāsta imeyathāteṣāmetegni kuṃbheṣu prajvalatkhāhitāḥ karāḥteṣāṃ yāmyairnarairmaṃtranyasto vahnissamedhatejāmayo guravo vṛddhāḥ spṛṣṭāyaistu padānṛbhiḥaṃgārarāśi madhyasthāstiṣṭhatyājānudāhinaḥmuktāniyairasaṃskṛtya teṣā māṃtrāṇi pāpināḥsaṃśairapakṛṣyate narairyāmyairmukhā tataḥayomayāni śūlāni tatkarṇeṣu punaḥ punaḥekasmin divase vāpi yajjācāye spaśāsanaṃākalyapūrayet yete śūlāni vasudhāyetanidāniśāmitāyaiśca pāpānāmabhiniṃdatāṃkarṇeṣu pūrayetthete yāmyā vilapatāmayibhaddhāvidhaṃ samānītāḥ krodhalobhānuvartibhiḥpṛthakurvaṃtite yāmyāḥ śarīrādatidāruṇāḥteṣāmeptā nivṛṣyaṃtagudenāṃtrāpivāyasaiḥsatvevenaikadhāchinnaḥ kṣāranadyī pravātyateputramṛtyukalatrādi vaṃdhuvargama kiṃcanaṃdvakṛtya dattāni mukhe svamāsānyaplutakṣudhādurbhikṣe saṃbhrame vāpi svācāryaṃ bhagavanmayaṃtasya vaktre male mūtramākalpaṃ kiṃkarāḥprāraṇāgataṃ yastyajati lobhādukto ca jīvanaḥsukṛtaṃ ye prayacchaṃti yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ narāḥnyāsā pahāriṇo vadvāssarvagātreṣu vaṃdhanaiḥkṣuttāpatṛdbhapta jihvātālavo vedanātarāḥmūṣāyāmapi paśyaitāndhyāyamānānyamānugaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udhyāyamadhaḥ kṛtvā taccauryādhyayanaṃ naraḥvibhrat kleśamavāpnoti yamamārgeti pīḍitaḥśleṣma mūtrapurīṣāṇiyairut sṛṣṭānivāriṇiparasparaṃ ca māṃsāni bhakṣayaṃti kṣudhārditāḥpatit pratigrahādānādyājunābhritya sevanātpaśyato mṛtyavargesya mitrāṇāmatithestathāayaṃ kṛtaghno mitrāṇāmayakārī sudurmatiḥkaraṃbha vālukāṃ tasmāttato yaṃtrāvapīḍitaḥkālasūtraṃ tathācchedamanekāścaivayātanāḥśrāddhasaṃgatino viprāssamupetya parasparaṃsvarṇasteyī ca vicavipraghna surāpagurukṛtyagāḥtiṣṭhaṃtyabda sahasrāṇi suvahvani punaḥ punaḥmṛtāḥ punaśca narakaṃ punarjvātāścatā dṛṣṭāṃbrahmaghno vā pitṛghne vā surāye gurutalyagaunāstyācāryadruho vedadharmaśāstreṣu niṣkṛtiḥnarake vasatiḥ proktāmanvādyairdharmapāragaiḥdharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhavedaśāstreṣu niścitaṃācaran sarvapāpebhyo vimuktassukhamaṣṇutevimukta upapāpebhyo gaṃdharvaissamodateśrotiyobhyaḥ pradatvāsau sarvapāpa vivarjitaḥabhyāgatātithibhyo yo dadātpannaṃ dine ditedatvā vāsāṃsi śuddhātmā śrotriyebhyo dine dinealaṃkārāṃścaralāni śrotriyebhyaḥ samapya caaśvadānaṃtuya kuryācchrotriyāya dvijātayegajadānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā vedavedāṃgavedine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadātyāṃdolikāṃ yastu sarvopaskarasaṃyutāṃpayasvinīṃ savatsāṃgāṃ yo dadāti dvijātayedvimukhīṃ go narodatvā sāṃga dakṣiṇayānvitāṃvimānavaramārūḍhasmiddha devamunistutaḥtulāpuruṣa mukhyāni mahādānāni suvrataḥgocarma sammitāṃ bhūmiṃ kaḍusasya samanvitāṃvimuktassakalān bhogāni haladhvāpi durlabhānsastutassukartairdevairdivyakanyā śatānvitaḥdvijāḥ sakalavarṇebhyaḥ pūjyāḥ śreṣṭhā mahītalejñānibhyopyādhikāḥ proktarayajvāno bhūri dakṣiṇāḥdakṣaṃ brahmavide kiṃcidapye kasmindine nṛpasahasrā brahmavibhyo yo dadāti dhanamakṣayaṃkulāpnutaṃ samuddhṛtyamayaṃ ca narakārṇavedaridrāya dvijāyāpi vivāha dhanamādarātśataṃ vivāhya viprāṇāṃ dhanaṃ datvā supuṣkalaṃśatasāhasrasaṃkhyāka brahmavidbhyo dine dinedaridrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca vivāhya dhanasaṃcayaiḥtatodhikaphalaṃ prāpya bhagavat kiṃkaro bhavetsu ācārya iti proktassarva tatvārtha vittamaiḥyena dattā mahābhāga tatopyācārya uttamaḥdīyateyebha kṛpayāsa sākṣādbhagavanmayaḥtameva sākṣādbrahmāṇaṃtame vācyutamīśvaraṃrājarājeśvarīn maṃtrā lakṣmīnārāyaṇīṃ śubhāṃyo dadāti tamācārya māhussarvetimaṃ vudhāḥsarvajñoyaṃ vahadbhānurgoga svarṇapavargadaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrame hṛdānetyodhikaṃ viddhi bhūpateācāryameva jānīhisyakṣādbhagavadākṛtiṃniṣkamātraṃ pradānena svācārya caraṇāṃvucceparaniṃdākṛtaghratvaṃ paramarmopaghaṭanaṃparasvaharaṇāśauraṃ devatānāṃ ca kutsanaṃācāryaniṃdā śravaṇaṃ tadājñollaṃghana tathācihnaṃ nārakiṇāmetadekaikamapi vā nṛpadayāruteṣu sadbhāvaḥ paralokaṃ pratikriyāgurudevarṣi siddhārthipūjanaṃ sādhusaṃgamaḥanyāni daivasadgarmakriyā bhūtāni yāni caetaddude śatorājyanbhavataḥ kathitaṃ mayātedahyanyatrāchāvodṛśaṃ sarvāṃ tvayādhunātatastamagrataḥ kṛtvā surājāgaṃtumudyataḥprasādaṃ kurudeveśatiṣṭha tāvanmuhurtakeparitā paṃcagātrebhyaḥ pīśavāvośca kṛtanaśaḥetacchratvāvacasteṣāṃta yāsyaṃ puruṣaṃ nṛpakiṃ mayā karma tatpuṇyaṃ satyaloke mahatkṛtaṃpitṛdevā tithi preṣya śiṣṭenānnena tena tutattahṛtvadgātra saṃparkāt pavanohlādadāyakaḥaśvamedhādayo yāgāstvayeṣṭā vidhivadyataḥbhagavadraśmi sahitā sadguroḥ kṛpayā nṛparājarājeśvarīviṣā lakṣmīnārāyaṇī parāācāryapatnī putrādi bhuktā śiṣṭaṃ dine dinemaṇimuktā suvarṇādi sarvasvaṃ bhavatārthitaṃpīḍana chedadāhādi mahāduḥkhasya hetavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadimatsannidhā vetānyāsanā na pravādhateḥehi rājeṃdra gacchāvo nijapuṇya amārtitānna svarge brahmaloke vā tatsukhaṃ labhyate naraiḥtasmānnatāvayāsyāmiyā yāvadetesu dukhitāḥdhikṛsya jīvitaṃ puṃsaḥ śaraṇārthi navāgataṃyajñadānataṃpī sāhaparatra na ca bhūtayasutpiyā sodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ yacca mūrdhvaśapradaṃ mahātprāptyaṃtyete yadi sukhaṃ vahavo duḥkhitemapiavaśyamasmādgatavyaṃ tasmāt pārthivagamyatāṃnayāmitvāmahaṃ svargatvayā samyagupāsitaḥyadi jānāsi dharmatvaṃ ratvaṃ vadiva śatakratoadhiṃdavopathāṃbhodheryathā vā divitārakāḥasaṃkhyeyāstathā rājanyathā yoniṣu jaṃtavaḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā raśmimālā samanvitālakṣmīnārāyaṇīnāmnā rājarājeśvarī parāapyācārya padadvadve pratyahaṃ vāṃchitaṃarpitaṃ gośataṃ nityaṃ tvayācārya padāṃvujevahuvāraṃ tvayāstamudrikā bharaṇādikaṃmahālakṣmīdhiyā sākṣāt savaryerdha supūjitāanena suvṛte naiṣāṃ yātanāvilayaṃgatāḥbrahmalokagataṃ rājanagurusaṃtoṣaṇāttavatadeva śatasāhasrasaṃkhyāmupagataṃ tavaete tu narake pāpaṃ kṣayayaṃ tu svakarmajaṃyadi tatsannidhāveṣāmutkarṣonopajāyatemamāstitetsurādhīśa vedaprāmāṇyamasticet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: eva muccataraṃ sthānatvayai vāptaṃ mahīpatetato yatatpuṣpavṛṣṭistasyopari mahīyatevimānamadhiropyainaṃ divyabhogasamyadgidaṃahaṃ cānye ca yate yātṛnābhyaḥ paricyutāḥpurānubhavajaṃ jñānamavāpyodīritaṃ mayāsvarūpapathihrehasya ghaṭīyaṃtravadavyayaṃkiṃ yayā putravaikāryaṃvadacāsmin vyavasthiterājarājeśvarīvidyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇī parāṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīmādau japan vidyāṃ dine dineihāpyaṣṭaguṇaiśvaryaṃ prāpyā khilamanorathānyato nā vartate mūmau saṃsāre duḥkhasaṃkulerājarājeśvarīvidyākātva yoktātya phalapradāanadhītyāpivā vedānvedadhyayanaphalaṃṭukathaṃ saṃprāpyate puṃbhistatsarvamakhilaṃ vadahitāya sarvajagatāṃ bhavasāgaratārakaṃnityaṃ saṃdhyāmupāsīta triṣu kāleṣu suvrataḥhotavya magnau satataṃ sāyaṃ prātaryatātmanādharmaśāstra purāṇāni iṣṭavyāni dine dineete dharmā gṛhasthasyapuritadhvaṃsa hetavaḥavaśyamapi kartavyā yāgāssaṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥamarairbhujyate svargasukhaṃ śāśvatamakṣayaṃsāṃgadakṣiṇayāyukta yāgakartrā niraṃtaraṃcaturyugaśataṃ svargasauravyamakṣayamuttamaṃagnihotrarataḥ sāyaṃ prātavedareśuciḥpunarbhūtalamāssadya satkarma niratassadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sānitrī jāpanirataḥ pitṛmātṛ prapūjakaḥsāṃga dakṣiṇayāyukta yāgakartā mahītalesatyalokaṃ samāsādya sukhaṃ kalpāṃtamakṣayaṃutpannassarṣavidyānāṃ pārago tithipūjakaḥsatkarmanirao dāṃto dehāṃte bhūlokabhākamaharṣīṇāṃ kule jātassarvavidyā suniṣṭhitaḥbrahmajñānaṃ samāsādya tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃnānā yoniṣu sabhūya prāpyajasānma śatānyapimalamūtrādi saṃkīrṇo garbheṣu vahuleccasauvālyayauvanakaumāsvārddhākādīnyanu kramātpuṇyapāpavaśāt svargasukhaṃduḥkhaṃ ca nārakaṃbrahmārpaṇādhiyā kṛtvā karma vedeṣu coditaṃbhaviṣyati vaidikācāranitara ācāryacaraṇārcakaḥdivyarūpadharaḥ paścāt kalpāṃtaṃ brahmalokabhāktadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃdhāma prayāt yatra na saṃśayaḥprāṇairarthairdhiyāvācā kāyena manasāpi cakulasāhasrasahito divyabhoga samanvitaḥmūlamācārya śuśrūṣā bhuktermukteśca bhūtalekiṃkarā nūtanayān kṛtvā svayaṃ tatyādakiṃkaraḥavaśyaṃ brahmasāyujyaṃ prāpnotyekena janmanāanādṛttha mahādānairapi yāma sahasrakaiḥna vrūyāda nṛtaṃ vākyaṃ kvacit kutrāpi sadguroḥśikṣayet pitarau vāpi svācāryasya viniṃdakauvimuktā ratnagajāśvādi dhanaṃdhānyaṃ mahītaleekamapyanṛtaṃ vākyaṃ saṃbhāḍyācārya sannidhau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryacaraṇadvaṃdva sannidhau niṣkapātrakaṃmāsābhyaṃtarato deyaṃ tadūrdhva vṛddhiprayutaṃmāsot prāgeva dātavyaṃ māsannitratayatothavāmāsa paṃcakataḥ prāgvādeyaṃ vṛddhi samanvitaṃtadūrdhva dviguṇaṃ deyaṃ vatsarāt triguṇaṃ tathāpradatvā taddaṇānmuktaḥ kalyāṃtepi bhavennahikṛtvā śuddhimavāpnoktaṃ mā kuruṣvātra saṃśayaṃyādīcchasi mahāsiddhi maṃtranissaṃśayo bhavasaṃbhāṣaṇanamapi tyājyaṃ tairācārya viniṃdakaiḥavaśyaṃ tatra gaṃtavyaṃ śrotavyamapi sādaraṃācāryatoṣaṇe palaṃ kṛtvā siddhiśraṃ vrajetkaṭaka dvitayaṃ vāpi vālī yugmamathāpi vāācāryapatnyaiyo dadyāt ṣaṇmāsevatsaretu vābhuktvā tadaṃte paramaṃ śāśvataṃ prāpnuyāt padaṃācāryatatvaṃ sakalavedaśāstreṣu gaupitaṃbhuktermuktermahadvījaṃ nānyaduktaṃ manīṣibhiḥśrīmadṛṣṭākṣaṇe japtvā rājarājeśvarī parāṃanusmṛtya sakṛdvāpi brahmabhūtā bhaviṣyatiprathamaṃ syāt trayīvījaṃ śrīvījaṃ tadanaṃtaraṃbhūyopi śriyamuccārya śrīmadṛṣṭākṣarī tataḥvidyeyamuktāṃ bhaktānāṃ bhogasvagāryavargadāmahāpātakarāśighnī sarvapuṇyaphalapradāḥsarvadarśana siddhāṃtarūpiṇī yogarūpiṇīsāmrājñī sarvavidyānā samastāyannivāriṇīparaṃ brahmātmakaṃ vā mamaharmibhirudīritaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paścāt triśaktilakṣmīḥsyādvidyā vījatrayātmikāsarvasaṃpatkarī sarvavidyāsiddhi phalapradāgaṃgātaraṃga kallola mahāvāksiddhidāyinīghuṭikā pādukādyaṣṭa siddhidā bhuktimuktidānityānaṃda mahāsiddhipradā dāridryanāśināṃbrahmavidyā triśakti śrīkūṭa tritayacidyutāṛṣayopi na jānaṃti rājarājeśvarīmimāṃrājarājoraṣyavidyāyāṃ āgameṣu prapaṭhyaterājarājamanornityaṃ sakṛt smaraṇatopi vāśatakratu phalaṃ sāṃgaṃ bhavatyasya na saṃśayaḥbhavatyeva phalaṃ rājarājavidyāt smṛteḥ sakṛtkṛtaṃ tena na saṃdeho rājavidyā smṛtesyakṛtrājarāja mahāvidyā smṛtestallabhyate sakṛtrājarāja mahāvidyāsmaraṇāt tatsakṛllabhetkāmadhenu sahasraṃ vā kalpadrumaśataṃ tu vāekavāramapi smṛtvā rājarājeśvarī parāṃpadaṃ labdhuṃ mahādānaiśca koṭiśaḥsāgatirlabhyate rājavidyānusmaraṇāt sakṛtmahānārāyaṇīṃ vidyāṃ kecidāhurmaharṣayaḥpravadāmovaya rājarājākhyāṃ sarvasiddhidāṃvedāssakala śāstroṇi purāṇāgamarāśayaḥkūṭa tritayākārāśriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣmībrahmavidyā triśakti śrīkūṭa tritayamiśritāṃsakṛt smaraṇāto vāpi pratyahaṃ sarvasiddhidāṃkṛtāste nānvahaṃ bhuptā bhavaṃtyanna na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: avaśyaṃ tatphalaṃ rājarājavidyā sakṛt smṛteḥśriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣaryā lakṣajāpena yatphalaṃsamastanyāsasahita śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃtatphalaṃ labhaṃte rājarājavidyāsacchajjapātrājarājamanuṃ japtvā tatphalaṃ sakṛdaśṇutesyame ca mahāvidyā rājarājeśvarī śubhārājarājamanorjāpi dehe tiṣṭhaṃti saṃtataṃtadevālaka naṃdāyāstudaṃvadarikāśramaḥjāhnavyādīni tīrthāni tatraiva nivasati hiśuśrūṣai ca sadācārya pādayossarvasiddhidādhanadhānyagejāśvādi sāhitāṃ ratnasaṃkulāṃpatnīputrādisahitaḥ śuśrūṣānisto bhavetdatvā pratyahamācārya caran.ābja yuge śubhepradātre sarvaralānāmapi vikṣasya koṭiśaḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇīvidyā na dātavyā kathaṃcanakoṭiśonena japtāsyāja rājeśvarī japātayameva paro brahmārudroviṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥsaṃsevya varṣa sāhasraṃ prāthaiṇairathaidhiyānvahaṃdātre sarvasya ca prāṇāt kanyakānāṃ ca deguropuraścamasihasraṃ vācājjimedhaśataṃ tu vāācārya sannidhaustheyaṃ kāryamācāryatoyaṇaṃācāryacaraṇadvaṃdva sāmīpyaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃtadeva divyakṣetraṃ syātta deva vadarīvanaṃtadeva tīraṃ vāgdevyāstatkurukṣetramīritaṃsarvatīrthasnānaphalamicchatāniyatātmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: upoṣaṇaparoyadvāvyatīpāte mahīpatedaśāṃśaṃ jvalite vahnau gurave kuṃḍaladvayaṃyajñopavīta triayaṃ datvā vāso yugānvitaṃekāmapi mahāvidyāṃ dattātreyasya yoginaḥṣaṇmāsādaṇimāghaṣṭaguṇaiśvaryayuto bhavetpāyasenājyamuktena hutvā vidyānidhirbhavetjaptvā sahasramekāṃ vā vidyāṃ vidyādvayaṃ tu vāsākṣādevasasva cakṣurbhāṃpaśyatyakhilasiddhidaṃtrisahasraṃ japedrātrau nityaṃ paścimadiṅmukhaṃśasyāsamīpe japtve vidyāmaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā mārgaṃ gacchatiyaḥ pumānsarvarogādipīḍāsu japanyaṃ ca sahasrakaṃaṣṭāṃgayogamanvicchanphalāśīniyatavrataḥaṣṭāṃgayogamāsādhakhecarojāyate dhruvaṃsahasratritayaṃ nityaṃ japtvāśaṃśitavrataḥatrisūno māṃ vidyāmekaikāmanvahaṃ śuciḥjaptvāsaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ maṃtrīsahasraṃ vijiteṃdriyaḥaṣṭāṃgasahitaṃ yogaṃ vāksiddhimatulāṃ śubhāṃbhogānaṣṭavidhāṃścāpi labdhāṃte muktimāpnuyātatrisūnoridaṃ yaṃtraṃ mahābhāgyasamṛddhidaṃṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṃgāni pitaraṃ cānasūyayāsanatsujānaṃ prahlādaṃ kārtavīryamataḥ paraṃitthamatrisuttaṃ sākṣādbhagavaṃtaṃ śriyānvitaṃataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi dvaipāyanamanornṛpapraṇavaṃ namasāyuktaṃ vadan bhagavate tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyādi siddhimicchanmadattarāṃprasādārthaṃ japanmāturbrahmālaṃkaraṇaiḥ śubhaibrahmaviṣṇvādi devānāmapyatu grahamicchatācaturṇāmapi vedānāṃ nityaṃ pārāyaṇātphalaṃgosahasra pradānasya phalaṃ dakṣiṇayānvitaṃśriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣaryāḥ puraśca vaphilaṃ śubhaṃdaśadvādaśadhā vāpi japyāptakṛta phalapradādharmārthakāmamokṣāścāsumicchan yatavrataḥpurakāya praveśādi sāmarthyaṃciṇimādikaṃvedānāmādi bhūtatvāt praṇavasya mahāmanoḥtriśakti lakṣmīvidyāyāsmaraṇādanvahaṃ bhuviatha kāmakalā sākṣācchaktiḥ śrīpārameśvarīatha trikūṇa saṃpūrṇā śriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣarītṛtīyaṃ svargalokākhyaṃ puramatra samīritaṃbrahmeśaviṣṇumatritayaṃ svaratritayamapyathatejastrayaṃcītrapurānāmoktaṃ śriya iṣṭadaṃetadusataraṃ nāma vedāṃteṣu śrutiṣvapianyāsāṃ divyakanyānāṃ suṃdaryākhyāna vidyatelaliteti māhannāma śriyaḥ sarvaphalapradaṃśriyo devyā mahacchabdo viśvādhikyaṃ vadātyapina vaktavyamidaṃ guptaṃ putrāyāpi kadācananāmadvayamidadevyāḥ śriya uktaṃ mahattaraṃetasyāḥ smaraṇānnityamumā lakṣmīḥi sarasvatīadhītāścaturo vedābhavaṃtyasya dine dinesaptakoṭi mahāmahāmaṃtrā api japtāssahasraśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tata ekākṣarī sākṣācchrī devyā citkalā śubhācicchaktiḥ śrīritirjñayā śaktirnārāyaṇīt parāetadbhyā sato nityaṃ cidrūpī puruṣo bhavetmātṛkā ca mahālakṣmīrlalitā parameśvarīkūṭa tritayavācyeyaṃ śrīstrayīrūpiṇī parāśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī vācyaṃ brahmanārāyaṇābhidhaṃsarvavidyāmaya sarvavījabhūtaṃ yaśatparaṃsvabhāva praṇavādyeyaṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī parāpraṇāvādya triśakti śrīsuṃdarī śrīsamanvitārājarājeśvarī nāmnā sarvavidyāmayī smṛtādadāt puṣṭaguṇaiśvaryaṃ vidyājālaṃ manoharaṃśaṃkhapadmādyāstaddvārinivasaṃti hipraviśaṃtyaṃ janādyāśca sidhyaṃtyasya na saṃśayaḥrājarājeśvarīvidyā japtāraṃ pratyahaṃ śuciṃśakravitteśa mukhyāścataṃ sevaṃte digīśvrāḥlakṣmīstanmaṃdire sākṣāttiṣṭhatyā bhūtasaṃplavaṃyāvadācārya pādābje suvarṇaṃ saṃprayacchatisuvarṇasya suvarṇatvaṃ triṃtrā cihnukamānataḥdhyātīyātaipi vā bhānugraharasoma parvaṇidvādaśyāṃ kārtike vāpi rājarājākhyavidyayosuvarṇamekaṃ datvātha gurupatnīpadrāṃvujekṛtavāneva bhavati sadyaḥ pratyayakāriṇīṃvārṇetuka na śakyaḥ syādvedānāmapyagocaraḥtyaktvā sarvapurāṇāni sarvopaniṣadopi canyāsajālamapi tyaktvā rājarājeśvarīmimāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedapārāyaṇaphalaṃ śāstrādhyayanajaṃ phalaṃśatakratu phalaṃ nityaṃ sarvadānaphalaṃ paraṃśriyo vidyā puraścaryā phalaṃ sāṃge dine dinelabhate nātra saṃdehonnākuruṣvātra saṃśayaḥdṛṣṭvā mahāmaṃtramamuṃ trivedīsāraṃ kṛtāthebhivadīśarūpīsa eva sākṣādbhagavānmukuṃdovidyā prabhāvāda bhavanmahātmaśrīkāṃtaḥ śrīmahāyogī śrīnārāyaṇa ucyateśrīnārāyaṇānāmāpismatvā smṛtvā dine dinenārāyaṇa samaṃ nāmayātakaudya vibhedanaṃnārāyaṇa parā vedānārāyaṇa parā makhāḥmātaṃga yuktvaso vāpi paṃcamaḥścapacopi vātadaṣyācārya vaktrājvātmāptavyaṃ nānyathā gurośuddhopya śuddhaḥ satarta smṛtvā paṃcākṣarīmimāṃkiṃ punaḥ śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyājaparatātmanāṃprabhāvodharṇituṃ naiva śakyate vidhināṃ pivāsurāṇāmapi vaṃdyaḥ syanmahṛṣīṇāṃ yatātmanāṃdaśadvādaśadhā vāpi yonu smarati saṃtataṃsapūtātmā sapṛthvīśassa bhrātā sa pitā tathāsa mahāvāsadevaśca sa yogī sa mahīmuniḥsa eva jagatāṃ sargāsthiti saṃhārakṛdvibhuḥtasyaiva mātā satataṃ dhanyā proktā mahītalemuktiṃ yāti na saṃdehaṣyitarosyapitsa mahārājarājeśvarīvidyā samāvāpyadhikānahiyāvāruṇī rājyalakṣmīrvaiva saṃsthitāyāvidyā brahmavaktrasthā sā vidyāsya mukhe bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryadakṣisau vāsyāḥ puraścaryābhidhīyatekoṭiśo yatphalaṃ prokta māgameṣu maharṣibhiḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā puraścaryādi karmasuhutvā dvādaśadhā vāpi rājarājākhya vidyayācakṣurbhyāṃ tatparaṃ brahma paśyatveva mahītalekalpadruma sahasraṃ ca kāmadhenu śataṃ tathāidameva tayotyugnamidameva mahadgataṃetadeva paraṃ śreya etadeva paraṃ phalaṃayameva paroyauga idameva mahadvrataṃrājarājeśvarīvidyā matvetthaṃ satataṃ smaretdvayameva mahanmukti vījamanyanna vidyateyājñavalkyaṃ mahātmānaṃ svapitrāsahitonvagātsamarpya yājñavalkyāya sarvasvadakṣiṇādhanaṃucchiṣṭamārjanādyaiścapāda saṃvāhanādibhiḥtatpatnī kiṃkarau bhūtvā bhūṣaṇādyaissamarcakaurājarājeśvarīvidyāṃ prāptavaṃtau gurormukhātavāpya sarvaśreyāṃsi brahmadṛṣṭā sanātanaṃīdṛśo varṇituṃ naiva śakyate na mayāpyahoāgameṣu purāṇeṣu naitasmādvidhate paraṃbhūtvā dāśarathirbhūmau śrīrāma iti kathyateanayā ramamāṇesau śrīrāma iti kathyateśrīnārāyaṇanāmādyamasyeva prathitaṃ śrūtaunārāyaṇa paraṃbrahmanavaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃvahujanmārjitaiḥ puṇyasaṃvapaiḥ pāpanāśanaiḥdvitīyamapi sarvādyabhedanaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tṛtīyaṃ vāsudevākhyamasyanāma nigadyatemahāpātaka yuktopi smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ sakṛtvedāvāra paribhraṣṭaḥ kirāto saṃgatiściraṃvālmīkiḥ prathittaḥ sākṣādabhūdṛṣi kulādhipaḥavāyuḥ paramedhāma śakrādyairapi durlabhaṃsākṣāt paṃcadaśārṇeye śrīrdevī sarvamātṛkādvitīye tu mahālakṣmīnāmadheyamudīritaṃsītānāmavaturthesyājjānakītyapi tatparaṃsamastādya harāṇi syussadya eva dvijottamāḥśrīnārāyaṇanāmādyaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇetyathatasmācchrī saṃyutā japyā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī śubhārājarājeśvarī japturnavratanāstyu poṣaṇaṃna raśmimālādhyayanaṃnyāsāpekṣāhivāna hirājarājeśvarīvidya smaraṇāt siddhirīritvāsarvayogamayī sarvadharmaśāstra svarūpiṇīsarvavedamayī sarvamaharṣi brahmarūpiṇīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīmenāṃ rājarājeśvarī parāṃācāryakṛpayā labdhvāmaṣṭā viṃśatidhānvahaṃjalpojapaphale nidrāsamādhirabhidhīyateśilpaṃ samastaṃ mudrāṇāṃ racanā bhavati dhruvaṃcittasya bhagavaddhyānaṃntatkriyā tapa ucyateavaśyamapi goptavyā nidhānamiva taskarātkanyakā api dātavyā rūpavatyaḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥsādhvī svapatnī taruṇī sarvāvayavasuṃdarīśiropi prāṇasahitaṃ dātavya madanītale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājyapradāya rājñe vā bhrātṛputrāyavaṃdhavaprāṇānapi ca sarvasvaṃ patnīṃ putrāṃśra kanyakāḥnirmatsarobhahaṃkārijitakrādho jiteṃdriyaḥśiṣyatve sapariyāhyo nānyo rājyapradopi caihāmutrāmitābhīṣṭa pradātācārya ucyatemitraputrakalatrādi saṃyabhyaḥ pracyuto cirātsahasrajanma suśvāno gardabhaḥ syāt tataḥ paraṃihāmi sakalaiśvaryayuto nityasukhāśrayaḥācāryacaraṇadvaṃdva sannidhau cihnukaṃ tu vāyadādhā vā pratijñānaṃ tadṛṇaṃ mahadīritaṃtabhyā sannitayā darvārdayaṃ vṛddhi samanvitaṃvatsarātyaṃ ca guṇitaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ nāstini niṣkṛtiḥbrahmatādātmya saṃsiddhiṃ ya icchet sādhakomuviya icchet paramaṃ duḥkhanete narakayātanāṃpitṛmātṛvadhe brahmaṣkṛtirucyatepatnīputrakalatrādyā niraṃtara sukhānvitaḥācāryasya kṛpāle śānnānyathā brahmanaṃdanāḥihāvi sakalaiśvarya matamuktistu śāśvatīrājarājeśvarī vidyāyānusmarati saṃtataṃmokṣāyate ca saṃsāro rājarājaśvarī japātbrahmaviṣṇumaheśādi padaṃ cāsya na durlabhaṃācārya sadṛśaṃ daivaṃ vidyate yadi bhūtaleaśvamedha sahasreṇa samaṃ sukṛtamasti cetratnamerusamaṃ dānaṃ yadi tiṣṭhati pāpahaṃjāhnavī sadṛśaṃ tīrthamasticet pātakāpaha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vārāṇasī samaṃ kṣetramasti cenmuktidāyakaṃrājarāja mahāvidyā sadṛśī vidyate tadāsarvavidyāyayī proktā sarvabrahmāramāyikāparipūrṇa kṛpālavāṃ yonu smarati saṃtataṃrājarājamahāvidyā māhātmya madyanāśanaṃiti kiṃcinmayā proktamatha vakṣyāmi sādhanaṃvakṣye brahmasutā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhva śuddhayānvitāḥācārya caraṇadvaṃdvaṃ dhyāyedbrahmavile śubheśuddhasphaṭika saṃkāśaṃ varābhaya karānvitaṃardhanārī naramayaṃ brahmarūpadharaṃ tu vādhyātvācāryaṃ mahātmānaṃ sarvajñaṃ karuṇānidhiṃtatpādapaprayugalagalatpīyūṣaviṃdubhiḥmūlādi brahmaraṃdhrāṃtaṃ bhānu koṭi śataprabhāṃdhyātyā tattejasaḥ puṃjapiṃjarīkṛta vigrahaḥsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi dṛṣṭvā japtvā ca pādukāṃmahānadī valadvahniṃ dṛṣṭā smṛtvā śriyaḥ patiyadvā brāhme samutthāya muhūrte yatamānasaḥasānnidhye guroḥ pādārūḍha śrīpādukāṃ nametaṣṭā viṃśatidhā smṛtvā daśadvādaśadhā daśadhāpivābhagavadraśmi sūktaṃ ca smṛtvā traidhaikadhāpi vāsakṛt raśmimālābhidhaṃ sūktaṃ śriyaḥ pūrvamudīritaṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhā japtvā śriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣarīsaṃsmaret suprabhātādistotraṃ bhagavataḥ priyaṃguruśca śukraḥ śanirāhuketavaḥ kurvaṃ tu sarve mama suprabhātaṃraibhyo marīciścya vano maharṣiḥ kurvaṃtu sarve mama suprabhātaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptasvarāssaptarasāttalāśca kurvaṃtu sarve mama suprabhātaṃsa śabdo mahatta sahaiva kurvaṃtu sarve mama suprabhātaṃsapta bhūrādi kṛtvā bhuvanāni sapta kurvaṃtu sarve mama suprabhātaṃitthaṃ prabhāte pravaraṃ vicitraṃ smarat paṭhedyaḥ śṛṇuyācca bhaktāduḥsvapnanāśodyana suprabhāto bhavecca satya bhagavat prasādātsarvapadadhiṣṭhātā bhūtvā mukti mavāpnuyātvimuktassakalā padbhyo nārāyaṇa mayo bhavetkhādireṇātha kāṣṭhena daṃtadhā vanamācaretsnānaṃ kuryāt tato nadyāṃ tadāge vā samāhitaḥsaṃdhyopāstiṃ tataḥ kuryāt sarvapāpaugha bhaṃjanīṃsa śūdra va dahikvāryassavasmādvi prakarmaṇaḥmātā sakalavidyānāṃ sāvitrī paramākalāsahasra prajapedyastu gāyatrī vedamātaraṃsahasraṃ prajapennityamatha paṃcaśataṃ tu vāaṣṭāviśādhikaṃ nityaṃ śataṃ vā prajapet sudhīḥtaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vijānīyāt sarvakarmasu pāvanaṃsa mahāpuruṣa śreṣṭho brāhmaṇottama ucyateṛṣiḥ ma ukto vidvadbhiḥ paṅkti pāvana prāvanaḥmaharṣiḥ sarvalokeṣu sa uttā vipraḥ kathyate vudhaiḥbrahmarṣiḥ sa mahānukto daivatopi pūjitaḥsa eva bhagavān sākṣānnārāyaṇa iti smṛtaḥpatitānāṃ sahasraṃ ca sapāvarpati pāvanaḥdviśataṃ vā śataṃ vāpi sāvitrīṃ vedamātaraṃajapā smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yathāktyāvi mātṛkāyathā śaktyā prajaptvātha sūktaṃ nārāyaṇabhidhaṃ

sanskrit: paṃcadhā ravivāraṃ vā jedhvā svagurupādayoḥhutvā dvādaśadhā paścācchrī madaṣṭārṇa vidyayāhatvātha vāsudevenaṃ vaiṣṇavena ghṛtaṃ hunetājyaṃ dvāsaṣoṇe vidyayā *******daśadhā paṃcadhā vāpi hucetvāvyā hṛtibhistataḥyadiṃ śaktaḥ śriyo devyā raśmibhirghṛtemekadhāaśvānanākhya manunā guruṃ vā duktayā sakṛtaṣṭāviṃśatidhā kṛtvā tatuḥ śrīmanubhistataḥhutvā dvādaśadhāt yena hutvā vyāhṛtibhidhavaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī vividyā japasaṃkalpamuccaretyadvā ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasyavaiṣṇavīṃ mātṛkāṃ parāṃcidrūpa mātṛkānyāsaṃ kṛtvā dhyātvā śriyaḥ patiṃśatādhika sahasraṃ vājyet paṃcaśataṃ tu vāsāyannātaśca madhyāṃhneghrāhmāṃ kāletha vā niśinārāyaṇai yainābhī nityaṃ smṛtamīdvijainārāyaṇanusmaraṇaṃ yahāṃmādikamaṃsabrahmaghno vā surāpīvāstepī vā gurutalpaganārāyaṇān smāṇaṃ kṛtvā prahamādarātnārāyaṇānusmāraṇovatarpaṇaṃ śvavaṃmāḥśruvāvapivedevedāṃtaśāstraihyasārabhūtaṃ sanātanaṃetatva kalevaraṃtyaktvā dvijātitvamavānyuyuśrīmadṛṣṭākṣarīṃ labdhvā gatiṃ prāpyūnumāṃtulā pūruṣamavāpnuyuḥ kovā pitāddarśānagātirbhavatśrīmadaṣṭārṇa ja*ṇaṃ gatiḥ śakyā narvaṇiṃ tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dharmaputra prasannātmārsarvaloguruḥ smṛtaḥupāryai vana maṃtyatra traparogati mubhāpsavāācāryakaraṇāprātyājapyā svargāyavagardāvidātyakaṃvācyaṃ vastvu brahmātmakaṃ paraṃ niśrutaraanaṃta macalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ manovāyāmagocaraṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ japandviśataṃ yojayonnityaṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī parāṃpitṛmātṛvadhādyaiśca mahāpātakasucayaiḥvārddhakeke yauvane vālye jāgrat svan prasuṃṣuptiṣuupātakajālai ca narakaprāpti hetubhiḥtraśataṃ yojayennityaṃ śrīyadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃvaṃdāneṣu yatparāyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalaṃśrīpradaṣṭākṣīri nitya prajapedyaścatuḥśataṃacaṃcalā mahālakṣmīrdhanadhānādi saṃkulādīdhamo puṣpamārogyatesya dine dinetatkarā vrevasatyeva saṃśayo nātra vidyatepādukāṃ janatyohādi sidhyakamanuttamaṃśaṃkhādinidhayastasya dvāritiṣṭhaṃtya caṃcalāḥtaṃ pālayaṃti mātiva mahālakṣmīḥ sutaṃ yathāpiturmātuḥ svapalyāśca kulairdvādaśabhiryutaḥśatādhikaṃ jastu sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ śuciḥsa eva pūrvajagatāmācārya ṛṣirucyatetatsaṃbhāṣuṇatinhaṇamāgriyīmaṃ phalaṃ bhavetkiṃkārāṃ tiṣṭhaṃti siddhāḥ kiṃ puruṣā api

sanskrit: ekatriṃśārṇasahitaṃ dvaipāyanapadaṃ tataḥparāśarasutasyeyaṃ vidyāmanvakṣarīśubhāmamaiva mūrtiraparākṛṣṇadvaipāyanābhidhāvibhāgakartrīvedānāṃ jagatāṃ hitakāriṇīdvaipāyanābhidhaḥ sākṣādbhagavān hariracyutaḥbrāhmesamaya utthāya saṃsmṛtyācāryapādukāṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhā vāpi prajaptvādau samāhitaḥācāryaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ vedavyāsa svarūpiṇaṃācārya paramātmānaṃ sākṣādvaipāyanākṛtiṃvādarāyaṇirasyokto munirbrahmavidāṃvaraḥvedavyāso mahāyogī deva ukto mahīpateekenākṣara yugmena caturbhiratha saptabhiḥdivyasiṃhāsanāsīnaṃ kālanīlāṃvudaprabhaṃvibhrāṇaṃ cinmayīmudrāṃvīrāsana samāśritaṃkuṃḍaladvayaṃ saṃśobhimukhāṃbhojaṃ jagadguruṃsevitaṃ siddhasaṃdhaiśca brahmavidbhiḥ samāvṛtaṃdvaipāyanamuniṃ sākṣādbhagavaṃtamahaṃbhajearcayet ṣaḍareyaṃtre paṃcakoṇasamanviteṣaṭkoṇa madhye saṃpūjya vedavyāsaṃ jagadguruṃjaiminiṃ ca sumaṃtuṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇeṣu prapūjayetatharvaṇaṃ tato vedamitihāsamatatparaṃromaharṣaṇanāmānaṃ yājñavalkyaṃ mahāmuniṃvaudhāyanāyastaṃvau ca caturasredigīśvarānākaraḥ sarvavidyānāmāśrayaḥ sarvasaṃpadāṃlakṣatrayaṃ japecchuddho vedavyāsa mahāmanuṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taṃpāpalaṃ yati brāhmadyāmatarormeravā apimahāyādiralānitahuhenivasaṃti hihastāṃvuje vasatyeva nātra kāryo vicāraṇāsa eva jagataḥ karmāhatṛpīlayitāpi catriśatādhiku sahasraṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī parāṃna śakyate mayā vaktaṃ hmarudrādrikairativāsudeva mahāvidyāṃ vaiṣṇavi ca ṣaḍakṣarīlakṣmīhṛdayavidyāṃ vā śrīṣaḍarṇamathāpi vāśaktaśvet sādhakavo nityaṃtyaṃ śriyaḥ yaṃ ca daśāṣmarīaṣṭaviṃśatidhāvapi jaṣmapaścādvinādīneuttara brahmaṃ vidyāmaṣṭāviṃśāsurīyārāṃāṣṭāti śātidhā vāpi jape dvādaśadhānvāhaśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyāstā vallakṣa japāt phalarājarājamahāvidyāṃ maṣṭāviṃśatidhānvahaṃaṣṭāviṃśati saṃkhyā kapuraścayaphilaṃ labheaṣṭāti viṃśati saṃkhyāka mahādānaṣṭa lakṣabhaṃrājārāja mahāvidyā sukṛtyaraṇatonvahaṃphalaṃ śatakta phalaṃ sāṃgamaṣṭā viṃśati saṃkhyayāvāmauti sākṣād brahmameyau dvariamedha sahasra ca mahādānāyutaṃ tathā |brahmaṇā tulitaṃ parvaṃ tathā vedacatuṣṭayaṃrājarājeśvarīvidyā suṃdarīllābhābhidhīrājarājeśvarījaverderdyejña śatairapīrājarājeśvarījasurjātakaṃ mṛtaṃ tuva nā śaucaṃvidyate tasya pūrṇāvāyaṃ kṛpāpapidi

sanskrit: sādhyo nārāyaṇe pāpegī sarvejñau bhagavānvibhuḥgāyatrama gāyatraṃ daivatayaṃ irityapilakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ svāmīdeva raktāḥ purātanaināṃganyāa karanyāsau nāṃginīcānyadevatālakṣmīnārāyaṇīvidyā rājarājeśvarī kalābhagavadyaktā mahāśrīsuṃdarīramāhadāsīitthaṃ bhagavatī gīta. śrurāvataśca śriyaḥ patemahepura sāmrājya bhogaṃ ca japisyathabrahmānaṃda sukhaprapti hetubhūta manaśvaraṃpraptuḥ śrīmadaṣṭārṇo śriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣarīsiddhā bhavati bhaktānāṃ sarvasiddhipradāyinīśākṣarīṃdanī śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī japtvā siddhau mevati sādhakaḥvahulāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā dhanadhānyādi saṃkulāśrīṣadṛṣṭākṣīrī viṣṇvā siddhi prāpnoti śāśvatīratnadviye manoramyeyāsijāta valāvūṃteayodhyānagare tu tradivya prāsādaśobhitevahuyojana vistīrṇe mamarvātkikaṃ mānvitetanmadhye maṃḍape tatyajāṃ kanada vibhūṣitenavaṇikya sāhasrabhaṃ kāṃti virṇīrtibhagavā kiṃkara śreṣṭhaissarvatassamarpya kṛteurgāgaṇapati kṣetrayā na bhairavasobhitevibhūṣitetatrāsīnaṃ mahātmānaṃ kāla nīlāṃvada prabhaṃnavaratnamaya śrīmajjāṃvūnada kirīṭinaṃpadma yatra viśālākṣaṃ kāmacāpa samabhravaṃ

sanskrit: smitavaktraṃ viśālākṣaṃ dāḍimī sadaśadvijaaṃgulīyaka ratnaiśca muktāhāreṇa śobhitaṃśaṃkhavakrābhayavarakara śrīvatsavakṣatyavīrāsana samāsīnaṃ varerāvaradaṃ vibhuṃasya vāmāṃkaparyaṃka sthito davītrāyī yaīvidyutkoṭi pratīśkaśayī varayugāvṛtālalāṭaya haṃsarājatkaskarītilakaṃkitādivyacaṃnaliptāṃgīrājīvāyata locanāśukraphalasamāktahema tāṭaṃkabhūṣitāyamarāja samāyutanosikā bharaṇānvitākaviṃva phalaprakhyādharayuttama vibhūṣitāmuktāhārayuta grīvāpadakādi vibhūṣitāprāśaṃkarā svarṇaciṃtākādi vibhūṣitāsuvṛtta vimalortagahemakuṃbhānibhastanīkaladaīlītastaṃbha sukumāroru śobhitāmāhārhābharaṇoyotā save sāmrājyānayikāmahāśrīsurīdevī dakṣiṇesya śriyaḥ pateyamarāga mahāratna sunnibhā viśvanāyikāikṣu vāmaṃ vayapyeṣu pāśāṃkuśālasatkarāsvaṇaṃ kāṃcī guṇeyetāratnakaṃcukasaṃyutāyapra yatra viśālākṣīdinya kuṃḍalaśobhītāsuvṛtta hemakuṃbhābhustanayugma virājitāsarvasammohakarī savalokavaśaṃkarītatpartāvūnada prakhyātāṃ kanada vibhūcchitābrahmaviṣṇumaheśeṃdra vadyaṃ māna pādaṃvujā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūgoyakasaṃkośā vidyut sāhasra sannibhādivyapītāṃ varadharā kirīṭādi vibhūṣitāsragvasra saṃchaṃnnā divyagaṃdha vibhūṣitārājovayatra sadṛśa netra yugma vibhūṣitāprasannavaṃdanāsubhūḥ saṃsmītāna na paṃkajāsudhāpūrita sauvaṇa kilaśopamasustanīāṃgalīyakakeyūra divyakaṃkaṇā bhūṣitāicchājñānakriyo śāktirūpiṇī parasūpikaṃcukaśobhitāṇī vedamātṛkā icchājñāna kriyośāktirūpiṇī pararūpiṇītrīmūrti rūpātrayyaṃt rūpiṇī ca trayī mayīsāmrājyālakṣmīrviśvaṃbharā triyātrailokya śrubhe nīlodevī mahīdevyau divyākalpavibhūṣitedivyābharaṇa saṃpannā divyasragvasra saṃvatāḥpaścābhāge sthitā devyaḥ smita vaktrāṃvujāḥ śubhāsuvarṇo ratnasaṃvarṣi śvetacchatravaro vibhuḥmūrtimaṃtaścaturvedāścaturdikṣvasya saṃsthitāḥsāmrājyalakṣmīsahitaḥ puratosya virājatedivyarūpadharābhāṃti puratīsyaści padyatetriśaktilakṣmyasahitaṃ nīlābhūmi samānvitaṃmūrtimabhiścaturvadaussaṃstutaṃ jagatāṃ patiṃbrahmaviṣṇumaheśaṃ ipramadāmarasevitaṃsarvayajapatiṃ sadyaṃ jagatāṃpati macyutaṃvahnimaṃḍalamadhyasthaṃ paramaṃ purulaṃ vibhuṃnārāyaṇaṃ jagannāthamanaṃtaṃ parameśvaraṃardhvega śrīpatirvadvādhyāyennārāyaṇīrvibhuṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: khavilasatkarapuṃjāḍhyamarddheddire śamaniśaṃ harimāśrayāmaḥimānahyasamurcitayādayamaṃ hemāṃvujāśamaniśeharimāśrāyāmaḥkirīṭa cakrātva vibhūṣaṇāhyamaddhāṃga lakṣmīrpāṃtamarcayāmaḥphalaṃ śubhaṃavāpya sarvaśreyāṃsi brahmasāyujya siddhibhākśrīrūpīṇyā svayalyācya sahitaṃ parameśvaraṃjagattritaya sāmrājya hetubhūtāṃ sanātanīgatyame tadapi dhyāna sūklaṃ yugmabhya ādarātmayokta vidhino yāmya jīvanmūkto bhavetpumānbrahmavidyāṃ praptvātha śrīśrīsāśadvādaśākṣarīsuprābhātamahāsmotraṃ paṭhitvā tadanaṃtaraṃnārāyaṇātmakaṃ divyaṃ kavacaṃ vajraṃ yajaraṃniśāyāyamarddharātraivāptvācaryā purassaraṃsiddhimānyoti mahatīṃ trailokyenāpi durlabhāṃanusmṛtya sakṛdvāpi śriyaḥ paṃcadaśākṣarīkṛta śaucastataḥ srātvā saṃdhyāṃ katvo tataḥ paraṃkṛtāṃjali puṭo natvā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ śubhāṃsahasramatharvā paṃcaśataṃ vāpi catuḥśataṃnocedadhogatipro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥyathā śaktyā prajapatvātha dvādaśāṇāṃ śriyo japetaṣṭottarasāte nitya umadhyaviṃśatidhāpivārājeśvarīvidyāṃ mahāsiṃhāsaneśvarī āṣṭaathavā samaye brāhme saṃsasṛtyācāryapādukāsnātvā saṃdhyāmuyāsyātha śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī śubhāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāsudeva mahāvidyāṃ vaiṣṇavīvaṃ ṣaḍakṣārīlakṣmīṃ hṛdayavidyāṃ vā prajaptvāṣṭottavaṃraśataātrāpya śākto bhagavaddha ca vidyāṃ dine dinenityahomaṃ ca nirvartya śrīmadaṣṭākṣarī parācihnaya mātṛkārvamavaśya pratyahaṃ japetśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāmācāryājñā purassarajapet paṃcaśataṃ yadvā triśataṃ vā catuḥśataṃlakṣmīhṛdayavidyāṃ vā yathā śaktyā prajapyatharājarājeśvarī viṃmuyānmahatbhāgavadraśmi sūktasya mahasrādvatitaṃ phalaṃprāpnoti pratyaha bhūmau saṃśayo nātra vidyateyajjaptvā pratyahaṃ dhīmābhārāyaṇa meyo bhavetchaṃdaḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇe vimuyādajānūhaṃ yugale vīdare hṛdivorasiprabhṛti pādāṃtaṃ sūyopyāṣṭekṣaṇarānprāsettarjanyādika niṣkāṃtu maṃguṣṭha dviteyapi capūrvavat praṇavādyāṃścajñamotāṃ vinyasedadhaṣavaṇaṃ cebhyormadhye śikhāyāṃṇakṣā tathāmakāramastraṃ vinyasya sa visarga ṣaḍaṃgakaṃ || 36 |||dhyāye svahṛdayāṃbhojeva devaṃ jagatpati napaṇayaḥ pumān dhyoyehva hṛdayābhoje devadevaṃ jagatpatikeyūravānmakarakuṃḍalavānkirīṭīhārīra rāmayavayurdhataśaṃ śvacakraḥardhāṃga śrīpatiṃ yadvā dhyoyennārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃpuṃḍarīkākṣa lakṣmyauḥgacchan stiṣṭanasvapanarbhūtan jāgratānnapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahadyaśaḥ rājarājeśvarī vidyā japahomādikarmasusudhyāna maṃtramamuṃ smṛtva siddhiṃ prāpnotyanumaṃsarvavidyā tejastayomayaṃ nārāyaṇīṃ varmavidyāṃ prayatotha smuccareiṣṭaṣvedarācarmāsigadesvāyaṃ pāśāndadhānoṣṭa guṇeṣṭa vāhuḥpāśāt syalevamāyāvadu vāmanovyāṃ trivikramaḥ khecatu viśvarūpaḥvīmuṃcato yasya mahyadahāṃ saṃdiśo vinedranyayastaṃścagamāḥrāmodrikūṭe śūrthe vipravo sa salakṣmāṇevyādbhātāgratomākarmavaṃdhātdevadhiviryuḥ sūṣārvanāṃtarān karmoharirmāṃ nirayāṃdaśeṣātyajñaśca lokādavati rahitāṃtādvalogaṇā krodhavaśādehīdaḥkākiḥkaleḥ kālamalāt prayātu dharmāvanāyorukṛtāṃvatāraḥnāyaṇaḥ prāhū udābhaśaktirmadhyāṃ dine viṣṭararī iyāṇiḥdoṣai hṛsīkerā utārdharātre niśātha ekova tuṣannanāthaḥdāmodaro vyādan sadhyaṃ prabhāte viśveśvaro bhagavān kālāmūrtiḥdaṃdagdhidaṃgdhyarisainyamāśukakṣaṃ yathāvāta sakho hutāśanāḥpāṃḍavaināyakayakṣarakṣobhūtagrahāṃścarṇayacūrṇayārīnadareravīśa ca yakasya pūrito bhīma svaneri hṛdiyā'nikaṃpancakṣūṣinarman chatacaṃ icchādayadviṣāmaghotāṃ harapāpa cakṣuṣaṃsarīsmāyebhyo |daṃṣṭribhyo bhūtebhyādyebhya enavāprayāṃtu saṃkṣayaṃ sadyo yonaḥ śreyaḥ pratīyakārakṣatve śeṣakṛcchebhyo viṣvavaenaḥ svanāmabhiḥvuddhīdriya manaḥ prāṇanyāṃ tu pārṣada bhūṣaṇāḥsatyenānenanaḥ sairve pāṃtunā śamuyardravābhūṣāṇayudhaliṃgāravyādhatteśaktīḥ khamā yayāpātu sairvesvarūpainasidā sarvakti sarvagi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prahāpayan lokabhayaṃ svanena svatejasāgrasta samastatejāḥekaviṃśati sa ekabhaṃtra rūpaṃ śaskaraṃsamasta uritaudyaghnaṃ sarvavighnavināśanaṃsamastāpahaṇaharaṃ sarvavidyāphalapradaṃvaiṣṇavaṃ kacaṃ divyaṃ sarvatrā vījayapradaṃācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ prāṇiyāta purassaraṃdāsīdāsangajāśvādyau vaiplavaṃ kavacaṃ śubhaṃdervoyadiṣṭāmayitāśrīmādaṣṭākṣarī parāṃvāsudeva mahāmaṃtra vaiṣṇavaṃ ca ṣaḍakṣaraṃiyaṃ nārāyanārāyaṇī sarvadevatārūpiṇī parākavacaṃ vaiṣṇavāṃ rivyaṃ vedavedāṃtasaṃgrahaṃnārāyaṇe mahayogīdhamaṃ putro jagatpatiḥvivivasvatedadhī vā padattavān sarvasiddhidāṃdevārṣevarye bhaṃgavā bhārado brahmanaṃdanahiṇayakasutāyātha prahrādāya sadattavātdhairavardhyo vadhyatva manaprāpyānatyaṃ vijayamātavānśiṣyāya dattavā tvaṃ dyetvaghrāsopirātmāhāsvaiyu vibhuprārthiti vahuśā pūrvaṃ maheśayayā pradattavānnārāyaṇamavilokānāṃ rājyaśriyāmavāptavāndrohamasya ca koraṃdromannosajya śriyā vibhūḥprāpāvānpātakaṃ ghoraṃ bhraṣṭaṃ śrīrāmavattathāsaṃpūrṇa dakṣiṇakraṃ ca kāyāraranāyakaśriyamāt pravān svāyaṃbhurvādibhi śāstre viprahatyātāsya cavāpi surāyā nāyutaṃ tuṃ vāmanvādi dharmaśāstrokta prāyaścita śruti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tvakṛṃtya vā māhādānānāyutairapi na śudhyatitasmādavaśyacāyaṃ prinairarthordhiyāgirāmukho vidhātā sau svasatebhyaḥ prattavānsaptvā nārāyaṇīvidyāṃ prāsriddhimattamāṃnārāyaṇe mahāyogī tasya putro bhaviṣyatisyāpi bhagavān śaṃbhurdakṣiṇemūtrirīśvaraḥnaumiṣṭe sumahāraroyeśaunakādibhya ādarāttepi sarve mahāprājñā vidhā metāmāko nāmnāśukācārya svenaiva bhūmau vidyā prakāśitātripurādyari saṃhāraṃ kṛtvābhū bhagavān śivaḥtrailokya japinaṃ raudramavaśyamapi daivatoasyāḥ paṭhanato bhūmau deśikaṃ ghriprasādataḥvyatīvāte mahāyoge ravisaṃkramaṇepi vāśrīmadaṣyakṣarīvidyāṃ japet paṃcaśatādhikaṃjaptvapiśanamekāṃte vaidyevaṃ ca ṣaḍaśaraṃprajaptvā triśataṃ prājño vidyāmaṣṭā daśākṣarīśatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā vidyāmetā mataḥ paraṃvidhivat saṃskṛte vahnau svācāryājñā purussaraṃvidyayā vāsudevasya śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunetekaviṃśati saṃkhyāṃkamaṃtraiḥ śrīpatimavarmaṇaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā vidyayā dvādaśārṇayāāṣṭaviṃśatidhā hutvā prāyaścitterhunevṛtaḥdeśikāghriṃ yugaṃ natvā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṃḍavat sudhīḥvaṣṭāśinamitta dravyamarpayeccaraṇadvayevastrerābharaṇaipalomācāryasyātha pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deśikānugrahāt siddhiṃ prāyotpanna na saṃśayaḥkadhā samāstarastaravyādhi saṃdyaddhaṃsi yaṭī yasīāraṇyevā naraṇye vā vokhyāghra samākulebrahmarākṣasavetālayakṣakūṣyaṃḍasaṃkaṭetyuktaḥ sakalamītimyojayaṃ prāpnoti śāśvataṃgṛhadauyādaśādoṣāḥ pūrva karmānugāstathāariṣṭānyapi naśyaṃti kavacesya japādvijāḥsiṃhā api mṛgāyaṃte hārāyaṃte phaṇīśrarāmadasyābhiḥ pīḍito vāpi jṛdiṃto vāpi śatrubhiḥvātenā ghūrṇito vāpi vimagnaśva mahārṇaveprāpnoti vijayaṃ sadyo muktasmakala saṃkaṭātjaptvā svācārya varaṇadvayerājā dāso bhavettasya prāṇairapi dhanerapiśāyān grahasrāmarthyaṃ prāpya nityajapaṃ śubhaṃāyuṣyaṃ mahadārogyamaiśvaryamaṇimādikaṃchatraya nimukti svārājya padavīmapirahasyame tatkavacaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vajrapaṃjarasthāvaragamamapi kṛtrimaṃ ca mahadviṣaṃsatya evāmṛtī bhūtvā vinaśyati na saṃśayatadveśapi vinaśyati dvijāgryaurapi coditāḥvarṇanapāṇātmātmakaṃ ekākī purato gacchetyaṃ grāmāmi mukhaḥ śuciḥnārāyaṇātmako bhūtvā vijityāri niṣkaṃdanaḥkurvaṃti kṣatitasya mahāstrārīyā saṃtatajaptvaidaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ varma dhanadhānyādi saṃkulāṃsaṃtataṃ ciraṃjātismorā bhūvā labdhvā sarvamanorathān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryapādayordatvā niṣkadvādaśakaṃ nṛpaathavaikādaśī śuddhākārtike māghamāsi vāsahasraṃ juhuyādagnau dvādaśyāṃ kāpilaṃ ghṛtaṃsamastaparvasahitaṃ bhāratākhyānapustakaṃtriniṣkadakṣiṇāmuktamācāryāya samarpya caaśvatthamūlamāśrinityaṃ niyamataḥ śuciḥtribhirmāsairnasaṃdehovidyānāṃ pārago bhavetvedavyāsa mahāvidyāṃ japtvā lakṣaṃ yata vrataḥjaptvā lākṣamimaṃtraṃ gurumārādhya yatnataḥśriyaṃ cāpnoti vipulāṃ brahmavidbhavati dhruvaṃmūkasyāpyaparairjaptā mahāvāksiddhidāyinījaptvā sahasraṃ śuddhātmā varṣamekaṃ jiteṃdriyaḥsaṃprāpya paramaṃbrahmasākṣādevaprapaśyatiācāryamarcayeddhīmān vastubhiḥ sakalairapivṛṣaparvādayo daityā udaṃkādyādvijottamāḥśarīraṃ naśvaraṃ matvā saṃsāraṃ duḥkhasaṃkulaṃācāryacaraṇāveva samabhyarcyānvahaṃ nṛpaekena janmanaivaitesiddhiṃ saṃprāpya durlabhāṃtasmādbhaumaṃ samāsādya śarīraṃ duḥkhasaṃkulaṃācāryānugrahaḥ pūrṇoyasya nāsti mahītalesaṃsārasāgaraṃ tartuṃya icchatyeka janmanāācāryapādukāvidyā pūrvikāṃ raśmimālikāṃsamastanyāsasahitāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japetbhagavansadṛśākāro bhagavat kiṃkaro bhavetuktātubhyaṃ mahārāja kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrūṇudhva yoginassarve brahmayuktā dṛḍhavratāḥaṣṭā viśatidhā vāpi daśadvādaśadhāpivāśriyaḥ paterbhagavatassakṛjjaptvā tataḥ paraṃpīṭhapūjāṃ vidhāyādau ca yodhyāpuranāmakaṃlayāṃga pūjāṃ mātraṃ vā kṛtvādau mini yatvrataḥcakrarājārdyayennityaṃ sugaṃdhi kusumaiḥ śrībhaiḥmanuyugmakaṃyajñabhāṇarāṇī vidyāse kṛtacārya yatnataḥbrahmavidyāṃ samuccārya sālagrāma śilānvitecaturviṃśati saṃkhyākaranupavārān samarpayetśrīśrīśadvādaśākṣaryā paṃcadhābhyarcya tatparaṃ śataṃ || 14 |||kṛtvetthaṃ pratyahaṃ bhūtāṃ katkādvādaṃ śaṃvatsaraṃlayāge pūjāṃ kṛtvādāvitthaṃ cābhyacye yatnataḥpūrvokta vidhinā yadvā samāvāhya jagatpatīḥcaturviṃśati saṃkhyākairabhyavyakṣi dṛḍhavrataḥśrīśrīśadvādaśākṣavayau tataḥ pratyahamarcayatsahasravarṣa pūjāyāḥ phalaṃ pratyahamānyuyātsarvatīrtha snānaphalaṃ sarvakratuṣu yatphalaṃtatyulaṃ sāgamāpnoti pretyahaṃ ca dṛḍhaṃ vrataṃdaśikānu grahātmākṣānnārāyaṇa padaṃ labhetabhyārcya pratyahaṃ pūrvaṃ tataḥ śrīpatirpayotpratyāhaṃ sarvarvayāyaudyo virmukteḥ koṭidānajaṃsālagrāmaśilāyuktaṃ cakrarājamahattaraṃkulasāhasrasahito ramate bhagavatpaelakṣmīyeterbhagavataḥ kṣetramuktaṃ marurṣibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣetraṃ lakṣmīpateḥ proktaṃ sadyassakalasiddhidaṃśriyaḥ paterbhagavataḥ suṃdrī vallabhātmanasuṃdarī vacchabhasyokta macyutasya śriyaḥ patedvārakāravyāpurīramyā satyaite muditāḥ smṛtāḥnivāsū bhūtā evāḥsyu daśarninikkti siddhidāḥkṣīrāśī vā phalāśī vā paṃcarātraṃ dine dineśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidhā japtvā sāhasra manvahaṃvahuvāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ datvā svadesika padāṃvujepaśyateva svakṣurbhyā varade bhaktavatsalaṃpravakṣyāmi samāsauna na śūṇadhaṃ nahyanaṃdanāḥyajñāyaṇīṃ vidyāṃ brahmadyāṃ yata vrataḥāyaṃpanā nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāṇaso dāśarathātmataḥāsyaivaṃ kalayā pūrṇe jātosmi jagatītalemadhumādhavamāṇaidvodha saṃtu ṛturītaḥtatra caitrābhidyemasi pratipadvinamāditaḥmahāpātaka rāśīghrāṃ kalilpraṣabhedanaṃsarvasaṃkaṭabhītighraṃ sarvaroga vibhaṃjanaṃtatra madhyāhnasamaye sākṣānnārāyaṇo vibhūḥrāmo dāśarathinasti parabrahma bhayosyuḥcicchaktiḥ sadarīsākṣācchīriyaṃ rasākalāyajadāna tapa strīrtha vratakodi phalapralamonyāti śāśvataṃśrīrāmanavamī prāthyava āvāyāsteṣāśveyo na nidyaṃtivāsaṃte navarātre sājatyāvyakaktaṃ svaṃ sarvaphaladaṃ vidyānāṃ siddhimicchāamahātī siddhimanvicchakuyādatravata śubhaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhumāse śuklapakṣe pratipadvidyase śubhebrahmavidyā manusmṛtya raśmibhaṃ sūkta mataḥ paraṃkpratipadvivasepāsya ca nityahomaṃ samāyyotha natvā deśikāmādarāttriśatā śātādhika sāhasraṃ pratyahaṃ prajapecchaciḥavaśyamapī vinyasya nyasya cidrūmamātṛkāṃsahasraṃ prajapennityaṃ mathavānni śatādhikaṃāṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā dvādaśāṇāṃ śriyo manaṃaṣṭottaraśatanityamumaṣṭā viṃśatiyuṣī vāpūrvekta vidhinābhyarcya śrīśrīśadvādaśāṇayāyajñanarāyaṇīvidyāṃ nityamaṣṭottara śataṃpratyahaṃtikvamekaikaṃ deśikāṃghri yugeyaṃ yatśrīrāmatanmadivase prātarutthāya vā yataḥpaṃcaviṃśatidhā varmanārāyaṇamayaṃ japatsāvitryā juhuyā pūrvamaṣṭottaraśataṃkāpitvātyaṃ hunedagnau siddhikāmassamahiḥaṣṭaviṃśatidhā hutvā vaiṣṇavyārvavedyayāpi caāṣṭārvisidhā rājyalakṣmyā ca dvayādvataṃmagava raśmividyabhirikaikāmāhutiranethyetvaikavīśaṃ saṃkhyake varmatrairataḥ paraṃhutvā japadibhiḥ paścīt prāyaścittai hunetācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ sāṣṭāgraṃṇityacaṣośanamitaṃ dravye dakṣiṇārthaṃ samarpayetanyaurā bharaṇairvastrai rasaṃ kuryācca deśikaṃpratyaha niṣkamekaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakadvigudakṣiṇāṃ datvā hū tvā hutvātha daśamī dine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yovacchakayamalaṃkāraṃ datvā yāsepinimalaṃvittalībhaṃ parityajya tadadhaṃvo tadardhakesākṣākṣītānaki vudhyā vāsolaṃkaraṇādikaṃāthayaṃ ca śataṃ patre puṣpeśca vratyaviṣayāsuvāsinīḥ paṃcadaśā viprān paṃcadaśāpyathadeśikottama pādābja prakṣālita jalaṃ śubhaṃdeśikottama hastākrā liṃgito mutrānataraṃaṣṭāviśitidhā hutvā rājārāravyā vidhadyayāśrīmadaṣṭārṇe vidyāyāḥ puraścaraṇa kṛtyataḥāyurārāgyamatulaṃ gṛtyorapi bhayaṃ vā karaṃakṣayān sarvabhogāṃśca vimānaṃ ca mahattaraṃmahītīyā puraścaryā sāṃgadakṣiṇayānvitāvāsudevasya metreṇa hutvā tada daśamī dinevaiṣṇavyā vidyayā hutvā ghṛtaṃta daśamodineśrīdvādaśārṇayā tatra hutvā saṃdajyaṃ daśamīdinesītāprasādān mahatī dhanadhānyaudya saṃkulīprāpnoti mahātīṃ lakṣmītīsminvarṣena saṃśayaḥramāvidyā siddhidaṃ dāsasmaivyāsa vālmīki satritāṃtiṣṭhaṃti bhūrtri matosya gṛhe ratnaugha varṣiṇaḥbhavatyasya na saṃdehassarvabhāgya samākulābhasya hastāṃvujeṣṭatyakṣayā muktiruttamāaśvamedha sahasrasya vājapeyāyuta tasya carājarodhyayā tatra daśayīdīvase śubheājyena koṭiśo hutvā śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayāagnigho māyute vāpi vājapeya sahasrakaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājarājeśvarīvidyā homena sadṛśaṃ phalaṃśrīrāmajanmā navamīyāto daśamīneāṇimādi guṇeśvaryaṃ putrapautrādi saṃpadabhagavadraśmividyābhirekaikāhuti homatahutvātha paṃcadhā vamurmaṃtrairnāsiyaṇeditaiḥnṛsiṃhamasya kūrmādi rūpiṇaṃ parameśvaraṃcakrādīnyāyudhānyasya mūrtimato dine dinesādhya nārāyaṇe yogī trijatpatisyatarakṣatyanvahaṃ siddhāssādhyāśca samarudraṇaḥsakhāyaṃ kurutekhasya kiṃkaraṃ vāyunaṃdanaṃaṣṭāṃga hitaṃ yogaṃ janmakoṭi smṛtiṃ śubhāṃākṣayāṃ putrapautradi samūddhiṃ ca mahattarāṃyadvā dinatrayaṃ kāryaṃ vrataṃ bhagavataḥ priyaṃsarvalokānā draṣṭānāṃ nigrahāya cacautramāseśakṛpakṣe madhyāhne navamīdinepumān daśamyaṃ bharato jātaḥ śaṃkhamūrtirjagatpatiḥjātau lakṣmārā śatrumau samitrāyāṃ sureśvarauavirāsīn māhānaksyorbhatalā ityitā satīpuraścaryā vrataṃ kāryaṃ jānakīrādyavaṃ priyakattorājyābhiṣekosyāmāsya paramāmaḥprahadī rāmaḥ prasannau bhaktatmalaprāddhadmaharṣayassiddhā bhaktasyā kṣayakārakaṃkriyate tasyasyā bhaktasya sākṣānnāpyo vibhubrahānaṃdaika vijñānaṃ kaivatsaṃ ca prapadyītiśrīrāma vaidrasya dina trayesmin vrataprabhāvena yutāṃ dvijāpyāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asyāmupoṣaṇa parāgupāda yugme datvā dhanaṃ vidhi harīśapadaṃ labhaṃteprāyatihā ratnākamanaṃtaṃ saukhyaṃ datvātha deśika padābjayu yuge ca vitaṃdatvāmu sarmaruśata dānaphalaṃ vakvavaṃśānvito bhagavataḥaṣṭākṣarasya japahoma samarcananikatvātha rājamanunāhiti mātrakaktetābhyāṃ dinatreye proktaṃ vatama pravakṣyetbrāhmemuhūrte utthāya praṇamyācārthapādayoḥśanayālā manusmṛtya kṛtaśauco jiteṃdriyaḥācāryacaraṇadvaṃ sādaraṃ praṇipatya cajaptvāthaṃ vāsudevāravyāṃ vaiṣṇavī ca śataṃ japetprasannalakṣmīvidyāṃ vā śrīṣaḍarṇamanuṃ tu vāprajayedvaiṣṇavaṃ varmaya ca viṃśatidhānvahaṃvātiteṃdriyo haviṣyāśītyaktā tāṃvūlalabhaṇaṃsamarpayet tadardha vā tṛtīyāṃ śamuthāpi vāmāyai deśikasyātha śrīvudhyā bharaṇādikaṃdvādaśyaṃ prātarutthāya nityakame samāpya caaṣṭāviṃśātidhā hutvā sāvitryādaugavāṃ ghṛtaṃ |śrāddhagavyajyamathavā vā sahasraṃ juhuyācchataṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvā lakṣmādvaśavarṇayāāṣya viṃśatidhā hutvā yajñeśamanā tataḥbhagagavadraśmibhiḥ pūrvaṃ hutvaikaikāṃ ghṛtāhutiṃhutvā japatvāyadibhiḥ paścāt kṛtvā brahmārpaṇā hutiṃācāyasimalaṃkṛtyagaṃdhapuṣpaiśca vāsasādhyāvacchasāmalaṃkaraṃ dauśikāyātha vārpayetauviprāsmuvāvāsi varṇā caladānānāṃ sahasraphalamakṣayaśubhamakṣayaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhagavaṃtaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhuṃsāṃgadakṣiṇayā yukta puraścarya sahasrataḥrājarājeśvarīvidyā prabhāvāhuvenugrahātvaiṣṇuvyāvarmavidyāyāḥ puraścayośatātyaṃtādṛśī mahatī siddhirjāyatesya na saṃśayaḥhutvātra prāpnuyāt siddhiṃ puraścayo śatodbhavāniṣkāṇaṃ śatasāhāsramapi dhenu sahasrakaṃācāryasannidhau yadvā pratijñāyātha dakṣiṇāṃkalpāṃte jñāninaḥ śuddhyadeśikāya mahātmaneṣaṇamāsānaṃtaraṃ deryadviguṇaṃ dravyamādarātmuktaṃ pitrā ca dhīmatādurlabhāṃdaṃ divasa tritaye vāpi navarātrepi vā vrataṃsa eva sarvaviprāṇāmagragaroyo mahān vibhūḥdinatrayavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ navarātranātādapivimuktaḥ pāparāśibhyaḥ samagra sukṛkatānvitaḥjaḍopi bhavati kṣipraṃ sītārāma prasādataḥsaṃtati vyāpinī lakṣmīṃ prāpnotye vācalāṃ dhruvabhavaṃti putrāḥ pautrāśva prapautrā pitādṛśāḥyakṣarājāmarādhīśasadaśī śriya mūrjitāṃdivyakanyā sahasreṇasāhitaṃ savarbhāgayuksvarvadeva priyo bhūtvā sarvardhigaṇa sammataḥtejomaya tanurbhūtvāṃ paṃcaviṃśati vārpirkadivyavastradharo bhūtvā divyabhoga sukhānvitaḥdvinatraye vrataṃ katvā sādhyā nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃvatserevatyevaśyaṃ cakṣurbhyā saṃpraśayati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svakarasthamiti dhyāyedapi svakatārthatāṃsvegamartyepi pātālo tasyā sādhyaṃ na vidyetebrahmārviṣṇumaheśāśca maheśaṃ yādigīśvarāḥpālayaṃti divārātraṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇatmakaṃitthaṃ suniścitaṃ sarvaṃjābhīdhaṃ brahmanaṃdanāḥśrīmadaṣṭaṇī siddhiryasmabhyaṃ yadīritāta ūrdhva dvijaśrīṣṭā kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchayaḥsanidhau karuṇātyanātyayā sagaprasapyetakāḥthitaṃ divyasādhanaṃcanmukhatva vadhaḥ śrītvānaṣṭīna saṃśayo mahānśriyo devyāḥ sahasrārṇa sūcitāna na prakāśitānārāyaṇe mahāyogīmuni svasmṛto vudhauḥdevatā jāganāthaḥ paramānmāsanāttanaḥkeśavetyatha nārāyāṇā mādhava yadda tataḥvāman śrīdhanetyutkā hṛṣṭīkośayadaṃtataḥvāsudeva padaṃ paścāt pradyumna padamapyathaadhokṣajanārasihācyuta śabdaṃ janārdanajāpa dvaṃdvaṃ jaganmūrti jagannātha padaṃ tataḥidevadedotyuktvā devatā sārvabhauma caviśvātman viśviṃbhana ca viśveśvana padaṃ tataḥvadevedyā padāṃ vedāṃta saṃstutaṃ padaṃ tataḥcaturyāṃ dravaturvyeha prasrīdayugalaṃ tataḥpraṇāvātān parātparaparamātmannataḥ paraṃyuyugmaṃ hayagrīvaptavaṃ vidyā nidheyahaṃtataścakataṇasidhokāṃmapāla kṛpānidhekṛtāṃta bhayaśabdāṃte nāśaneti padaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japadvaṃdvaṃ mukuṃdeni mucukuṃdastatetyathajamātha maraṇenyuktvā rahiteti yadātparaṃbhūsutākuva śabdāṃto bhūṣaṇeti japadvayaṃyajetyatha varāheti padaṃ na tahana na hare tataḥpadaṃ dāśarathītyaktvā rāmetivalari rāmayajñeti phalade suktvā yajñeśvara japa dvayaṃsahasraṇīṣeśabda ca sahasrākṣarpi tataḥsaṃhānakārakenyatkā samastasukharanāma cabhūtatakapadaṃ khāmin suṇīlasulābhetyathasāvitrī pravidyeti sarvaloka guro padaṃtriguṇaka karaśabdaṃte padaṃ trailokyanāyakajapadvaṃdva tataḥ sītāpate rādhāpate tataḥbhāmādyaṣṭayadaṃ paścāduccerenmahiṣīyatejapayugmaṃ daśarathātmajanāsannānaḥ paravatsāleti śāraroyeti śaṃkarārcya padāṃvujaprāra āṃjaneyu gurotparvavānanetpatyarthaṃ vaṃditavanadeti varīyati vimānārūḍhanāma cajapadvaṃva ca brahmaṇyadetaṃ dātmajetyathaḥśaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhana śrīvatlāṃchanamaheṃdraṃ vaṃdita padaṃ maheśāviḥdhiprajitauapayugmaṃ gokaleti saṃrakṣaka padaṃ tataḥnityānaṃdasya rūpoti cinmayeti cidīśvaraparamānaṃda rūpeti parameṣintataḥ panaṃpurastutyeni bhakteti padaprītikanetyathavīrarāghavaśabdaṃ ca vīreti puruṣetyatha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anaṃtarūpānaṃteti saukhyadā bhadanāma cadattātreyeti kadyīla dvaiyāya na padaṃ tataḥsurāsura mahāṣīti devarṣi padamapyathamahānubhāghaśārdvica japayugma mataḥ paraṃyogithṛtyaprānilāya yogi dhyeya padāṃvujaṃpṛthivyudakarūpeti tejo vāyu mayetyathasarvatatvamayet yaktvā sarveṃdriya manomayanityaṃ śāśvata śuddheti japadvaṃdva mataḥ paraṃprajāyati mayet yuktvā gaṃdhavadhivate padaṃsāketanagarādhīśamathurādhiyate padaṃkāṃcī punnīnāyakāṃtīhyavaṃtī nāyakītyathaśreta dvīpādviśadvāṃte nāyaketi padātparaṃayodhyānagarīdhīśa bhaktannīṇaparāyaṇaśrīvatsakaustustaloraska vanamālā vibhūṣitaḥdivyamālyapadaṃ paścādvirājita padaṃ tataḥsuprasannapadaṃ paścād vadanāṃvuja nāma cahānarūpunakeyūra kuṃḍaladvaya śobhitasāmasta bhaktā sāmājya bhogasvagapivrgādarādhāvallabhabhūnīlāvatkṛbheti japadvayaṃpuruṣāṃte mahāyugmaṃ rājanāmahādvayaṃbhūtanātha padaṃ lokanāthannādayataḥ paraṃlakṣmīpatī mahālakṣmīpate śabdā mataḥ paraṃjapayugmaṃ sasamuccārya śrīnārāyaṇanāma calakṣamyāligita vāmabhāgamaniśaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vitayehastairvibhraditi śrokarū paṃcamanunāyaka
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśamodhyāya uktoyaṃ brahmajñānibhirāvṛtaḥśrutā tava mukhāṃbhojādbhagavadraśmimālikādattātreyasya māhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ dvaipāyanasya caiti dāśarathiḥ pṛṣṭo bhagavānjānakīpatiḥśṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥvedeṣu sarvavedāṃteṣvapi sārārthasaṃgraheyadakṣaraṃ paraṃbrahma manovācāmagocaraṃtacchaktiścitkalānāmaśrīḥ sarvajagadaṃvikācidrūpiṇyātayāśaktyāsahitaḥ paramaḥ pumānajaṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ nāmnā viśvasṛṣṭividhāyakaṃparabrahmamayaḥ sākṣādahaṃ nārāyaṇo vibhuḥdakṣavānasmimadvidyāṃyayāmatphalayānvitaḥyasminkāle mahāvidyāṃ śrīśrīśadvādaśākṣarīṃvidyāyā brahmarūpatvādbrahmavidyetitāṃ jaguḥyasmātadbrāhmasamayedateyaṃ brahmaṇe mayābrahmatādātmya hetutvādbrahmavidyeyamīritābrahmavidyāmimāṃ prāhuḥ śrīśrīśabdādaśākṣarīṃparabrahmamayobhūtvā sasarjanikhilaṃ jagatśarīre saṃpraviṣṭābhūdbrahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭinaḥkartṛtvaṃ sarvajagatāṃmaṇimādi guṇānapiśrīśrīśadvādaśārṇeyaṃ brahmavidyā tataḥ smṛtābrāhmesamaya utthāya saṃsmṛtyācāryapādukāṃlabhate nityakalyāṇamakṣayāḥ saṃpadopi carājñī sakalavidyānāmadhikābhūcchutiṣvapisiddhyaṃti saiva sarvāsāṃ vidyānāmadhikā smṛtā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭaviṃśākṣarādhikya triśatākṣara saṃvutāsarvapātakasaṃhatrīśokanivāriṇīrājarāja mahāvidyā japāṃte dine dinesakṛt smaratiyo nityaṃ tasya syuḥ sarvasaṃdvaprasahasrākṣara vidyāyāḥ prajāpī sādhakottamaḥsahasrāṇamī mahāvidyā pratāyī satataṃ bhavetācāryakaruṇaivāsyādīkṣīktā paramārṣibhiḥdakṣiṇā gurupādābjā yugale kathitā bhuviprajaptvā paṃcadhā vidyāmighnāṃ saṃkha phalapradāṃativṛṣṭe maye vahni saṃnidhau paṃcadhā japetaśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā rājarājeśvarī parāpuraścarya vināpyasya siddhidaṃ dadyānmāhatarāṃsahasrākṣara vidyeya tasya siddhā bhaviṣyatimeheṃdrapurasāprājya lakṣmīrapi sarasvatīaya mṛtyuṇamanī sarvāriṣṭa nivāriṇīdeśikāṃdhi yuge vittaśāṭhyaṃ tyaktvādvigottamāḥdakṣiṇaṃ vahudatvā sahasrārṇamimāṃ truciḥsakṛt smarati vā rājarājavidyā japātparaṃprāpyā puṣpaṃ mahadbhāgyaṃ putrapautravatī śriyaṃtejomaya tanurbhūtvāṃ prāteparapadaśriyo devyāḥ sahasrāṇaṃ pravakṣyāmi tataḥ paraṃkalpamāśeṣalobhādekībhūtaṃ vapukhatunaḥ puṃḍakākṣa lakṣmyāḥyasya vijñānatopīha pūjyato trijagatsvapipadaṃ hṛdayadevīti śiro devi padaṃ tataḥnetra devyastra devīti kāmeśvari padaṃ tataḥ

sanskrit: bheruṃḍa vahni śabdāṃte vāsinīti mahāpadaṃnitye nīlapatāketha vijaye sarvamaṃgaleparameśvara śavāṃte parameśvari śadvātaḥnāthama viprotyaloyāmadrāmāyītyathadharmāvāryamapi prītrya muktakeśīśvaretyathapaṭṭaṃdevamayītyuktvā prabhākarapadaṃ tataḥmanojadevaśabdagatemapi kalāṇa śabdātaḥvāsudevamapi śrīrāmānaṃdāyamayītyathamahimāsiddha īśitva siddhe pada mataḥ paraṃparabhuktiṃ siddhe padaṃ cecchyā siddhe pretyi padātparaṃmāheśvari ca kaumāri vaiṣṇavīti padātparaṃmāhālakṣmi padaṃ sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇi yadātpāraṃparaṃ sarṣavaśītvatkākaraṇīpi padātparaṃsarvakhecarite sarvavījī padaṃ tataḥcakrasvāmini śabdāṃte prakaṭetyatha yoginiākarṣiṇi padaṃ śadvākaviṇīti padaṃ tataḥsākarṣiṇi śabdāṃte gaṃdhāṃ karṣiṇyataḥ paraṃparastṛtyākaṣīni śabdāṃtenāmākarṣiṇyataḥ paraṃamūtākarṣiṇīyudhkaraśaraṇakarṣiṇītyathaguptayoginyaṃ namādya kusumenaṃga mekhaleanaṃgarekhenaṃgādyaveginīti padaṃ tataḥsavaṃ saṃkṣībhāṇetyuktvā cakrasvāminyathoccaretsarvasaṃkṣībhiṇī suktvā sarvavidāviṇītyathasarvasaṃmohinī yuktvā sarvastāṃbhinyataḥ paraṃsarvaraṃjini śabdāte sarvonmādinyathoccaret

sanskrit: sarvamaṃtramayī yuktvā sarvadvaṃkṣayaṃ karicakrāsvāmī niśadvaṃvaṃ saṃpradāyādyayoginisupraśamani sarvavighnānivāriṇīsarvārthasādhaketyuktvā cakra svāminmathecceretsarvajña savaśaktaṃtha sarveśvarya prādāpīnisarvaṣārākhāyetha sarvayāya hareṣadaṃsarvośita phaletyukāprade sarvayadṛtanigabhādhogiṃ padaṃ vaśiniti padātparavimaleśa marūṇejami nīti yatparaṃsarvaroga haret yuktvā cakrakhāminyathoccaretvāśinyaṃ kuśinot yuktvā mahākāmeśvarītyathamāhāśrīsuṃdarītyuktvā sarvasiddhi mahetyathaśrīśrīmāhāpadaṃbhadyarikeya mataḥ paraṃparāpara rahasyāya yoginīti pada taptaḥtripurāṃte vāsinīti tripurāśrīḥ padaṃ tataḥtripurāṃ ca padaṃ paścānmātripurasuṃdarimahāmāhāpūrvaśaktopada paścān mahāpadaṃmahāmahānaṃda iti māhāśabda mataḥ paraṃmahāśrīcakranagasāmrājñīti padaṃ tataḥayaṃ manaḥ śriyo dovyā yuṣmabyaṃ kathito mayādakṣiṇāmūrtirasyoktavṛṣiḥ sarvajña īśvaraḥpāśaṃ cāṃkuṣṭā maikṣavaṃdhanurathośokādinekobhābhāsuraṃ divyākalpa śatānvitaṃimahadāśrayāmī paramaṃ sāmrājyalakṣmīmayaṃdhyātvā hṛtkamale nityaṃ sahasrārṇe manuṃ japet

sanskrit: khevarāvaṃ maharṣitvaṃ brahmarṣitvāmathāpi vākhadaśca pādukā siddhirajanaṃvila siddhimadādavaśyākarṣaṇaṃ saṃmohastaṃbhanāni ca sarvataḥetāḥ paṃcadaśamīktā dvidyānāṃ siddhayaḥ kramātsatyāṣṭa mālā japanaṃ sakvatkatka dine dinesatyāṣu mālikājīvoṣarāmā saṃvatmaraṃ tu vāidādīnaṣṭadikapālānāpīdāsārakanotyasauśriyo devyā mahāvidyāṃ śraddhāmeva triśo japetśruyo devyāḥ sahasrāṇaṃ vedavedota saṃgrahaṃasmin prajatyepi sakṛtṛ sarvāḥ siddhyati sīddhayaḥsahasrārṇe padeśārthāmācārya karuṇa parāvaṣāśinamitaṃ dravyamathavā dakṣiṇa smṛtāśālagrāmaśelāyukteyā pūjāpūvamīritāsiddhyatyasya na saṃdehaḥ kiṃ ca brahmamayo bhavetsmāraṇādatra vidyāyāṃ tāsāṃ yumo bhavetvidyāyāṃ smaraṇī naitāḥ pālayaṃti svaputravatmātṛvan maṃdire tasya rakṣatyā caṃdratārakaṃsahasrāṇaṃ mahāvidyāṃ śriyo devyāḥ sakajjapetsahasrā prajaptavyā śriyaḥ sarvaphalapradāitīdaṃ kathitaṃ viprāḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrītumicchathaśrutvāva mukhāṃbhojāt purātyāpi prakāśitāśrītumicchāmaḥ kṛpayāktu marhasirājarājeśvarīvidyā sādhanaṃ mahadiṣṭadaṃ****** nare prāhaddevyai śriyai hariḥsopyasymajjanako yogī kardamo bhagavānṛṣiḥ

sanskrit: lakṣmīpatī raghupati yadiyānāṃ yatirhariḥaṃsau dāśarathī rāmo ukārāya yāvanaḥkathayāmāsasyomi trimaratādibhya ādarātdeśaṃ kālaṃ ca vīkṣyāhau bhavasāgaratāratāraṇaṃyo dadāti svājñiṣyāya deśikaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥyaḥ śikṣayatitaṃ prārāvāyīmīśvaraṃyaḥ sikṣayati śiṣyebhyasta mācāryaṃ vidurvadhāḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ yaḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ prakāśayetsamastaraśmisahitāṃ śriyaḥ padaśākṣīrīvadaṃti paramācāṃ brahmāṇaśaṃkaraṃ vibhaṃyuguptāṃ sakalavedeṣu ṣaṇaṣāgameṣvapitaṃdeśikīttamaṃ prājñāṃ sākṣādbhādākṛtitamevotamamācorya vidurnārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃbrahmaṃ rudrādidavevobhyarvanādviṣuavijñāyamaṃ kolaṃ sudeśamanavekṣya camadhumāse bhaveduḥkhaṃ mādhave ratna saṃpadaḥsyamastābhīṣṭasiddhiḥ syācchrāvaṇemāsi saṃtataṃāśvine dhanadhānyādi saṃpadaḥ syuḥ pade padejapalakṣmīrmārgāśīṣe bhavatyasya na saṃśayaḥmādhamāse bhaveśokṣādragavadarśanaṃ vudhāḥdvitīyā vā tṛrīyā casyekādaśī tathā deśamomahapurāyā etāḥ syustithayaḥ trubhāḥdeśākālaṃ parokṣyetthaṃ śiṣyasya guṇāguṇankālevaramapi prāṇansaṃrakherājya saṃpadadaṃācāryapatnī prādhrāṇaṃ kaikayaṃ prisahaṃ śaci

sanskrit: yadapanatījiṃtodāṣī hastārbhyā tāḍitopivāpūrṇanugraha evāyemiti yomanyate bhṛśaṃtathā vidyasya śiṣyasya bhavasāgaratāriṇīśathamācarya pādābja kiṃkarāyātamānasaḥrājarājeśvarī vidyā mayanayaṃ pratyahaṃ japetyeṣāṃ śruvaṇato vāpi bhavato siddhiranuttamātadevā bhūyo vayāmi śṛkhaṃtu paramarṣayaḥsaṃtamadhumāse tuduktaṃ sakalasiddhidaṃvatsane vatsane kṛtvāniyāṣatamānasaḥsvarūvṛṣaiva bhagavatssaṃbhrāriṇamīśvaraṃathavā madhumāse trayati pādinamāditaḥkṣudhā vedamātaramabhya nityahomaṃ samāpravakatāṃjali rūpāsīta sūktaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ japanjaptvā pratyahamekāṃte vāsudeva mahāmanuṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā dvādaśāṇa ramā manuṃaṣṭāviṃśādhā japtvā sahasraṇi dviyaṃ sakṛtācāryacaraṇadvaṃdve pratyahaṃ pūrva sasmitaṃtadaddhavānvahaṃ bhaktyā vittalobhaṃ parityajetekabhaktāśano vāpi navamyādi dinatrayeśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyā vīsu devādikānapipaṃcaviṃśatidhā nityaṃ divasa tritaye japetmekaikamathavā divasa tritayerpayetkarṣamānamalaṃkāramekaika divaserpayetśrīrāmajanmadivase yadvālaṃkārayuttamaṃśrīrāmajanmādivasa maheṃdiyaśata prabhaṃ

sanskrit: daśamyekādaśī vā pitatmamaiyāvyate vudhauḥakaṃ parva samaṃ prāhurmāhāmiddhi pradāyakaṃsaṃskṛtyā vidivadvahisāṃvi āgoghṛtaṃ abhaṃkāpilājyaṃ hunedagnau śatādhika sahasrakaṃvāsudevasya manutā vaiṣṇavyā ca ṣaḍaṇayāhatvāya ca śataṃ vahnau tryaddhagavyātyamādarātpaṃcadhā juhuyādvarma maṃtrairātya mataḥ paraṃpraṇipatya ca sāṣṭāṃgaṃ hmāṃte jātavedasaṃgṛhavāsāḥ samapyadi kuṃḍa dvitayaṃbhubhaudrākṣā bharaṇaṃ vāpi muktālakaraṇaṃ tu vāśālagrāma śilāṃ dadyāddakṣiṇāsahitā guroḥkadalī phalarāśiṃ ca śarkanāṃ ca guḍaṃ tathādvādaśātha suvāsinyo dvādaśa brāhmaṇā apiācāryaśeṣa bhuṃjīta svayaṃdhubhiranvitaḥyasya vijñānatau vāpī pūjyate saṃcarācarauviśeṣadivase vāṣijvalite jātavedasi***** hutvādau śrīdhayā huti mācaretavyāhatagati siddhaḥ sarvabhāgyanyidhirbharvatbhūtvaṃ hatkata kṛtyotha sākṣīnnārāyaṇe bhavetkṛtvā brahmamayaḥ sākṣādvimuktaḥ pāparāśibhiḥsakalā vidyāṃ nāma nadhītopi sādhakaḥmuktāratnagajāśvādi saṃkalāṃ dhanasaṃkulaṃdīrghamādyuṣya māsādya vimuktaḥ sakalairgadauḥparamaṃ padamānyoti kulasāhasaṃ yataḥpuraścaryāmimā kṛtvā siddho bhavati raṇadhakaḥ

sanskrit: nārāyaṇaṃ māhātmānaṃ bharatādimiranvitaṃdarśanena labhate mahāsāmarthyamuttamaṃarogyaṃ dīrghāmāyuṣyaṃ śaṃkhāṃdī śrīnidhīnnavasaṃprāpyā tatparaṃ dhāmadehāṃte viśati svayaṃtasya puṇya phalaṃ vaktraṃ nāhaṃśakroṇi bhūsurāḥnārāyaṇe mahātmāsau rāmādāśarathirvibhuḥbrahmarṣirbhirvaśiṣṭādyauḥ sahitaḥ sapibhiṣṭaṃtaḥsākṣītkate jagannāthe śrīrāme paramātmanibhūtale svarge mertyepi pātāle sākṣānnārāyaṇātmanabrahmānaṃdaika vijñānaṃ jāti smaraṇamuttamaṃdurlabhaṃ devasaṃdyaiścā durlabhaṃ paramarṣibhiḥtrivārayaḥ karotīidaṃ vrataṃ paramapāvananārāyaṇaṃ brahmatmānaṃ paśyatyeva svacakṣuṣāprārthya taddivya kanyābhiḥ kaṃdapaṃ sadṛśaḥ śriyāanenaiva śarīreṇa jarāmaraṇa varjitaḥsiddha gaṃdharva pakṣaiścaṃdravadānayakinaraiḥprasādān mahatī siddhiṃ prāpyade vaiśvadurlabhāṃtejomaya tanurbhūtvā divyabhoga samanvitaḥkalpāṃte hari sāyujyaṃ kukoṭi sāmāvitaḥna saṃśayonna viśvāsaṃkurudhaṃ brahmanaṃdanāatrātharvāṃgiro gītājāthaṃ saṃpratiḥ vakṣyateaṣṭārṇavidyāṃ śrītisāssaṃgrahāṃ japtvā sahasrāṃ triśatāṃ dineṣuśrīvisavidyāṃ śajñamādareṇa japtvārka varṇaṃ pranumiṃdirāyāḥsmṛtvātha varma prajayecca paṃcanārā praṇasyākhila lokasākṣiṇaḥjagaptvā mahadvāmaṃ dinejakha deśikasyāṃ priyage samarpaṇaṃ

sanskrit: śrīrāmajanmādi dinatraye tu karṣaṃ pradadyādatha niṣkamekasavasuḥ ācāryapatnīṃ kamalādhiyārcayedarūparmatrāpi dinatrayesminaṣṭākṣareṇatha manudvayena sataṃ tathāṣṭādhikamatra hutvātadvarma maṃtrairapivaṃ ca hutvā natvāgremabhyarcya puru praṇamyavāsobhisarakalpagaṇairathārcayeda śakta ekena vibhūṣaṇenakṣīrapradāṃ vatsayutāṃ pradadyādavaśyamācāryāyadāravidetuṣṭipradaṃ bhūktikaraṃ praśastaṃ khagāṃ pavarāgaṃ pradamādareṇavāḥpituśca mātuḥkalajaiḥ sametā āruddhyānaṃ sakalārtha yuktaṃkṛtvā nārāyaṇātmāsau bhavatyatra na saṃśayaḥbhūyopi saṃpravakṣyāmiścarāpūr' brahmanaṃdanāḥnāvā tretāyugādyāvala rāmajanmatithirbhaganī tithirisṭadātrīparabrahmaṇilīnatā catadājñāṃ śisāpragarahya saṃdhyā mayāsyatha viśuddhacetāḥna ca vaikṛvenarājādhirājena mārameśaṃ manūttame nātha ghṛtaṃ sugavyaṃpaṃcātha hutyā harivarma maṃtrerjayādibhirgavya ghṛtena hutvāhaimaṃ suraramya gurukaṇī yugmesu kuṃḍalā saṃkaraṇaṃ pradadyātvarṣāśanaṃ vyamatha pradadyācchataṃ sahasraṃ dhananansamarpayettanmanavittaṃ na hi śikasya dadyāt padābje manusiddhikāmaḥphalatrayaṃ phavālavakaṃ vāramyaṃ vahusyūlamalamari prasiddhaṃupānaho chara varāṇi dadyo dvetāṃ tayāṃragatta sādhakebhyaḥmṛṣṭhānnatāṃ phalasudakṣiṇadyaiḥ saṃtovya viprāṃśc suvāsinīścaḥmuktaḥ mahemaheṃdra viśvaramāna lakṣmīmākalpamakṣapya samṛddhiyaktāsyāt kaṃdarghya sāhasra samānakāṃtimi vāya putrānsurāṇamirāmānuddhatā divyaṃ vararālā bhūṣaṇaṃ vimānumārudyara viprakāśaḥ

sanskrit: ārabhya tadinaṃ nityaṃ yataḥ śreyaḥ paraṃparāvijñeyaḥ paramācāryastameva satataṃ vibhuṃnācarenmanasādrohamapi tasya guroḥ kvacitna tasya niṃdāśravaṇaṃ yatra kutrāpi vā caretputramitrakalatrādisaṃpabhyaḥ pracyavaṃtitegrāmasūkaratāṃprāpya caṃḍāleṣvapi jāyatetyaktvānyasmaidhanaṃdhānyamalaṃkārādikaṃ śubhaṃśrutyuktaṃ vihitaṃ karmatyaktvānyatraratodvijaḥācāryapatnīputrādipoṣaṇaṃ nityamādarāttasmādavaśyamācāryacaraṇāṃvuruhadvayaṃapi brahmavidenyasmaidadātu na dadātu vāsatpatnīpūjanaṃ sākṣānmahālakṣmyārcanaṃ viduḥācāryapatnīputrāṇāmasāṃnidhye śriyaḥpateḥtatsarvamarpitaṃ vastu gatvāpi bahuyojanaṃpautrāya vātha tadbhātre gurudravyaṃ samarpayetaṃdhaṃ tamaḥ pravitrāti yāvadābhūta saṃplavaṃkartavyamanvahaṃ nityaprayatnenāpi sādhakaiḥpitṛsaṃpoṣaṇaṃ paścāt patnīputrādipoṣaṇaṃācāryamāṃvijānīyātatpatnīmapi ca śriyaṃtadvaṃśasaṃbhavānviddhisanakārīnmahāmatepatnyādipoṣaṇenehasaukhyamakṣapyamaśnutteetatkālevarāṃtesya matsvarūpaṃ dadāmyahaṃtyajet svapatnīputrādīn tyajedbhrātṛṃścavāṃdhavānmātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi bhrātaraṃ vāṃdhavaṃtu vāācāryaniṃdākartāraṃ hanyādyadvā parityajet

sanskrit: sudurlabha yogivarai rapītdyaṃ prāpnoti lakṣmīpati dhāma paścātvatsare vatsare vaśyaṃ japahomādikāḥ krīyāḥkṛtvā phalapradānaṃ catvāva harivaṃdanaṃakṣayaṃ cirāayuṣya makṣayā rogyamuttamaṃakṣayā mahatīṃ vidyāṃ gaṃgākalolasaṃnibhāṃakṣayān divyabhogāśca mānuṣānayo dalebhānakṣayābhīṣṭadā tṛtvā dakṣavaṃdiya saṃviduḥṣaṣṭi triśata saṃkhyāka tithi *yamanuttamārājarājeśvarīvidyā homasaṃmiśritāṃ śubhāṃakṣayāvāṃ tṛtīyātyāṃ deśikānujñayādvijāḥpuraścaraṇame tadyaḥ karoti prativatsaraṃnimagnānnarakaṣvapi etatkalarvarasyāṃte yoginamapidurlabhaṃekena dvivase naiva puraścaryā śātodbhavāathaikasmindine siddhiranyāpyatra pravakṣyateapi gaṃḍena yogena yuktvā yadvā sukarmaṇāpradoṣe vā madhyāhne vātha saṃdhyaṣḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ nāmnā yogarājaṃ vadaṃtilakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ yogavadaṃti paramarṣayaḥmahālakṣmipatiḥ sākṣāt prasīdati dayānidhiḥnityaṃ paṃcāgni madhyasyeyāṃ siddhiṃ mahatī labhātyatkiṃcidāpi datvāso prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥayutaṃ pratyahaṃ japtvā hutvā sāhasra manvahaṃekāmapyāhutiṃ kṛtvā tatopi dviguṇaṃ phalaṃlakṣmīnārāyaṇonisaṃ sahasraṃ brahmavidyayādatvātra kusumaṃ caikaṃ tatopi dviguṇaṃ phalaṃ

sanskrit: tulā puruṣa mukhyāni mahādānāni ṣoḍaśaatrācāpidābhoje nikamātraṃ ca kāṃcanaṃlabhyate sau mahāyogo māhābhāgyena nānyathayogosmin samanu prāpto niśāyāmahivāśraviḥdeśikānujñayāstātvā tīrthe sarasī vā śuciayodhyānagare cakre śālagrāma śilānvitetriśatādhika sāhasra mamarcayed brahmanidyayātriśatādhika sāhasramarcaya brahmavidyayāekaika puṣpadānena brahmavidyāṃ samuccarantata ācārya sānnidhye vidhivat saṃskṛte nalesāvitryā juhuyādādāvaṣṭottaśataṃ vudhaiḥsahasraṃ juhuyādagrau śatādhikamataḥ paraṃaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā pratyekaṃ jātavedasihutvā paṃcaśataṃ vahnau rasmibhirjuhuyāt sukṛtaṣṭāviśatidhā gavyaṃ juhuyāddvātamādarātpaṃcadhā juhuyādamrau śuddhenājyena sādhakaḥācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ praṇipatyātha sādaraṃācāryakarṇa yugale pradadyāt kuṃḍala dvayaṃśālagrāmāmaśilāṃ kṣaddhāṃ tasya haste samarpayetcaturviṃśātini kanānika dvādaśakaṃ tu vāekādhenurvahukṣīrā pradātavyāṃ savatsakāpreṣaṇīyāstinnāstasya maṃdiraṃ siddhimicchatāḥśāktānāṃ dhanādhyānāṃ tu vakṣyotāddīvahudakṣiṇayā yuktā deśikāya samarpayetmudrikodaravaṃdhādīna laṃkārān samarpayet

sanskrit: śālagrāmaśilāṃ niṣkaśata sāhasradākṣiṇāṃmahādānāni cānyāni dadyādā jādhanī tu vāyogarāje mahtyatra lakṣīkṣī nārāyaṇābhidhekoṭiśastilahomasya phalaṃ dviguṇamaṣṇutesavaṇe meru dānasya phayanyoti śāśvataṃgāyatrā koṭi homasya sukṛtaṃ sāgamakṣayaṃakṣayaṃ yatphalaṃ bhoktaṃ purāṇaiḥ paramarṣibhiḥsaṃpūrṇa dakṣiṇā yukta vājimedhā yutena calakṣmīnārāyaṇe yoga protyevanaṃ saṃśayaḥkhaṇesteya śatenāpi gurupaśatena vāsaṃprāpyātyaṃta saubhāgyaṃ kaṃdayesa daśa prabhaṃratnaṇaṃśi samākīṇemavāpye jagatītalevimuktaḥssakalāphalaḥ sarvaroga vivarjitaḥmukulakoṭi saṃmuddhṛtya brahmānaṃdarasāspadaṃrājarājamahāvidyā sādhanaṃ sakaleṣṭadaṃrājarāja mahāvidyāśeṣa māhāhyamanuttamaṃbrahmavidyānusaṃdhānaṃ yathā śaktyā tataḥ paraṃśrīdevīrāśmi vidyānāṃ smaraṇaṃ ca tataḥ paraṃgāyatrāyāsanāyaścābhitya homastataḥ paraṃpaṃcadaśārṇayā upāstiśca dine dinesahasrārṇa mahāvidyā dvayo yāstistataḥ paraṃvarmaṇe vaiṣṇavasyātha ghaṭanaṃ pratyahaṃ tathāsaṃpūrṇo yāstirityuktā sarvasiddhikarī śubhābhagavadraśmi sūktasya smaraṇaṃ ca tataḥ paraṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā japo nityaṃ sahasraśaḥ
