sanskrit: vāsudevādi vidyānāṃ yathā rātryājamojvaḥcatuḥśataṃ paṃcaśataṃ triśataṃ vā śataṃ tu vāaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityamaviśatidhāpi vāyajñeśvara mahāvidyā smaraṇaṃ sāyamapyathabrahmavidyā japonityaṃ sadhyo yāstirataḥ paraṃvāsudevasya vaiṣṇavyā yathā sakti japonvaheāṣṭottaraśataṃ vepi yāvacchakya japothavāaṣṭaviśavacchavya japonvahaṃrājarājamahāvidyā smaraṇaṃ yena saṃtataṃkaṃapte yena saṃpūrṇeyāsanā janitaṃ phalaṃanahīta śrutirapi yāgahīnopi vānvahaṃlakṣmīnārāyaṇīvidyāṃ taptvā sarvaśrutiṣvapipārāyarāṇa phalaṃ nityaṃ vedābhāṃ sāgamādaśatekāmapyāhuti ghṛtvā rājarājyavidyayārājarāja mahāvidyā smṛteranvahamādarātsaṃsīddhā bhavaṃtyatra na saṃśayaḥbhṛguvāsara saṃyuktā citrā nakṣatra saṃyutāvarṣe dvādaśabhiryogaḥ prāpyateya sanātanavāreṣu bhārgavovārastithiṣṭhekādaśīśramābrahmatātmā saṃsiddhipradoyamakhileṣṭadaḥtasya nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī rājyalakṣmī samanvitaḥlakṣmīssakalaṃ bhaktabhāṃ prasannā kamalāyāsamasta jagatāṃ māthaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥprasanna kamalāyoge saṃprayoganoyākejuhāti su samidvedagnaudyatkividapi kāṃcanaṃ

sanskrit: bhūtyā nāmagragarā paraṃ tvamahaṃ dāsyāmimatyadeprasīdatyasya bhaktasya satyameva na saṃśayaḥdeśikānutathā srātvā nityakarma samāpya catriśātādhika sāhasraṃ juhuyāt kāpilaṃ ghṛtahutvātha ca vāsudeva svamanunāṣṭottaśatatadvādaśārṇa śriyāya śrīrājyalakṣmyātha vā tataḥhunedaṣṭottaraśatamaṣṭāviṃśatidhāpi vātāto japāgadībhirhotvā katvā brahmarparāgahutigaṃdhapuṣpairatnaṃ kṛtya dhanu dvitayamādarātvahakṣmīra samāyukta savatsa dakṣitānvitaṃarpayedvakṣiṇā tatra vaśośananitaṃ dhanaācayedapitāṃ vastrairalaṃkāraissamarcayetpuṣpamāse paurṇamāsyāmakaṃ vāro bhavedyadibhūteśvaranāmāyaṃ mahalakṣmīpatidhiyaḥmahāciṃtāmaṇirmnā yogoyaṃ durlabho bhuviadhaḥśāyī haviṣyaśī śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃvāsudeva mahavidyo vaudyavivaṃ ṣaḍakṣarīprasanna lakṣmīmatha vinitya paṃcaśataṃ japetaṣṭāviṃśatidhā yadvā saṃprāpto caṃdravayarvaṇisaṃskṛtyovārdhavaddhā tatrāvātva śripaiḥghṛtamiśrīstīlau paścacchaṃtādhika sahasrakahutvā dvādaśadhāva vadahau vaiṣṇavyā vidyayāpyathatriśata juhuyādājya śuddhāmeva śatata vāyājayāḥdibhistato hatvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇahuniagnitra jvalitaṃ paścannatvācārya padadvayaṃ

sanskrit: avaśyaṃ kuṃḍala dvaṃdvaṃ deśikāya samarpayetsarvasvamarpayeddhīmānyaccayā vadāho sthitacaturviṃśatiti niṣkavāṃ tadardhavā samarpayetsālāgrāma śilāṃ dadhādyā vicchasaṃ dakṣiṇatulahirāya garbhādi dānadyānmahīpatiḥyadyatvorātit sarvamanatu phaladaṃ smṛtavāsobhirapya laṃkārairarcayet sādhakottamaḥyāvacchavyamalaṃkāgatvā deśikakarṇayāḥsūniṣka dvādaśakaṃ dadyāt vaṇinaṣkamathavārpayatdatvālaṃ datvālaṃkaraṇaṃ yāvacchakyaṃ dadyojottamāpratyayekeyo viprebhyaḥ pradadyāddakṣiṇamathaparadyurbrāhaṇā bhojyā suvāsinyokaṃ saṃkhyayāśālagrāhamāśelāśyaṃ dātavyā dakṣiṇanvitājanekakoṭi brahmāṃḍa sāgadāna yabhetśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī siddhimānyātyeva mahattarīprāmāṃti savulābhīṣṭanaiśvaryaṃ vaṇimādikaṃtaṃ mānayaṃti śakrāyā dikpālāśca maharyayaḥgātaraga sadṛśī vidyāṃ ca dhiṣyaṇeyamāputrapautrādi saṃpattiṃ bhogāna vivānapidote svayadataṃrasme pracchatya calaṃ śubhaṃtīpāta samāyuktā vaiṣṇavarkṣa samanvitāyadyarkavāsaserotrasyāddadhaudiya iti smṛtaḥcaturviśatimirvaryairvaṣa dvādaśakena vāetat sarvasaṃnāmaṃ nāsti pāṭatālodi vivā bhuviravidyarva sahasrepi kṛtaṃ tadṛśaṃ na hi

sanskrit: phalaṃ na śatyate vaktaṃka tasya śubhakarmaṇaḥdānasya kartaṃ sukataṃ hi vaktamanataṃdevana na śakyatepicaturmukho vā jalajātalāta janmāṣaḍānano vagiśasya ṣatramahodaye yogavarenna samyak snātvā sadācāryaya praṇamyasārvabhaumaṃ mahodayābhidye yoge vārddhīdayabhidhekoṭi koṭi puraścaryā phala prāpnoti śāśvataṃvamiru sāhasra dānasya phalaṃ prāpnotya saṃśayaekāhutyāpi sadṛśaṃ purāyaṃ nāsmatra bhūsurāḥna pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmanaṃdanāḥsāmudreṇāṃbhusāsrānaṃ tatra kartavyamādarātsnātavya sarvapādyānāṃ nivṛtyathaṃ samāhitaiḥsnātvā viśuddhātmā nityaṃ saṃdhyāmuyāsya cakāpilājyaṃ samādāyaṃ śuddheyavyājyameva vāaṣṭāviṃśatidhā brahmavidyayāpighṛpitaṃ hunettatrāvāhyasamiddhegnau śatādhika sahasrakaṃvāsudevena manunā viṣvoratha ṣaḍarṇayāśrīdvādaśārśā maṃtreṇa rājyalakṣamyātha vā tataḥaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hutvārvo maṃtrairataḥpradaṃprāyaścittāhutīḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā brahmārpaṇāhātisarvasvāmayeyeddhīmānala kṛtya tataḥ paraṃavaśyamaryaddhene vahusasya samanviteparaṃ datvā dvijātivaryebhyo deśikasya priyāmatha****** ddhānuṃ vahusasya samanvitīdatvā dvijātivaryebhyo deśikasya priyāprāmathasamarpayen mahadānānyatha bhūyādi svayaṃ

sanskrit: datvā sasūkṣma vāsepi varṣāśanamitaṃ dhanaṃvittalomaṃ parityajya dadyāddeśika pādayoḥkāsya pātraṃ tadadardhaṃ vā phalaśi samanvitaṃdakṣiṇā sahita dadyādavaśya sādhakottamaḥ || 111 |||datvā suvāsinī rekaviṃśatsakhyā manoharāḥdakṣiṇābhiścatāṃ kalaistoṣayitvā tataḥ paraṃdeśikānujñayā paścādbhaṃjīyādvaṃdhubhissahaarddhodaye vā kṛtvetthaṃsi prāpnoti śāśvatīsadyo vimucyate vaśyaṃ purāsīyutī bhavetpaśyatyeva svacakṣurbhyāṃ lakṣmīsaditamacyutaṃasādhyamavidevānāma sādhyaṃ yogināmapidhanadhīnyayuśruvāta saṃkulāṃ ratnasaṃkulīyāṃraṃgatosau vidyānāṃ śāstrāṇāmapi pāragaḥciraṃjāti smaro bhūtvā brahma dṛṣṭvā sanātanaṃkulakoṭiṃ sasamudbhṛtyanmayāti paramaṃ padaṃsādhanāni na śavāṃte sayāvaktaṃ dvajarṣabhāḥtattacchāstreṣa vakṣyati sinyānyu vudhyādvijarṣabhārājādhirāja vidyāyā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarasya cayacchatvāpi dvijā bhūdyau jīvanmuktussukhī bhavetṛṣinasiyaṇo yogī śāśvataḥ śaṃkarocyutaḥsa eva viṃdhyadeśasyā janānā nāpi bhūtalemuktido darśanādeva narāṇamatra sastaṃ tataṃmuktidaḥ sarvamartthānāṃ bhūtale darśanādapiāsmin taṃtre purā proktā sadyaḥ pratyayakāriṇīdvārakānagare vāpi kṣetre vā puruṣottame

sanskrit: etedyanyatamaṃ kṣotramāgatya niyatra vrataḥsrātvā prātarviśuddhātmā nityaṃ saṃdhyāmupāsya canityahoma samāpyātha śrīmadaṣṭākṣī śubhāṃvāsudeva mahāvidyā vaiṣṇavī ca śate japetdvādaśāṇaṃ śriyaṃ vāpi rājarājeśvarīmathapaṃcaviṃśatidha nityaṃ japet paṃcāhamādarātnaranārāyaṇīvidyāṃ japedaṣṭottareśataṃekabhaktāśano nityaṃ phalāśī vā haviṣyabhuksnātvā deśikayādāva prakṣālitalaṃ yovetācārya sābherdhāvagni pratiṣṭhāpya saṃmāhitaṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhā pūrvasāvitryājvalite naleśriyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ paścāt samāvāhya yata vrataḥekaikāmārhate katvā śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayāvāsudevasya manunā vaiṣṇavyā ca ṣaḍarṇayāśrādaśārṇayā paścāt prasanna ramayāpi vābhagavadraśmi vidyābhidyaitamekaikaśo hunethutvātha ca maṃtraiśca paṃcadhā huthātteaṣṭottaraśata hutvā kṛtvā homaṃ japodibhiḥpāvake praṇipatyātha svācārya caraṇadvayealekatyathānyāyaṃ kudralādyaissuvāsasā**ṇaśi ca datvātha samarpya ca vasuṃdharīasānnidhyepi saṃkalpya sūkṣmaṃ vā sopi nirmalaṃaśaktaścāpyathācārya pādābjaṃ praṇipatya caśubhaṃ paridhānottarīyārtha vāso yumaṃ samarpya catadardhā vā tadhardhe vā vittaśādhyā vivarjitaḥ

sanskrit: kanatkanaka ciṃtākaṃ tāṭakakarakaṃtu vāśubhapratyāmrāpa suvarṇa vā vastrayuktaṃ samarpayetpaṃcaviṃśati saravyākā atha paṃcaddaśāpivākṛtvā mahotsāvaṃ tatra svācāryānujñayā hareḥitthavadarikāraroga mathurāyāmathāpi vāihākhyaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaṃnareṇa sehitaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhaṃsuṃdarī vallabhaṃ brahmarudra śakrādibhirvṛtepaśyatyaṃvana saṃdehastadārabhya jagatpateḥaṇimodi guṇeśvasūve jāti samūtiḥ śubhāmaharārogyamayūpyaṃ vaugaśvamenuttamaṃuputrapātrābhivṛddhiśca brahmajñānama caṃcalaṃvatsare vatsare tasya dattātreyodi yoginaḥayaṃ dāśarathiḥ sākṣādbhāgavānacyuto vibhuḥanugrahyāyalīkānāṃ suvarṇamukharītaṭeanaṃtaśayano yogo śeṣāḍāvaṃjanā calevāyaputrādyā oṃ janācalanāyakaṃadyodhyānagarapīṭha tasyā bhūdaṃjanācalerāmodāśathisvāmīraṃganātha iti smṛtaḥtatra tiṣṭhati vidhviśoṇamosauragaṃnāyakaḥdvitīyaṃ naimiṣārāyaṃ sadyo mukti phalapradecaturtharagadhāmāravya bhukrikṣetramudīritesarvapīṭhamayīsa vā vidyādharma tapomayīmanu yatra kutrāpiyo nityajapenniyatavrataḥśrīnivāsaṃ mahāvidyā kṣetreṣveteṣuyaḥ śuciḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: janāhasaṃtumāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānodaṃḍayaṃ tu vāeva māpadgatasyāpimatiryasya bhave dṛḍhājanāḥ stuvaṃtu kutsaṃtu lakṣmīstiṣṭhatu gacchatubrahmavidyāpradaḥ svāmībrahmavidyāpradaḥ pitābrahmavidyāpradaḥsākṣādācāryonānya ucyatesaṃsevya bhagavadrūpamācāryaṃ karuṇānidhiṃpraṇavaṃ pramoṣmāṇaṃ vāmanetravibhūṣitaṃtadeva viṃdurahitaṃ tṛtīyāṃtasthyamapyathasa dīrghaṃ vāmapādānagravījaṃ vahnimataḥ paraṃekatriṃśākṣaraṃ paścāddīrghasvaradibhūṣitaṃhṛdayena samāyuktaṃ śrīśrīśadvādaśākṣarīsarvayogamayī sarvayāga tīrthasvarūpiṇīsarvapātavāsaṃhartrī sarvavyādhinināśinīāyurārogyaputrārtharājyalakṣmīsamṛddhidāmayāpi varṇitu naiva śakyeyaṃ dvādaśākṣarīekena janmanaivāṃtebhagavatpadamakṣayaṃavaśyaṃ tena japtavyā śrīśrīśadvādaśākṣarīmaṃdirenivasaṃtyevayāvadācandratārakaṃbrahmavidyānusaṃdhānamahimnātraiva labhyatekṛttādyathatenaivalābhyate dvādaśākṣarīnālye na tapasālabhyamihalokemahīpateācāryānugrahādbrāhmekāle japtvānvahaṃ nṛpatriśataṃ vā śucirdhīmān smṛtvācāryasya pādukaṃanenajanmanaiyāsomatkalāsahito bhavetadyāpi brahmarudrādyāḥ sanakādyāścayoginaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīnivāsa mahāvidyā sadyaḥ pratyayakāriṇīśrīnivāsa mahāvidyāmācāryavadanāṃvujātśrīnivāsa mahāvidyā bhavavaṃdha vimocanīśrīnivāsetiyo nāmamātraṃ vā pratyahaṃ smoretśrīnivāsābhirdha kṣetraṃ śrīnivāso jagatpatiḥsmaraṇācchre nivāsasya yatra kutrāpi saṃtataṃarcanācchrī nivāsasyā tridinaṃ vā dvijottamāḥdarśatācchrī nivāsasyā vimuktaḥ pāparāśibhiḥśrīnivāsa mahāvidyā japataḥ pratyahitryaciḥasminnayodhyānagare naimiṣepi mahāvabherāmodāśarathiḥ śrīmānparabrahmamayo vibhuḥkṣetreṣveteṣṭa satataṃ sarvasiddhikarī śubhāādau trayīmayī vījaṃ prāṇavākhyaṃ mahattaraṃśriyo pitanmahāvījaṃ tadanatamuccaretmāyāvījamidaṃ yamvrāccaturthamatmathākṣaraṃtrayodaśā videye vahi valī samānvitaaṇimādi guṇeśvarya pradāyuṣya vivarddhanīnārado bhagavāt prāpya brahmaputro mahātayākṣaṇimā dviguṇan prāpyate trailokya saṃcaratyasauāvitābhāva saṃvaṃdhā śrīdevyā jagatītiḥmuktilamīnivāsyeyaṃ śrīnivāsaḥ parātparaḥmahālakṣmīnivāsauya śrīnivāsa iti smṛtaḥśrīnivāsa mahāmaṃtraṃ trayī sāraṃ mahodayaṃśrīnivāso mahāyogī sabhavet parame padehāpi śrīnivāsaḥsyodaṃte mukti śrīyaṃ vrajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: goptavyā sarvakaladā prāṇai kaṃṭha gatairapiśrīnivāsasya labhate pūrṇanugrahamiṣṭadaṃchaṃdo jāgatamityukte gāyatrametha vā smṛtaṃnārāyaṇo mahālakṣmīpatirdevata mucyatekījakaṃ kāmarājaṃ syādiṣṭāthai viniyujyatelakṣyāridi vījaivadvirāvṛtyā ṣaḍaṃgakaṃlakṣmīnivāsa jagadabhayakare viśvavadhabhukudaṃpuraścayoḥ karmāṇi nāsya saṃti mahāmanoḥviniyoge pravakṣyāmi mṛtyudhaṃ brahmanaṃdanāḥdhṛtvā bhūrddhi gurorājāṃ prātaḥ srātvā samāhitaḥtriśetādhika sāhasraṃ prajaptvā niyatavrataḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā maṃtraṃ śrīhṛdayābhidhaṃrājarājeśvarī vidyāmaṣṭā viṃśātitadhā japetśrīnivāsamanuṃ rātrau sahasraṃ triśatādhikaṃṣaṣṭehni prātarutthāye prātaḥ srātvā samāhitaḥkāpilājyaṃ hunedagnau śrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyayāāṣṭāviṃśatidhā hatvā śrīmaṃtreṇa tataḥ paraṃaṣṭāviṃśatidhā hatvā varma vidyābhirapyathatriśataṃ juhuyādātyāṃ yādibhiratho hunetdeśikāṃghri yugaṃ paścāt sāṣṭaṃgi daṃḍavannametpradadyānniṣka sāhasrīmācāryaṃ caraṇadvayetadardha vā tadardha vā vittaśāṭhya vivārjitaḥdatvā paṃcaśābhya vrāhāṇaśca nagasanīḥyaṣet bhūṃjati gurubhukrā aśeṣa vaṃdhabhiranvitaḥniśitasmin dine khaprebharatādibhiranvitaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇa jagannāthamāṃjaneyābhirhatapaśyatyeva svacakṣarbhyārbhyo saprasannamukhāṃvuvajaṃjānakī ramaṇaṃ sākṣāt paśyasvīlakādaṃbhūtvā pāraṃgataḥ sarvavidyānāmadadhīrapirājamaheṃdrābhyāṃ sa sudṛśī śriyamukṣayaṃsaṃprāpyāṣṭa gaṇaiśvarya māyurāroyamuttamaṃdṛṣṭā nārāyaṇātmāniṃ svayameva svacakṣuṣādivyabhogayuto divyakanyāśat samanvitaḥmodate paramedhāmni sannidhā viṃdirāyuteekasminmapi vā kṣetreyaḥ karoti jiteṃdriyaḥvinīr'ṇaṃ janeyādyāḥ suhṛtva prāpnuvaṃtyapimānayaṃti vaśiṣṭādyāstaṃbhaktau jānakīpatautasyā bhīṣṭaphalaṃ nityaṃ prayacchaṃti na saṃśayaḥsarasvātī ca yamunākāverīsaritīvarāāsāmanyatamasthāne yatra kutrapivā śuciḥsamadhāvī mahāvāmmovidyābhirdhiṣaṇaprabhaḥdīrghamāyuṣya māsādya yogaṃ cāṣṭāṃgayutaṃparāṃ gatimavāpnoti punarāvṛtti varjitāṃpuraścayā sahasraṃ vā puraścaryā śataṃ tu vāpuraścaryā triyaṃ vāpi kṛtvā saṃpūrṇa dakṣiṇasaṃpūrṇa dakṣiṇā yuktau dvadyānmadhyamadākṣiṇaṃvitaśāṭhyaṃ parityajye pradadyādiṣṭasiddhayekaroti vratī tasya hānireva prajāyatesahasraśepi kṛtvāso na siddhiṃ labhate kvacitdeśikāṃghri yuge datvā dākṣiṇaṃ śastracoditāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anekābhāgya saṃpattirbhavet taya pade padeācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvakaikarpa nirato bhavetsiddhyatyasya mahāvidyā devatvamapi sīddhyatina siddhyatyeva saṃpūrṇa kraubhistuvātamevaṃ nityamabhyarcya brahmatādātmyasiddhibhākupāsya pratyahaṃ śraddho brahmatādātmya siddhibhākyathāśaktyapyanu smṛtya deśikānujñayānvahaṃbrahmavidyā manusmṛtya śrīśrīśadvādaśākṣarirājarājeśvarīdyāmavaśyaṃ pratyahaṃ śuciḥsiddhibhāk brahmatādātmya saṃsiddhi hetu bhūtāni bhūtaleanyāpi mahāvidyā ratnāni jagatītalaiśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyādotevaśameśvaraḥrājarājamavidyā pradātāpi maheśvaraḥbrahmavidyā pradātāpi sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥsamastavidyā sāmrājñī brahmavidheti kathyatetatepi śrīmadaṣṭāro sāmrājñī sarve saddhidaḥekāpyatra mahāvidyā labhyate yanmukhāṃvujāttatpadardvaṃdva pūjaiva brahmatādāsya siddhidālabhyate hi mukhāṃ bhāṃjādyasya viprasya sādhakaiḥvidyā catuṣṭayaṃ yasya vadanāllamyate bhuvitatpadadvaṃdvaśaścaṣī na hi carṇapituṃ kṣamāḥbhāṣāracita maṃtropi tasya siddho bhavatyalaṃyeṣāsyaraṇataḥ sidhyaṃtyukhilā api siddhayaḥdeśikānujñayā japtyā sadyaḥ pratyayakāriṇīācāryānujñayā nityaṃ japtvā niyatamānasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: satyaṃ vacmi hitavacmi sāraṃvacmi punaḥ punaḥśrīmadaṣṭakṣarīvidyā japyā sakalasiddhidāsmartavyā pratyahī vidyā rājarājeśvarī śubhāanyadāyāsa phaladamuktaṃ sarvaṃ maharṣibhiḥdevatvādi mahāsiddhikasme tataccatuṣṭayaṃnārāyaṇe jagatkatto sarptānaṃda cidātmakaḥsādhanāni mayoktāni catvāri jagatītaleācāryacaraṇadvaṃse vā daṣṭāditaḥ parāśriyaḥ paṃcadaśārṇatha rājarājeśvarī śubhāmayā pūrvaṃ mukarektima sādhanapaṃcakaṃmukti śrītavaḥ pacayena nityamuyattasāḥityuktka bhagavānyogī kapilaḥ kardamātmajaḥśratvai tatkāpilaṃ śāstraṃ brahmaputrostapodhanāḥsarvasaṃśayanirmuktassatyaloka mathogatāḥśruktvā sakalavedātasaraṃ śāstramanuttamaṃrājarājeśvarī vidyāmāhātmyamadynāśanaṃsanatkumāra pramukhā yoginaścathata vratāḥsākṣajjagannāthaṃ jīvanmuktāstato bhavankiṃcidukta māyā tubhyaṃ deviparvaja kanyakerāmodāśarāthi bhūtvā kośatva śālyāgarbhasavaḥāṃjaneyādibhirnityaṃ sevito bharatāribhiḥsevitaḥ satataṃ sākṣāviṣṭhurmānuṣa rūpadhṛkumādi deśa sakalāndharmān khilasiddhidāndāśarathīyādavyaṃ kathayānā sa bhūpatiḥbrahmavidyā tataḥ proktā śrīśrīśadvāśākṣarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uktātha vadradhā muktihetukī sarvasiddhidāmukti sāmrājya kuvamālā hetukī nā parā smṛtāprānnalakṣmīvidyātha kathitā sarvasiddhidāśrīdevyā atha saṃprokta vidyā paṃcadaśākṣarīrājarājeśvarīvidyā tato vahuśa īritāaṣṭākṣrāṃga bhūtatvātran māhātmyamadyāpahaṃdattātreyo mahāyogī sākṣādbhagavadaṃśajaḥanugrahāya jagatāṃ cakāra jagatīpatiḥcakāra sumahatratnaṃ svanāmnā sarvāsiddhidaṃbrahmavidyā vilāsāravyaṃ taṃtraṃ vedāṃtasāmmitaṃbrahmaputro mahyatejā vaśiṣṭā ruṃdhatīpatiḥdvauyānātmajaḥ sākṣācchaṃkarāṃśa samudbhavaḥmūlaṃ dāśarathīyākhyaṃ śāstraṃ vedāṃta saṃgrahaṃajanātanayaḥ paścāt kiṃkaro jānakīpateḥchaṃdo mayotha bhagavān vinatā tayo vibhuḥsarveṣāmapi śāstrārṇāmūlaśāstramidaṃ paraṃnāviśvāsotra kartavyo muktilakṣmīmabhīṣṇatāśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā japyā śuddhaiva siddhidāvedavedāṃtasammitaṃ purā nārāyaṇe noktaṃ janakāya mahātmanevaśiṣṭādi mahaṣīṇā sannidyauṣṭachotā mamatasyāṃ śenātīrṇesmi rudro mṛtyuṃjayaḥ śivaḥmama śrīrāmacaṃdrasya yaḥ karotibhidībhuvirāma eva parabrahmamudro viṣṇuḥ prajāpaktiḥraktame tatparamaṃ taṃtre guhyataraṃ śubhaṃśrutvā guhyatamaṃ śāstramidaṃ dāśarathīritaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deśikaṃ śastrivaktārama saṃpūjya vimūḍhadhīḥpūjayati vaktāraṃ śāstrasyā mahāmanāḥvṛddhiṃ na dhānyavṛddhiṃ sau bhāgyavṛddhiṃ ca śubhāni nityaityuktaṃ girijādevyai śivena paramātmanāpūrvaḥ nārāyaṇenoktamuttaraṃ śaṃkareritaṃatraikamapi vādhyāyamarthajñāna puraḥsaraṃprayāti paramaṃdhāma sanātanamunuttamaṃmatvātmānaṃ paraṃbrahma rāmaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃkṛtakṛtyāstato jagmuḥkhā śrīmānmuditānanāḥvaidaśāsarthasaṃgrahe jānakīpātinā proktaṃ jagadānuṃhetakabhāradvāja kulośva vedayatnaṃ yato ya nāmāyapi caśaraṇaguruḥ tenedamullāsitaṃrājarājeśvarīmaṃtrātmābhabhavata kipārdranayano vaṃśīdharaṃ yātvahaṃhaṭhavati mātṛjāravad vai prāṇāṃtaṃ kuṭilamatāvidaṃkatevedasāraṃ raghūttaṃ sa taṃtraṃ lilikhehaṃ vaṃśīdharaḥ śrīśatuṣṭyai
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyurārogmamaiśvaryaṃ paśavaścavasūni caācāryāpādukāyugmapūjakasya dine dinebrahmavidyānusaṃdhānāṃnaṃtaraṃ raśmijāpinaḥdhanadhanyākalāvājimuktāratnaughasaṃkulāāvirbhavati vidyābhiḥ saṃkulāsatataṃ nṛpana dṛśyate mahāvidyādvidaivatyāśi mahāmatecūḍāmaṇyātmikaikaiva brahmavidyāparānahiśacīndraurohiṇīcaṃdrau svāhā vahnī prabhāravīstrīṣuṃ rūpāṇi sarvāṇi śrīśrīpatyaṃśaṃjānihisarvavidyāmayīṃ tasmāchrī śrīśadvādaśākṣarīṃcarācarasametāni bhuvanāni caturdaśaasau viśvaṃbharaḥ sākṣādbrahmavidhāprajāpakaḥācāryapādukāyugmamabhyarcyānvahamādarātgṛhe svargasukhaṃ teṣāmakṣayaṃsyāddinedineśatravomitratāṃ yāṃtimāyaṃ ca sukṛttāyatedhaneśaḥ śakramukhyāśca surāḥkaikaryamanvahaṃyoginaḥ sanakādyāśca vaśiṣṭhādyāmaharṣayaḥācāryacaraṇāṃbhojadvayārcanaratonvahaṃsiddhakṣetraṃ tadevoktaṃ samaṃtādyojanāyutaṃasādhyamapi devānāmapi dīpāṃtarasthitaṃbrahmavidyānusaṃdhānādapyasyānvayasaṃbhavāḥbrahmavidyānusaṃdhānaṃ kriyate yena nityaśaḥtadgahadvāritiṣṭhaṃti siddhayoṣṭāṇimādayaḥtasmādiyaṃ mahāvidyā śrīśrīdvādaśākṣarīupāsitavyā yatnena pratyahaṃ niyatavrataiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti dāśarathīyesmin taṃtre vedārthasaṃgraheyasya vijñānamātreṇa brahmavidyāśu siddhyatibrahmavidyādvidaivatyośrīśadvādaśākṣarīsādhanaṃ brahmavidyāyāḥ śṛṇu vakṣyāpi nṛpateśirasyaṃ jalimādhāya daśadaṣṭvādvādaśadhāpirāānanyadarśanau dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjyāpi svaśaktitaḥbrahmavidyāṃjapaṃtyaśvābhaśrīśrīśadvādaśakṣarīṃācāryapādukāvidyābhāvepi svasya mūrddhanimānasaiḥ svarṇapuṣpādyaiḥ samabhyarcyopacārakaiḥṛṣirasyamahāyogīmādhyonārāyaṇo vibhuḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇo sarvajagataḥ pitarau vibhūsvāpinau sarvagaṃ jagatāṃ puvānāvatimuṃdarautrayī vījaṃ ca vidvājaṃ vījamatranṛponamaprītyarthaṃ viniyogotra samudāhṛta iṣṭadaḥcinyasya panamānmānaṃ dhyāyeccitkalayānvitaṃkalpavāṭī samāyuktesaṃtānārāmaśobhitemaṃrāravāṭī mahite pārijātavanāhṛtepadmagagākhyamāṇikyaprākāreṇātha śobhitevaiḍūryaratnaprākāraśobhitenaramevitemuktāphalamahāratnaprākāreṇāthaveṣṭitehrasva vidgumaralodyapākāreṇa ca veṣṭitetasminmaṇimayatnaṃbha sāhasrāyutaśāṃbhivetatra cādhāraśaktyādi dhṛtehīrahiraṇyayaṃtasminnaṣṭadaleyagne maṃtrākṣarapayeśubhetasminvālārkasāhasrakoṭinulyamabhānvite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśvaryā sahaviśve śā vāsudevaḥ manānanaḥsrigdhaviṃvaphalābhoṣṭaḥ musmitānana paṃkajaḥharicaṃdana liptāṃgaḥ kastūrītilakāṃcitaḥjapākusupasaṃkāśakarapallavaśobhinaḥśrībhatsakaustubhābhyāṃ ca śobhitaḥ pṛthukkṣamāvālārkamadaśajyotsrapītāṃvarapugāhṛtaḥakalaṃkitacaṃdrābhananakhapaṃktivibhūṣitaḥpāṃcatanparathāṃgābhyāṃ vigajitakaradvayaḥsphuradvidyullatākrāṃtāsitāsibhra ivarājanegade ca paramekrī utpanna sākṣājjagatpatiḥdivyacedaṃnalīsāṃgīkanakāṃvarabhūṣaṇāmaṃrārapārijātādi divyapuṣpasraganvitāratnāvataṃ sa śobhādyācikurāṃtelimannibhekeyūrāṃgadahārādyairbhūṣaṇai ete śobhitāanyonyā śliṣṭahṛdvāhūdivyābharaṇaśobhinauśaraṇyo sarvalokyanāṃśaraṇāmanavatmalaukartāraumarvajagatāṃ viśvaraśvarakṣaṇa tatparaunīlādevyā ca bhūrevyāvāmadakṣiṇaśobhitaubrahmarudra maheṃdrādiśigemāṇikyakāṃtibhiḥralartihāsanāsīnaurājitāvilabhūṣaṇauyogihṛtpadmasaṃpūjyau nityadaivanasevitaulakṣmīnārāyaṇau nityaṃbhajāmi pratyahaṃ vibhūprajapet samaye brahme śrīśrīśadvādaśākṣarīṃdhyātvā nārāyaṇāṃ sākṣāt sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣiteācāryapalīmāyaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇai vibhū
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryanāṃ vijānīhi tat patnīmapidhaściyaṃathavā saccidānaṃdasvarūpasthamavyayaṃniṣkalaṃke nirupamaṃtejorūpeparātparaṃekaiveyaṃ dvidaivatyā lakṣmīnārāyaṇīśubhāyāṃ vidyāṃjapatonityaṃkalyāṇaṃ sakalabhavatśubhemāsi śubhelagne divase ca śubhe nṛpasadguruḥ śubhadaḥ proktaḥ sanmāsaḥ śubhadaḥ smṛtaḥmadhumāse mahaduḥkhaṃ sādhakasya prajāyatejyeṣṭhamaraṇamāprotividyomaprapivaṃdhubhiḥśrāvaṇe mahato lakṣmīṃ saṃprāptotya ca lośubhāṃmuktāmāṇikyasaṃpūrṇāmāśvine labhatethiyaṃmārgaśīrṣe bhavellakṣmīrdhanahānyādisaṃkulāsākṣādbhagavatā lakṣmyā api saṃdarśanaṃ nṛpaphālgunemāsi siddhiḥ syāt tridaśairapi durlabhādaśamyekādaśī śuklādvādaśī ca trayodaśīsiddhidāṃ kecidapyahuḥ śuklapakṣāṣṭamīṃ śubhāṃśubhapradājñeyā hānidau bhaumabhānujauśubhagnahāṇāṃ daṣṭvānye muhūrttā api siddhidāḥsarvāgamarahasyatamācāryaṃ vṛṇuyā dvibhuṃrahasyamapi vidyānāmavijñāya mahīpatetāvubhāvapiduḥkhauyairihāpi sahitau śṛpabhūyopyavaśyaṃ vedeṣu dharmaśāstreṣu pāragaṃbahuyojana sāhasramapi gatvā mahītaledatvā rahasyaṃ vidyānāṃ sāṃgamācāryavaktranaḥtameva toṣayennityamācāryaṃ bhavāvanmayaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathāktyārccaye tatra niyamonāsti bhūpateśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ samastanyāsa saṃyutāṃsamadvīyavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ dhanadhānyauya saṃkulāṃtasmādyegaṃ ca kālaṃ ca sarahasyānmanūnapisarvajñasyaiva sānnidhye gṛhṇīyāt sakalānyanūnavaśyamapi gṛhṇīyādbhūyaḥ sarvajña sannidhauarpayeddakṣiṇāṃ sāṃgā japahomādikarmasuāvāryadakṣiramādeyāyatkiṃcidapi bhūpatedatvāyatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ dharmaśāstra śrutiṣvapiaśvamedhādi yāgeṣu datvā koṭi sahasraśaḥnaṣṭe puṇye martyalokaṃ bhūyopi prāpnuvaṃti hipunarāvṛttirahitaṃ śāśvataṃ padamaśrutebrahmavidyājayāsaktāraśmimālānuciṃtakaḥsamānarūpāḥ śrīviṣṇordivyālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥayodhyānagare sākṣātyade bhagavataḥ śubhegatvātrananivarjaṃte viṣṇunāsahasasthitāḥtatsamānasukhaṃ nityaṃ prāpnuvaṃti manīṣiṇaḥnāmuvaṃ nipunaḥ sargaṃ sargasthā iva jaṃtavaḥtathā tenaiva jāyaṃte murtyalokeyathecchayāna karpavaṃdhanaṃ janmabrahmavidyāratātmanāṃnadāsyaṃ vai pareśasyavaṃdhanaṃ parikīrtitaṃābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇāḥvahvāyāsaphalāduḥkhajanmakāṇūhetavaḥsvargamaṃsthānnarān dṛṣṭvā kṣīṇe karmaṇi devatāḥtasmāt svargasukhaṃ bhūpavahuyatnaikasādhanaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yajña na taporūpaṃ karmavedesu coditaācāryapatnīputrādīnabhyarcya pratyahaṃ tataḥraśmimālāmanuspṛtya śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japanācāryācaraṇāṃbhoja dvayameva madāsmaretādyaṃ vījadvayaṃtyatkā śrīśrīpatidaśākṣarīṃaraṇye vānaraṇye vāsvagṛhevānadītaṭeāsīnovāśayānośrivātiṣṭhan gacchanathāpi vāācāryānugrahaṃ prāpya sabhataṃ masmarannapavratakoṭi tapastītha mahāyāgaphalānvitaḥdaśārṇavidyāmātraṃ vā sadācāryā kṛpānvitaḥsamāpya sarvavidyānāmādhipatyaṃ ca durlabhaṃdehāṃte tatparaṃdhāma vrajatyeva śriyaḥ pateḥtanniṣṭassatataṃ bhūtvā bhagavaṃtamanussaretśrīśājñollaṃghakaḥ sarvajagadohī mahīpatedātavyānyapirānāti satpātrebhyoviśeṣataḥyatravṛtamimevobhe tatpātraṃ pracakṣyatekurvan vaidikamācārepātrabhūtobhaveddvijaḥjīvanneva sa śūdraḥ syātanmukhaṃ nāvalokayetapātradānānnarakaṃ pātradānāt paraṃ padaṃdhanaṃ yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tadācāryatya pādayoḥrahasya manyadvakṣyāmi śṛṇu rājanmahīpatebhagavadraśmimālākhyāvidyāpeyemayeritābrahmavidyājayāsa sakto vedoktācāra tatparaḥpātrāṇāmutamaṃ pātra mayamevocyate budheuktācārarato nityamācāryacaraṇārccaka
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: avāpya sarvayāgānāṃ phalaṃ pratyahamaśrutaṃbrahmaṇaḥ padamādyanodatekālamakṣeyaṃbrahmavidyājapedyastu śrīśrīśadvādaśākṣarībhagavānapittaṃ nityaṃ pitṛvadkṣati dhruvaṃsamarcayati hastābhyā taddhastaṃ śaṃkhakravatananyadarśanaḥ prātaḥ prātarutthāya paśyatikalayānitaṃbrahmavidyānusaṃdhānādbrahmarṣitvamupāgatāḥpunaḥ prācetaso bhūtvā brahmavidyānu ciṃtanātpulahādyā mahābhāgā brahmaputrā mahīpatebrahmavidyānusaṃdhānamācāryacaraṇārcanaṃtasmācchubheṣumāseṣusuśrubheṣvapinavāramāsadoṣaḥ syādgadurbrahmaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥakṣayaṃ japahomādiphalaṃ syāttatra saṃtataṃmeruśailasamaṃ viddhitatsvarṇaṃ nātrasaṃśayaḥdātavyānimayatena vittalobhavivarjinīṃācāryasannidhau kṛtvā mahālakṣmī samanvitaṃpūrvopadiṣṭā vidyāścaravīdugrahaṇe śubhesākṣādayaṃ parvakālo mahānukto maharṣibhiḥyahaṇe sarvavidyānāmuktamāmeṣu saṃtataṃsrvāsāmapi viyānāmācāryavadanāṃdujātpādyamāsepradeyāni sarvadānāni bhūpateyasyopanayanārthaṃ vā mādyamāsi prayacchatimāghamāse daridrāya vivāhadhanamuttamaṃnarakasthān samuddhṛtya brahmaloke mahīpate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣayona nasyapurāyasya tadvisyoḥ parame padetāvadvaṃśābhivṛddhiḥ syādiha loke mahīpatepadyānakṣetra saṃyuktā paurṇimā tatra pāsmṛtāvaiśākhaśrāvaṇādīni māghamāsa samānihiaśubheṣvapimaraseṣu ravīṃdugrahaṇaṃ nṛpaalabhyā api yogāsyuḥ śubhātaśubhamāsyapividyopadeśaṃ kurvīta nānyathā siddhi rucyatenadadyātra ca gṛhṇīyādvidyājāta mahīpateācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvabhajanīyaṃ dine dineādau kṛtvā prayatnena samastanyāsa saṃyutāṃetadeva paraṃtatvaṃ vedāṃteṣu śrutiṣvapiiti dāśarathīyesminnaṃ vedārthasaṃgraheiktoyaṃ dvādaśodhyāyo brahmatatvārthasādhanaḥsādhanaṃ brahmavidyāyāḥ kathayāmāsa śabhavenārāyaṇo mahāyogī kathayāmāsa yatparaṃsādhanaṃ brahmavidyāyānavācyamapi kutracitnahomastarpaṇaṃ vāpi siddhavidyeyamiṣṭadāparasya brahmaṇaḥ sākṣādāśudarśanasiddhidāavaśyaṃ savaye brāhmeja savyāsiddhimicchatāpūjayet samaye brāhme brahmavidyāmimāṃ śuciḥcatuḥśataṃ japedyadvātriśateśatameva vāmaṃsiddhiṃ mahatīmiṣṭāṃ prāpnotyāśrunasaṃśayaḥeva bhaktāśanonityaṃ tatpūrvadivasatrayaṃsaṃkalpyakeśavādīnimataśoccaranmahāpātakakoṭibhyassadya eva vimutyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītvāṃtarapi śuddhaḥ syāt sadyo niṣkalmaṣo bhavettrirācampa sadācārya sannidhauśaṃsita vrataḥācāryapatnīmācīryāṃtrātvā śrīśrīśarūpiṇaupadmarāga samāyukte taptahema vinirmitaṃmuktāratnamayaṃ vāpitasatyā api bhūṣaṇaṃmaṃhīdakṣiṇayuktāṃ godvayaṃ ca tamarpayetsarvāvaraṇasaṃyuktau lakṣmīnārāyaṇau vibhusparśakālaṃ samārabhyamokṣakālāṃtamādarātsuvarṇapuṣpalakṣeṇavarṣakodyarcanātphalaṃācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pūrvamuktāṃ tataḥ paraṃtasminkāle gurordatvā māsātryāgevasādhakaḥviṃśāḍhakamitānmudrānatha vā dvādaśāṭhakānprasthaṃ cātha tadarthaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ dhenu samudbhavaṃpalīputra sametāyasvācāryāya samarpayetdvādaśārṇāgahātidyāmadyaḥ siddhyati bhūpateśrīśrīśayoḥ prasādena tasmicarye mahīpatedhanadhānya samāyuktāṃ saṃtati vyāpinīṃ dhruvaṃmahadārogyammasādyadīrghamāyuranuttamaṃśuklā tṛtīyo vaiśākhe bhṛgutvāsaraṃ saṃyutātretādyā sā tithirjanmatithivālamahātmanaḥumāśaṃkarayogaśca kathyataitaddine vudhaiḥatra dattaṃ japtanityā kṣayaphalapradaṃācāryājñāṃ samāsādya prātasnātvā viśuddhadhīḥanyarcya kusumairyāvatphalaṃ prāpte bhūtaleprāpyayusmyaṃ viśuddhātmā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: phalacittayamādāyapānasaṃsumanoharaṃniṣkadvayayutaṃ vāpi dadyādācāryapādayoḥdadyādācāryayanmaiva vahvālaṃkaraṇādikaṃgavyaṃ dadyadhyaryayetpaścādāḍhakaṃ vā tadardhakaṃakṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmitthaṃ kṛtvā dvijottamaḥasādhyamaṃtrasaṃsiddhimakṣayāṃ prāpya bhūtalemaṃdabhāgyopi saṃmāpyaśriyamaṣṭaguṇānvitāṃsākṣātkaśyapavanputrapautrasaṃpatisaṃyutaḥaṃte vaikuṃḍamāpnoti daśapūrverdaśāparaiḥvastvarpayati śuddhātmātrasareṇumitaṃ tu vāpradadāti na saṃdehasmasminneva hi vatsareakṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmitthaṃ kuryānmahīpatenavarātrabhidhaṃ parvaratnaṃ sakalasiddhidaṃbhāgyavahamabhāpānāṃ sākṣādbrahmatvahetukaṃyā mahānavamī tatra samastaphalasiddhidāmahānavamyāsadṛśī na puṇyatithirucyateyadyatkerāti karmeṣṭaṃtanmahānavamīdinenakṣatramutarāṣāḍābhārgavovāsaro yaisvāyaṃbhu vākhyamanvādisahitā sā mahātithiḥalabhyonāmayogoyaṃ durlabhastridaśairapinavarātravrataṃ kuryādavaśyaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃkoṭiṇovi vratairanyaiṃ kṛtairnāproti tatphalaṃdatamiṣṭaṃ hutaṃ japtamanaṃta phalasiddhidaṃkṛtaṃ kamarmātra sāmrājya śriyamevadadātphalaṃlakṣmīnārāyaṇau nityamarcayedbrahmavidyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekabhaktāśanastatrasahasraṃ vārcayeddhīmānsahasraṃ triśatāyikaṃtata ācāryapādābjaṃ natvā sāṣṭāṃgamādarātkuṃḍaladvitayāṃramyaṃ madatvācāryakarṇayoḥdadyādācārya pādābja caraṇāya vasuṃdharāalaṃkārān vahūnanyānapitasmai samarpayetdadyādvāsoyugaṃ kṣaumaṃ kāryā saṃvāsusūkṣmīkaṃsahānavamyāṃ vasudhācāryāya samarpayetdatvā sahasvaśaḥ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥbrahmāṃḍakoṭidānasya phalamatyaṃta maśrutepitṛṇāmapi sāhasraṃtārayettisthitaṃdivyabhogasamāyuktā jīvanyuktā bhavetyapisāṃgadakṣiṇayāyuktagosahasarapradānajakarṇālaṃkaraṇaṃ hematāṭaṃka dvitayaṃ śubhaṃmuktājāle samāyuktavālīyugalameva vāsākṣālakṣmīnivāsosmaibhagavatpatra na saṃśayaḥdivyāṃ varadharo divyaratnābharaṇabhūṣitaḥbhūdānadakṣiṇoṃ proktā sarvastaṃ aṃdirasthitaṃcaturviśati niṣkaṃvānadabhāvetadardhakaṃmahīpratinidhi dravyamathavā dakṣiṇānvitaṃvatvāronaḍuhodeyā bhūdānerājavallabhacaturṇāmapyanaḍuhāṃ caturniṣkamathāpicāprasīdati hariḥ sākṣānmahālakṣmīsamanvitaḥśuklātṛtīyāvaiśākhīṃ yā proktā kṣayatijñitāasmin dinadvayenityaṃ sarvamakṣayasiddhidaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: labhyate vahubhirvarṣairdurlabhaṃ stridaśairapipare ghurvijayānāmadaśamī śravaṇānvitāśrīśrīśāvarcayedvīmānsahasraṃ sādhakonṛpaḥnighadvayasuvarṇāṃ vā niṣkaṃmekamathāpi vāsamāśrurāja sānnidhye vivodepi mahādraṇeitthamācarataḥ puṃso bhāgyārāśinyadepadeanakurddhaṃ pravakṣyāmi patrapuṣpārcanāt phalaṃvilvapatraissamabhyarcyatya sahasrakaṃacalāṃ mahatīṃ lakṣmīsaṃtativyāpinīṃ bhavetsahasraṃ māsamātreṇa śatajanmasamudbhavaiḥmahākavirmahāvāgmī bhavatyeva natyena na saṃśayaḥmahāpāpopavāpodyairapi māsādvimucyateketakī kusumairnityamabhyarcya brahmavidyamāmadadāyuṣyamārogyamaiścaryamacalaṃ labhetmahāpātakodyāpi māsamātreṇa mucyatesaṃprāpya putrapautrādi samṛddhiṃ mahatīṃ labhetsaṃbhayatyarisaṃghātānacalāṃ ca śriyaṃ labhetabhyabhyarcya lakṣmī lakṣmīśau māsamātreṇa pātakaiḥjakṛtahasamudbhūteḥ komalaiḥ pallavaiḥ śubhaiḥanekakoṭijanmotthairapi pāpairvimucyateālayassarvabhogānāṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥabhyarcya māsamātreṇa mahāpāpaiśca dāruṇaiḥputrapautrādisaṃpatimapyasau labhate nṛpaabhyarcyamāsamātreṇa vimuktaḥ pāparāśibhiḥdivyabhogayuto bhūtvā putrapautravaṃtī śriyaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vrajatpatena saṃdeho bhagavansannidhiṃ nṛpasauvarṇaṃ puṣpamekavā datvā bhagavāte nṛpaekaṃ suvarṇapuṣpaṃ vā daśacihukanirmitaṃmaheṃrasadṛśo lakṣmyāvidyayādhiṣaṇaprabhaḥsau varṇapuṣpamekaṃ vā puṣpamanyansugaṃdhi vālakṣmīlakṣmīśayoddetvā pratyahaṃ dvādaśārṇayāghṛtaṃ haviḥ phalaṃ vāpi madhuratritayaṃtu vāagniṣṭomaphalaṃ nityaṃ protyatra na saṃśayaḥraśmimālāmanusmṛtya kalyāṇānidinedineanenaiva pramāṇebha saptakoṭimanuṣvapianenaiva pramāṇena brahmavidyābhadaṃgurubrahmavidyāpradācāryasadaśaṃvajagattrayetasmādavaśyamācāryapādukāyugamādarātnamākṛtyāpi saṃpūjyaśreyasāṃrāśimaśnutemahānadīṃ śrotriyaṃ kamaṇi ratnamathāpi vāsarvāpadmovimuktaḥ syācchreyānnityamavāpnuyātsamāpya śrīmadaṣṭārṇajapādikamapyārabhetkiṃciduktaṃ yayā bhūpapunaḥ kiṃ śrotumicchasimāhātmyaṃ brahmavidyāyāḥ śrutamasmābhirādarātvaśiṣṭādi maharṣīṇāṃ sannidhau jānakīpatiḥyathā nārāyaṇenādau janakāyoktamādarātanaṃtaviṃdusahitaṃ śaktirvidudvayānvitāpunastrayodaśayutāśaktirvyomasaviṃdukaṃdehāṃtarvarti jīvātmā parabrahmāṃśasaṃbhavaḥniśvāsollāsarūpeṇa japatyanudinaṃ manuṃ

sanskrit: haṃsarūpīhariḥ sākṣātparamātmaivedevatāparamātmānusaṃdhāne viniyoga udāhṛtaḥhaṃsamityādi ṣaṭvīryavarṇairaṃguliṣunyasetsūryātmane hṛdinyasya pūrvadirghādimaṃ tathāhaṃsī somātmane mūdhinyasya haṃsamathoccaretkavacaṃ nyasya haṃsai ca padaṃ brahmānmanetasaḥśabdabrahmatanuṃ hṛdaṃnujakuṭīnīḍesahāsaṃsmaretmāheśvaraṃ paraṃdhāmasmarāmimanasāhṛdidevatābhyo japāvidyā japaṃ nityaṃ samarpayetvyomavījena jīvātmā somena parameguraḥjīvojapatyanudinaṃ parabrahmaibhyasiddhayejapatyanudinaṃ haṃsahaṃsahaṃseti dvijapuṃgavāḥjapatyanukṣaṇasohaṃ sohamityevasaṃtataṃanaṃtatvāddhakārasya sakāreṇacidīritālakṣmīnārāyaṇīmetāṃ vidyāṃ tasmānmaharṣayaḥcinevedananvidhiṃ vakṣye japasyai tanmanordvijāḥmūlādhārapardamaṃḍape caturdalaśabdataḥgaṇeśāyamayāpaścātkṛtamityajapāpadaṃvādilāṃta vījaṣaṭkaṃ samuccārya tataḥ paraṃpadmesthitāya hemādyavarṇāya brahmaṇe padaṃgadiphāṃtān samuccārya maṇipūrakamaṃḍapeviṣṇavetha mayetpādi ṣaṭvahasraṃ nivedayetanāhatapadaṃ maṃḍape dvādaśadale tataḥvarṇāpātha sadāpūrvaśivāyeti padātparaṃsvaraṣoḍaśakaṃ proktvā viśuddhābhidhamaṃḍale

sanskrit: gopaketyathavarṇāya tato jīvātmane padaṃhaṃ kṣaṃ bhrūmadhya ityuktvā ājñāmaṃḍapa ityathavicitravarṇāya padaṃ paramātmana ityathaakārādi kṣakārāṃtānvarṇānuccārya yatnataḥsahasradalaśabdaṃnna tataḥ padmesthitādya canayetpādyeka sāhasraṃ japaṃ tasmai nivedayettithi vādādi saṃkalpyārabhyārkohyamapyathaṣaṭśatāṣaṭśatādhikamutkaikaviṃśatiṃ proccaret padaṃucchvā sanniśvāsāmyāmevātha jāgrat svapnapadaṃ tataḥajapādimagāyatrīṃ maṃtravākyamataḥ paraṃeva mucchvā saniśvāsa japaṃ śrīparamātmanena vidyate japo yasyā vidyāpāparamātmanaḥahomaṃdadhiyo viprāḥ kāmamohavaśaṃgatāḥajayā maṃtrasārajñoyaṃ kiṃcidapi vā manuṃhaṃsavidyāmavijñāyayomaṃtrānna parā bhavetvedā api purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi saṃtataṃjaptvā dvādaśasāhasraṃ caturvarṇamimaṃ manuṃniyamoyaṃtīnāṃ syānnānyeṣāṃ samudīhṛtaḥajayā manumuccārya gṛhasthassahpalau bhavetcaturarṇamimaṃ maṃtraṃ saṃsmṛtya satataṃ śuciḥpaśyatyevasva cakṣurbhyāṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitaṃyasyāmanupalabdhāyāṃ maṃtrāḥ sarvevṛyaivahiśrīmātṛkā samākhyātā devatādeśikottamaṃṛṣirbrahmāsya maṃtrasya chaṃdogāyatramīritaṃkramāt ṣaṭgānyabhidheyānihvaṃgulīvapi saṃtataṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṃgamātramapi vā kṛtvā vaśyaṃ japedimāṃviśadaprabhāṃ trinayanāṃ vāgdevatāmāśrayeyādikṣāṃtādaśoktāścarāka paṃcāśadakṣarājaptavyā viṃdurahitā viṃduyuktāpi vā sasasaptakoṭi mahāmaṃtrādharmaśāstrāṇyathāpi caajaptvā mātṛkā vidyāṃ yo manūna parān japetkṣakārāṃte japāyaṃtraṃhaṃsatyuccaransadāprajaptvānudinaṃ maṃtrān puraścaraṇapuṇyabhākyojayennityamekāgraḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥhaṃsarūpī hariḥ sākṣātparamātmāśriyaḥ patiḥsamarpya pūrvamajayāṃ saṃkalpyāpi tataḥ paraṃphalaṃ sakalavidyānāṃpārago jīvavadbhavetsakṛcchravaṇamātreṇagnahedveda catuṣṭayaṃitihāsapurāṇānāṃ sārajño bhavati dhruvaṃdṛśyaṃte vatsarādūrdhvaṃ prasannāvaradā apitasya hastastu na sparśāt sākṣātmūkopi vatsarāntadṛṣṭi kṛṣṭo bhavati nidhissahalasaṃpadāṃdivyaṃ vimānamāruptya vaikuṃṭho nivasatyasausarvajñatvaṃ manojñatvaṃ brahmarṣitvamanuttamaṃvarṣādvarṣadvayādvāpi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥanulomavilomasthaiḥ kḷptayā varṇamālayāvairimaṃtrā api nṛṇāmanyemaṃtrāśca kiṃ punaḥaṣṭāviṃśatidhānityaṃdaśadvādaśadhāpi vāavaśyaṃ mahatī siddhiṃ prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥnyāsajāla samāyukta śrīmaddaṣṭārṇaciṃtanaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīmātṛkānusaṃdhānālasthatapasaḥ phalaṃtyajet sakaladharmāṃśca na tyajen mātṛkā parāṃlabhyaṃte yasya vaktrābjāt prāṇāṃtepinataṃ tyajetācāryavadanāṃbhojāllabdhasti saphalāḥ smṛtāḥgururyadittayaḥ siddhastasya vidyāśusiddhyatidehatyādāvatāṃ kāśyāṃ gurorīśasya vaktrataḥvālmīkirvipramātro saukiṇāṃtastrī samāgamātanugrahānmaharṣīṇāṃ dhanyastaṃ rāmanāma caprāptavānagragaṇyattvaṃ brahmādyairapi pūjyatāṃsadyaḥ siddho bhavecchiṣyaḥ sākṣādbrahmāpi paśyatisahasrakṛtvo gāyatrī japakartā dine dineīdṛśaḥ sadgururyeṣāṃ bhavatyatra dvijanmanāṃniṃdaṃ tu vāṃdhavāssarvetyajyaṃ tu strīsutādayaḥācāryacaraṇāṃbhojadvayameva gatirmamaācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja dvayānnānyagatirnamasasaṃtarati saṃsāraṃ muktimuktiṃ ca viṃdatimṛtiradyayugāṃtesyādācāryaṃ parityajetputrānphaleṃnnaṃ bhrātṛṃśca vedāṃtāṃśca śrutīstathāmātṛkāṃ yo nagṛhṇati mātṛkāṃ na dadātiyaḥmātṛkājapataḥ puṃsaḥ pratyahaṃ niyatātmanaḥtasya vaktrāṃvujādbhāṃti sakalyāssarahasyakāḥtasmādācāryakāruṇyānmātṛkāṃ prāpya sādhakaḥanāvāsena saṃsiddhiṃ labhate mahatīṃ parāṃjānakīpatinā proktaṃ mayāpi samudīritaṃiti dāśarathīye yesmin taṃtre dhyāyaścaturdaśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asmābhirbrahmavidyāyāmāhātmyaṃ tvanmukhācchrutaṃvedavedāṃtaśāstraughasārabhūtārthasaṃgrahātśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī vidyāmāhātmyaṃ saṃgamādarātśṛṇudhvaṃ brāhmaṇāśreṣṭhāssarvajñādīrghadarśinaḥbhagavandevadeveśa jānakīvallabhaprabhośrīmaṣṭākṣarīvidyāmūlahe turitīritāsaṃsārābhodhitaraṇaṃ brahmajñānamathājñayaṃśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃvānyāṃ vidyāṃ kathayame prabheśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ kathayāmāsatatvataḥpurā vaidehanagare janakāya mahātmaneśrīmaddaṣṭārṇa māhātmyaṃ yaduktaṃ tacchṛṇu prabhośrīmaddaṣṭarṇā māhātmyaṃ tvayāpṛṣṭaṃ pravakṣyateśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ brahmadarśanasiddhāṃnirguṇaṃ nirvikāraṃvattamaḥ pārepratiṣṭhitaṃtadeva puruṣākāramabhūnnārāyaṇātmakaṃsvāminnacitsamāyukto jagatsargemanodadhebhavāndraṣṭuṃ kathaṃ śakya āvābhyāṃ jagatīpatebrahmāṇamimaṃ vācāṃ patiṃ prabhuṃ anaṃtaraṃmahārudraṃṣṭaṣṭavānparameśvaraṃaśaktautau vibhuṃ draṣṭaṃ brahmarudrānatho catusarvajñakaruṇā kaṇāpūrṇanetrastvaṃ vadāvābhyāṃ maheśvaraḥparamātmāparabrahmasacidānaṃdalakṣaṇaḥetadgṛhītvā satataṃ kurutāṃ sargamuttamaṃacyutohamānaṃ tohaṃ śivohaṃ śaṃkarosmyahaṃrahasyaṃ paramaṃ guptaṃ navācyamapi kutracit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvā tadanusaṃdhānaṃ sadātmānau viṣpattaḥjarāmṛtyuvihīnatvaṃ yuvayossidhyati dhruvaṃnārāyaṇo mahāyogīvabhūvāṃtarhito nṛpabhūtānāmaṃtarānmāhaṃ paramātmāsanātanaḥaṇoraṇīyānmahatomahīpānasmyahaṃ nṛpayadādityagataṃ jyotissarvalokaprakāśakaṃahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā śarīre prāṇināṃ sthitaḥprajāpatīnāṃ brahmāhaṃ rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkarosmyahaṃamarāṇāṃ maheṃdrosmivitteśo yakṣarakṣasāṃsṛjāminikhilaṃ viśvaṃ saṃharāmi punaḥ punaḥyajñeśoṃyajñabhoktāsmivedanārāyaṇosmyahaṃyajñanārāyaṇaścāsmi sarvayajña phalapradaḥsamastanyāsasahitāmaṣṭārṇāṃviddhimāṃ nṛpaakṣarāṇāmakārātmāvaruṇoyāṃyatistathājīvātmā sarvabhutānāmahameva mahīpatedigīśo lokapālātmā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarosmyahaṃvedasāra mahāmaṃtraḥ śrīmānaṣṭākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥācāryavadanāllabdhāye japaṃti dine dineācāryaṃ māṃ vijānīhi maṃtramūrtidharāṃ vibhuṃbhagavadraśmi vidyābhissahitāṃ sarahasyakāṃvedasāramahāvidyātrayameva mahīpateanyesaṃpuṭitā maṃtrāvetthaṃ sarvaphalapradāḥiṣṭasiddhipradāḥ proktā na cānye saṃpuṭī kṛtāḥasaṃpuṭitanevedaṃyatīnāṃ muktisiddhidaṃgāyatrī sarvavedānīmātā sakalasiddhidā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svabhāva praṇavāghaiva mahāsiddhipradā smṛtātāvanmātraphalaṃdātuṃśaknoti na mahatphalaṃmiśritāṣṭākṣarī vidyā svasāmarthyaṃ nayacchatiśuddhaivāṣṭākṣarī vidyāsvācāryavadanāṃvujātsarvavedamayī sarvavedāṃtārthasvarūpiṇīsarvayogamayī sarvasāṃkhyavedāṃtarūpiṇīśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarī vidyānānyāvidyedaśīnṛpasamastabhogadā sarvavidyāsiddhipradāyinīsamastamuktāratnaughavarṣiṇī bhaktamaṃdirejatṛṇāṃ rūpasaubhāgya samastaiśvaryasiddhidāsamastarogasaṃhartrī sarvaduḥkhaprabhaṃjanīsarvopadravasaṃhartrī mahādādivyabhaṃjanīsamastaśreyasāṃrāśirmahāsalakṣmīracaṃlāaśvamedhādiyāgānāṃ phalamicchan dine dinetulāpuruṣadānādiphalamicchan dine dinecaturṇāmapi vedānāṃ pārāyaṇa phaleptunāśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīviyā japakarturathānvahaṃyaśetiṣṭhaṃti śakrādyādikpālāḥ kiṃ karā ivasaṃcaransakalānlokānbhāskarāyutasannibhaḥmūrtimadbhiścaturvedaiḥścaturddikṣusamanvitaṃsvāhākārasvadhākāra vaṣaṭkāraissamūrtibhiḥśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃvidyāṃ jihvāyāṃ pradadarśahaāpādamastake tasya dṛṣṭvāsau vismito bhavatdadarśa caturovedān dīvyamānāt svatejasāuvāca yajña puruṣaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tvāṃ matye sarvalokānāṃ kartāraṃ sthitikārakaṃtathāpīyaṃ mahāmāyāmāṃ yohayati satataṃkemīsvaṃtejasādīptā vidyāmahātmyasūcakāḥkasyopāsamayānityaṃ tvāṃ paśyāmyagrataḥ sthitaṃsaṃkhyāya na mahābhāgaṃ yatvaṃ māṃ pṛṣṭavānasiśrīmaddaṣṭārṇamaṃtrātmālokānāmīśvaromyahaṃnārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahmaparamātmāhamīśvaraḥmamavāca ime vedājagatsargādihetavaḥācāryacaraṇāṃbhojadvaṃdvārcanarattāssadādivyakanyā sahasraśca kāmadhenubhiranvitāḥciṃtāmaṇiḥ kalpataruḥ kāmadhenuḥ sudhārasaḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyānyāsa pūrvādinedinenyāsahīnāmimāṃ vidyāṃ yo dadāti vimūrḍhyāḥpūrvaṃ nyāsairvirahitāṃ gṛhītvāpi mahāmatebhagavadraśmi vidyānāṃ pāraṃgatamakalmaṣaṃbahuyojanasāhasramapi gatvā śrayedguruṃpitāmātā tathā bhrātā caturveda pradopi vāyattadbrahmaparaṃ jyotiśrīṃmaddaṣṭākṣarātmakaṃtadeva sūkṣmaparamaṃ sthūlaṃ cāpi sadeva hiādyaṃ trayīmayīvījaṃ praṇavākhyaṃ samātanaṃacoyajūṃṣi sāmānisāhi śrīramṛtāsatāṃakṣarāṇāmakārosau prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥādyonārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādakāreṇocyase muneiyaṃ trayīmayī nityā mama vāmāṃkasaṃścitātasmāt praṇava vācyaṃ yallakṣmīnārāyaṇāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇavākhyamidaṃ vījaṃ śrīvījamiti kathyateaviprairapijapyāḥ syurmaṃtrāḥ praṇavavarjitāḥavaśyaṃ brāhmaṇairjapyā nikṣipta praṇavā apiiyamaṣṭākṣarīvidyā svābhāvapraṇavādikāmuktilakṣmī vījabhūtājñānalakṣmī phalapradāaṃte nārāyaṇapadaṃ caturthyaṃta samanvitaṃpraṇavena paraṃbrahmaśrīrapyuktā mahāmuneiyaṃ samastavidyānāṃ vījabhūtāparāsmṛtānārāyaṇaivyaṃ jīvasya kathyate namasāmunenārāyaṇapadaṃ dānaṃ nārāyaṇaparaṃtapaḥnārāyaṇaḥ paraṃjyotirātmānārāyaṇaḥ paraḥjaptṛṇāṃ brahmahatyādi mahāpātakanāśanaṃvidhānāsayaṇāvarṇāvarṇituṃ naiva śakyateaṇimādi guṇaiśvaryaṃ brahmajñānamakalmaṣaṃetesādhyāstayāssiddhā ācāryacaraṇārcakaḥetemadvadanīdbhūtā vedāssāṃgāssanātanāḥathattecaturovedāmūrtimaṃto mahāmatiṃsāṃkhyāyana mahābhāgavākyamasmākamādarātayaṃ samastajagatāmādyo nārāyaṇocyutaḥaṇoraṇīyānmahatomahīyānahamīśvaraḥmaṃtramūrtirayaṃ sākṣātparamātmā sanātanaḥhitāya sarvajagatāṃ svasvarūpopa labdhayeasmābhiḥ kathyate yadyatatkartavyaṃ dvijottamaiḥtrividhaṃ karmakartavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ pratyahaṃ munedātavyaṃ sakalaṃ dānamihāmutraphalāptaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asmābhirapi yadguptaṃ tadvakṣyā mokṣasāṃprataṃsarvavidyāmayīṃ viddhitāmeva paramāṃmunetadraśmi vidyāsahitāye yaṣṭākṣarī śubhāapi prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhavātairnavaktavyādurātmanevidyārahasyaṃ vijñeyaṃ japtavyāṣṭākṣarī śubhābhūyopi janmasaṃprāpyamajjaṃti narakārṇavesaṃsārasāgaraṃ tartuṃ janmamṛtyu jarā apiśrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīvidyā yena nityaṃ prajapyattemuktā asya na saṃdehāḥ pitaropi pitāmahāḥpāvanā api tanmitra vāṃdhayājñātayastathābhagavāneva jānāti nānyo jānāti tatvataḥśakrādyā aṣṭakikpālāḥ kaikaryaṃ prāpnuvaṃtyapiśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā japahomādibhirmunevāṃchitaṃ samavāpnoti yogināmapidurlabhaṃmalamūtrāttayaṃ māṃsamajjāmedosthisaṃyutaṃsravatyeva divārātraṃ durgaṃdhimalamevahiyadvastu jihvayāyuktaṃ tatsarvaṃ dehamadhyagaṃsadyomuktaṃ vastujātamapyudgīrṇaṃ punarmukhātupastheṃdriyatomūtraṃ srakameva divāniśaṃsaṃtānakāraṇaṃ vījamapi durgaṃdhi satataṃatra krodhaśca kāmaścarāgadveṣādayoguṇāḥkhastrīyoniṣucāsaktaḥ kāmīparvadine apianubhūyamahaduḥkhaṃ mātṛyone vinirgataḥsasataṃ malamūtrādyaipīḍitaḥ kṣudhayānvitaḥyauvane viṣayāsakto dhanārjanarataḥ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhavattītthaṃ mahārājaḥ prākṛtopi narassadānidrayāyadṛtaṃ kiṃ cidāyurvyādhimirapyathāālasyena ca vṛddhatve kiṃcidāyurgataṃ munevaddhau sau kālapāśena dharmarājasya kiṃkaraiḥatha pātakaśeṣeṇa punarbhūtatmamāgataḥsaṃprāpyaśvāna janmādijñataścaṃḍālayoniṣupuṇyaśeṣeṇaviprāṇāṃkule jāto bhavenmunetadā svargasukhaṃ bhuṃkte punarbhūmau ca jāyatesvargasaukhyaṃ duḥkhamiśraṃ duḥkhameva samīrītaṃpiśarjitamapi dravyamathavā prapitāmahaiḥsvaprāṇānapi datvāsmaiciraṃ śuśrūṣaṇorataḥācāryacaraṇāṃbhojayugalaṃ kalmaṣāpahaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ bhagavadraśmipūrvikāṃācāryapādayugale śuśrūṣaṇaratttassadāavaśyaṃ paramaṃdhāma punarāvṛttivarjitaṃna vidyāmātradāne namahānācārya ucyateanyatra vidyānyāsādīngṛhītvāpi mahāmatevahuyojanasāhasramapi gatvā mahāmateśubhedine śubhelagne caṃdratārāvalānvitekārtikemārgaśīrṣe vā dehaprāṇadhanairapigṛhṇīyāt pūrvamācārya vaktrājādraśmimālikāṃgṛhītvācāryapādābja dvaye sarvasvamapyathaprātaḥprātassamuṣyāya nityamācāryatoṣaṇesamastanyāsasahitāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japetaṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ vā vijñaddhiścātulā śubhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvajñatvaṃ manojñatvaṃ kāmarūpatvamakṣayaṃbrahmatvamapi rudratvaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ ca na durlabhaṃpādukāṃjanakhaḍgāṣva api sidhyaṃti siddhayaḥaṣṭāṃgasahitaṃ yogaṃ prāpya khecaratāmapiśvetadīpādi bhagavatyadeṣu viharatyasauācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja dṛḍhabhakto dine dinejāti smaraṇamāsādya lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmakaṃetadeva paraṃ śreya idameva tapaḥ paraṃayameva paroyoga idameva paraṃ phalaṃidamva trayovedāssaśāstrāṇyāgamāni capitāmātāsuhṛddhātāprāṇavaṃ dhussuhṛtsakhāācārya eva bhagavān brahmāviṣṇurmaheśvaraḥiti matvā sadācāryaṃ vidyāmaṣṭākṣarīṃ japetsarahasyāṃ mahāvidyāṃ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japetsarahasyāvayaṃ sṛṣṭā iṃdirāpatināmuneśrīmaddaṣṭārṇamāhātmyaṃ sarasvatyaivadatyapiśrīmaddaṣṭārṇa māhātmyaṃ maharṣibhyaḥ prayacchatiayodhyānagare paścādbhūtvā daśarathātmajaḥvaśiṣṭādi maharṣīṇāṃ sannidhau jānakīpatiḥtatraṃ dāśarathīyākhyaṃ vedasāraṃ mahodayaṃśrutvā samastavedānī sārabhūtaṃ yaśaskaraṃsanatkumāraḥ sarvajño vaśiṣṭaśca mahāyaśāḥdattātreyo mahāyogīsau bhagavadaṃśajaḥśrīmaddaṣṭārṇa māhātmyaṃttepi vakṣyaṃti sādaraṃśrīmaddaṣṭārṇamāhātmyaṃtepi vakṣyaṃti sāraṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmarṣayovaśiṣṭādyābhāradādyāḥ surarṣabhaḥvasurudrārkacaṃdrādyāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyāśca saṃtataṃśrīmaddaṣṭārṇa tatvajño yatra tiṣṭhati bhūtaleyatrācārya padāṃbhoja dṛḍhabhakto viyatsvapitatra gaṃgāgayākāśīkurukṣetraṃ sāgaraṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā japahomārcanādibhiḥtuṣṭo bhavati bhaktasya prasīdatyapi satataṃmartitritayamagnīṃnāṃ tritayaṃ ca jagattrayaṃśrīmaddaṣṭārṇavidyāyāḥ padātraya samudbhavaṃbrāhmādyāmātaropyaṣṭau bhairavā asitādayaḥśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyā aṣṭavarṇasamudbhavāḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ bhāvenatāṃ sadā japaniti sāṃkhyāyanaṃ brahmasutaṃ yogivaraṃ prabhuṃutkābhavāvatāsākaṃ vedāṃ aṃtarmukhānṛpatadārabhya sadācārya padaṃ dvaṃdvaṃ samarcayankiṃciduktaṃ mahīpālasādhanaṃ ca pravakṣyatepravakṣyāmi samāsena samahitamanābhavapraṇamyaśayanasthopi daśadvādaśadhā tataḥsmṛtvā gaurīmaheśaucavāṇīṃdhātāramapyathaprāṅmukhodha sudhāṃ natvā bhūtale dakṣiṇaṃ padaṃācārya caraṇāṃbhojārūḍhaṃ śrīpādukādvayaṃananyadarśano dṛṣṭvānatvā sāṣṭāṃgamādarātananyadarśino dṛṣṭvā dhenu pṛṣṭamathāpi vāśuddhaṃ vāsaḥ parīdhāya śrīmadācāryapādukobhagavadraśmividyāṃ cayaṃcadhā vāsredhā japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrāṇāṃ mahāvidyāmekāvṛtyātha vā japetprātaḥ srātvā viśuddhātmāmārjayedvārdravāsasāyosau tapanmudetyādi saurasūkte na nityaśaḥyosau tapanmudetyādi sāvitraṃ sūktamanvahaṃādityāmukhoptvā dīrghamāyurarogatāṃdhanena paśubhirvāpi na viyuktau bhavetyasauprāṇānāyamya saṃkalpyamaṃtrasaṃdhyāṃ samārabhetudake vilikhedyaṃtraṃ sāṃgaṃ vījādisaṃyutaṃārṣachaṃdo daivataṃ ca vījaśaktīnyasettataḥāvāhanāhimudābhiḥ pūjayitvā tataḥ paraṃśrīmaddaṣṭākṣaraṃ japtvā vāmahaste viniḥkṣipetmārjayitvā vaiṣṇavena ṣaḍarṇena jalaṃ pivetarghyaṃ datvā tridhā paścādgāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ jayetnārāyaṇapadaṃ paścādvidmahe padamapyathadhiyoyonaḥ pracodeti yadityakṣaramuccaretbhuktimuktipradāsākṣādbrahmadarśanasiddhidāchaṃdo gāyatramityuktaṃ paramātmāśriyaḥ patiḥaṣṭāṃviṃśatidhānityaṃjapedvādaśadhyāpi vāādityamaṃḍalagataṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidhāṃ nyaset sakalasiddhidāṃstutiṃ kuryādbhagavataḥ paṃcādhā vā tridhaikadhātarpayitvā pitṛdevānmanuṣyāṃśca tataḥ paraṃekena janmanāmuktimucchitā sarvasiddhidāśrīmadaṣṭārṇavidyāyā japahomādikaṃ sadānityahomaṃ samāpyāthanatvācāryapadāṃvujaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yatkiṃciddakṣiṇāṃ hīmapyācāryapadāṃvujeatha vā pratyahaṃ hutvā smṛtvācāryapadāṃvujaṃsūyaṃ śākaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāpi yatkiṃcidapi dakṣiṇāṃkarotyavaṃ divasamapiyāgaphalaṃ labhetśrotriyāyāthavā dadyādapi teṣāmasannidhauapātrebhyo dhanaṃ dattamapi merusamaṃnṛpavaidikācārasahito vedavicchotriyaḥ smṛtaḥavedaviduṣedānaṃdattaṃ yatkiṃcidapyathajapahomasamiddīptehutaṃ śrotriyapātakedānamācāryapādābje daṃtayatkiṃcidapyatavipramātre pratijñātamapi vācādhanādikaṃpratijñātaṃ ca yadvācāṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtarenṛpaācāryebhyaḥ pratijñātamapi śākaghṛtādikaṃihāpi devatāśāpaṃ prāpyāṃte narakaṃ vrajetyatkiṃcidapi datvātha siddhiṃ cāpnoti durlabhāṃsaṃkrāṃtau bhārgavevāre dattamakṣayasiddhidaṃapi sākṣādbhagavatena deyaṃ śreya icchatājapaṃtīṣvapi sarvāsudattama evapi siddhidaṃalabhyayogeṣu dattamakṣayaṃ bhogamokṣadaṃbhārgave vāsaredānamakṣayaśrīsamṛddhidaṃanaṃtasaukhyadaṃsvargabhogamokṣasamṛddhidaṃprathamaṃ sumahaddānaṃ vahuśasyaughasaṃkulaṃyathoktadakṣiṇāyuktaṃ mahīdānaṃ mahīpateśrotriyāya daridrāya vivāhamadravyamapyathadvitīyaṃ sumahaddānamettadvaṃśābhivṛddhidaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmarāgamaṇisvarṇakuṃḍaladvitayānvitaṃsālaṃ kṛtaṃ vahukṣīraṃ savatsaṃdhenupaṃcakaṃdattamācārya pādābje parvakāle viśeṣataḥsadyaḥ sakalaḥ duḥkhauhyaharaṇaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃnavamaṃdirasaṃyuktaṃ samastakleśavarddhanaṃtulāpuruṣamukhyānidānāni sumahaṃtyapiāṃdolikāṃkaśivikāṃyaḥ prayacchati parvasusadya eva vimuktosau pitṛmātṛkulānvitaḥkalpyāṃtepyakṣayānbhogānbhuṃktesau brahmaṇaḥ padevarṣāśatamitadravyadakṣiṇāsahitaṃ nṛpabhuṃktepi durlabhān bhogānnaṃdanādivaneṣvasaudatvā sadyo vimukto sau mahāpātakarāśibhiḥvaikuṃṭhe paramedhāmnimodanekālakṣayaṃvastradānaṃ mahātpuṇyaṃ divyabhogasamṛddhidaratnadānaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ merumūrdhisukhapradaṃkarṇeṣu muktāmaraṇadānaṃ māheṃdrabhogadaṃmahāduritasaṃghānāṃ nāśanaṃ muktimuktidaṃdānaṃ kalmaṣarāśimaṃ saukhyadaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padetatadāvāryapādābje datvā siddhiṃ parāṃ vrajetdhānyadānamihāmutra samasteṣṭaphalapradaṃācāryacaraṇāṃbhoja dvayameva na saṃśayaḥduḥkhamiśraṃ sukhaṃ bhaumaṃ tasmāddharmarato bhavetadharmonarakakleśasiddhidoyamamaṃdiremaharṣisiddhaṃ gaṃdharvaiḥ pūjyaḥ syādapidaivataiḥvaidikācāranirataḥ śrotriyaḥ pātramucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: apātraṃ vedarahitaḥ sarvakarma vahiṣkṛtaḥākalyaṃ narake ghore vahuduḥkhapradāyakaṃkulaṃ tārayate dāturddaśapūrvaṃdaśāparaṃācāryāyāstu mātraṃ vā datvā yāti parāṃgatiḥśrīmaddaṣṭārṇa sidhyarthaṃ vibhumācāryamāśrayetpitāmātāttathāvārya ihāmutrāpinaṃ tataṃyativeṣadharoviprovaṃdyaḥ pitrāpisataṃtaṃgarbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyā.ṃ piturmātāgarīyasīācārya eva tatrāpi daivasaṃpūjyameva hiācārya eva tasyāpi pratyahaṃ daivataṃ nṛpaācāryasya parityāgānnarakaugheṣu saṃtaṃtaṃapi sākṣātkṛta brahmasvarūpajñānināmapitasmādavaśyamācāryaṃ sarvaṃjñaṃ bhagavanmayaṃkuṃḍalodaravaṃdhādyairmudrikābhiranekaśaḥetadeva mahacchreyaḥ sādhanaṃ nānyaducyatenaddaivamadhikaṃ śrīśānnamuktisadṛśaṃ phalaṃnāṣṭārṇavidyājapahomapūjanādgatipradaṃ nāsti paratravehaācāryapādāṃvujayugmatīrthānnavidyate pāvanamanyatīrthaṃācāryapatnyaivagirīṃdvakanyakāvāṇīśacībhūmiraruṃdhatī caabhyarcya saṃpoṣya dhanairanekairavaśyamaṃte harirūpametitaḥuktaṃ nārāyaṇe nādau yadyadbhagavatā dvijāḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ japennyāsapurassaraṃuktaḥ saptadaśodhyāyaḥ pātakaudya vibhedanaḥuktaṃ bhagavatāpūrvaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥchaṃdogāyatramityuktaṃ chaṃdaṃ sāmuttamottamaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇāstrijagatāṃpatirdevassanātanaḥviniyogo bhagavataḥ prasādārtha sudāhṛtaḥjamadagnirvaśiṣṭaśca kaśyayogastya evagāyatryudimaganuṣṭupyavṛhatīpaṅktireva cadharodhruvastathā soma āyaugnirvāyureva cakruddholkāyāgnijāpāṃtai kṛṣṇavarṇā yadṛdyathavīro kṛpāgni jāpāṃte piṃgaleti padātparaṃhemavarṇāyakavacaṃ sahasro klāyaśabdataḥaṃgulīpaṃcakanyāsamevameva samācaretvinyasya nama sāyuktānnābhau guhye tataḥ paraṃsa viṃdukākṣasyāsaḥ kartavya iti bhūyateastraṃ tathodare pṛṣṭhe nyāsamaṣṭāṃgamācaretaṃtavīhirmātṛkākhyānyāsaṃ kuryādanyadhīḥdevatāmātṛkāsākṣāccidrūpāśrīḥsarasvatīhrasvadīrghāṃdyaṃtayutaiḥ ṣaḍvirvargaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgakaṃādikṣāṃtākṣaraśreṇīmāṇikyākalpadhāriṇīṃathāṃtarmātṛkānyāsaḥ kaṃṭhahṛnnābhiguhyakedaśapatre ca ṣaṭpatre catuḥpatredvipatrakeekaikavarṇamekaikapatrāṃtarvinnyasenṛpaśirovadanavṛttepi cakṣuḥ śrotrayugepyathaurdhvādhodaṃtapaṃktau ca vinyaset ṣoḍaśasvarātṭa ta vargadvayaṃ pādasaṃdhyagreṣu tathānyasethṛdormūlakakulkakṣahṛdādikarapavayepaṃcāśadakṣaranyāsaḥ krameṇaivaṃ vidhīyatemāyālakṣmī kāmavījapūrvonyastavya iṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāṃtyai tathā mādhavāya tuṣṭau iti nyaset namaḥmadhusūdanaśāṃtī ca trivikramakriye tathāmedhāyai ca hṛṣīkeśoharṣāyai ca namastathālajjāyai vāsudevāya lakṣmyai saṃkarṣaṇāya caaniruddhā paratyai ca svarāṃte pravadedathadurgāyai ca prabhāyai ca khaḍgine vinyasedathahaline ca tathāvāṇyai tathāmuśalinevadetpāśine vijayāyai ca tathaivāṃkuśinevadetvimadāyai namastataḥ naṃdajāsunaṃdāyai naṃdine ca smṛti tathāsamṛddhyaiharayeśuddhyai kṛṣṇaṣuddhīnataḥ paraṃśauraye ca kṣamāyai ca śūrāya paramātataḥkledinyaiṣiśca mūrtiśca klinnāyai tadanaṃaraṃpuruṣottamaśca vasudāvaline ca parā tathāvalāyāpyatha sūkṣmāyai vṛṣāghnāya tataḥ paraṃhaṃsāya ca prabhāyesyādvarāhāya niśātathāvidyutāyaitvagātyā ca hyasṛgātmā ca hyasṛgātmā tataḥ paraṃjīvātmane ca paramātmane nama itīrayetvinyasyaivaṃ kramādbhūpavirāḍrūpī na saṃśayaḥśirovadanavṛtādiścayaṃ nyāsakramaḥ smṛtaḥdehināṃ nyāsamātreṇa brahmatādātmyasiddhidaḥvinyasya satataṃ dhīmānbhagavanmayanāṃ vrajetśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japtvā sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavetśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japtvā yathā śaktyā dinedineācāryānugrahādbhūtvā mahatīṃ siddhimaśnutekeśavādirayaṃnyāsonyāsamātreṇadehināṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatvanyāsamatho vakṣye śṛṇuṣvāvahitonṛpamādayaḥ pratilomyenakāṃtāḥ sparśasaṃjñakāḥjīvaḥ prāṇaśca buddhiścāpyahaṃkāromanastathāpūrddhni ghrāṇe ca hṛdayepyupastho pādayorapijñāneṃdriyāṇiyaṃ cāpi tatasthāne nyaset punaḥtathaiva tatatsthāneṣu tattadeva pravinyasetākāśānilatejāṃsi salilaṃ pṛthivī tathāśahau ca saṣalāḥ paṃcatathāyaśca valā-apihṛtpadma somasūryāya svakalāyuktaṃ maṃḍalāṃparameṣṭhī ca puruṣo viśvavyāpīnivartakaḥmūrdhnāsye hṛdiguhye ca pādayorvyāpakaṃ tataḥatatvasyāpya pūjyasya tatprāpterhetunāpunaḥyaḥ kuryātatvavinyāsaṃ sa eva bhavati dhruvaṃtatassa eva tatvāni sarvaṃ tasminpratiṣṭhitaṃsarvatatvamayaḥ sākṣātatvadhidvavidbhavetviśvaṃmarovijāḍātmāsākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavetācāryānugrahaṃ prāpya śrīmadaṣṭākṣaraṃ japantanmūrtipaṃjaranyāsasya tanmūrtisiddhayenamo bhagavate vrūyādvāsudevāya ityathaśrīmaṣṭākṣarau vidyāmādāveva samuccaranvāsudevadvādarśārṇasyaikekākṣaramuccarannāmaikaikamuapadāya sūryasyāpi ca nāmasulalāṭenābhi hṛdayakaṃṭhapārśvāṃsakaṃdharekeśavaśca tato vrūyānnārāyaṇa iti dvayaṃtrivikramo vāmayaśca śrīdharo navamaḥ smṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣṇorddhādaśanāmānicāmūnimunisaptamaiṃdrocitravasānpūṣā ca parjanyo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥtanmūrtipaṃjaranyāsastubhyamuktomayāvibhośrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japtvācāryānugrahātsadātanmūrtipaṃjaranyāsaṃkṛtvā tanmūrtisiddhayevarṇanyāsaṃ daśavidhaṃ pravakṣyāmi tataḥ paraṃādau yogāsanamayaṃ svadehaṃ bhāvayeddhiyāpīṭhoparitalaṃ pārśvadvayanābhimukhātmakaṃnavaśakti mahāpīṭhamaṃtrayukte tataḥ paraṃsvātmānameva dhyātvātha na gavanmayamacyutaṃādhāre hṛdivakaktre narormūlayugale tathāekaikaṃ mūlamaṃtrārṇanamoṃtaṃ praṇavādikaṃkaṃṭhe nābhau ca hṛdayestanayugme ca pārśvayoḥmūrdhnāsye netrayugalokarṇayugme tataḥ paraṃvāhusaṃdhyaṣṭakepādasaṃdhiṣvaṣṭa subhūpateaṃgulīṣvaṣṭasunyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭoguṣṭhaṃ vineritaḥtvagasṛṅmāsamedosthimajjāśuṣkamāyānnṛpaprāṇarūpaṃ svahṛdayāṃvuja evākṣarānnyasethṛdayeccoderapaścādūrujaṃthāpadeṣu cakapolaskaṃdhayugaloruddhayecaraṇadvayeitthaṃ daśavidhaṃ varṇanyāsaṃ kṛtvā dine dinemūlamaṃtrākṣaranyāsaṃ kṛtvānyāsaṃ kṛtvā daśavidhaṃ nṛpamātṛkākṣaravinyāsaṃ kecidbrahmavidomalāḥmātṛkāvarṇavinyāsa ādyaḥ śuddha itīritaḥmāyāvījādikonyāsaścaturthaḥ samudīritaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāṅmāyākamalādyaścanyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhā udīritaḥhaṃsamaṃtrādikaḥ paścānnyāsoṣṭama udīritaḥvaiṣṇavomātṛkānyāsodarāmaḥ samudīritaḥkecidbrahmavidonityaṃ kurvaṃtya khilasiddhidaṃvedāgamapurāṇeṣu kathitā brahmavittamaiḥnyāsaṃ keśavakīrtyādyamavaśyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ nyasetvinyasya mātṛkāmaṃtarvahiḥ pūrvaṃ dine dinetatvanyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvānyasya tanmūrtipaṃjaraṃitthaṃ vinyasya vidhivat sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavetnyāsaṃ caturaśavidhaṃ kṛtvedyaṃ nityamādarātupadiśyaivapuratonyāsajālamidaṃ guruḥcaturdaśavidhanyāsamajñātvāyogururnṛpanāvātmavaṃcakau proktau vubhāvapi na saṃśayaḥsatataṃ siddhamaṃtrasya vahujñasya mahātmanaḥsahasraṃ yojanaṃ vāpi gatvā vedārthapāragaṃpradadyādapi gṛhṇīyācchrīmaddaṣṭākṣarīṃ śubhāṃnyāsaḥ syānmaṃtrasantāhonyāsahīno na siddhidaḥcaturdaśavidhinyāsaṃ kṛtvā japtvā dine dinecaturdaśavidhanyāsapūrvikāmiṃdirāpateḥtamācāryaṃ vijānīhi sākṣānmadrūpiṇaṃ vibhuṃsarahasyamanordātājñeya ācārya īśvaraḥvahuyojana sāhasramapi gatvā mahīpateśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ samastanyāsapūrvikāṃsa eva sakalanyāsa pūrvavidyāpradovibhuḥtameva daivatāṃ viddhi sadācāryaṃ ghṛṇānidhi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paramātmā paraṃbrahma sa eva harirucyateśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ samastanyāsapūrvikāṃcaturdaśavidhanyāsakartā svācāryamīśvaraṃadevo na yajñedevamityeṣāśāścatīśrutiācāryānujñayā nityaṃ kṛtvetthaṃ nyāsamādarātājñāsiddho mahāyogī bhavedbrahmasamonṛpatīrtvā siddhimavāpnoti devānāmapi durlabhāṃsakṛsmaraṇatovāpi japakoṭiphalaṃ labhetśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīsiddhiṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapisārātsāratadaṃ puṇyamāgameṣu śrutiṣvapiśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ vidyāmādāvuccārya yatnataḥvidrūparmātṛkānāma prokteyaṃ sarvakāmadhukcidrūpamātṛkānyāsamavaśyaṃ pratyahaṃ nyasetvinyasya pratyahaṃ japtvā śatamaṣṭocaturaṃ tu vācaturdaśavidhaṃ nyāsaṃ nyasyācidrūpamātṛkāṃsamastanyāsasahitā śrīmadaṣṭākṣarīśubhābrahmatādātmyasaṃsiddhimaṇimādiguṇāṃśriyaṃśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyāprajapyā sarvasiddhidāśrīdaṣṭākṣarīṃvidyāṃ dadyācchiṣyāya sadguruḥtaṃtre dāśarathīyesminnadhyāyoṣṭādaśaḥ smṛtaḥdhyāyennirāmayaṃ vastu sarvabrahmāṃḍanāyakaṃanuttamaṃ durādharṣaṃ durvijñeya manūpamaṃādimadhyātarahitaṃ niṣkalaṃ niraṃjanaṃmūādi brahmaraṃdhrāṃtaṃ tejaḥ paramakṣayaṃdhyāyet svahṛdayāṃbhoje paramātmānamacyutaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalpadrumagaṇākīrṇāṃ divyaprākāraśobhitaṃtadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃdhāma vaikuṃṭhamiti viśrutaṃtanmadhye nagarī divyāsā'yodhyeti prakīrtitādivyākṣarogaṇaiḥ strībhissarvataḥ samalaṃ kṛtāṃstoraṇairvṛtācaṃḍādidvārapālaiśca kumudādyaiḥ surakṣitāārūḍha yauvanernityaṃdivyaṃ nārīnarairvṛtāratnaprākārasahitaṃ hematoraṇaśobhitaṃdivyākṣarogaṇaiḥ strībhissarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtaṃmāṇikya staṃbha sāhasrajuṣṭaṃ ratnamayaṃ śubhaṃmadhye siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ śubhaṃdharmajñānavaraiśvaryavairāgyaḥ pādavigrahaiḥādhāraśakti cicchukti mukhyaśaktibhirāvṛtaṃchaṃdomayaṃ sarvamaṃtramayaṃ ratnavibhūṣitaṃtanmadhyeṣṭadalaṃ padmamudayārkaśataprabhaṃāsīnaṃ paramātmānaṃ śriyā sahaparātparaṃyuvānamudayādityasamakoṭi samadyutiṃprabuddhaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ kāmadevāya samabhruvaṃmuktāphalābhadaṃtādyasasmitadharavidrumaṃtaruṇāditya varṇābhyāṃ kuṃḍalābhyāṃ virājitaṃmaṃdārapārijātāḍhyakavarīkṛtakeśakaṃhārasvarṇasragāsaktakaṃṭhuṃgrīvavirājitaṃpīnavṛtāyatabhujaiścaturbhirupaśobhitaṃvālārkakoṭiśaṃ saṃkāśakaustubhādivibhūṣisaudivyamālāṃvaradharaṃ vanamālīvirājitaṃvālātapanibhaślakṣṇapītavastrayugāṃvṛttaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sajyothyacaṃdrapratimanakhapaṃṅktivibhūṣitaṃdivyācaṃdanaliptāṃgaṃ divyapuṣpasraganvitaṃvaradābhayahastābhyāmitarābhyāṃ tathaiva cahiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ suvarṇarajatatprajāṃratnakuṃḍalasaṃyuktāṃ vālīyugalaśobhitāṃmaṃdāraketakījātīkusumāṃcitakuṃḍalāṃbhagavaccāyasadṛśa bhūyugmena virājitāṃalaṃkaśaraccaṃdra sahasrasadṛśānanīekaviṃvaphalaprakhyādharaṃ dvayavirājitāṃsusrignanīakuṭilakuṃtalairupaśobhitāṃādyabhūṣaṇaciṃtākapadakādivibhūṣitāṃtaptakāṃcana varṇābhāṃ taptakāṃcanabhūṣaṇaṃnānāratnavicitrāḍhyakanakāṃvujamālayābhujadvayadhṛtodagra padmayugmavirājitāṃmātaraṃ sarvajagatāṃśaraṇāgatavatsalāṃkāṃtyāvirājitapadāṃbhaktatrāṇaparāyaṇāṃaṃ takoṭibrahmāṃḍenāyakaṃ bhaktavatsalaṃpārśvayodharaṇīdevyānīlādevyā samanvitaṃanaṃtavihagādhīśaṃ senānyādyaiḥ sureśvaraiḥsarvadevottamairvaṃdyaṃ dhyeyaṃ sakalayogibhiḥitthaṃ lakṣmīpatiṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhuṃācāryavadanādevadhyānasūktamidaṃ śubhaṃbrahmatādātmyasaṃsiddhiṃ vrajatyāśu na saṃśayaḥvedāśvarathamārūḍhaṃ pītāṃvaravirājitaṃsuvarṇaratnakhacitamudrikābhiralaṃkṛtaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vālāditya sahasrābhaṃ kāmakoṭi samadyutiṃsuvarṇaratnakhacitamudrikābhiralaṃkṛtaṃkaustubhodbhāsitoraskaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitaṃmunibhirvālakhilyādyairbrahmarudrādidaivataiḥvīrāsana samāśīnaṃ vidyutkoṭi samāśriyāekonaviṃśakaḥyatra saṃpūjya lakṣmīśaṃ brahmānaṃdasukhaṃ labhetavaśyaṃ sakalanyāsāḥ kartavyā gurvanujñayātataḥ hṛdayāṃbhoje dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃtatpralīmapi ca dhyoyettrijaganmātaraṃ śriyaṃkirīṭavidyāmuccārya manasā kusumāṃjaliṃtrayīvījaṃ kirīṭetike pūreti padaṃ tataḥśaṃkhacakragadāpadmahastaśabdamataḥ paraṃvakṣasthalapadaṃ paścācchrībhūmisahitetyathapadaṃ dīpti karāpānaṃtādityeti padādathaayaṃkirīṭamaṃtraḥ syādbhagavanmūrti siddhidaḥtaddivya bhūṣaṇaṃ proktamanyanmānuṣabhūṣaṇaṃavaśyaṃ bhagavadrūpī svayameva bhaveddhruvaṃtaduktamālaṃkaraṇameteṣvapi mahīyatesuśuddhapadmarāgākhyaṃ maṇiviṃduvibhūṣitaṃācāryakarṇayordatvā praṇipātapurasaraṃācāryapatnīmabhyarcya ṣaṇmāṣādiṃ dirāpatiṃācāryarūpiṇaṃ viddhimāmeva jagatīpatiṃmakarākṛti saṃtaptakāṃcanena vinirmitaṃācāryakarṇayordatvā śubhalagne śubhedine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uddhṛtya kāṃcanamayaṃ vimānaṃ divyamakṣayaṃbrahmāṃḍamakhilaṃ bhitvā padaṃ prāpnoti śāśvataṃputrapautravatī māyurā rogyasahitāṃ labhetbrahmānaṃda sukhāvāptikaraṃ tatanna saṃśayaḥtadeva bhagavatyalyāśriyāpidhṛta bhanvahaṃgrahaṇādiṣu puṇyeṣu kāleṣu niyatavrataḥbrahmatādātmyasaṃsiddhimavaśyaṃ prāpnuyādasauācāryāya kapalyai tatsutebhyopi saṃtataṃyatra saṃpūjya lakṣmīśaṃ brahmānaṃdasukhaṃ labhettadvahirvilikhedvṛtaṃ caturasramataḥ paraṃsādhyaṃ karma samālikhya ṣaṭsukoṇeṣvataḥ paraṃśrīmadṛṣṭākṣarī varṇān vilikhedaṣṭapatrakelikhitvā dvādaśāreṣu vāsudeva mahāmanoḥnṛsiṃhānuṣṭubhanorekaikaṃ varṇamālikhetśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīviyāyaṃtramatadudīritaṃcaturasraṃ vināṣṭārṇayaṃtraṃ laghusamīritaṃyaṃtrametalikhitvādau saivarṇaṃ rājataṃtu vāprāṇasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā subhalagne śubhedinealaṃkāraiścavāsobhirapi tasya kalatrakaṃtriśagreśubhedine *********alaṃkāraiśca tādhika sāhasraṃ japtvā hutvā śataṃ ghṛtaṃathavādhārayeyaṃtraṃgulīkṛtya yatnataḥvilikhya dhārayitvādau pūjayedyadisaṃtataṃcalaṃti saṃpadonyasya maṃdire kutracit kvacitrakṣākaraṃ śubhakaraṃ sarkāriṣṭavimardadanaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryānugrahātasye mokṣa śrīśāśvātīśrubhāatha pūjāvidhānaṃte pravakṣyāmi dvidhāndayavimalotkarṣiṇī jñānākriyāyogā tathaiva caśaṃkhaṃ oṃ namaḥ yadamāmāṣyapadaṃ bhagavate tataḥvāsudevāya śabdaṃ ca tataḥ sarvātmaneyaddaṃanena pīṭhaṃ maṃtreṇapīṭhaṃ bhagavatī yajetśrīśrīśabdāvṛśākṣeryā samāvāhyaśriyaḥpatiṃmūlavidyāṃ śriyāṃśriyo maṃtrānbrahmavidyāṃ sāmuccaranhṛdayādi ṣaḍaṃgāti ṣaṭkauṇaiṣathāccayaṃtdikṣvabhyacyeściyaṃ vāṇīṃ ratiṃ prītiṃ vidikṣu cakaustubhaṃ muśalaṃ khaḍgaṃ vanamālā mataḥparaṃgarutmaṃtaṃ śaṃkhanidhiṃ dikṣu vidmeśvaraṃ tatacaturthāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ dikpālaiḥ paṃcamaṃ vidaḥitthaṃ taṃtre sasamabhyarcyaramānāthaṃ jagatpatiṃvṛsūjāvidhānaṃte rahasyamapi saṃtataṃcaṃdraṃ pracaṃ ītyagdvāreyāśebhadrasubhadrakaudhātāraṃ ca vidhātārasutaradvāti pūjayetaṃvukarṇaṃ saṃvaṃ netraṃ susamukhasujhatiṣṭitaṃtanmadhye bhagavaddivyāṃtaṃ pureti gṛhāya camaṇiprākyarasahritatomareti yadāsaraṃvimānaṃ tatra saṃpūjyaṃ tanmadhye divyaśabdataḥtanmadhye yadasaccārya rājāsthānayaṃdaṃ tataḥitthaṃ mamḍayamabhyarcya tanmadhye yadamadhyatharatnamaṃḍapamabhyarcyaṃ caturthyaṃtaṃ namocitaṃtanmadhye sarvarvaveheti samaddiṣyapadāṃtparaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ratnasiṃhāsanāyeti nabhimuccāmaṃḍapamabhyacye caturthyaṃtaṃtanānvitaṃtanmadhye sarvavedeti sumaddivya padātparaṃsiṃhāsanaṃ saṃmabhyarcya dharmaṃ jñānamataḥ paraṃajñānamapyavairāgyamanaiśvaryaṃ vidikṣa casāmavedaṃ tato vedamatharvaṇamataḥ paraṃabhyarcya maṃḍalaṃ vahneryarjadarkasyamaṃḍalaṃcainateyaṃtrayīrājaṃ yajecchaṃdāṃsyataḥ paramyā yaddivyapadaṃ yogapīḍāyanama ityathatanmadhye yadamuccāryavāla sūyaśatetyathapadmamabhyarcya tanmadhye sāvitryai nama uccaretvījaśatī tatonyasya devadevaṃ śriyaḥ patiśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃvidyāṃ vāsudevamanaṃtataḥsavovacārānkurvīta śrīśrībrahmavidyayāratnasiṃhāsanaṃ yaścātkalpayāmi namaḥ padaṃratnasiṃhāsaṃsanaṃ yādyamarghyamācamanīyakaṃca sradvayaṃ svaparṇaccoyavīḥtayaṃ tataḥnānāvidhāni divyāniṃ kusumāni ca kalpayetdhūpadīpaṃ kalpayitvānīrājanamataḥparaṃrakṣīmācamanīyaṃ ca bhūyo naivedyamādarārāttāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca caturviśatyupacārān prakalapayetṣālagrāmaśilācaktodhyāyaṃtteḥthavāṃ tataḥbhūdevīṃ dakṣiṇeyāśvaivāmenīlā samarcayetvāyavye madhyabhāge ca sarvadikṣu krammatrayavimalāmāditobhyarcya tata utkarṣiṇīṃ nṛpaiṃśāmānugrahe paścārcayedvasudhāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃkarṣaṇamathovāṇīṃ pradyumnaṃ ratimapyathakeśaṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ mādhavaṃ goviṃdaṃ viṣṇumeva caśrīdharaṃ na hṛṣīkeśaṃ yamanābhamataḥ paraṃpradyumnamaniruddhaṃ ca puruṣottamamapyathaupeṃdraṃ ca hariṃ paścāccharī kṛṣṇaṃ cakramāghanetnārasiṃhaṃ vāmanaṃ ca jāmadagryamataḥ paraṃbuddha ca kalkimihyetānaṃvāṃ ratārāntramādyajetanaṃtaṃ sarvamabhyarcya viṣṇarṣunamataḥ paraṃpaṃcamāvaraṇaṃ proktamṛgvedaṃ yajuṣāṃgaṇaṃdharmaṃ ca yajñapuruṣaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃvaraṇamīritaṃmuśalaṃ sasamaṃ proktaṃ hevasyāvaraṇaṃ śubhaṃtāmasīnisṛtīyayaścabhārgavīvarūṇau tathārudrāṇīśaṃkaraupaścādurddhve vākcaturānanauvajrāyudhaṃ śaktidaḍaukhaḍgaṃyāśaṃdhvaṃjaṃgadāṃdhyānmaruhuṇāścaiva viśvedevānataḥ paraṃkapilādi mahāsiddhāṃ nṛtātreyādiyoginājñāninojanakādyāścanṛyākṣaśarathādikānarkāvṛtyā samabhyarcya lakṣmīnārāyaṇau vibhūtata ācāryamuddiśya bhagavatsatridhau nṛpatāmraṃ dhānyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāpi prasahaṃśceya icchatāavaṃdhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryādanyathā pāpabhugbhavetmahāpātakasaṃdyaudyanāśanaṃ bhuktimuktidamāsimāsyathā vā kuryāt prathamebhāgarvadinealabhyayomegeṣu sadākartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ nṛpaitthamarcyataḥ puṃsaḥ śreyo rāśirdinedine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: itthaṃ śrīśrīśayajanaṃ mahānyāga udāhṛtaḥnyūnātirikta saṃpūtyai yāgasāphalyasiddhayeācāryadakṣiṇāhīnaṃ yaddinaṃ vasudhāpateyamabhītihaṃ puṃsāṃ bhogakhargāyavargardalakṣmīnārāyaṇainityamitthamarcatonṛpepūjāvidhānametate proktaṃ janakabhūyajaśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā jayāsaktasya saṃtataṃsamastābhīśitaṃ tasyā sidhyapi sudurlarbhaiti dāśarathīyetraviṃśodhyāya udīritaḥvedoditaṃ sadācāraṃ manvādyairapyudīritaṃyathāśriyathatistuṣo bhaktānāṃ sataṃ bhavetśrīmadaṣṭākṣarī vidyāraśmimālāsamanvitāpurā bhagavatā prokaṃ rudrāya paripṛcchatesādhya nārāyaṇe nādāvuktaṃ rājñe mahātmanebrahmacaryaṃ vagāhamsthyaṃ vanavāsaścatikṣutāśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīvidyā samastāśramiṇāmapisadācāravatānityaṃ samastanyāsasaṃyutāsaṃkṣeyādadittaṃ pūrvaṃ sadācāraṃ mahāmateśṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi sadācāraṃ mahāmatebrāhmaṇākṣatiyāvaiśyāstrayovarṇādvijāḥ smṛtāyeṣāṃ kriyābhiṣekādi śmaśānāṃtā ca vaihikītasyaṃdanātyākyuṃ savanaṃ sīmaṃtīnnayanaṃ tataḥnāmahyekādaśegehāñcaturthemāsinikṣamaḥśamamenī vrajatyeva vījagarbhajameva casamamevāṣṭame devā sāvitrīṃ brāhmaṇohaṃti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmatejobhivṛdhyarthaṃ viprobdeyaṃ vamerhatimahāvyāhṛti pūrvacivedamadhyāyayedguruḥdhūrvoktavidhinā śaucaṃ kuryādā ca manasadāsrātvāṃvudetairmaṃtraiḥ prāṇānāyamyayasrataḥagnikārye tataḥ kṛtvā śrīmadadaṣṭākṣarīrataḥvuvaścasāvahamitisvupāptīta tato guruṃāpurvalaṃ yaśokṛddhirvarddhetaheraharniśaṃkarmaṇāmanasāvācāhitaṃtasyatvaret sadāśaktā kṛtajñāḥścacayodrīhikalyānasūyakāḥśrīmadaḥṣṭākṣarīṃ sāṃgāṃ jñātuṃjasu ca saṃtataṃvedīdhyayanasidhyarthaṃ prātyayeṣṭākṣarastha cadhārayenmekhilādaṃḍeya vīlājinameva cabrāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāmādimadhyāvasā tataḥvāgyato gurvanujñātībhuṃjītānnamakutsayananāyurogyamanāyuṣyamasurgyaṃ cāti bhojanaṃna dvirbhujītacaikasmin divākvāpi dvijottamaḥmadhumāṃsaṃ prāṇihiṃsāṃbhāskarālokaṃnāṃjameaupanāyanikaḥkāso brahmakṣatraviśāṃparaḥitothyūrvena saṃskāryāḥ patitādharmavarjitāḥsāvitrīyatitaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃsārgaṃni samāvaretupavītaṃ krameṇasyātkāryāsaṃśāṇamāvikaṃvilvayālāśayordvaṃge brāhmaṇasthanṛyasthatuṃāmaulitvālalāṭaṃ vā nāsikoddhe pramāṇataḥpradakṣiṇaṃ parīsāgnimuyasyāpadivākadaṃmātṛmātṛdyasūpitṛpitṛṣṇasṛpurasmarāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aupanādya nikekāletato viprāgryamaṃdirayāvadvedamadhītesaucaredvedatānitraupakurvan gurornityaṃ tadakteṣu naiṣṭikaḥgṛhāśramaṃ samāśrisayaḥ punarbrahmacaryabhākanāśramī na tiṣṭheta dinamekamapidvijaḥjayaṃ hīmaṃ vrataṃdānaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛryaṇaṃmekhalājinadaṃḍāścaliṃgaṃ syādbrahmacāriṇaḥtridaṃḍādiyateruktamupalakṣaṇamatravaijīrṇaṃ kamaṃḍalaṃ daṃḍamayavītādine apividṛdhyāsṣoḍaśevarṣekeśāṃtaṃ karma cakramāttapomajña vratebhyaśca savesmācchrubhakarmaṇaḥvedāraṃbhe visargeva vidadyāstraṇavaṃ sadāvedasyavadanaṃ proktaṃ gāyatrīnniyaddāparāsahasraṃsādhikaṃ kiṃcittrikametajjayaṃtyamīātryavdṛmetadhobhyasthe srutidyastramananyadhīḥtrivarṇamayamoṃkāraṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svāmititrayaṃdakṣrametāścajayaḥ vyāhṛti pūrvakaṃ pūrvakaṃviḥdhikratordaśaguṇo japakraturudīritaśvamedhādiyāgebhyo dvāvuktāvaṃdhikaukratadhikaṃ proktamācāryaivedavedāṃtaceddibhiḥsaṃpūrṇadhānyadharaṇīddānasyakalamaśruteśrutyabhyāsohi viprasya paramaṃ tapa ucyatesadogdhīṃ dhenumutsṛjyagrāmakoḍaṃ dadhukṣatisukalyaṃ saradvasyaṃ ca tamācāryāṃ vidurvadhāḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīsāṃgālabhyateyanmukhāṃvujāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yodhyāya vedekadeśaṃ śrute raṃgānyathāpi vāyathāvidhi niṣaṃkādiyaḥ karma kurute dvijaḥathādhānātyākayajñādagrīyomādikānmakhyātpiturmāturūpādhyāyā'harorācāryatopi casahasraśodhikaḥ prokta ācāryobhagavānasauṣoḍaśārṇādividyāśca nṛsiṃhānuṣṭubhādayaḥśusa sa koriyannūnāṃvaśāstrāṇāmapi saṃtaṃtaṃśuddhaiva śrīmadaṣṭārṇā rājñīnātodhikāparāyaḥ prayacchati viprosau sādhakāya mahīyatebrahmaviṣṇūmaheśebhyopyadhikaḥ śataśonṛpaācāryacaraṇaṃbhoje bhaktassadā bhavetvaiśyānāṃdhānyadhenataścaturthānāṃ tu janmataḥtathā vipronadhīyāmastrayomīnāmadhāriṇaḥbrahmacārīvaredaikṣyaṃ veśyasuprayatīnvahaṃna nāma pratigṛhṇīyātparokṣepyavahaṃ nakarṇaupidhāvavāstheyaṃ yātavyaṃ vātatonyaktaḥmatsakṣarīkṣadrakīraḥ syāti raskārādbhāvet krimiḥpuṣṭirvaṣa sahasrāṇivaṣṭāsukṛmitāṃ vrajetkṛpiviṃśativarṣeṇajñāṇāgurudoṣayoḥpramadāsaprabhāvaṃti kṛcinnaivavipaścitaḥsvavaśaṃ cāpi kurvaṃti sūtravaddhaśakuṃtavatvalavaṃtīdriyāṇpatramohayaṃtyapikovidavidyāsidhyatitalpaścādbrahmapaśyatikevalaṃśaktyā varṣaśatenāpinokartuttasya niṣṇutiḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīsāṃgā bhagavadraśmisaṃvutā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasyoyakartaṃ kenāpi na śakyaṃ kalpakoṭibhiḥjanakemātariguṇairuṣutuṣṭeṣu saṃtatatrīnyussamatikramya trikalpaṃ niyatatyathapītāmātā ca veddānāyuyadeṣṭā tataḥ paraṃcaturvargaphalaṃ proktaṃ caturgurusamarcanātbrahmavidyāpradācāryaṃ prāṇāṃtepinaḥ saṃtyajettaṃptaktānarakeghoretiṣṭhasācaṃdratārakaṃsarvā api makṣavidyā yatrā tiṣṭhaṃti siddhidaḥsa eva sākṣādbhāgavānbhogasvargāyavargadaḥraśmividyāpradāvāryosvasamīpasthite paraṃratnajātaissūvahnibhismatoṣyācāryamanvahaṃnirvāṇāryapraktoyaṃ sadācāraścadhīmatāṃvidyājātaṃyavitvā tu gṛhāśramamathāśrayetātrukūlyaṃ hidaṃyatyostrivargaphalahetavepratikūlaṃ kalatrecennaskeṇahi kiṃ satataḥsvabhāryāyaṃ vinītāyāṃ trivargovarddhate dhruvaṃ cajalaukākevalaṃ raktamādadānāmamasvinīpramadā sarvaṃmādate cittaṃ vittaṃvalaṃ sukhaṃudvahena tato bhāryāṃ savarṇe sāhulakṣaṇaṃudvahetadvijobhāryāṃmyāsyāṃ mṛdubhāṣiṇīṃsulakṣaṇamucāritrāya surāyurvivarddhayetkulakṣaṇāpiyāsādhvī sarvalakṣaṇayūsusālakṣmīśānugrahādeva gṛheyopi daṣavāpyatenānāvidhairalaṃkāraissurūyāstābhavaṃtihitālāvarāyataraṃgirāyo bhavaṃti hi sulakṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇapriyāśrīrvāśacīvāśakravallabhāsvādhīnayatikānāṃcasuśīlānāmṛgīdaśāṃsulakṣaṇaiḥ smacāritrairapi maṃdoyuṣaṃpatiṃācāryapatnīśrīvudhyāvāsolaṃkaraṇādibhiḥte sarvabhāgyasahitāḥ kaṃdarpasadṛśaprabhāḥadhyāya ekaviṃśoyaṃ taṃtre dāśarathīriteyeṣāṃ vijñānamātreṇa sarvayāyaiḥ pramucyategāṃdharvorākṣasaścīpiyaiśācoṣmaducyataṃdīyate tatsutaḥ eyāsuruṣānekaviṃśatiparāhādāpagoddaṃ dvayārṣastajjaḥ punātiṣadratatkanyāyāṃ samuhānnovaṃśyānaṣṭau punātisaḥāsuraḥ krayaṇādravyairgāṃdharvonyonyaṃdyaṃtaḥchalena kanyāharaṇātyaiśācogahiṃtoṣṭamaḥaṣṭamasteyuyāpiṣūḥpāṣiṣṭhānāṃ hi saṃbhavetpratodorveśyayādeyovāsoṃtaḥ śūdrayā tathāsavarṇābhista sarvābhiḥ pāṇirgrāsvāsvayṃvidhiḥadharpyairdharmarahitāmaṃdabhāgyadhanāyuṣaḥstrīṇaṃ varamanusmṛtvā yathā kāmyatha vā bhavetśrīddhārhasarvaparvāṇi yatvāsājyānidhīmatāṛtukālābhigāmoyaḥ svadāratirataścayaḥṛtuḥ ṣoḍaśayāminyaścatastrastāsuvahiṃtāḥyuktvā caṃdramasadusthaṃ madyāṃmūlaṃ vihīya caśuciṃ putraṃ prasūyeta puruṣārthaprasādhakaṃśuklamarāyapi kanyāyāḥ kanyāvikrayāya yakṛtatonā evapi kanyāyā upajīve sitādhane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kevalaṃ nirayagāsteṣāmapi ca yūrvajāḥtatra tuṣṭhā mahālakṣmīrnivesedvānavāriṇāḥkuvivāhaḥ kriyālopaḥ kulepāta na hetavaḥpaṃcayajñakriyāṃ vāpi patnīdainaṃdinīmapikhaṃḍinī yeṣiṇī cukṣo khadakuṃcamārjanīṛtavaḥ paṃcanirdviṣṭāpṛhīśreya vivarddhanāḥatrodakupayobhūlaphalaivopi gṛhāśramīsatkṛtya bhikṣave bhikṣāṃ datvā tu māpnuyāttārayedvighnasaṃghebhyaḥ yāyaudhādapidustarātājanmasaṃcitātpuṇyāpṛtchaṇātsavahirbhavetetānyapi pradeyāni sadābhyāgatatuṣṭayepraṇodhātithimannāśīkiliṣī ca gṛhāśrīmīna pūrvakāla āyā tīnacadeṣṭa tataḥ kvacitadatvātaṃvaliṃ tasmai yathā śaktyannamapye yetatithiścārthinopyeṃtebhojyā nātra vivāraṇāsvārthaṃ yacannadyaṃ bhuṃkte kevalaṃ svodaraṃbharaḥaparāmṛśyayobhuṃṅkte sabhuṅgapāpamakṣayaṃvaiśvadevavivihīnāye ātithyena vivarjitāḥakṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tu bhuṃjate yadvijādhaḥvedoditaṃ svakaṃkarmanityaṃ kuryādataṃdritaḥṣuṣṭyāṣṭamyosmyajedbhayaṃ tailaṃ māsasyabhakṣyaṃsāṃnodayaṃtamavekṣyet nāstaṃ yāṃtaṃ na madhyagaṃna vīkṣetītmanīrūpamasadhāvennavarṣatidevatāyatanaṃ vipraṃ dhenuṃ madhumṛdeghṛtaṃaśvatthacaisavṛkṣyaṃ ca guruṃjalaghṛtaṃ ghaṭa
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hajasvalāṃ na sevetanāṣṇīyāt sahabhāryayānāṣṇaṃtīṃ striyamīkṣetatejaskāmodvijottataḥasaṃtarpye sadācāryaṃ na ratnaṃ dhārayet kvacitna mūtraṃ gauvrajekuyonnavalmīkena bhasmaniviprasūrya vāyvagricaṃdrārkovagustapidivāṃ saṃdhyāsukarṇasya brahmasūtra udamukhaḥmukhenopadhamennāgriṃ nagrāṃ nekṣetayoṣitāṃpraṇihiṃsānukuvitanāṣṇīyāt saṃdhyayordvayoḥvirāmūtraṣṭhivanaṃ nāsyukuryāddīrghajijīviṣuḥnaikaḥ svadhyātkṛcicchatyenaśayānesavodhayeyetnadivoddhatasāraṃ ca bhakṣayedadhinoniśiyaṃtrikapriyo nasyātkāṃ syeyādaunadhāvayetdātuḥ śrīdvraphalanāstibhoktā kilviṣa bhāgbhavetnabhinnabhojaneṣṇīyānnāṣṇītāgnyādihṛṣitaṃvālātayaṃdivāsvāyaṃtyajedīryajajīviṣuḥhastauśironudhanuyānnākarṣehāsanaṃ yadākarajaiḥ karajaccheraṃ tṛṇavedaṃvavarjayetnāyadvoreṇagaṃtavyaṃ khaṃ veśmaparaveśmanoḥnaśayīta kṛcigraḥ prāṇairbhuttotanaiva casaṃviśennārdracaraṇonīcchīṣṭaḥ kvacidavrajetsoyānatkaścanācāmannatiṣṭan dhārayārṣivetna ca vīkṣetavirāmūtrenocchiṣṭasaṃspṛśedviraḥpatitaissahasaṃ vā saṣyatanāyaiva jāyatebrāhmaṇyāddhāyate vipraḥ śūdrodhamoccahīyatedvijuśrūṣaṇaṃ dharmaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āṃdolanaṃ karābhyāṃ ca keśānāṃ keśaluṃchanaṃbrāhmaṇaḥ sānvayo yāti narakānaikaviṃśatimahāvātardhanaurātrāvanadhyāyāḥ prakīrtitāsaṃdhyayordṛṣaloyāṃte rājavādhe ca sūpakepratipadyapi pūrṇāḥ vāmamāyāṃ sarvayasuupākarmaṇivotsargenāvibhānautarautaleanadhyoṣu caiteṣunādhīyīvradvijaḥ kvacitbhūtāṣṭamyoḥ paṃcadaśyorbrahmacārī bhavet sadātasmāta dūratastyājya variṇāṃ copasevanaṃmavatāṃ yasmāchreyovidyānadarlabhāprīpaṃcanānṛtaṃ vrūyādeṣadhamau mahīyatebhadrairavahisaṃsargonābhadraiśca kadācanaetavīkṣītanāśricissatyabrahmarṣigrahatārakāḥutkocadhūtadīnārtadravyaṃ dūrātparityajetna spṛśedanimitetasvānikhānitvanāturaḥpādaśododakaṃ sūtrannmucchiṣṭatrodakāniaharniśaṃ śratijoyāṣṇautā vāniṣevaṇātvṛddhānprayatnādvaṃdetaneṣāṃdadyāt khamāsanaṃśrutibhūdevadevānāṃ nṛpasādhutayasvināṃnamanuṣyastutiṃ kusyātrātmānaṃ vahumānayetadharmānsevate pūrvaviṣūnavisarjayanuddhṛtyaṃ paṃcamṛtpiṃḍātsāyātyarajalāśayekuśrāddhayāṃ pātrabhūtāyatkiṃcidīyatevasuācāryadānaleśasyakulāṃ nāṃhīti ṣoḍaśīṃsvargerṇautāvubhausyātāṃya tato śraddhayā svadhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣaretkīrtanatodānamāyurviprāvamānataḥmaṇimālyagṛhaṃdhānyaṃ grāhyametadupasthitaḥabhyudyatāni grāhyāṇi cetānyapinigṛṣṭātaḥmādhyasyamāśrayeddedīsutevidyagnisṛḥjya caavaśyaṃ gṛhiṇīkāryamācāyecaraṇārcanaṃekana tanmanāmuktirnaranārāyaṇāśramejanmanāmuktirācāryacaraṇarcanātsadācāra paro nityaṃ misamācāryasevakaḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarīṃ japtvā sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavetyamākarṇya narodhīmānmuṃcatyajñānajataṃmaḥyaṃ śrutvopi narohīmānmucyateyāyarāśibhiḥtatra puṇyaṃ bhavedviprasmṛtivartmanānubhājanātkalikālādvapi sadāchidraṃ prāthajighāṃsataḥkalikālāhapi hato brāhmaṇe raṃdhradarśanātatadrarataḥ parityajya naro na nirayī bhavetadauvapitryaṃ palalamavatsāṇoya yasyajetvayavekaśaphaṃdvepatakramerakamāvikaṃāyuṣkāmaiḥ svargakāmaiḥstyājyaṃ māṃsaṃ prayatnataḥtyajetyaryuṣitaṃ sarvamakhaṃḍasnehanirmitakālyamitthaṃ yalaṃ bhakṣayanna ca doṣabhākyādaśāṃbhavatīpratyalaulyānmāṃsoyajñevinaḥnighrannahiṃsakoviprastāsāmapiśubhagatiḥatra hi sātha hiṃsāsyādviṃsānyatra sudastarādarācārasyatastheha nāmatrāpi sukhāṃ kvacitupakartāghātapitāhiṃsakā aṣṭadhā smṛtāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00521 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṃmāsabhakṣako yastu dvitīyotra viśiṣyatesukhaduḥkhāni tulyāni yathātmrani tathāpareyakvātaṃ hi punaḥ yaścitsārvamātmanisarbhavetkriyāṃ kriyāhīne kuto dharmo dharmahīne kutaḥ sukhaṃtasmāddhermotrakartavyaścāturvaṇe na yatnataḥdānaṃ ca vidhinādeyaṃ kāleyātrevamāvataḥna kevalaṃ hi dhāti śeṣaṃ tasya ca naśyatitadakṣaṃya bhavedatra yaratra ca na saṃśayaḥgrahaṇādiṣu kāleṣu yodhvādādārādhṛtavarṣyaśanamitaṃ taddravyaṃ śataniṣkamudāhṛtaṃācāryacaraṇāṃbhoje varṣāśanamitaṃ dhanaṃtulāpuruṣamukhyāni mahādānāni bhūriśaḥpitṛvaśyaśataiyukto mātarvaśya śatairapimātāpitṛvihīnaye maujīpāṇi grahādibhiḥbrāhmaṇāyadaridrāyapāṇigrahamitaṃdhanaṃnāgnihotrairnatarccaiyonāgniṣṇomādibhirmakhaiḥpittagehepiyākanyārataḥ paśya sasaṃskṛnāyastāpariṇayenmohāt sabhavedvaṣalopatiḥvijñāpya doṣabhayoḥ kanyāyāśca varasya castriyaḥ pavitrāḥ satataṃ naitādaṣyaṃtī kutravitkalyāṇavāṇīṃ gaṃdharvastenamedhyāssadāstriyaḥśrutodbhavettugaṃdharvāstalyāge ca pradīyatepitaghnāvikṛtarajāsratastāṃ parivarjayetanyathā tatphaladātuḥ pratigrāhīya tatyadhaḥdevabhuktāṃ dadadātā na svargamadhigacchati

sanskrit: yajñeyātrāṇi sarvāsinaduṣyaṃti vudhāḥ kvacitnāryorati prayogeṣyaśghrāmṛgagrahaṇeśuciḥbrāhmaṇāh yādato medhyāḥ striyomedhyāśca sarvataḥnatyātyādūṣitānārīnārupāgonavidhīyatesaṃśuddhārajasānāryastaṭinīvegataḥ śuciḥsomayāsasaukhyānibhuṃjecātrīpikīrtibhākkanyāpradaḥ prarvanāśe prakṛtisthaḥ paraḥ paraḥgamyaṃ tvabhāvedātaṇāṃ kanyākuryāt svayaṃvaraṃparibhūtāmadhaḥ śayyāṃ vāsayedhabhicāriṇīgarbhabhartavadhādau ca bhakṣatyapicayātakegattiṃ utyādyaputraṃ śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇyādevahīyatedevāghāstanavāśraṃti sa vahva ca svārgaṃ na gacchatikṛtyābhirnihatānīvayaśyeyuṣmānyaṃ saṃśayaḥbhūtikāmaitaraitityaṃ saṃkaṭeṣūtkaṭeṣu caramaṃtevatāstatra tatrasyuḥ saphalāḥ kriyāḥācāryapatnī saṃpūjyā viśeṣādbhārgavedinetāṭaṃkahemaciṃtākavālī yugmādibhūṣaṇaiḥvimuktaḥ sakalāyabhṇedustarātsaṃkaṭādapiyatra tuṣyati bhartrā strīyayābhartācatuṣyatitayo hato hato hato homaḥ prahutobhautikovaliḥpaṃcayajñānimānkurvanbrāhmaṇonāsīdatibrāhmāṇaṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchedvāhujātamanāmayaṃjātamātraḥ śiśrustāvadhāvadaṣṭau samāḥ smṛtāḥbharaṇaṃ yoṣyavargasya dṛṣṭādaṣṭaphalodayaṃācāryaḥ svayittāmātvapasāni samāśritāḥ

sanskrit: sajīvati yumānyatraivahnibhiścīyajīvyatedo nānāḥtha viśiṣṭebhyo dātavyaṃ bhūti kāmyayāvibhāgaśīlasaṃyuktodayāvoṃśca kṣamānvitaḥśarvarāmadhyamauyāmauhutaśeṣaṃ ca yaddhaviḥnavaitāni gṛhasthena kāyorāyabhyāgateguroabhyutthānamihāyātasastehaṃ pūrvabhāṣaṇaṃtathaivavyayayuktāni kāryāṇyetāminaivaśayyātṛṇajalābhyaṃgadivāgārhasthāsiddhidāḥpaiśūnyaṃ yaradārāścadrohaḥ krodhānṛtāpriyaḥnavāśyakakarmāṇi kāryāṇi prativāsaraṃvaiśca devaṃ tathātithyaṃ navamaṃ pitṛtarpaṇaṃjanmarkṣamaithunaṃ maṃtrīgṛhachidra ca vanaṃnavaitāni prakāśyānirahaḥ pāpamakutsitaṃkanyādānaṃ guṇotvā ṣonānyatkenāpi kutracitmātāpitṛgṛruṣvevanavakaṃdatamakṣayakuvaidyekitave dhūrte śaṭhe malle ca vaṃdiṣuputreṣu sātsasarvasvaṃdārāśca śaraṇāgatāḥyo dadāti sabhūḍhātmā prāpraśritairviśūdhyatideyaṃ ca viśvavidyāgenānyatkasmāpi kutracitanyati navakaṃ vacmi sarveṣāṃ svargamārgadaṃusteyamiṃdriyākrodhassarveṣodharmasādhanaṃsatāmabhimatāṃ puṇyaṃ gṛhasthonāvasīdatiyasyaitaivinayāḍhyāśca tasya sarvatra gauravaṃsyāyonyagṛhavāsaścanārīṇāṃ dūṣaṇānī ṣaṭsavārdhuṣika ityuktassarvakarmavahicchrutaḥ
